question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Choose the correct articles: 'He is _____ most talented artist in _____ university.'
explanation_en: Superlative adjectives ('most talented') strictly demand the definite article 'the'. The specific recognized institution also takes 'the'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] सही आर्टिकल का चयन करें: 'She holds a master's degree from _____ European university.'
optionA_hi: a ('यू' / yoo की व्यंजन ध्वनि होने के कारण 'a' लगेगा)
explanation_hi: 'A' और 'An' का प्रयोग उच्चारण की ध्वनि पर निर्भर करता है। 'European' शब्द 'E' से शुरू होने पर भी 'यू' (व्यंजन ध्वनि) से बोला जाता है, अतः 'a European' सही है।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Select the correct article: 'She holds a master's degree from _____ European university.'
explanation_en: Phonetic rule: Articles depend on initial phonetic SOUND, not the written letter. 'European' begins with the consonant sound /j/ ('yoo'), so the indefinite article 'A' is used (a European, a university, a one-rupee coin).
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] अगणनीय संज्ञा (Uncountable Nouns) के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionA_hi: All the furniture in the conference hall was imported. (furniture का बहुवचन furnitures नहीं होता)
optionC_hi: A furniture in the hall was imported. (गलत)
explanation_hi: Furniture, scenery, information, luggage, advice आदि uncountable nouns हैं। इनमें 's' लगाकर बहुवचन नहीं बनाया जाता और इनके साथ एकवचन क्रिया आती है।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Spot the grammatically sound statement regarding uncountable nouns:
optionA_en: All the furniture in the conference hall was imported.
optionC_en: A furniture in the hall was imported.
optionD_en: All the furnitures in the conference hall were imported.
explanation_en: Nouns like 'furniture', 'information', 'scenery', 'advice', 'luggage', 'baggage', 'poetry', and 'machinery' are strictly uncountable. They never take plural 's/es' or plural verbs.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] उचित क्रिया चुनें: 'The jury _____ divided in their opinions regarding the verdict.'
optionA_hi: were (मतभेद होने पर Collective Noun बहुवचन की तरह व्यवहार करता है)
explanation_hi: जब किसी समूहवाचक संज्ञा (Jury, Committee, Team) के सदस्यों में मतभेद (divided) हो, तो क्रिया और सर्वनाम दोनों बहुवचन (were / their) आते हैं।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Select the correct verb: 'The jury _____ divided in their opinions regarding the verdict.'
explanation_en: When a collective noun (jury, committee, team) is divided in opinion or individuals act separately ('in their opinions'), it takes a PLURAL verb ('were') and plural pronoun ('their').
examTag: NDA English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] सही वाक्य संरचना चुनें: 'Seldom _____ such an astonishing natural spectacle.'
optionA_hi: have I witnessed (नकारात्मक क्रियाविशेषण से शुरू होने पर Inversion नियम)
explanation_hi: Inversion नियम: जब वाक्य 'Seldom', 'Never', 'Rarely', 'Barely' जैसे नकारात्मक शब्दों से आरंभ होता है, तो कर्ता से पहले सहायक क्रिया (Auxiliary verb) आती है।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Choose the correct inverted clause: 'Seldom _____ such an astonishing natural spectacle.'
explanation_en: Negative Adverb Inversion: When a sentence begins with negative or restrictive adverbs (Seldom, Rarely, Never, Little, Scarcely), inverted word order (Auxiliary verb + Subject + Main verb) is mandatory.
examTag: State PCS General English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The number of applicants registering for the civil services examination _____ increased dramatically.'
optionD_hi: has ('The number of' के साथ एकवचन क्रिया)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'The number of' एक निश्चित संख्या दर्शाता है अतः इसके साथ Singular Verb ('has') आती है; जबकि 'A number of' के साथ Plural Verb ('have') आती है।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Fill in the blank: 'The number of applicants registering for the civil services examination _____ increased dramatically.'
explanation_en: Formula: 'THE number of + Plural Noun + SINGULAR VERB' (denotes a single definite count). In contrast, 'A number of + Plural Noun + PLURAL VERB' (denotes many). Here, 'has' is correct.
examTag: Bank SO English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] सही संबंधसूचक अव्यय चुनें: 'Death before dishonour is preferable _____ a life of shame.'
optionC_hi: to (Prefer, Preferable के साथ सदैव to आता है)
explanation_hi: Prefer, Preferable, Senior, Junior, Superior आदि लैटिन तुलनात्मक शब्दों के बाद 'than' का प्रयोग वर्जित है; इनके साथ हमेशा 'to' आता है।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Select the correct preposition: 'Death before dishonour is preferable _____ a life of shame.'
explanation_en: Adjectives and verbs of preference ('prefer', 'preferable', 'prior', 'senior', 'junior', 'superior', 'inferior') are followed by the preposition 'TO', never 'than'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] व्याकरणिक त्रुटि सुधारें: 'Myself Dr. Rajesh, and I am the chief medical officer.'
optionD_hi: I am Dr. Rajesh (Reflexive Pronoun कभी वाक्य का कर्ता नहीं बन सकता)
explanation_hi: Reflexive Pronoun (Myself, Himself) का प्रयोग कभी भी सीधे वाक्य के कर्ता (Subject) के रूप में अपना परिचय देने के लिए नहीं किया जा सकता। 'I am...' कहना शुद्ध है।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Correct the underlined error: 'Myself Dr. Rajesh, and I am the chief medical officer.'
explanation_en: A reflexive pronoun ('myself', 'himself', 'yourself') cannot function as the grammatical subject of a sentence without a preceding subject noun or personal pronoun. 'I am Dr. Rajesh' is correct.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] बिना किसी व्याकरणिक दोष वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: Walking in garden, stinging me was a bee.
optionB_hi: Walking through the botanical garden, a bee stung me. (Dangling Modifier दोष)
optionC_hi: While walking through the garden, a bee was stinging me.
optionD_hi: Walking through the botanical garden, I was stung by a bee. (कर्ता I टहल रहा था)
explanation_hi: पार्टिसिपल वाक्यांश (Walking through...) का संबंध तुरंत आने वाले मुख्य कर्ता से होना चाहिए। मधुमक्खी टहल नहीं रही थी, बल्कि व्यक्ति टहल रहा था।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Choose the sentence free of dangling modifier errors:
optionA_en: Walking in garden, stinging me was a bee.
optionB_en: Walking through the botanical garden, a bee stung me.
optionC_en: While walking through the garden, a bee was stinging me.
optionD_en: Walking through the botanical garden, I was stung by a bee.
explanation_en: A participle phrase must modify the logical subject immediately following the comma. In sentence B, 'Walking through the garden' illogically modifies 'a bee' (meaning the bee was walking). Sentence A is correct.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'You will not succeed in clearing the exam _____ you study with consistent discipline.'
optionC_hi: unless (शर्त/Condition दर्शाने के लिए unless का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: 'Unless' शर्त (Condition) दर्शाता है ('जब तक कि... नहीं'), जबकि 'Until' समय सीमा (Time) दर्शाता है। यहां नियमित पढ़ाई एक शर्त है, अतः 'unless' आएगा।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Fill in the blank: 'You will not succeed in clearing the exam _____ you study with consistent discipline.'
explanation_en: 'Unless' is condition-oriented (meaning 'if not'), while 'Until' is time-oriented (meaning 'up to the time when'). Here, studying consistently is a condition, so 'unless' is correct.
examTag: SSC CPO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] उचित क्रिया चुनें: 'The first innings of the cricket test match _____ interrupted by persistent rain.'
optionB_hi: was (Innings दिखने में बहुवचन है किंतु अर्थ में एकवचन)
explanation_hi: Innings, News, Mathematics, Physics आदि संज्ञाएं देखने में बहुवचन लगती हैं किंतु अर्थ में एकवचन होती हैं, अतः इनके साथ 'was' लगेगा।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Choose the correct verb: 'The first innings of the cricket test match _____ interrupted by persistent rain.'
explanation_en: Nouns like 'innings', 'news', 'mathematics', 'physics', 'politics', and 'measles' end in 's' but are grammatically singular and take singular verbs.
examTag: IBPS PO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] वाक्य पूरा करें: 'It is high time we _____ decisive action against environmental pollution.'
optionB_hi: took ('It is high time' के बाद Simple Past Tense / V2 आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'It is high time' या 'It is time' के बाद यदि कर्ता (Subject) आए, तो क्रिया का भूतकालिक रूप (Past Indefinite / V2) आता है।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Complete the sentence: 'It is high time we _____ decisive action against environmental pollution.'
explanation_en: Idiomatic grammar rule: Phrases like 'It is time', 'It is high time', and 'It is about time' followed by a subject strictly require the Subjunctive Past tense (V2 verb). Hence, 'took' is correct.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The old philosopher was _____ feeble to undertake such a arduous expedition.'
optionD_hi: too ('too...to' नकारात्मक अर्थ में अत्यधिक कमजोरी दर्शाता है)
explanation_hi: 'Too... to' संरचना नकारात्मक अर्थ देती है (इतने दुर्बल कि यात्रा नहीं कर सकते थे)।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Fill in the blank: 'The old philosopher was _____ feeble to undertake such a arduous expedition.'
explanation_en: The correlative pair 'TOO + adjective + TO + verb' conveys a negative implication ('so feeble that he could not undertake').
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] सकारात्मक कार्य हेतु सर्वनामों का सही क्रम (231 नियम) चुनें:
optionA_hi: I, you, and he have completed the assignment.
optionB_hi: You, he, and I have completed the assignment successfully. (2nd, 3rd, 1st Person नियम)
optionC_hi: He, you, and I have completed the assignment.
optionD_hi: You, I, and he have completed the assignment.
explanation_hi: सभ्यता और व्याकरण का 231 नियम: सामान्य वाक्यों में पहले 2nd Person (You), फिर 3rd Person (He), और अंत में 1st Person (I) आता है।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Select the grammatically correct sequence of pronouns for a positive action:
optionA_en: I, you, and he have completed the assignment.
optionB_en: You, he, and I have completed the assignment successfully.
optionC_en: He, you, and I have completed the assignment.
optionD_en: You, I, and he have completed the assignment.
explanation_en: General Etiquette Rule (231): When multiple singular personal pronouns appear together for a positive or neutral act, the order must be Second Person (You), Third Person (He/She), and First Person (I).
examTag: NDA English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'My father objected to _____ joining the international sailing academy.'
optionB_hi: my (Gerund / -ing क्रिया से पूर्व Possessive Adjective आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Gerund (v1 + ing) से ठीक पहले हमेशा Possessive case ('my', 'his', 'her') का प्रयोग होता है, Objective case ('me', 'him') का नहीं।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Fill in the blank: 'My father objected to _____ joining the international sailing academy.'
explanation_en: A noun or pronoun preceding a gerund (verb acting as noun, 'joining') must be in the POSSESSIVE case ('my joining', 'his going', 'their coming').
examTag: State PCS General English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] उचित शब्द चुनें: 'Scarcely had the keynote speaker stepped off the stage _____ the thunderous applause erupted.'
optionD_hi: when (Scarcely had के साथ when का संयोजन)
explanation_hi: 'Scarcely had' के बाद दूसरा उपवाक्य हमेशा 'when' से जुड़ता है।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Identify the correct clause structure: 'Scarcely had the keynote speaker stepped off the stage _____ the thunderous applause erupted.'
explanation_en: Correlative standard: 'Scarcely had + Subject + V3 ... WHEN'. Using 'than' here is a classic examination trap.
examTag: Bank SO English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] सही क्रिया चुनें: 'More than one candidate _____ disqualified for violating code of conduct.'
optionD_hi: was ('More than one' के बाद संज्ञा व क्रिया दोनों एकवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'More than one' के बाद संज्ञा और क्रिया दोनों एकवचन (candidate was) आते हैं।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Choose the correct verb: 'More than one candidate _____ disqualified for violating code of conduct.'
explanation_en: Grammar Rule: 'More than one + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('More than one candidate was...'). However, 'More candidates than one were...' takes plural.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] वाक्य में अतिरेक (Redundancy) दोष पहचानें:
optionA_hi: 'How will we' का क्रम गलत है
optionC_hi: 'Supposing' और 'if' दोनों एक साथ प्रयुक्त नहीं होते; केवल एक का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: 'Supposing' और 'if' दोनों का अर्थ शर्त लगाना है। दोनों का एक साथ प्रयोग पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous error) है।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Identify the redundancy in: 'Supposing if the train gets cancelled, how will we reach the summit?'
optionC_en: 'Supposing' and 'if' should never be used together; use either 'Supposing' OR 'If'
explanation_en: 'Supposing' and 'if' both introduce conditional suppositions. Using both together ('supposing if') is a superfluous tautology. Use either 'Supposing the train...' or 'If the train...'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [शर्तसूचक वाक्य एवं इनवर्जन नियम] सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'The strict teacher made all the delinquent students _____ the entire chapter thrice.'
optionA_hi: rewrite (Causative verb 'make' के बाद Bare Infinitive / बिना to की क्रिया)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Make' का प्रयोग Causative verb (प्रेरणार्थक क्रिया) के रूप में Active voice में हो, तो इसके बाद Bare Infinitive (बिना 'to' के मूल क्रिया V1) आता है।
question_en: [Conditional Clauses & Inversion Rules] Select the correct verb form: 'The strict teacher made all the delinquent students _____ the entire chapter thrice.'
explanation_en: Causative verbs like 'make', 'let', and 'bid' in active voice take a BARE INFINITIVE (base verb without 'to'). Hence, 'made them rewrite' is grammatically correct.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: सही क्रिया का चयन कीजिए: 'Neither the manager nor the employees _____ present at the emergency briefing.'
explanation_hi: निकटता का नियम (Rule of Proximity): जब दो कर्ता 'neither...nor' या 'either...or' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया हमेशा अपने सबसे नजदीकी कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। यहां रिक्त स्थान के सबसे निकट 'employees' (बहुवचन) है, अतः 'were' सही है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Select the grammatically correct verb: 'Neither the manager nor the employees _____ present at the emergency briefing.'
explanation_en: Rule of Proximity: When two subjects are connected by 'either...or' or 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'employees' (plural) is closest to the blank, so plural verb 'were' is correct.
examTag: IBPS PO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें: 'The captain, along with all his crew members, _____ rescued from the sinking vessel.'
optionB_hi: was (प्रथम कर्ता The captain के अनुसार एकवचन)
explanation_hi: जब दो कर्ता 'along with', 'as well as', 'together with' आदि से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया हमेशा प्रथम कर्ता (First Subject) के अनुसार आती है। 'The captain' एकवचन (singular) है, इसलिए 'was' लगेगा।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Fill in the blank: 'The captain, along with all his crew members, _____ rescued from the sinking vessel.'
explanation_en: When two subjects are joined by 'along with', 'as well as', 'together with', 'in addition to', or 'accompanied by', the verb strictly agrees with the FIRST subject. The captain (singular) takes 'was'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: सही विकल्प चुनें: 'One of the most famous tourist destinations in India _____ the Taj Mahal.'
optionC_hi: is (One of the के बाद संज्ञा बहुवचन किंतु क्रिया एकवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb'। यहां 'destinations' बहुवचन है किंतु वाक्य का मुख्य कर्ता 'One' (एकवचन) है, अतः क्रिया 'is' होगी।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Identify the correct completion: 'One of the most famous tourist destinations in India _____ the Taj Mahal.'
explanation_en: Structure: 'One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb'. The subject of the sentence is the pronoun 'One' (singular), which governs the singular verb 'is'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: शर्तसूचक वाक्य को पूरा करें: 'If you had warned me about the heavy traffic, I _____ earlier.'
optionC_hi: would have started (भूतकाल की अधूरी शर्त का नियम)
explanation_hi: तृतीय शर्त (Third Conditional): यदि 'If' उपवाक्य में 'had + V3' (Past Perfect) हो, तो मुख्य उपवाक्य में 'would have + V3' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Complete the conditional sentence: 'If you had warned me about the heavy traffic, I _____ earlier.'
explanation_en: Third Conditional (unfulfilled past condition): 'If + Past Perfect (had + V3) ... Main clause: Subject + would have + V3'. Hence, 'would have started' is mandatory.
examTag: NDA English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: काल्पनिक वाक्य हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'If I _____ the Prime Minister, I would ensure free healthcare for all.'
optionA_hi: were (काल्पनिक/अवास्तविक स्थिति में सभी कर्ताओं के साथ were)
explanation_hi: काल्पनिक या असंभव शर्त (Subjunctive Mood) में 'I', 'He', 'She' आदि एकवचन कर्ताओं के साथ भी 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' का ही प्रयोग किया जाता है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Choose the correct hypothetical structure: 'If I _____ the Prime Minister, I would ensure free healthcare for all.'
explanation_en: Subjunctive mood: In unreal, imaginary, or hypothetical conditions ('If I were...'), the plural past subjunctive 'were' is used for all persons and singular pronouns.
examTag: State PCS General English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: उचित समुच्चयबोधक भरें: 'Hardly had the train arrived at the platform _____ the passengers rushed to board it.'
optionB_hi: when (Hardly/Scarcely के साथ सदैव when आता है)
explanation_hi: सहसंबंधी नियम: 'Hardly' और 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का जोड़ा बनता है, कभी भी 'than' या 'then' नहीं आता।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Fill in the appropriate conjunction: 'Hardly had the train arrived at the platform _____ the passengers rushed to board it.'
explanation_en: Correlative conjunction pair rule: 'Hardly / Scarcely + had + Subject + V3 ... WHEN + Subject + V2'. 'Than' is used exclusively with 'No sooner'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'No sooner did the thief see the police officer _____ he took to his heels.'
optionB_hi: than (No sooner के साथ तुलनात्मक Than का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'No sooner' के साथ सदैव 'than' (t-h-a-n) का प्रयोग होता है। परीक्षा में अक्सर 'then' या 'when' देकर त्रुटि पूछी जाती है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Fill in the blank: 'No sooner did the thief see the police officer _____ he took to his heels.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'No sooner' is a comparative adverbial construction that always pairs with 'THAN' (not then, when, or that). Inversion is applied in the first clause.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: 'Lest' के साथ आने वाली उचित सहायक क्रिया चुनें: 'Walk carefully lest you _____ stumble and fall.'
optionC_hi: should (Lest के साथ अनिवार्य रूप से should आता है)
explanation_hi: 'Lest' का अर्थ होता है 'कहीं ऐसा न हो कि'। व्याकरण के नियमानुसार 'lest' के बाद केवल 'should' का प्रयोग होता है और इसके साथ 'not' कभी नहीं आता।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Identify the modal that correctly pairs with 'lest': 'Walk carefully lest you _____ stumble and fall.'
explanation_en: 'Lest' means 'for fear that' or 'so that... not'. Grammatically, 'lest' is strictly followed by the modal auxiliary 'SHOULD' (or bare subjunctive). Furthermore, negative words like 'not' are never used after lest.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: सही सर्वनाम चुनें: 'Each of the participants must submit _____ project proposal by Friday.'
optionC_hi: his or her (Each के लिए एकवचन possessive pronoun)
explanation_hi: 'Each', 'Every', 'Either' व्याकरणिक रूप से एकवचन (singular) होते हैं। अतः इनके लिए possessive pronoun भी एकवचन 'his' या 'his or her' आता है, 'their' नहीं।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Select the correct pronoun: 'Each of the participants must submit _____ project proposal by Friday.'
explanation_en: Indefinite distributive pronouns 'each', 'either', and 'every' are grammatically singular and require singular possessive adjectives ('his/her', not plural 'their').
examTag: SSC CHSL - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: उचित संबंधवाचक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The woman _____ the committee selected as chairperson has extensive international experience.'
optionB_hi: whom (कर्म/Object के रूप में whom का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: 'Who' कर्ता (Subject) के लिए आता है, जबकि 'Whom' कर्म (Object) के लिए आता है। समिति ने 'उन्हें' चुना (कर्म), अतः 'whom' सही है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Choose the correct relative pronoun: 'The woman _____ the committee selected as chairperson has extensive international experience.'
explanation_en: 'Who' functions as a grammatical subject (he/she), while 'Whom' functions as a grammatical object (him/her). The committee selected HER (object), so 'whom' is required.
examTag: SSC CPO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Dr. Sharma has been researching renewable energy solutions _____ 2015.'
optionC_hi: since (निश्चित समय/Point of Time हेतु since)
explanation_hi: निश्चित समय (Point of Time जैसे 2015, सुबह, सोमवार) के लिए 'since' का प्रयोग होता है; समयावधि (Period of Time जैसे 5 वर्ष, 2 घंटे) के लिए 'for' आता है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Fill in the blank: 'Dr. Sharma has been researching renewable energy solutions _____ 2015.'
explanation_en: In Present Perfect Continuous tense, 'SINCE' is used with a specific point in time (2015, Monday, 5 AM), whereas 'FOR' is used for a duration/period of time (for 10 years).
examTag: IBPS PO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: सही उपपद (Articles) चुनें: 'He is _____ most talented artist in _____ university.'
optionD_hi: the, the (Superlative डिग्री के पूर्व the तथा निश्चित संस्था हेतु the)
explanation_hi: सुपरलेटिव डिग्री (Superlative Degree जैसे most talented, highest) के पहले हमेशा 'the' आता है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Choose the correct articles: 'He is _____ most talented artist in _____ university.'
explanation_en: Superlative adjectives ('most talented') strictly demand the definite article 'the'. The specific recognized institution also takes 'the'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: सही आर्टिकल का चयन करें: 'She holds a master's degree from _____ European university.'
optionD_hi: a ('यू' / yoo की व्यंजन ध्वनि होने के कारण 'a' लगेगा)
explanation_hi: 'A' और 'An' का प्रयोग उच्चारण की ध्वनि पर निर्भर करता है। 'European' शब्द 'E' से शुरू होने पर भी 'यू' (व्यंजन ध्वनि) से बोला जाता है, अतः 'a European' सही है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Select the correct article: 'She holds a master's degree from _____ European university.'
explanation_en: Phonetic rule: Articles depend on initial phonetic SOUND, not the written letter. 'European' begins with the consonant sound /j/ ('yoo'), so the indefinite article 'A' is used (a European, a university, a one-rupee coin).
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: अगणनीय संज्ञा (Uncountable Nouns) के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionA_hi: A furniture in the hall was imported. (गलत)
optionC_hi: All the furniture in the conference hall was imported. (furniture का बहुवचन furnitures नहीं होता)
explanation_hi: Furniture, scenery, information, luggage, advice आदि uncountable nouns हैं। इनमें 's' लगाकर बहुवचन नहीं बनाया जाता और इनके साथ एकवचन क्रिया आती है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Spot the grammatically sound statement regarding uncountable nouns:
optionA_en: A furniture in the hall was imported.
optionC_en: All the furniture in the conference hall was imported.
optionD_en: All the furnitures in the conference hall were imported.
explanation_en: Nouns like 'furniture', 'information', 'scenery', 'advice', 'luggage', 'baggage', 'poetry', and 'machinery' are strictly uncountable. They never take plural 's/es' or plural verbs.
examTag: NDA English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: उचित क्रिया चुनें: 'The jury _____ divided in their opinions regarding the verdict.'
optionA_hi: were (मतभेद होने पर Collective Noun बहुवचन की तरह व्यवहार करता है)
explanation_hi: जब किसी समूहवाचक संज्ञा (Jury, Committee, Team) के सदस्यों में मतभेद (divided) हो, तो क्रिया और सर्वनाम दोनों बहुवचन (were / their) आते हैं।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Select the correct verb: 'The jury _____ divided in their opinions regarding the verdict.'
explanation_en: When a collective noun (jury, committee, team) is divided in opinion or individuals act separately ('in their opinions'), it takes a PLURAL verb ('were') and plural pronoun ('their').
examTag: State PCS General English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: सही वाक्य संरचना चुनें: 'Seldom _____ such an astonishing natural spectacle.'
optionC_hi: have I witnessed (नकारात्मक क्रियाविशेषण से शुरू होने पर Inversion नियम)
explanation_hi: Inversion नियम: जब वाक्य 'Seldom', 'Never', 'Rarely', 'Barely' जैसे नकारात्मक शब्दों से आरंभ होता है, तो कर्ता से पहले सहायक क्रिया (Auxiliary verb) आती है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Choose the correct inverted clause: 'Seldom _____ such an astonishing natural spectacle.'
explanation_en: Negative Adverb Inversion: When a sentence begins with negative or restrictive adverbs (Seldom, Rarely, Never, Little, Scarcely), inverted word order (Auxiliary verb + Subject + Main verb) is mandatory.
examTag: Bank SO English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The number of applicants registering for the civil services examination _____ increased dramatically.'
optionD_hi: has ('The number of' के साथ एकवचन क्रिया)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'The number of' एक निश्चित संख्या दर्शाता है अतः इसके साथ Singular Verb ('has') आती है; जबकि 'A number of' के साथ Plural Verb ('have') आती है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Fill in the blank: 'The number of applicants registering for the civil services examination _____ increased dramatically.'
explanation_en: Formula: 'THE number of + Plural Noun + SINGULAR VERB' (denotes a single definite count). In contrast, 'A number of + Plural Noun + PLURAL VERB' (denotes many). Here, 'has' is correct.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: सही संबंधसूचक अव्यय चुनें: 'Death before dishonour is preferable _____ a life of shame.'
optionD_hi: to (Prefer, Preferable के साथ सदैव to आता है)
explanation_hi: Prefer, Preferable, Senior, Junior, Superior आदि लैटिन तुलनात्मक शब्दों के बाद 'than' का प्रयोग वर्जित है; इनके साथ हमेशा 'to' आता है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Select the correct preposition: 'Death before dishonour is preferable _____ a life of shame.'
explanation_en: Adjectives and verbs of preference ('prefer', 'preferable', 'prior', 'senior', 'junior', 'superior', 'inferior') are followed by the preposition 'TO', never 'than'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: व्याकरणिक त्रुटि सुधारें: 'Myself Dr. Rajesh, and I am the chief medical officer.'
optionB_hi: I am Dr. Rajesh (Reflexive Pronoun कभी वाक्य का कर्ता नहीं बन सकता)
explanation_hi: Reflexive Pronoun (Myself, Himself) का प्रयोग कभी भी सीधे वाक्य के कर्ता (Subject) के रूप में अपना परिचय देने के लिए नहीं किया जा सकता। 'I am...' कहना शुद्ध है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Correct the underlined error: 'Myself Dr. Rajesh, and I am the chief medical officer.'
explanation_en: A reflexive pronoun ('myself', 'himself', 'yourself') cannot function as the grammatical subject of a sentence without a preceding subject noun or personal pronoun. 'I am Dr. Rajesh' is correct.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: बिना किसी व्याकरणिक दोष वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: Walking in garden, stinging me was a bee.
optionB_hi: Walking through the botanical garden, a bee stung me. (Dangling Modifier दोष)
optionC_hi: Walking through the botanical garden, I was stung by a bee. (कर्ता I टहल रहा था)
optionD_hi: While walking through the garden, a bee was stinging me.
explanation_hi: पार्टिसिपल वाक्यांश (Walking through...) का संबंध तुरंत आने वाले मुख्य कर्ता से होना चाहिए। मधुमक्खी टहल नहीं रही थी, बल्कि व्यक्ति टहल रहा था।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Choose the sentence free of dangling modifier errors:
optionA_en: Walking in garden, stinging me was a bee.
optionB_en: Walking through the botanical garden, a bee stung me.
optionC_en: Walking through the botanical garden, I was stung by a bee.
optionD_en: While walking through the garden, a bee was stinging me.
explanation_en: A participle phrase must modify the logical subject immediately following the comma. In sentence B, 'Walking through the garden' illogically modifies 'a bee' (meaning the bee was walking). Sentence A is correct.
examTag: SSC CPO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'You will not succeed in clearing the exam _____ you study with consistent discipline.'
optionA_hi: unless (शर्त/Condition दर्शाने के लिए unless का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: 'Unless' शर्त (Condition) दर्शाता है ('जब तक कि... नहीं'), जबकि 'Until' समय सीमा (Time) दर्शाता है। यहां नियमित पढ़ाई एक शर्त है, अतः 'unless' आएगा।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Fill in the blank: 'You will not succeed in clearing the exam _____ you study with consistent discipline.'
explanation_en: 'Unless' is condition-oriented (meaning 'if not'), while 'Until' is time-oriented (meaning 'up to the time when'). Here, studying consistently is a condition, so 'unless' is correct.
examTag: IBPS PO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: उचित क्रिया चुनें: 'The first innings of the cricket test match _____ interrupted by persistent rain.'
optionD_hi: was (Innings दिखने में बहुवचन है किंतु अर्थ में एकवचन)
explanation_hi: Innings, News, Mathematics, Physics आदि संज्ञाएं देखने में बहुवचन लगती हैं किंतु अर्थ में एकवचन होती हैं, अतः इनके साथ 'was' लगेगा।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Choose the correct verb: 'The first innings of the cricket test match _____ interrupted by persistent rain.'
explanation_en: Nouns like 'innings', 'news', 'mathematics', 'physics', 'politics', and 'measles' end in 's' but are grammatically singular and take singular verbs.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: वाक्य पूरा करें: 'It is high time we _____ decisive action against environmental pollution.'
optionD_hi: took ('It is high time' के बाद Simple Past Tense / V2 आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'It is high time' या 'It is time' के बाद यदि कर्ता (Subject) आए, तो क्रिया का भूतकालिक रूप (Past Indefinite / V2) आता है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Complete the sentence: 'It is high time we _____ decisive action against environmental pollution.'
explanation_en: Idiomatic grammar rule: Phrases like 'It is time', 'It is high time', and 'It is about time' followed by a subject strictly require the Subjunctive Past tense (V2 verb). Hence, 'took' is correct.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The old philosopher was _____ feeble to undertake such a arduous expedition.'
optionB_hi: too ('too...to' नकारात्मक अर्थ में अत्यधिक कमजोरी दर्शाता है)
explanation_hi: 'Too... to' संरचना नकारात्मक अर्थ देती है (इतने दुर्बल कि यात्रा नहीं कर सकते थे)।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Fill in the blank: 'The old philosopher was _____ feeble to undertake such a arduous expedition.'
explanation_en: The correlative pair 'TOO + adjective + TO + verb' conveys a negative implication ('so feeble that he could not undertake').
examTag: NDA English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: सकारात्मक कार्य हेतु सर्वनामों का सही क्रम (231 नियम) चुनें:
optionA_hi: You, he, and I have completed the assignment successfully. (2nd, 3rd, 1st Person नियम)
optionB_hi: I, you, and he have completed the assignment.
optionC_hi: He, you, and I have completed the assignment.
optionD_hi: You, I, and he have completed the assignment.
explanation_hi: सभ्यता और व्याकरण का 231 नियम: सामान्य वाक्यों में पहले 2nd Person (You), फिर 3rd Person (He), और अंत में 1st Person (I) आता है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Select the grammatically correct sequence of pronouns for a positive action:
optionA_en: You, he, and I have completed the assignment successfully.
optionB_en: I, you, and he have completed the assignment.
optionC_en: He, you, and I have completed the assignment.
optionD_en: You, I, and he have completed the assignment.
explanation_en: General Etiquette Rule (231): When multiple singular personal pronouns appear together for a positive or neutral act, the order must be Second Person (You), Third Person (He/She), and First Person (I).
examTag: State PCS General English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'My father objected to _____ joining the international sailing academy.'
optionD_hi: my (Gerund / -ing क्रिया से पूर्व Possessive Adjective आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Gerund (v1 + ing) से ठीक पहले हमेशा Possessive case ('my', 'his', 'her') का प्रयोग होता है, Objective case ('me', 'him') का नहीं।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Fill in the blank: 'My father objected to _____ joining the international sailing academy.'
explanation_en: A noun or pronoun preceding a gerund (verb acting as noun, 'joining') must be in the POSSESSIVE case ('my joining', 'his going', 'their coming').
examTag: Bank SO English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: उचित शब्द चुनें: 'Scarcely had the keynote speaker stepped off the stage _____ the thunderous applause erupted.'
optionC_hi: when (Scarcely had के साथ when का संयोजन)
explanation_hi: 'Scarcely had' के बाद दूसरा उपवाक्य हमेशा 'when' से जुड़ता है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Identify the correct clause structure: 'Scarcely had the keynote speaker stepped off the stage _____ the thunderous applause erupted.'
explanation_en: Correlative standard: 'Scarcely had + Subject + V3 ... WHEN'. Using 'than' here is a classic examination trap.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: सही क्रिया चुनें: 'More than one candidate _____ disqualified for violating code of conduct.'
optionB_hi: was ('More than one' के बाद संज्ञा व क्रिया दोनों एकवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'More than one' के बाद संज्ञा और क्रिया दोनों एकवचन (candidate was) आते हैं।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Choose the correct verb: 'More than one candidate _____ disqualified for violating code of conduct.'
explanation_en: Grammar Rule: 'More than one + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('More than one candidate was...'). However, 'More candidates than one were...' takes plural.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: वाक्य में अतिरेक (Redundancy) दोष पहचानें:
optionA_hi: 'Supposing' और 'if' दोनों एक साथ प्रयुक्त नहीं होते; केवल एक का प्रयोग करें
optionB_hi: 'How will we' का क्रम गलत है
explanation_hi: 'Supposing' और 'if' दोनों का अर्थ शर्त लगाना है। दोनों का एक साथ प्रयोग पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous error) है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Identify the redundancy in: 'Supposing if the train gets cancelled, how will we reach the summit?'
optionA_en: 'Supposing' and 'if' should never be used together; use either 'Supposing' OR 'If'
explanation_en: 'Supposing' and 'if' both introduce conditional suppositions. Using both together ('supposing if') is a superfluous tautology. Use either 'Supposing the train...' or 'If the train...'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: प्रमुख व्याकरणिक नियम पर आधारित प्रश्न: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'The strict teacher made all the delinquent students _____ the entire chapter thrice.'
optionD_hi: rewrite (Causative verb 'make' के बाद Bare Infinitive / बिना to की क्रिया)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Make' का प्रयोग Causative verb (प्रेरणार्थक क्रिया) के रूप में Active voice में हो, तो इसके बाद Bare Infinitive (बिना 'to' के मूल क्रिया V1) आता है।
question_en: Identify the core grammatical principle: Select the correct verb form: 'The strict teacher made all the delinquent students _____ the entire chapter thrice.'
explanation_en: Causative verbs like 'make', 'let', and 'bid' in active voice take a BARE INFINITIVE (base verb without 'to'). Hence, 'made them rewrite' is grammatically correct.
examTag: SSC CPO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] सही क्रिया का चयन कीजिए: 'Neither the manager nor the employees _____ present at the emergency briefing.'
explanation_hi: निकटता का नियम (Rule of Proximity): जब दो कर्ता 'neither...nor' या 'either...or' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया हमेशा अपने सबसे नजदीकी कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। यहां रिक्त स्थान के सबसे निकट 'employees' (बहुवचन) है, अतः 'were' सही है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Select the grammatically correct verb: 'Neither the manager nor the employees _____ present at the emergency briefing.'
explanation_en: Rule of Proximity: When two subjects are connected by 'either...or' or 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'employees' (plural) is closest to the blank, so plural verb 'were' is correct.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें: 'The captain, along with all his crew members, _____ rescued from the sinking vessel.'
optionB_hi: was (प्रथम कर्ता The captain के अनुसार एकवचन)
explanation_hi: जब दो कर्ता 'along with', 'as well as', 'together with' आदि से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया हमेशा प्रथम कर्ता (First Subject) के अनुसार आती है। 'The captain' एकवचन (singular) है, इसलिए 'was' लगेगा।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Fill in the blank: 'The captain, along with all his crew members, _____ rescued from the sinking vessel.'
explanation_en: When two subjects are joined by 'along with', 'as well as', 'together with', 'in addition to', or 'accompanied by', the verb strictly agrees with the FIRST subject. The captain (singular) takes 'was'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] सही विकल्प चुनें: 'One of the most famous tourist destinations in India _____ the Taj Mahal.'
optionD_hi: is (One of the के बाद संज्ञा बहुवचन किंतु क्रिया एकवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb'। यहां 'destinations' बहुवचन है किंतु वाक्य का मुख्य कर्ता 'One' (एकवचन) है, अतः क्रिया 'is' होगी।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Identify the correct completion: 'One of the most famous tourist destinations in India _____ the Taj Mahal.'
explanation_en: Structure: 'One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb'. The subject of the sentence is the pronoun 'One' (singular), which governs the singular verb 'is'.
examTag: NDA English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] शर्तसूचक वाक्य को पूरा करें: 'If you had warned me about the heavy traffic, I _____ earlier.'
optionC_hi: would have started (भूतकाल की अधूरी शर्त का नियम)
explanation_hi: तृतीय शर्त (Third Conditional): यदि 'If' उपवाक्य में 'had + V3' (Past Perfect) हो, तो मुख्य उपवाक्य में 'would have + V3' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Complete the conditional sentence: 'If you had warned me about the heavy traffic, I _____ earlier.'
explanation_en: Third Conditional (unfulfilled past condition): 'If + Past Perfect (had + V3) ... Main clause: Subject + would have + V3'. Hence, 'would have started' is mandatory.
examTag: State PCS General English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] काल्पनिक वाक्य हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'If I _____ the Prime Minister, I would ensure free healthcare for all.'
optionD_hi: were (काल्पनिक/अवास्तविक स्थिति में सभी कर्ताओं के साथ were)
explanation_hi: काल्पनिक या असंभव शर्त (Subjunctive Mood) में 'I', 'He', 'She' आदि एकवचन कर्ताओं के साथ भी 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' का ही प्रयोग किया जाता है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Choose the correct hypothetical structure: 'If I _____ the Prime Minister, I would ensure free healthcare for all.'
explanation_en: Subjunctive mood: In unreal, imaginary, or hypothetical conditions ('If I were...'), the plural past subjunctive 'were' is used for all persons and singular pronouns.
examTag: Bank SO English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] उचित समुच्चयबोधक भरें: 'Hardly had the train arrived at the platform _____ the passengers rushed to board it.'
optionA_hi: when (Hardly/Scarcely के साथ सदैव when आता है)
explanation_hi: सहसंबंधी नियम: 'Hardly' और 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का जोड़ा बनता है, कभी भी 'than' या 'then' नहीं आता।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Fill in the appropriate conjunction: 'Hardly had the train arrived at the platform _____ the passengers rushed to board it.'
explanation_en: Correlative conjunction pair rule: 'Hardly / Scarcely + had + Subject + V3 ... WHEN + Subject + V2'. 'Than' is used exclusively with 'No sooner'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'No sooner did the thief see the police officer _____ he took to his heels.'
optionB_hi: than (No sooner के साथ तुलनात्मक Than का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'No sooner' के साथ सदैव 'than' (t-h-a-n) का प्रयोग होता है। परीक्षा में अक्सर 'then' या 'when' देकर त्रुटि पूछी जाती है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Fill in the blank: 'No sooner did the thief see the police officer _____ he took to his heels.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'No sooner' is a comparative adverbial construction that always pairs with 'THAN' (not then, when, or that). Inversion is applied in the first clause.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] 'Lest' के साथ आने वाली उचित सहायक क्रिया चुनें: 'Walk carefully lest you _____ stumble and fall.'
optionB_hi: should (Lest के साथ अनिवार्य रूप से should आता है)
explanation_hi: 'Lest' का अर्थ होता है 'कहीं ऐसा न हो कि'। व्याकरण के नियमानुसार 'lest' के बाद केवल 'should' का प्रयोग होता है और इसके साथ 'not' कभी नहीं आता।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Identify the modal that correctly pairs with 'lest': 'Walk carefully lest you _____ stumble and fall.'
explanation_en: 'Lest' means 'for fear that' or 'so that... not'. Grammatically, 'lest' is strictly followed by the modal auxiliary 'SHOULD' (or bare subjunctive). Furthermore, negative words like 'not' are never used after lest.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] सही सर्वनाम चुनें: 'Each of the participants must submit _____ project proposal by Friday.'
optionD_hi: his or her (Each के लिए एकवचन possessive pronoun)
explanation_hi: 'Each', 'Every', 'Either' व्याकरणिक रूप से एकवचन (singular) होते हैं। अतः इनके लिए possessive pronoun भी एकवचन 'his' या 'his or her' आता है, 'their' नहीं।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Select the correct pronoun: 'Each of the participants must submit _____ project proposal by Friday.'
explanation_en: Indefinite distributive pronouns 'each', 'either', and 'every' are grammatically singular and require singular possessive adjectives ('his/her', not plural 'their').
examTag: SSC CPO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] उचित संबंधवाचक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The woman _____ the committee selected as chairperson has extensive international experience.'
optionD_hi: whom (कर्म/Object के रूप में whom का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: 'Who' कर्ता (Subject) के लिए आता है, जबकि 'Whom' कर्म (Object) के लिए आता है। समिति ने 'उन्हें' चुना (कर्म), अतः 'whom' सही है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Choose the correct relative pronoun: 'The woman _____ the committee selected as chairperson has extensive international experience.'
explanation_en: 'Who' functions as a grammatical subject (he/she), while 'Whom' functions as a grammatical object (him/her). The committee selected HER (object), so 'whom' is required.
examTag: IBPS PO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Dr. Sharma has been researching renewable energy solutions _____ 2015.'
optionA_hi: since (निश्चित समय/Point of Time हेतु since)
explanation_hi: निश्चित समय (Point of Time जैसे 2015, सुबह, सोमवार) के लिए 'since' का प्रयोग होता है; समयावधि (Period of Time जैसे 5 वर्ष, 2 घंटे) के लिए 'for' आता है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Fill in the blank: 'Dr. Sharma has been researching renewable energy solutions _____ 2015.'
explanation_en: In Present Perfect Continuous tense, 'SINCE' is used with a specific point in time (2015, Monday, 5 AM), whereas 'FOR' is used for a duration/period of time (for 10 years).
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] सही उपपद (Articles) चुनें: 'He is _____ most talented artist in _____ university.'
optionA_hi: the, the (Superlative डिग्री के पूर्व the तथा निश्चित संस्था हेतु the)
explanation_hi: सुपरलेटिव डिग्री (Superlative Degree जैसे most talented, highest) के पहले हमेशा 'the' आता है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Choose the correct articles: 'He is _____ most talented artist in _____ university.'
explanation_en: Superlative adjectives ('most talented') strictly demand the definite article 'the'. The specific recognized institution also takes 'the'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] सही आर्टिकल का चयन करें: 'She holds a master's degree from _____ European university.'
optionA_hi: a ('यू' / yoo की व्यंजन ध्वनि होने के कारण 'a' लगेगा)
explanation_hi: 'A' और 'An' का प्रयोग उच्चारण की ध्वनि पर निर्भर करता है। 'European' शब्द 'E' से शुरू होने पर भी 'यू' (व्यंजन ध्वनि) से बोला जाता है, अतः 'a European' सही है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Select the correct article: 'She holds a master's degree from _____ European university.'
explanation_en: Phonetic rule: Articles depend on initial phonetic SOUND, not the written letter. 'European' begins with the consonant sound /j/ ('yoo'), so the indefinite article 'A' is used (a European, a university, a one-rupee coin).
examTag: NDA English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] अगणनीय संज्ञा (Uncountable Nouns) के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionA_hi: All the furniture in the conference hall was imported. (furniture का बहुवचन furnitures नहीं होता)
optionC_hi: A furniture in the hall was imported. (गलत)
explanation_hi: Furniture, scenery, information, luggage, advice आदि uncountable nouns हैं। इनमें 's' लगाकर बहुवचन नहीं बनाया जाता और इनके साथ एकवचन क्रिया आती है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Spot the grammatically sound statement regarding uncountable nouns:
optionA_en: All the furniture in the conference hall was imported.
optionB_en: All the furnitures in the conference hall were imported.
optionC_en: A furniture in the hall was imported.
explanation_en: Nouns like 'furniture', 'information', 'scenery', 'advice', 'luggage', 'baggage', 'poetry', and 'machinery' are strictly uncountable. They never take plural 's/es' or plural verbs.
examTag: State PCS General English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] उचित क्रिया चुनें: 'The jury _____ divided in their opinions regarding the verdict.'
optionC_hi: were (मतभेद होने पर Collective Noun बहुवचन की तरह व्यवहार करता है)
explanation_hi: जब किसी समूहवाचक संज्ञा (Jury, Committee, Team) के सदस्यों में मतभेद (divided) हो, तो क्रिया और सर्वनाम दोनों बहुवचन (were / their) आते हैं।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Select the correct verb: 'The jury _____ divided in their opinions regarding the verdict.'
explanation_en: When a collective noun (jury, committee, team) is divided in opinion or individuals act separately ('in their opinions'), it takes a PLURAL verb ('were') and plural pronoun ('their').
examTag: Bank SO English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] सही वाक्य संरचना चुनें: 'Seldom _____ such an astonishing natural spectacle.'
optionB_hi: have I witnessed (नकारात्मक क्रियाविशेषण से शुरू होने पर Inversion नियम)
explanation_hi: Inversion नियम: जब वाक्य 'Seldom', 'Never', 'Rarely', 'Barely' जैसे नकारात्मक शब्दों से आरंभ होता है, तो कर्ता से पहले सहायक क्रिया (Auxiliary verb) आती है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Choose the correct inverted clause: 'Seldom _____ such an astonishing natural spectacle.'
explanation_en: Negative Adverb Inversion: When a sentence begins with negative or restrictive adverbs (Seldom, Rarely, Never, Little, Scarcely), inverted word order (Auxiliary verb + Subject + Main verb) is mandatory.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The number of applicants registering for the civil services examination _____ increased dramatically.'
optionA_hi: has ('The number of' के साथ एकवचन क्रिया)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'The number of' एक निश्चित संख्या दर्शाता है अतः इसके साथ Singular Verb ('has') आती है; जबकि 'A number of' के साथ Plural Verb ('have') आती है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Fill in the blank: 'The number of applicants registering for the civil services examination _____ increased dramatically.'
explanation_en: Formula: 'THE number of + Plural Noun + SINGULAR VERB' (denotes a single definite count). In contrast, 'A number of + Plural Noun + PLURAL VERB' (denotes many). Here, 'has' is correct.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] सही संबंधसूचक अव्यय चुनें: 'Death before dishonour is preferable _____ a life of shame.'
optionD_hi: to (Prefer, Preferable के साथ सदैव to आता है)
explanation_hi: Prefer, Preferable, Senior, Junior, Superior आदि लैटिन तुलनात्मक शब्दों के बाद 'than' का प्रयोग वर्जित है; इनके साथ हमेशा 'to' आता है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Select the correct preposition: 'Death before dishonour is preferable _____ a life of shame.'
explanation_en: Adjectives and verbs of preference ('prefer', 'preferable', 'prior', 'senior', 'junior', 'superior', 'inferior') are followed by the preposition 'TO', never 'than'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] व्याकरणिक त्रुटि सुधारें: 'Myself Dr. Rajesh, and I am the chief medical officer.'
optionB_hi: I am Dr. Rajesh (Reflexive Pronoun कभी वाक्य का कर्ता नहीं बन सकता)
explanation_hi: Reflexive Pronoun (Myself, Himself) का प्रयोग कभी भी सीधे वाक्य के कर्ता (Subject) के रूप में अपना परिचय देने के लिए नहीं किया जा सकता। 'I am...' कहना शुद्ध है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Correct the underlined error: 'Myself Dr. Rajesh, and I am the chief medical officer.'
explanation_en: A reflexive pronoun ('myself', 'himself', 'yourself') cannot function as the grammatical subject of a sentence without a preceding subject noun or personal pronoun. 'I am Dr. Rajesh' is correct.
examTag: SSC CPO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] बिना किसी व्याकरणिक दोष वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: Walking through the botanical garden, I was stung by a bee. (कर्ता I टहल रहा था)
optionB_hi: Walking through the botanical garden, a bee stung me. (Dangling Modifier दोष)
optionC_hi: Walking in garden, stinging me was a bee.
optionD_hi: While walking through the garden, a bee was stinging me.
explanation_hi: पार्टिसिपल वाक्यांश (Walking through...) का संबंध तुरंत आने वाले मुख्य कर्ता से होना चाहिए। मधुमक्खी टहल नहीं रही थी, बल्कि व्यक्ति टहल रहा था।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Choose the sentence free of dangling modifier errors:
optionA_en: Walking through the botanical garden, I was stung by a bee.
optionB_en: Walking through the botanical garden, a bee stung me.
optionC_en: Walking in garden, stinging me was a bee.
optionD_en: While walking through the garden, a bee was stinging me.
explanation_en: A participle phrase must modify the logical subject immediately following the comma. In sentence B, 'Walking through the garden' illogically modifies 'a bee' (meaning the bee was walking). Sentence A is correct.
examTag: IBPS PO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'You will not succeed in clearing the exam _____ you study with consistent discipline.'
optionC_hi: unless (शर्त/Condition दर्शाने के लिए unless का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: 'Unless' शर्त (Condition) दर्शाता है ('जब तक कि... नहीं'), जबकि 'Until' समय सीमा (Time) दर्शाता है। यहां नियमित पढ़ाई एक शर्त है, अतः 'unless' आएगा।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Fill in the blank: 'You will not succeed in clearing the exam _____ you study with consistent discipline.'
explanation_en: 'Unless' is condition-oriented (meaning 'if not'), while 'Until' is time-oriented (meaning 'up to the time when'). Here, studying consistently is a condition, so 'unless' is correct.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] उचित क्रिया चुनें: 'The first innings of the cricket test match _____ interrupted by persistent rain.'
optionA_hi: was (Innings दिखने में बहुवचन है किंतु अर्थ में एकवचन)
explanation_hi: Innings, News, Mathematics, Physics आदि संज्ञाएं देखने में बहुवचन लगती हैं किंतु अर्थ में एकवचन होती हैं, अतः इनके साथ 'was' लगेगा।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Choose the correct verb: 'The first innings of the cricket test match _____ interrupted by persistent rain.'
explanation_en: Nouns like 'innings', 'news', 'mathematics', 'physics', 'politics', and 'measles' end in 's' but are grammatically singular and take singular verbs.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] वाक्य पूरा करें: 'It is high time we _____ decisive action against environmental pollution.'
optionB_hi: took ('It is high time' के बाद Simple Past Tense / V2 आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'It is high time' या 'It is time' के बाद यदि कर्ता (Subject) आए, तो क्रिया का भूतकालिक रूप (Past Indefinite / V2) आता है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Complete the sentence: 'It is high time we _____ decisive action against environmental pollution.'
explanation_en: Idiomatic grammar rule: Phrases like 'It is time', 'It is high time', and 'It is about time' followed by a subject strictly require the Subjunctive Past tense (V2 verb). Hence, 'took' is correct.
examTag: NDA English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The old philosopher was _____ feeble to undertake such a arduous expedition.'
optionD_hi: too ('too...to' नकारात्मक अर्थ में अत्यधिक कमजोरी दर्शाता है)
explanation_hi: 'Too... to' संरचना नकारात्मक अर्थ देती है (इतने दुर्बल कि यात्रा नहीं कर सकते थे)।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Fill in the blank: 'The old philosopher was _____ feeble to undertake such a arduous expedition.'
explanation_en: The correlative pair 'TOO + adjective + TO + verb' conveys a negative implication ('so feeble that he could not undertake').
examTag: State PCS General English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] सकारात्मक कार्य हेतु सर्वनामों का सही क्रम (231 नियम) चुनें:
optionA_hi: You, he, and I have completed the assignment successfully. (2nd, 3rd, 1st Person नियम)
optionB_hi: I, you, and he have completed the assignment.
optionC_hi: You, I, and he have completed the assignment.
optionD_hi: He, you, and I have completed the assignment.
explanation_hi: सभ्यता और व्याकरण का 231 नियम: सामान्य वाक्यों में पहले 2nd Person (You), फिर 3rd Person (He), और अंत में 1st Person (I) आता है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Select the grammatically correct sequence of pronouns for a positive action:
optionA_en: You, he, and I have completed the assignment successfully.
optionB_en: I, you, and he have completed the assignment.
optionC_en: You, I, and he have completed the assignment.
optionD_en: He, you, and I have completed the assignment.
explanation_en: General Etiquette Rule (231): When multiple singular personal pronouns appear together for a positive or neutral act, the order must be Second Person (You), Third Person (He/She), and First Person (I).
examTag: Bank SO English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'My father objected to _____ joining the international sailing academy.'
optionA_hi: my (Gerund / -ing क्रिया से पूर्व Possessive Adjective आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Gerund (v1 + ing) से ठीक पहले हमेशा Possessive case ('my', 'his', 'her') का प्रयोग होता है, Objective case ('me', 'him') का नहीं।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Fill in the blank: 'My father objected to _____ joining the international sailing academy.'
explanation_en: A noun or pronoun preceding a gerund (verb acting as noun, 'joining') must be in the POSSESSIVE case ('my joining', 'his going', 'their coming').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] उचित शब्द चुनें: 'Scarcely had the keynote speaker stepped off the stage _____ the thunderous applause erupted.'
optionB_hi: when (Scarcely had के साथ when का संयोजन)
explanation_hi: 'Scarcely had' के बाद दूसरा उपवाक्य हमेशा 'when' से जुड़ता है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Identify the correct clause structure: 'Scarcely had the keynote speaker stepped off the stage _____ the thunderous applause erupted.'
explanation_en: Correlative standard: 'Scarcely had + Subject + V3 ... WHEN'. Using 'than' here is a classic examination trap.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] सही क्रिया चुनें: 'More than one candidate _____ disqualified for violating code of conduct.'
optionC_hi: was ('More than one' के बाद संज्ञा व क्रिया दोनों एकवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'More than one' के बाद संज्ञा और क्रिया दोनों एकवचन (candidate was) आते हैं।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Choose the correct verb: 'More than one candidate _____ disqualified for violating code of conduct.'
explanation_en: Grammar Rule: 'More than one + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('More than one candidate was...'). However, 'More candidates than one were...' takes plural.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] वाक्य में अतिरेक (Redundancy) दोष पहचानें:
optionB_hi: 'Supposing' और 'if' दोनों एक साथ प्रयुक्त नहीं होते; केवल एक का प्रयोग करें
optionC_hi: 'How will we' का क्रम गलत है
explanation_hi: 'Supposing' और 'if' दोनों का अर्थ शर्त लगाना है। दोनों का एक साथ प्रयोग पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous error) है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Identify the redundancy in: 'Supposing if the train gets cancelled, how will we reach the summit?'
optionB_en: 'Supposing' and 'if' should never be used together; use either 'Supposing' OR 'If'
explanation_en: 'Supposing' and 'if' both introduce conditional suppositions. Using both together ('supposing if') is a superfluous tautology. Use either 'Supposing the train...' or 'If the train...'.
examTag: SSC CPO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: [एसएससी व बैंकिंग इंग्लिश कैप्सूल] सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'The strict teacher made all the delinquent students _____ the entire chapter thrice.'
optionD_hi: rewrite (Causative verb 'make' के बाद Bare Infinitive / बिना to की क्रिया)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Make' का प्रयोग Causative verb (प्रेरणार्थक क्रिया) के रूप में Active voice में हो, तो इसके बाद Bare Infinitive (बिना 'to' के मूल क्रिया V1) आता है।
question_en: [SSC & Banking English Capsule] Select the correct verb form: 'The strict teacher made all the delinquent students _____ the entire chapter thrice.'
explanation_en: Causative verbs like 'make', 'let', and 'bid' in active voice take a BARE INFINITIVE (base verb without 'to'). Hence, 'made them rewrite' is grammatically correct.
examTag: IBPS PO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: सही क्रिया का चयन कीजिए: 'Neither the manager nor the employees _____ present at the emergency briefing.'
explanation_hi: निकटता का नियम (Rule of Proximity): जब दो कर्ता 'neither...nor' या 'either...or' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया हमेशा अपने सबसे नजदीकी कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। यहां रिक्त स्थान के सबसे निकट 'employees' (बहुवचन) है, अतः 'were' सही है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Select the grammatically correct verb: 'Neither the manager nor the employees _____ present at the emergency briefing.'
explanation_en: Rule of Proximity: When two subjects are connected by 'either...or' or 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'employees' (plural) is closest to the blank, so plural verb 'were' is correct.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति करें: 'The captain, along with all his crew members, _____ rescued from the sinking vessel.'
optionA_hi: was (प्रथम कर्ता The captain के अनुसार एकवचन)
explanation_hi: जब दो कर्ता 'along with', 'as well as', 'together with' आदि से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया हमेशा प्रथम कर्ता (First Subject) के अनुसार आती है। 'The captain' एकवचन (singular) है, इसलिए 'was' लगेगा।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Fill in the blank: 'The captain, along with all his crew members, _____ rescued from the sinking vessel.'
explanation_en: When two subjects are joined by 'along with', 'as well as', 'together with', 'in addition to', or 'accompanied by', the verb strictly agrees with the FIRST subject. The captain (singular) takes 'was'.
examTag: NDA English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: सही विकल्प चुनें: 'One of the most famous tourist destinations in India _____ the Taj Mahal.'
optionC_hi: is (One of the के बाद संज्ञा बहुवचन किंतु क्रिया एकवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb'। यहां 'destinations' बहुवचन है किंतु वाक्य का मुख्य कर्ता 'One' (एकवचन) है, अतः क्रिया 'is' होगी।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Identify the correct completion: 'One of the most famous tourist destinations in India _____ the Taj Mahal.'
explanation_en: Structure: 'One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb'. The subject of the sentence is the pronoun 'One' (singular), which governs the singular verb 'is'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: शर्तसूचक वाक्य को पूरा करें: 'If you had warned me about the heavy traffic, I _____ earlier.'
optionA_hi: would have started (भूतकाल की अधूरी शर्त का नियम)
explanation_hi: तृतीय शर्त (Third Conditional): यदि 'If' उपवाक्य में 'had + V3' (Past Perfect) हो, तो मुख्य उपवाक्य में 'would have + V3' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Complete the conditional sentence: 'If you had warned me about the heavy traffic, I _____ earlier.'
explanation_en: Third Conditional (unfulfilled past condition): 'If + Past Perfect (had + V3) ... Main clause: Subject + would have + V3'. Hence, 'would have started' is mandatory.
examTag: Bank SO English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: काल्पनिक वाक्य हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'If I _____ the Prime Minister, I would ensure free healthcare for all.'
optionD_hi: were (काल्पनिक/अवास्तविक स्थिति में सभी कर्ताओं के साथ were)
explanation_hi: काल्पनिक या असंभव शर्त (Subjunctive Mood) में 'I', 'He', 'She' आदि एकवचन कर्ताओं के साथ भी 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' का ही प्रयोग किया जाता है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Choose the correct hypothetical structure: 'If I _____ the Prime Minister, I would ensure free healthcare for all.'
explanation_en: Subjunctive mood: In unreal, imaginary, or hypothetical conditions ('If I were...'), the plural past subjunctive 'were' is used for all persons and singular pronouns.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: उचित समुच्चयबोधक भरें: 'Hardly had the train arrived at the platform _____ the passengers rushed to board it.'
optionB_hi: when (Hardly/Scarcely के साथ सदैव when आता है)
explanation_hi: सहसंबंधी नियम: 'Hardly' और 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का जोड़ा बनता है, कभी भी 'than' या 'then' नहीं आता।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Fill in the appropriate conjunction: 'Hardly had the train arrived at the platform _____ the passengers rushed to board it.'
explanation_en: Correlative conjunction pair rule: 'Hardly / Scarcely + had + Subject + V3 ... WHEN + Subject + V2'. 'Than' is used exclusively with 'No sooner'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'No sooner did the thief see the police officer _____ he took to his heels.'
optionB_hi: than (No sooner के साथ तुलनात्मक Than का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'No sooner' के साथ सदैव 'than' (t-h-a-n) का प्रयोग होता है। परीक्षा में अक्सर 'then' या 'when' देकर त्रुटि पूछी जाती है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Fill in the blank: 'No sooner did the thief see the police officer _____ he took to his heels.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'No sooner' is a comparative adverbial construction that always pairs with 'THAN' (not then, when, or that). Inversion is applied in the first clause.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: 'Lest' के साथ आने वाली उचित सहायक क्रिया चुनें: 'Walk carefully lest you _____ stumble and fall.'
optionA_hi: should (Lest के साथ अनिवार्य रूप से should आता है)
explanation_hi: 'Lest' का अर्थ होता है 'कहीं ऐसा न हो कि'। व्याकरण के नियमानुसार 'lest' के बाद केवल 'should' का प्रयोग होता है और इसके साथ 'not' कभी नहीं आता।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Identify the modal that correctly pairs with 'lest': 'Walk carefully lest you _____ stumble and fall.'
explanation_en: 'Lest' means 'for fear that' or 'so that... not'. Grammatically, 'lest' is strictly followed by the modal auxiliary 'SHOULD' (or bare subjunctive). Furthermore, negative words like 'not' are never used after lest.
examTag: SSC CPO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: सही सर्वनाम चुनें: 'Each of the participants must submit _____ project proposal by Friday.'
optionD_hi: his or her (Each के लिए एकवचन possessive pronoun)
explanation_hi: 'Each', 'Every', 'Either' व्याकरणिक रूप से एकवचन (singular) होते हैं। अतः इनके लिए possessive pronoun भी एकवचन 'his' या 'his or her' आता है, 'their' नहीं।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Select the correct pronoun: 'Each of the participants must submit _____ project proposal by Friday.'
explanation_en: Indefinite distributive pronouns 'each', 'either', and 'every' are grammatically singular and require singular possessive adjectives ('his/her', not plural 'their').
examTag: IBPS PO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: उचित संबंधवाचक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The woman _____ the committee selected as chairperson has extensive international experience.'
optionD_hi: whom (कर्म/Object के रूप में whom का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: 'Who' कर्ता (Subject) के लिए आता है, जबकि 'Whom' कर्म (Object) के लिए आता है। समिति ने 'उन्हें' चुना (कर्म), अतः 'whom' सही है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Choose the correct relative pronoun: 'The woman _____ the committee selected as chairperson has extensive international experience.'
explanation_en: 'Who' functions as a grammatical subject (he/she), while 'Whom' functions as a grammatical object (him/her). The committee selected HER (object), so 'whom' is required.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Dr. Sharma has been researching renewable energy solutions _____ 2015.'
optionA_hi: since (निश्चित समय/Point of Time हेतु since)
explanation_hi: निश्चित समय (Point of Time जैसे 2015, सुबह, सोमवार) के लिए 'since' का प्रयोग होता है; समयावधि (Period of Time जैसे 5 वर्ष, 2 घंटे) के लिए 'for' आता है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Fill in the blank: 'Dr. Sharma has been researching renewable energy solutions _____ 2015.'
explanation_en: In Present Perfect Continuous tense, 'SINCE' is used with a specific point in time (2015, Monday, 5 AM), whereas 'FOR' is used for a duration/period of time (for 10 years).
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: सही उपपद (Articles) चुनें: 'He is _____ most talented artist in _____ university.'
optionA_hi: the, the (Superlative डिग्री के पूर्व the तथा निश्चित संस्था हेतु the)
explanation_hi: सुपरलेटिव डिग्री (Superlative Degree जैसे most talented, highest) के पहले हमेशा 'the' आता है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Choose the correct articles: 'He is _____ most talented artist in _____ university.'
explanation_en: Superlative adjectives ('most talented') strictly demand the definite article 'the'. The specific recognized institution also takes 'the'.
examTag: NDA English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: सही आर्टिकल का चयन करें: 'She holds a master's degree from _____ European university.'
optionA_hi: a ('यू' / yoo की व्यंजन ध्वनि होने के कारण 'a' लगेगा)
explanation_hi: 'A' और 'An' का प्रयोग उच्चारण की ध्वनि पर निर्भर करता है। 'European' शब्द 'E' से शुरू होने पर भी 'यू' (व्यंजन ध्वनि) से बोला जाता है, अतः 'a European' सही है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Select the correct article: 'She holds a master's degree from _____ European university.'
explanation_en: Phonetic rule: Articles depend on initial phonetic SOUND, not the written letter. 'European' begins with the consonant sound /j/ ('yoo'), so the indefinite article 'A' is used (a European, a university, a one-rupee coin).
examTag: State PCS General English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: अगणनीय संज्ञा (Uncountable Nouns) के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionC_hi: A furniture in the hall was imported. (गलत)
optionD_hi: All the furniture in the conference hall was imported. (furniture का बहुवचन furnitures नहीं होता)
explanation_hi: Furniture, scenery, information, luggage, advice आदि uncountable nouns हैं। इनमें 's' लगाकर बहुवचन नहीं बनाया जाता और इनके साथ एकवचन क्रिया आती है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Spot the grammatically sound statement regarding uncountable nouns:
optionA_en: All the furnitures in the conference hall were imported.
optionC_en: A furniture in the hall was imported.
optionD_en: All the furniture in the conference hall was imported.
explanation_en: Nouns like 'furniture', 'information', 'scenery', 'advice', 'luggage', 'baggage', 'poetry', and 'machinery' are strictly uncountable. They never take plural 's/es' or plural verbs.
examTag: Bank SO English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: उचित क्रिया चुनें: 'The jury _____ divided in their opinions regarding the verdict.'
optionC_hi: were (मतभेद होने पर Collective Noun बहुवचन की तरह व्यवहार करता है)
explanation_hi: जब किसी समूहवाचक संज्ञा (Jury, Committee, Team) के सदस्यों में मतभेद (divided) हो, तो क्रिया और सर्वनाम दोनों बहुवचन (were / their) आते हैं।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Select the correct verb: 'The jury _____ divided in their opinions regarding the verdict.'
explanation_en: When a collective noun (jury, committee, team) is divided in opinion or individuals act separately ('in their opinions'), it takes a PLURAL verb ('were') and plural pronoun ('their').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: सही वाक्य संरचना चुनें: 'Seldom _____ such an astonishing natural spectacle.'
optionC_hi: have I witnessed (नकारात्मक क्रियाविशेषण से शुरू होने पर Inversion नियम)
explanation_hi: Inversion नियम: जब वाक्य 'Seldom', 'Never', 'Rarely', 'Barely' जैसे नकारात्मक शब्दों से आरंभ होता है, तो कर्ता से पहले सहायक क्रिया (Auxiliary verb) आती है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Choose the correct inverted clause: 'Seldom _____ such an astonishing natural spectacle.'
explanation_en: Negative Adverb Inversion: When a sentence begins with negative or restrictive adverbs (Seldom, Rarely, Never, Little, Scarcely), inverted word order (Auxiliary verb + Subject + Main verb) is mandatory.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The number of applicants registering for the civil services examination _____ increased dramatically.'
optionA_hi: has ('The number of' के साथ एकवचन क्रिया)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'The number of' एक निश्चित संख्या दर्शाता है अतः इसके साथ Singular Verb ('has') आती है; जबकि 'A number of' के साथ Plural Verb ('have') आती है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Fill in the blank: 'The number of applicants registering for the civil services examination _____ increased dramatically.'
explanation_en: Formula: 'THE number of + Plural Noun + SINGULAR VERB' (denotes a single definite count). In contrast, 'A number of + Plural Noun + PLURAL VERB' (denotes many). Here, 'has' is correct.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: सही संबंधसूचक अव्यय चुनें: 'Death before dishonour is preferable _____ a life of shame.'
optionB_hi: to (Prefer, Preferable के साथ सदैव to आता है)
explanation_hi: Prefer, Preferable, Senior, Junior, Superior आदि लैटिन तुलनात्मक शब्दों के बाद 'than' का प्रयोग वर्जित है; इनके साथ हमेशा 'to' आता है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Select the correct preposition: 'Death before dishonour is preferable _____ a life of shame.'
explanation_en: Adjectives and verbs of preference ('prefer', 'preferable', 'prior', 'senior', 'junior', 'superior', 'inferior') are followed by the preposition 'TO', never 'than'.
examTag: SSC CPO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: व्याकरणिक त्रुटि सुधारें: 'Myself Dr. Rajesh, and I am the chief medical officer.'
optionA_hi: I am Dr. Rajesh (Reflexive Pronoun कभी वाक्य का कर्ता नहीं बन सकता)
explanation_hi: Reflexive Pronoun (Myself, Himself) का प्रयोग कभी भी सीधे वाक्य के कर्ता (Subject) के रूप में अपना परिचय देने के लिए नहीं किया जा सकता। 'I am...' कहना शुद्ध है।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Correct the underlined error: 'Myself Dr. Rajesh, and I am the chief medical officer.'
explanation_en: A reflexive pronoun ('myself', 'himself', 'yourself') cannot function as the grammatical subject of a sentence without a preceding subject noun or personal pronoun. 'I am Dr. Rajesh' is correct.
examTag: IBPS PO - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: बिना किसी व्याकरणिक दोष वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: Walking through the botanical garden, I was stung by a bee. (कर्ता I टहल रहा था)
optionB_hi: Walking in garden, stinging me was a bee.
optionC_hi: Walking through the botanical garden, a bee stung me. (Dangling Modifier दोष)
optionD_hi: While walking through the garden, a bee was stinging me.
explanation_hi: पार्टिसिपल वाक्यांश (Walking through...) का संबंध तुरंत आने वाले मुख्य कर्ता से होना चाहिए। मधुमक्खी टहल नहीं रही थी, बल्कि व्यक्ति टहल रहा था।
question_en: Spot the standard grammatical usage: Choose the sentence free of dangling modifier errors:
optionA_en: Walking through the botanical garden, I was stung by a bee.
optionB_en: Walking in garden, stinging me was a bee.
optionC_en: Walking through the botanical garden, a bee stung me.
optionD_en: While walking through the garden, a bee was stinging me.
explanation_en: A participle phrase must modify the logical subject immediately following the comma. In sentence B, 'Walking through the garden' illogically modifies 'a bee' (meaning the bee was walking). Sentence A is correct.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: मानक व्याकरण सम्मत प्रयोग का चयन कीजिए: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'You will not succeed in clearing the exam _____ you study with consistent discipline.'
optionD_hi: unless (शर्त/Condition दर्शाने के लिए unless का प्रयोग)
