question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 1] सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'The strict teacher made all the delinquent students _____ the entire chapter thrice.'
optionD_hi: rewrite (Causative verb 'make' के बाद Bare Infinitive / बिना to की क्रिया)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Make' का प्रयोग Causative verb (प्रेरणार्थक क्रिया) के रूप में Active voice में हो, तो इसके बाद Bare Infinitive (बिना 'to' के मूल क्रिया V1) आता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 1] Select the correct verb form: 'The strict teacher made all the delinquent students _____ the entire chapter thrice.'
explanation_en: Causative verbs like 'make', 'let', and 'bid' in active voice take a BARE INFINITIVE (base verb without 'to'). Hence, 'made them rewrite' is grammatically correct.
examTag: State PCS General English - Grammar Foundations & Syntax

question_hi: उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The entire faculty congratulated him _____ his stupendous achievement in the civil services exam.'
optionD_hi: on (Congratulate के बाद सदैव on आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Congratulate' और 'Congratulations' के बाद हमेशा 'ON' आता है, 'for' लगाना सामान्य परीक्षा त्रुटि है।
question_en: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: 'The entire faculty congratulated him _____ his stupendous achievement in the civil services exam.'
explanation_en: Fixed Preposition: The verb 'congratulate' (and noun 'congratulations') is strictly followed by the preposition 'ON' (congratulate someone ON something), never 'for'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The suspect was accused _____ embezzlement and subsequently charged _____ grand theft.'
optionD_hi: of, with (Accused of तथा Charged with)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी अपराध का आरोप लगने पर 'Accused OF' और औपचारिक कानूनी आरोप तय होने पर 'Charged WITH' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Select the correct prepositions: 'The suspect was accused _____ embezzlement and subsequently charged _____ grand theft.'
explanation_en: Fixed Preposition pair: One is 'accused OF' a crime, but 'charged WITH' a crime. Similarly: guilty of, convicted of.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: वाक्य पूरा करें: 'Physicians strongly advise patients to abstain _____ processed sugar and tobacco.'
optionC_hi: from (Abstain, Refrain के साथ from का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: बचने या परहेज करने वाले शब्द (Abstain, Refrain, Prevent, Prohibit) के बाद हमेशा 'from' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Complete the advice: 'Physicians strongly advise patients to abstain _____ processed sugar and tobacco.'
explanation_en: Verbs denoting avoidance or separation ('abstain', 'refrain', 'prevent', 'prohibit', 'deter', 'desist') take the fixed preposition 'FROM' followed by a gerund or noun.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Though he is junior _____ me in service, he is technically superior _____ solving algorithmic challenges.'
optionB_hi: to, at (Junior to तथा proficient/superior at)
explanation_hi: लैटिन तुलनात्मक शब्द (Junior, Senior, Superior, Inferior) के बाद 'than' कभी नहीं आता, सदैव 'to' आता है।
question_en: Fill in the blank: 'Though he is junior _____ me in service, he is technically superior _____ solving algorithmic challenges.'
explanation_en: Comparative adjectives ending in '-ior' (junior, senior, superior, inferior, anterior, posterior) are followed by 'TO', never 'than'. Being skilled at a task takes 'at' / 'in'.
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'His multinational firm deals _____ pharmaceutical exports, but he knows how to deal _____ difficult clients.'
optionA_hi: in, with (व्यापार हेतु Deal in, व्यवहार/निपटने हेतु Deal with)
explanation_hi: अंतर: किसी वस्तु का व्यापार करने के लिए 'Deal in' आता है, जबकि किसी व्यक्ति से व्यवहार करने या समस्या से निपटने के लिए 'Deal with' आता है।
question_en: Choose the correct preposition: 'His multinational firm deals _____ pharmaceutical exports, but he knows how to deal _____ difficult clients.'
explanation_en: 'Deal in' means to trade in a commodity/business ('deals in textiles/medicines'). 'Deal with' means to handle, interact with, or address someone or something.
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: सही प्रीपोजिशन चुनें: 'The veteran soldier is blind _____ the left eye, but the doting father is blind _____ his son's shortcomings.'
optionD_hi: in, to (शारीरिक आंख से अंधा blind in, दोषों के प्रति अनदेखा blind to)
explanation_hi: शारीरिक रूप से किसी आंख से अंधा होने पर 'blind in/of the eye' और दोषों या गलतियों को अनदेखा करने पर 'blind to' आता है।
question_en: Select the appropriate prepositions: 'The veteran soldier is blind _____ the left eye, but the doting father is blind _____ his son's shortcomings.'
explanation_en: Physical sight loss in an eye: 'blind IN an eye' (or 'blind of'). Figurative ignorance of faults: 'blind TO someone's faults'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: रद्द करने (cancel) के अर्थ में प्रयुक्त फ्रेजल वर्ब चुनें: 'Due to adverse meteorological conditions, the rescue operation was _____.'
explanation_hi: 'Call off' का अर्थ होता है किसी कार्यक्रम या अभियान को रद्द करना (Cancel)।
question_en: Identify the phrasal verb meaning 'to cancel': 'Due to adverse meteorological conditions, the rescue operation was _____.'
explanation_en: 'Call off' means to cancel an event or mission. 'Call on' means to visit someone. 'Call for' means to demand or require.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: 'Put up with' का अर्थ क्या है: 'She refused to put up with his unruly tantrums any longer'?
explanation_hi: 'Put up with' का अर्थ होता है किसी अप्रिय व्यवहार या स्थिति को सहन या बर्दाश्त करना (Tolerate)।
question_en: What does the phrasal verb 'put up with' convey in: 'She refused to put up with his unruly tantrums any longer'?
explanation_en: The three-word phrasal verb 'put up with' means to tolerate or endure an unpleasant situation or behavior patiently.
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: जांच करने के अर्थ में सही फ्रेजल वर्ब भरें: 'The magistrate constituted a special committee to _____ allegations of financial irregularities.'
explanation_hi: 'Look into' का अर्थ होता है किसी मामले या आरोप की जांच-पड़ताल (Investigate) करना।
question_en: Fill in the blank: 'The magistrate constituted a special committee to _____ allegations of financial irregularities.'
explanation_en: 'Look into' means to investigate or examine the facts of a situation. 'Look after' means to take care of someone.
examTag: State PCS General English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: उचित फ्रेजल वर्ब युग्म चुनें: 'Riots _____ in the border district, while our transport vehicle _____ on the highway.'
optionA_hi: broke out, broke down (दंगे भड़कना broke out, वाहन खराब होना broke down)
explanation_hi: दंगा, आग या बीमारी अचानक फैलने के लिए 'Break out' और गाड़ी/मशीनरी खराब होने के लिए 'Break down' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Select the correct pair: 'Riots _____ in the border district, while our transport vehicle _____ on the highway.'
explanation_en: 'Break out' means to start suddenly (wars, epidemic diseases, riots, fire). 'Break down' means mechanical failure of machinery/vehicles, or collapsing emotionally.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: Passive Voice में बदलें: 'The civil engineers are constructing a high-speed railway viaduct.'
optionA_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct is constructed...
optionB_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct has been constructed...
optionC_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct is being constructed by the civil engineers. (is being + V3)
optionD_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct was constructed...
explanation_hi: Present Continuous टेंस का Passive Voice बनाते समय 'is/am/are + being + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Convert to Passive Voice: 'The civil engineers are constructing a high-speed railway viaduct.'
optionA_en: A high-speed railway viaduct is constructed by the engineers.
optionB_en: A high-speed railway viaduct has been constructed by the engineers.
optionC_en: A high-speed railway viaduct is being constructed by the civil engineers.
optionD_en: A high-speed railway viaduct was constructed by the civil engineers.
explanation_en: Present Continuous Passive transformation: 'Subject + is/am/are + BEING + V3 (past participle) + by + agent'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: आदेशात्मक वाक्य का Passive Voice बनाएं: 'Shut the front gate immediately.'
optionB_hi: You are requested to shut the gate.
optionC_hi: The front gate should be shut...
optionD_hi: Let the front gate be shut immediately. (Let + Object + be + V3)
explanation_hi: आज्ञा या आदेश वाले वाक्यों का Passive Voice 'Let + Object + be + V3' संरचना से बनाया जाता है।
question_en: Convert the imperative command into passive: 'Shut the front gate immediately.'
optionB_en: You are requested to shut the gate.
optionC_en: The front gate should be shut by you immediately.
optionD_en: Let the front gate be shut immediately.
explanation_en: Imperative Order Passive formula: 'LET + Object + BE + V3'. 'Shut' has identical base and past participle forms (shut-shut-shut).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: Passive Voice में परिवर्तित करें: 'Everyone in the academic community knows Professor Sen.'
optionA_hi: Professor Sen is known by everyone...
optionB_hi: Professor Sen has been known with everyone.
optionC_hi: Professor Sen is known to everyone in the academic community. (Know के बाद to आता है, by नहीं)
optionD_hi: Professor Sen was known to everyone.
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Know' क्रिया के Passive Voice में 'by' के स्थान पर 'to' (known to) का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: Convert to passive: 'Everyone in the academic community knows Professor Sen.'
optionA_en: Professor Sen is known by everyone in the academic community.
optionB_en: Professor Sen has been known with everyone.
optionC_en: Professor Sen is known to everyone in the academic community.
optionD_en: Professor Sen was known to everyone.
explanation_en: Prepositional Passive Exception: The verb 'know' takes 'TO' in passive voice (known TO), never 'by'. Similarly: surprised AT, pleased WITH, astonished AT, satisfied WITH.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: अर्ध-कर्मवाच्य (Quasi-passive) का सही रूपांतरण पहचानें: 'Quinine tastes bitter.'
optionA_hi: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted. (Quasi-passive मानक संरचना)
explanation_hi: Quasi-passive नियम: स्वाद या गंध बताने वाले वाक्यों का पैसिव 'Subject + is + adjective + when it is + V3' से बनता है।
question_en: Identify the standard passive conversion of: 'Quinine tastes bitter.'
optionA_en: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.
explanation_en: Quasi-passive / Middle voice verbs of perception (taste, smell, feel): 'Subject + verb (be) + adjective + when it is/they are + V3'. 'Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.'
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: Passive Voice बनाएं: 'The audience laughed at the comic performer.'
optionA_hi: The comic performer was laughed at by the audience. (फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन 'at' क्रिया के साथ रहेगा)
optionB_hi: The comic performer laughed at the audience.
optionC_hi: The audience was laughed at by the performer.
optionD_hi: The comic performer was laughed by the audience.
explanation_hi: नियम: जब Active voice में क्रिया के साथ Preposition जुड़ा हो (laughed at), तो Passive voice में भी वह Preposition क्रिया के ठीक साथ रहता है।
question_en: Convert to passive: 'The audience laughed at the comic performer.'
optionA_en: The comic performer was laughed at by the audience.
optionB_en: The comic performer laughed at the audience.
optionC_en: The audience was laughed at by the performer.
optionD_en: The comic performer was laughed by the audience.
explanation_en: Prepositional Verb Passive: When a verb takes an inseparable preposition ('laughed at', 'looked after', 'aimed at'), the preposition MUST be retained right after V3 in the passive.
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'The geography professor said, "The earth revolves around the sun."'
optionA_hi: The geography professor said that the earth had revolved...
optionB_hi: The geography professor said that the earth revolves around the sun. (सार्वभौमिक सत्य का काल नहीं बदलता)
optionD_hi: The geography professor said that the earth revolved...
explanation_hi: नियम: यदि Reported Speech में कोई सार्वभौमिक सत्य (Universal Truth), ऐतिहासिक तथ्य या वैज्ञानिक नियम हो, तो Reporting verb भूतकाल में होने पर भी काल नहीं बदलता।
question_en: Convert to Indirect Speech: 'The geography professor said, "The earth revolves around the sun."'
optionA_en: The geography professor said that the earth had revolved around the sun.
optionB_en: The geography professor said that the earth revolves around the sun.
optionC_en: The geography professor told that the earth was revolving.
optionD_en: The geography professor said that the earth revolved around the sun.
explanation_en: Universal Truth / Scientific Fact Exception: When reported speech expresses a universal truth, habitual action, or scientific law, the tense of the reported clause remains in Present Indefinite.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: Indirect Narration में बदलें: 'The investigator said to the witness, "Where did you find the abandoned document?"'
optionA_hi: The investigator asked that where... ('that' का प्रयोग वर्जित)
optionB_hi: The investigator asked where did he find...
optionC_hi: The investigator asked the witness where he had found the abandoned document. (did find बदलता है had found में तथा साधारण पदक्रम)
optionD_hi: The investigator enquired where he found...
explanation_hi: नियम: Wh- प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में 'that' नहीं आता, wh-शब्द ही योजक बनता है; वाक्य साधारण (Assertive) बनता है और Past Indefinite बदलकर Past Perfect (had + V3) हो जाता है।
question_en: Transform into indirect narration: 'The investigator said to the witness, "Where did you find the abandoned document?"'
optionA_en: The investigator asked the witness that where he had found the document.
optionB_en: The investigator asked the witness where did he find the abandoned document.
optionC_en: The investigator asked the witness where he had found the abandoned document.
optionD_en: The investigator enquired where he found the abandoned document.
explanation_en: Rules for Wh-questions: 1. 'Said to' becomes 'asked'. 2. No conjunction 'that' is used; the wh-word itself acts as connector. 3. Word order becomes assertive (Subject + Verb). 4. Past Indefinite ('did find') changes to Past Perfect ('had found').
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'Rohit said to me, "Can you solve this complex equation?"'
optionB_hi: Rohit enquired me that I can...
optionC_hi: Rohit asked me if I could solve that complex equation. (if + I could + that)
optionD_hi: Rohit told me that if I could...
explanation_hi: Yes/No प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में योजक 'if' या 'whether' आता है, 'can' का 'could' होता है और 'this' का 'that' हो जाता है।
question_en: Convert to indirect speech: 'Rohit said to me, "Can you solve this complex equation?"'
optionA_en: Rohit asked me whether could I solve that equation.
optionB_en: Rohit enquired me that I can solve that equation.
optionC_en: Rohit asked me if I could solve that complex equation.
optionD_en: Rohit told me that if I could solve this equation.
explanation_en: Auxiliary Yes/No questions: 1. Conjunction 'if' or 'whether' is used. 2. 'Can' shifts to past modal 'could'. 3. Demonstrative 'this' changes to 'that'. 4. Word order is assertive.
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: Indirect Narration में बदलें: 'The doctor said to the patient, "Take these medicines regularly and avoid cold water."'
optionB_hi: The doctor advised the patient to take those medicines regularly and to avoid cold water. (advised + to + V1 + those)
optionC_hi: The doctor told to take these...
explanation_hi: आदेशात्मक या सलाह वाले वाक्यों में 'said to' को 'advised/ordered' में बदलते हैं, क्रिया से पहले 'to' जोड़ते हैं और 'these' का 'those' हो जाता है।
question_en: Convert to indirect narration: 'The doctor said to the patient, "Take these medicines regularly and avoid cold water."'
optionA_en: The doctor said that patient should take medicines.
optionB_en: The doctor advised the patient to take those medicines regularly and to avoid cold water.
optionC_en: The doctor told the patient to take these medicines.
optionD_en: The doctor ordered the patient that take these medicines.
explanation_en: Imperative Speech transformation: Reporting verb becomes 'advised', 'ordered', or 'requested'. The imperative verb is replaced by an infinitive ('to take'). Demonstrative 'these' changes to 'those'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'The captain said, "Hurrah! We have won the championship trophy!"'
optionA_hi: The captain exclaimed that they have won...
optionC_hi: The captain exclaimed with joy that they had won the championship trophy. (exclaimed with joy + that they had won)
explanation_hi: 'Hurrah' विस्मयबोधक शब्द को 'exclaimed with joy' में बदलते हैं, 'that' लगाते हैं और 'have won' का 'had won' हो जाता है।
question_en: Change into indirect speech: 'The captain said, "Hurrah! We have won the championship trophy!"'
optionA_en: The captain exclaimed that they have won the championship trophy.
optionB_en: The captain said with happiness that we won the trophy.
optionC_en: The captain exclaimed with joy that they had won the championship trophy.
optionD_en: The captain shouted that we had won the trophy.
explanation_en: Exclamations with 'Hurrah' become 'exclaimed with joy that...'. Present Perfect 'have won' shifts to Past Perfect 'had won', and pronoun 'we' changes to 'they'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The patient died _____ cancer, while many miners died _____ exhaustion and asphyxiation.'
optionD_hi: of, from (बीमारी से मृत्यु Die of, थकान/कारण से मृत्यु Die from)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी बीमारी से मरने पर 'die OF' (die of disease) और बाहरी कारण, भूख या थकान से मरने पर 'die FROM' आता है।
question_en: Select the correct prepositions: 'The patient died _____ cancer, while many miners died _____ exhaustion and asphyxiation.'
explanation_en: Cause of death nuance: Dying of a specific disease = 'die OF cancer/cholera'. Dying from an external cause or overwork = 'die FROM hunger/overwork/exhaustion'. Dying in battle = 'die IN harness/action'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: शुद्ध वाक्यांश चुनें: 'It was arduous for the junior clerks to _____ the heavy workload.'
optionA_hi: cope with (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cope up with' सर्वथा अशुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: परीक्षाओं में बार-बार पूछी जाने वाली त्रुटि: मानक अंग्रेजी में केवल 'cope with' सही होता है, 'cope up with' बोलना या लिखना पूर्णतः अशुद्ध है।
question_en: Identify the standard idiom: 'It was arduous for the junior clerks to _____ the heavy workload.'
explanation_en: Frequent Indian English Error: The idiom is strictly 'COPE WITH' (meaning to manage or deal successfully with something difficult). The expression 'cope up with' is a non-standard grammatical error.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The old files were properly catalogued and disposed _____ according to archives protocol.'
optionB_hi: of (Disposed of में सिंगल 'f' आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: छुटकारा पाने या निस्तारण करने के लिए 'Dispose OF' (सिंगल 'f') होता है, 'dispose off' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: Fill in the blank: 'The old files were properly catalogued and disposed _____ according to archives protocol.'
explanation_en: Spelling/Preposition trap: The correct phrasal verb meaning to get rid of or sell off is 'DISPOSE OF' (single 'f'), never 'dispose off'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The software developer is familiar _____ Python syntax, but his name is not familiar _____ the panel.'
optionD_hi: with, to (विषय का ज्ञान familiar with, किसी व्यक्ति को परिचित होना familiar to)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी विषय या वस्तु की जानकारी होने पर 'familiar with' और किसी व्यक्ति को ज्ञात होने पर 'familiar to' आता है।
question_en: Select the correct prepositions: 'The software developer is familiar _____ Python syntax, but his name is not familiar _____ the panel.'
explanation_en: A person is 'familiar WITH' a subject or topic ('familiar with the rules'). Something is 'familiar TO' a person ('her voice sounds familiar to me').
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: 'Brought up' का अर्थ क्या है: 'She was brought up by her grandparents in a tranquil village'?
optionA_hi: Reared and educated from childhood (पालन-पोषण करना)
explanation_hi: 'Bring up' (Past: brought up) का अर्थ होता है बच्चे का पालन-पोषण करना या चर्चा में कोई मुद्दा उठाना।
question_en: What is the meaning of 'bring up' in: 'She was brought up by her grandparents in a tranquil village'?
explanation_en: 'Bring up' means to care for and raise a child until maturity. Figuratively, it can also mean to mention a topic during discussion.
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: 'Enter' क्रिया के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionB_hi: The diplomats entered the conference hall at 10 AM. (भौतिक स्थान में प्रवेश हेतु enter के बाद preposition नहीं आता)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी कमरे या इमारत में प्रवेश करने के अर्थ में 'Enter' के बाद 'into' नहीं आता। केवल समझौता या संधि करने में 'enter into an agreement' आता है।
question_en: Spot the correct usage regarding the verb 'enter':
optionA_en: The diplomats were entered the hall.
optionB_en: The diplomats entered the conference hall at 10 AM.
optionC_en: The diplomats entered into the conference hall.
optionD_en: The diplomats entered in the conference hall.
explanation_en: Rule: 'Enter' is a transitive verb that takes no preposition when physically entering a place ('entered the room/hall'). 'Enter into' is only correct figuratively when starting an agreement, contract, or discussion ('entered into a treaty').
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: Passive Voice में रूपांतरित करें: 'Citizens must obey traffic regulations.'
optionA_hi: Traffic regulations must be obeyed by citizens. (modal + be + V3)
optionD_hi: Traffic regulations must have been obeyed.
explanation_hi: Modal Auxiliary क्रियाओं का Passive Voice 'Modal + be + V3' से बनाया जाता है।
question_en: Convert to passive voice: 'Citizens must obey traffic regulations.'
optionA_en: Traffic regulations must be obeyed by citizens.
optionC_en: Traffic regulations are obeyed by citizens.
optionD_en: Traffic regulations must have been obeyed.
explanation_en: Modal Passive structure: 'Subject + Modal Auxiliary (must/can/should) + BE + V3 + by + agent'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'Karan said, "If I had known the reality, I would have intervened."'
optionB_hi: Karan said that if he had known the reality, he would have intervened. (Past Perfect Conditional का काल अपरिवर्तित रहता है)
optionD_hi: Karan said that if he knew...
explanation_hi: भूतकाल की अधूरी शर्त (Third Conditional: had + V3 ... would have + V3) का काल Indirect Speech में नहीं बदलता।
question_en: Convert into indirect speech: 'Karan said, "If I had known the reality, I would have intervened."'
optionA_en: Karan told that if he had had known the reality...
optionB_en: Karan said that if he had known the reality, he would have intervened.
optionC_en: Karan said that if he had known, he will intervene.
optionD_en: Karan said that if he knew the reality, he would intervene.
explanation_en: Third conditional clauses ('had + V3 ... would have + V3') undergo no backshift in tense when converted to indirect speech because Past Perfect represents the deepest past.
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: सही प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'Security protocols prevented unauthorized personnel _____ accessing the main server room.'
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी को कोई काम करने से रोकने के लिए 'Prevent from + V1-ing' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Identify the correct preposition: 'Security protocols prevented unauthorized personnel _____ accessing the main server room.'
explanation_en: Structure: 'Prevent / Prohibit / Restrain someone FROM + doing something (Gerund)'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: 'Resemble' के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionC_hi: The young prodigy resembles her grandmother remarkably. (Resemble के बाद कोई preposition नहीं आता)
optionD_hi: The young prodigy is resembling... (Stative verb)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Resemble' (समान दिखना) के बाद 'to' या 'with' नहीं आता और इसका continuous tense ('is resembling') नहीं बनता।
question_en: Spot the correct grammatical construction for 'resemble':
optionA_en: The young prodigy resembles with her grandmother.
optionB_en: The young prodigy resembles to her grandmother.
optionC_en: The young prodigy resembles her grandmother remarkably.
optionD_en: The young prodigy is resembling her grandmother.
explanation_en: Verbs like 'resemble', 'marry', 'discuss', 'order', and 'accompany' do not take prepositions like 'with' or 'to'. Furthermore, 'resemble' is a stative verb not used in continuous aspect.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The entire faculty congratulated him _____ his stupendous achievement in the civil services exam.'
optionB_hi: on (Congratulate के बाद सदैव on आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Congratulate' और 'Congratulations' के बाद हमेशा 'ON' आता है, 'for' लगाना सामान्य परीक्षा त्रुटि है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: 'The entire faculty congratulated him _____ his stupendous achievement in the civil services exam.'
explanation_en: Fixed Preposition: The verb 'congratulate' (and noun 'congratulations') is strictly followed by the preposition 'ON' (congratulate someone ON something), never 'for'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The suspect was accused _____ embezzlement and subsequently charged _____ grand theft.'
optionA_hi: of, with (Accused of तथा Charged with)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी अपराध का आरोप लगने पर 'Accused OF' और औपचारिक कानूनी आरोप तय होने पर 'Charged WITH' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Select the correct prepositions: 'The suspect was accused _____ embezzlement and subsequently charged _____ grand theft.'
explanation_en: Fixed Preposition pair: One is 'accused OF' a crime, but 'charged WITH' a crime. Similarly: guilty of, convicted of.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] वाक्य पूरा करें: 'Physicians strongly advise patients to abstain _____ processed sugar and tobacco.'
optionA_hi: from (Abstain, Refrain के साथ from का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: बचने या परहेज करने वाले शब्द (Abstain, Refrain, Prevent, Prohibit) के बाद हमेशा 'from' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Complete the advice: 'Physicians strongly advise patients to abstain _____ processed sugar and tobacco.'
explanation_en: Verbs denoting avoidance or separation ('abstain', 'refrain', 'prevent', 'prohibit', 'deter', 'desist') take the fixed preposition 'FROM' followed by a gerund or noun.
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Though he is junior _____ me in service, he is technically superior _____ solving algorithmic challenges.'
optionA_hi: to, at (Junior to तथा proficient/superior at)
explanation_hi: लैटिन तुलनात्मक शब्द (Junior, Senior, Superior, Inferior) के बाद 'than' कभी नहीं आता, सदैव 'to' आता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Fill in the blank: 'Though he is junior _____ me in service, he is technically superior _____ solving algorithmic challenges.'
explanation_en: Comparative adjectives ending in '-ior' (junior, senior, superior, inferior, anterior, posterior) are followed by 'TO', never 'than'. Being skilled at a task takes 'at' / 'in'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'His multinational firm deals _____ pharmaceutical exports, but he knows how to deal _____ difficult clients.'
optionB_hi: in, with (व्यापार हेतु Deal in, व्यवहार/निपटने हेतु Deal with)
explanation_hi: अंतर: किसी वस्तु का व्यापार करने के लिए 'Deal in' आता है, जबकि किसी व्यक्ति से व्यवहार करने या समस्या से निपटने के लिए 'Deal with' आता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Choose the correct preposition: 'His multinational firm deals _____ pharmaceutical exports, but he knows how to deal _____ difficult clients.'
explanation_en: 'Deal in' means to trade in a commodity/business ('deals in textiles/medicines'). 'Deal with' means to handle, interact with, or address someone or something.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] सही प्रीपोजिशन चुनें: 'The veteran soldier is blind _____ the left eye, but the doting father is blind _____ his son's shortcomings.'
optionA_hi: in, to (शारीरिक आंख से अंधा blind in, दोषों के प्रति अनदेखा blind to)
explanation_hi: शारीरिक रूप से किसी आंख से अंधा होने पर 'blind in/of the eye' और दोषों या गलतियों को अनदेखा करने पर 'blind to' आता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Select the appropriate prepositions: 'The veteran soldier is blind _____ the left eye, but the doting father is blind _____ his son's shortcomings.'
explanation_en: Physical sight loss in an eye: 'blind IN an eye' (or 'blind of'). Figurative ignorance of faults: 'blind TO someone's faults'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] रद्द करने (cancel) के अर्थ में प्रयुक्त फ्रेजल वर्ब चुनें: 'Due to adverse meteorological conditions, the rescue operation was _____.'
explanation_hi: 'Call off' का अर्थ होता है किसी कार्यक्रम या अभियान को रद्द करना (Cancel)।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Identify the phrasal verb meaning 'to cancel': 'Due to adverse meteorological conditions, the rescue operation was _____.'
explanation_en: 'Call off' means to cancel an event or mission. 'Call on' means to visit someone. 'Call for' means to demand or require.
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] 'Put up with' का अर्थ क्या है: 'She refused to put up with his unruly tantrums any longer'?
explanation_hi: 'Put up with' का अर्थ होता है किसी अप्रिय व्यवहार या स्थिति को सहन या बर्दाश्त करना (Tolerate)।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] What does the phrasal verb 'put up with' convey in: 'She refused to put up with his unruly tantrums any longer'?
explanation_en: The three-word phrasal verb 'put up with' means to tolerate or endure an unpleasant situation or behavior patiently.
examTag: State PCS General English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] जांच करने के अर्थ में सही फ्रेजल वर्ब भरें: 'The magistrate constituted a special committee to _____ allegations of financial irregularities.'
explanation_hi: 'Look into' का अर्थ होता है किसी मामले या आरोप की जांच-पड़ताल (Investigate) करना।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Fill in the blank: 'The magistrate constituted a special committee to _____ allegations of financial irregularities.'
explanation_en: 'Look into' means to investigate or examine the facts of a situation. 'Look after' means to take care of someone.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] उचित फ्रेजल वर्ब युग्म चुनें: 'Riots _____ in the border district, while our transport vehicle _____ on the highway.'
optionD_hi: broke out, broke down (दंगे भड़कना broke out, वाहन खराब होना broke down)
explanation_hi: दंगा, आग या बीमारी अचानक फैलने के लिए 'Break out' और गाड़ी/मशीनरी खराब होने के लिए 'Break down' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Select the correct pair: 'Riots _____ in the border district, while our transport vehicle _____ on the highway.'
explanation_en: 'Break out' means to start suddenly (wars, epidemic diseases, riots, fire). 'Break down' means mechanical failure of machinery/vehicles, or collapsing emotionally.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] Passive Voice में बदलें: 'The civil engineers are constructing a high-speed railway viaduct.'
optionA_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct is being constructed by the civil engineers. (is being + V3)
optionB_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct is constructed...
optionC_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct has been constructed...
optionD_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct was constructed...
explanation_hi: Present Continuous टेंस का Passive Voice बनाते समय 'is/am/are + being + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Convert to Passive Voice: 'The civil engineers are constructing a high-speed railway viaduct.'
optionA_en: A high-speed railway viaduct is being constructed by the civil engineers.
optionB_en: A high-speed railway viaduct is constructed by the engineers.
optionC_en: A high-speed railway viaduct has been constructed by the engineers.
optionD_en: A high-speed railway viaduct was constructed by the civil engineers.
explanation_en: Present Continuous Passive transformation: 'Subject + is/am/are + BEING + V3 (past participle) + by + agent'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] आदेशात्मक वाक्य का Passive Voice बनाएं: 'Shut the front gate immediately.'
optionA_hi: You are requested to shut the gate.
optionB_hi: The front gate should be shut...
optionC_hi: Let the front gate be shut immediately. (Let + Object + be + V3)
explanation_hi: आज्ञा या आदेश वाले वाक्यों का Passive Voice 'Let + Object + be + V3' संरचना से बनाया जाता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Convert the imperative command into passive: 'Shut the front gate immediately.'
optionA_en: You are requested to shut the gate.
optionB_en: The front gate should be shut by you immediately.
optionC_en: Let the front gate be shut immediately.
explanation_en: Imperative Order Passive formula: 'LET + Object + BE + V3'. 'Shut' has identical base and past participle forms (shut-shut-shut).
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] Passive Voice में परिवर्तित करें: 'Everyone in the academic community knows Professor Sen.'
optionA_hi: Professor Sen is known to everyone in the academic community. (Know के बाद to आता है, by नहीं)
optionB_hi: Professor Sen was known to everyone.
optionC_hi: Professor Sen is known by everyone...
optionD_hi: Professor Sen has been known with everyone.
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Know' क्रिया के Passive Voice में 'by' के स्थान पर 'to' (known to) का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Convert to passive: 'Everyone in the academic community knows Professor Sen.'
optionA_en: Professor Sen is known to everyone in the academic community.
optionB_en: Professor Sen was known to everyone.
optionC_en: Professor Sen is known by everyone in the academic community.
optionD_en: Professor Sen has been known with everyone.
explanation_en: Prepositional Passive Exception: The verb 'know' takes 'TO' in passive voice (known TO), never 'by'. Similarly: surprised AT, pleased WITH, astonished AT, satisfied WITH.
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] अर्ध-कर्मवाच्य (Quasi-passive) का सही रूपांतरण पहचानें: 'Quinine tastes bitter.'
optionB_hi: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted. (Quasi-passive मानक संरचना)
explanation_hi: Quasi-passive नियम: स्वाद या गंध बताने वाले वाक्यों का पैसिव 'Subject + is + adjective + when it is + V3' से बनता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Identify the standard passive conversion of: 'Quinine tastes bitter.'
optionB_en: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.
explanation_en: Quasi-passive / Middle voice verbs of perception (taste, smell, feel): 'Subject + verb (be) + adjective + when it is/they are + V3'. 'Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.'
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] Passive Voice बनाएं: 'The audience laughed at the comic performer.'
optionA_hi: The comic performer was laughed at by the audience. (फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन 'at' क्रिया के साथ रहेगा)
optionB_hi: The audience was laughed at by the performer.
optionC_hi: The comic performer laughed at the audience.
optionD_hi: The comic performer was laughed by the audience.
explanation_hi: नियम: जब Active voice में क्रिया के साथ Preposition जुड़ा हो (laughed at), तो Passive voice में भी वह Preposition क्रिया के ठीक साथ रहता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Convert to passive: 'The audience laughed at the comic performer.'
optionA_en: The comic performer was laughed at by the audience.
optionB_en: The audience was laughed at by the performer.
optionC_en: The comic performer laughed at the audience.
optionD_en: The comic performer was laughed by the audience.
explanation_en: Prepositional Verb Passive: When a verb takes an inseparable preposition ('laughed at', 'looked after', 'aimed at'), the preposition MUST be retained right after V3 in the passive.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'The geography professor said, "The earth revolves around the sun."'
optionB_hi: The geography professor said that the earth revolves around the sun. (सार्वभौमिक सत्य का काल नहीं बदलता)
optionC_hi: The geography professor said that the earth had revolved...
optionD_hi: The geography professor said that the earth revolved...
explanation_hi: नियम: यदि Reported Speech में कोई सार्वभौमिक सत्य (Universal Truth), ऐतिहासिक तथ्य या वैज्ञानिक नियम हो, तो Reporting verb भूतकाल में होने पर भी काल नहीं बदलता।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Convert to Indirect Speech: 'The geography professor said, "The earth revolves around the sun."'
optionA_en: The geography professor told that the earth was revolving.
optionB_en: The geography professor said that the earth revolves around the sun.
optionC_en: The geography professor said that the earth had revolved around the sun.
optionD_en: The geography professor said that the earth revolved around the sun.
explanation_en: Universal Truth / Scientific Fact Exception: When reported speech expresses a universal truth, habitual action, or scientific law, the tense of the reported clause remains in Present Indefinite.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] Indirect Narration में बदलें: 'The investigator said to the witness, "Where did you find the abandoned document?"'
optionA_hi: The investigator asked that where... ('that' का प्रयोग वर्जित)
optionB_hi: The investigator asked where did he find...
optionC_hi: The investigator asked the witness where he had found the abandoned document. (did find बदलता है had found में तथा साधारण पदक्रम)
optionD_hi: The investigator enquired where he found...
explanation_hi: नियम: Wh- प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में 'that' नहीं आता, wh-शब्द ही योजक बनता है; वाक्य साधारण (Assertive) बनता है और Past Indefinite बदलकर Past Perfect (had + V3) हो जाता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Transform into indirect narration: 'The investigator said to the witness, "Where did you find the abandoned document?"'
optionA_en: The investigator asked the witness that where he had found the document.
optionB_en: The investigator asked the witness where did he find the abandoned document.
optionC_en: The investigator asked the witness where he had found the abandoned document.
optionD_en: The investigator enquired where he found the abandoned document.
explanation_en: Rules for Wh-questions: 1. 'Said to' becomes 'asked'. 2. No conjunction 'that' is used; the wh-word itself acts as connector. 3. Word order becomes assertive (Subject + Verb). 4. Past Indefinite ('did find') changes to Past Perfect ('had found').
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'Rohit said to me, "Can you solve this complex equation?"'
optionA_hi: Rohit asked me if I could solve that complex equation. (if + I could + that)
optionB_hi: Rohit enquired me that I can...
optionD_hi: Rohit told me that if I could...
explanation_hi: Yes/No प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में योजक 'if' या 'whether' आता है, 'can' का 'could' होता है और 'this' का 'that' हो जाता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Convert to indirect speech: 'Rohit said to me, "Can you solve this complex equation?"'
optionA_en: Rohit asked me if I could solve that complex equation.
optionB_en: Rohit enquired me that I can solve that equation.
optionC_en: Rohit asked me whether could I solve that equation.
optionD_en: Rohit told me that if I could solve this equation.
explanation_en: Auxiliary Yes/No questions: 1. Conjunction 'if' or 'whether' is used. 2. 'Can' shifts to past modal 'could'. 3. Demonstrative 'this' changes to 'that'. 4. Word order is assertive.
examTag: State PCS General English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] Indirect Narration में बदलें: 'The doctor said to the patient, "Take these medicines regularly and avoid cold water."'
optionA_hi: The doctor advised the patient to take those medicines regularly and to avoid cold water. (advised + to + V1 + those)
optionD_hi: The doctor told to take these...
explanation_hi: आदेशात्मक या सलाह वाले वाक्यों में 'said to' को 'advised/ordered' में बदलते हैं, क्रिया से पहले 'to' जोड़ते हैं और 'these' का 'those' हो जाता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Convert to indirect narration: 'The doctor said to the patient, "Take these medicines regularly and avoid cold water."'
optionA_en: The doctor advised the patient to take those medicines regularly and to avoid cold water.
optionB_en: The doctor said that patient should take medicines.
optionC_en: The doctor ordered the patient that take these medicines.
optionD_en: The doctor told the patient to take these medicines.
explanation_en: Imperative Speech transformation: Reporting verb becomes 'advised', 'ordered', or 'requested'. The imperative verb is replaced by an infinitive ('to take'). Demonstrative 'these' changes to 'those'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'The captain said, "Hurrah! We have won the championship trophy!"'
optionA_hi: The captain exclaimed with joy that they had won the championship trophy. (exclaimed with joy + that they had won)
optionC_hi: The captain exclaimed that they have won...
explanation_hi: 'Hurrah' विस्मयबोधक शब्द को 'exclaimed with joy' में बदलते हैं, 'that' लगाते हैं और 'have won' का 'had won' हो जाता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Change into indirect speech: 'The captain said, "Hurrah! We have won the championship trophy!"'
optionA_en: The captain exclaimed with joy that they had won the championship trophy.
optionB_en: The captain shouted that we had won the trophy.
optionC_en: The captain exclaimed that they have won the championship trophy.
optionD_en: The captain said with happiness that we won the trophy.
explanation_en: Exclamations with 'Hurrah' become 'exclaimed with joy that...'. Present Perfect 'have won' shifts to Past Perfect 'had won', and pronoun 'we' changes to 'they'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The patient died _____ cancer, while many miners died _____ exhaustion and asphyxiation.'
optionC_hi: of, from (बीमारी से मृत्यु Die of, थकान/कारण से मृत्यु Die from)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी बीमारी से मरने पर 'die OF' (die of disease) और बाहरी कारण, भूख या थकान से मरने पर 'die FROM' आता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Select the correct prepositions: 'The patient died _____ cancer, while many miners died _____ exhaustion and asphyxiation.'
explanation_en: Cause of death nuance: Dying of a specific disease = 'die OF cancer/cholera'. Dying from an external cause or overwork = 'die FROM hunger/overwork/exhaustion'. Dying in battle = 'die IN harness/action'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] शुद्ध वाक्यांश चुनें: 'It was arduous for the junior clerks to _____ the heavy workload.'
optionA_hi: cope with (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cope up with' सर्वथा अशुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: परीक्षाओं में बार-बार पूछी जाने वाली त्रुटि: मानक अंग्रेजी में केवल 'cope with' सही होता है, 'cope up with' बोलना या लिखना पूर्णतः अशुद्ध है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Identify the standard idiom: 'It was arduous for the junior clerks to _____ the heavy workload.'
explanation_en: Frequent Indian English Error: The idiom is strictly 'COPE WITH' (meaning to manage or deal successfully with something difficult). The expression 'cope up with' is a non-standard grammatical error.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The old files were properly catalogued and disposed _____ according to archives protocol.'
optionB_hi: of (Disposed of में सिंगल 'f' आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: छुटकारा पाने या निस्तारण करने के लिए 'Dispose OF' (सिंगल 'f') होता है, 'dispose off' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Fill in the blank: 'The old files were properly catalogued and disposed _____ according to archives protocol.'
explanation_en: Spelling/Preposition trap: The correct phrasal verb meaning to get rid of or sell off is 'DISPOSE OF' (single 'f'), never 'dispose off'.
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The software developer is familiar _____ Python syntax, but his name is not familiar _____ the panel.'
optionD_hi: with, to (विषय का ज्ञान familiar with, किसी व्यक्ति को परिचित होना familiar to)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी विषय या वस्तु की जानकारी होने पर 'familiar with' और किसी व्यक्ति को ज्ञात होने पर 'familiar to' आता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Select the correct prepositions: 'The software developer is familiar _____ Python syntax, but his name is not familiar _____ the panel.'
explanation_en: A person is 'familiar WITH' a subject or topic ('familiar with the rules'). Something is 'familiar TO' a person ('her voice sounds familiar to me').
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] 'Brought up' का अर्थ क्या है: 'She was brought up by her grandparents in a tranquil village'?
optionB_hi: Reared and educated from childhood (पालन-पोषण करना)
explanation_hi: 'Bring up' (Past: brought up) का अर्थ होता है बच्चे का पालन-पोषण करना या चर्चा में कोई मुद्दा उठाना।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] What is the meaning of 'bring up' in: 'She was brought up by her grandparents in a tranquil village'?
explanation_en: 'Bring up' means to care for and raise a child until maturity. Figuratively, it can also mean to mention a topic during discussion.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] 'Enter' क्रिया के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionD_hi: The diplomats entered the conference hall at 10 AM. (भौतिक स्थान में प्रवेश हेतु enter के बाद preposition नहीं आता)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी कमरे या इमारत में प्रवेश करने के अर्थ में 'Enter' के बाद 'into' नहीं आता। केवल समझौता या संधि करने में 'enter into an agreement' आता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Spot the correct usage regarding the verb 'enter':
optionA_en: The diplomats entered in the conference hall.
optionB_en: The diplomats entered into the conference hall.
optionC_en: The diplomats were entered the hall.
optionD_en: The diplomats entered the conference hall at 10 AM.
explanation_en: Rule: 'Enter' is a transitive verb that takes no preposition when physically entering a place ('entered the room/hall'). 'Enter into' is only correct figuratively when starting an agreement, contract, or discussion ('entered into a treaty').
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] Passive Voice में रूपांतरित करें: 'Citizens must obey traffic regulations.'
optionC_hi: Traffic regulations must be obeyed by citizens. (modal + be + V3)
optionD_hi: Traffic regulations must have been obeyed.
explanation_hi: Modal Auxiliary क्रियाओं का Passive Voice 'Modal + be + V3' से बनाया जाता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Convert to passive voice: 'Citizens must obey traffic regulations.'
optionB_en: Traffic regulations are obeyed by citizens.
optionC_en: Traffic regulations must be obeyed by citizens.
optionD_en: Traffic regulations must have been obeyed.
explanation_en: Modal Passive structure: 'Subject + Modal Auxiliary (must/can/should) + BE + V3 + by + agent'.
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'Karan said, "If I had known the reality, I would have intervened."'
optionA_hi: Karan said that if he knew...
optionC_hi: Karan said that if he had known the reality, he would have intervened. (Past Perfect Conditional का काल अपरिवर्तित रहता है)
explanation_hi: भूतकाल की अधूरी शर्त (Third Conditional: had + V3 ... would have + V3) का काल Indirect Speech में नहीं बदलता।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Convert into indirect speech: 'Karan said, "If I had known the reality, I would have intervened."'
optionA_en: Karan said that if he knew the reality, he would intervene.
optionB_en: Karan said that if he had known, he will intervene.
optionC_en: Karan said that if he had known the reality, he would have intervened.
optionD_en: Karan told that if he had had known the reality...
explanation_en: Third conditional clauses ('had + V3 ... would have + V3') undergo no backshift in tense when converted to indirect speech because Past Perfect represents the deepest past.
examTag: State PCS General English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] सही प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'Security protocols prevented unauthorized personnel _____ accessing the main server room.'
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी को कोई काम करने से रोकने के लिए 'Prevent from + V1-ing' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Identify the correct preposition: 'Security protocols prevented unauthorized personnel _____ accessing the main server room.'
explanation_en: Structure: 'Prevent / Prohibit / Restrain someone FROM + doing something (Gerund)'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन एवं फ्रेजल वर्ब विशेषांक] 'Resemble' के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionB_hi: The young prodigy is resembling... (Stative verb)
optionD_hi: The young prodigy resembles her grandmother remarkably. (Resemble के बाद कोई preposition नहीं आता)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Resemble' (समान दिखना) के बाद 'to' या 'with' नहीं आता और इसका continuous tense ('is resembling') नहीं बनता।
question_en: [Fixed Prepositions & Phrasal Verbs Special] Spot the correct grammatical construction for 'resemble':
optionA_en: The young prodigy resembles with her grandmother.
optionB_en: The young prodigy is resembling her grandmother.
optionC_en: The young prodigy resembles to her grandmother.
optionD_en: The young prodigy resembles her grandmother remarkably.
explanation_en: Verbs like 'resemble', 'marry', 'discuss', 'order', and 'accompany' do not take prepositions like 'with' or 'to'. Furthermore, 'resemble' is a stative verb not used in continuous aspect.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The entire faculty congratulated him _____ his stupendous achievement in the civil services exam.'
optionB_hi: on (Congratulate के बाद सदैव on आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Congratulate' और 'Congratulations' के बाद हमेशा 'ON' आता है, 'for' लगाना सामान्य परीक्षा त्रुटि है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: 'The entire faculty congratulated him _____ his stupendous achievement in the civil services exam.'
explanation_en: Fixed Preposition: The verb 'congratulate' (and noun 'congratulations') is strictly followed by the preposition 'ON' (congratulate someone ON something), never 'for'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The suspect was accused _____ embezzlement and subsequently charged _____ grand theft.'
optionC_hi: of, with (Accused of तथा Charged with)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी अपराध का आरोप लगने पर 'Accused OF' और औपचारिक कानूनी आरोप तय होने पर 'Charged WITH' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Select the correct prepositions: 'The suspect was accused _____ embezzlement and subsequently charged _____ grand theft.'
explanation_en: Fixed Preposition pair: One is 'accused OF' a crime, but 'charged WITH' a crime. Similarly: guilty of, convicted of.
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: वाक्य पूरा करें: 'Physicians strongly advise patients to abstain _____ processed sugar and tobacco.'
optionB_hi: from (Abstain, Refrain के साथ from का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: बचने या परहेज करने वाले शब्द (Abstain, Refrain, Prevent, Prohibit) के बाद हमेशा 'from' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Complete the advice: 'Physicians strongly advise patients to abstain _____ processed sugar and tobacco.'
explanation_en: Verbs denoting avoidance or separation ('abstain', 'refrain', 'prevent', 'prohibit', 'deter', 'desist') take the fixed preposition 'FROM' followed by a gerund or noun.
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Though he is junior _____ me in service, he is technically superior _____ solving algorithmic challenges.'
optionB_hi: to, at (Junior to तथा proficient/superior at)
explanation_hi: लैटिन तुलनात्मक शब्द (Junior, Senior, Superior, Inferior) के बाद 'than' कभी नहीं आता, सदैव 'to' आता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Fill in the blank: 'Though he is junior _____ me in service, he is technically superior _____ solving algorithmic challenges.'
explanation_en: Comparative adjectives ending in '-ior' (junior, senior, superior, inferior, anterior, posterior) are followed by 'TO', never 'than'. Being skilled at a task takes 'at' / 'in'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'His multinational firm deals _____ pharmaceutical exports, but he knows how to deal _____ difficult clients.'
optionC_hi: in, with (व्यापार हेतु Deal in, व्यवहार/निपटने हेतु Deal with)
explanation_hi: अंतर: किसी वस्तु का व्यापार करने के लिए 'Deal in' आता है, जबकि किसी व्यक्ति से व्यवहार करने या समस्या से निपटने के लिए 'Deal with' आता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Choose the correct preposition: 'His multinational firm deals _____ pharmaceutical exports, but he knows how to deal _____ difficult clients.'
explanation_en: 'Deal in' means to trade in a commodity/business ('deals in textiles/medicines'). 'Deal with' means to handle, interact with, or address someone or something.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: सही प्रीपोजिशन चुनें: 'The veteran soldier is blind _____ the left eye, but the doting father is blind _____ his son's shortcomings.'
optionA_hi: in, to (शारीरिक आंख से अंधा blind in, दोषों के प्रति अनदेखा blind to)
explanation_hi: शारीरिक रूप से किसी आंख से अंधा होने पर 'blind in/of the eye' और दोषों या गलतियों को अनदेखा करने पर 'blind to' आता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Select the appropriate prepositions: 'The veteran soldier is blind _____ the left eye, but the doting father is blind _____ his son's shortcomings.'
explanation_en: Physical sight loss in an eye: 'blind IN an eye' (or 'blind of'). Figurative ignorance of faults: 'blind TO someone's faults'.
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: रद्द करने (cancel) के अर्थ में प्रयुक्त फ्रेजल वर्ब चुनें: 'Due to adverse meteorological conditions, the rescue operation was _____.'
explanation_hi: 'Call off' का अर्थ होता है किसी कार्यक्रम या अभियान को रद्द करना (Cancel)।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Identify the phrasal verb meaning 'to cancel': 'Due to adverse meteorological conditions, the rescue operation was _____.'
explanation_en: 'Call off' means to cancel an event or mission. 'Call on' means to visit someone. 'Call for' means to demand or require.
examTag: State PCS General English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: 'Put up with' का अर्थ क्या है: 'She refused to put up with his unruly tantrums any longer'?
explanation_hi: 'Put up with' का अर्थ होता है किसी अप्रिय व्यवहार या स्थिति को सहन या बर्दाश्त करना (Tolerate)।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: What does the phrasal verb 'put up with' convey in: 'She refused to put up with his unruly tantrums any longer'?
explanation_en: The three-word phrasal verb 'put up with' means to tolerate or endure an unpleasant situation or behavior patiently.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: जांच करने के अर्थ में सही फ्रेजल वर्ब भरें: 'The magistrate constituted a special committee to _____ allegations of financial irregularities.'
explanation_hi: 'Look into' का अर्थ होता है किसी मामले या आरोप की जांच-पड़ताल (Investigate) करना।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Fill in the blank: 'The magistrate constituted a special committee to _____ allegations of financial irregularities.'
explanation_en: 'Look into' means to investigate or examine the facts of a situation. 'Look after' means to take care of someone.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: उचित फ्रेजल वर्ब युग्म चुनें: 'Riots _____ in the border district, while our transport vehicle _____ on the highway.'
optionA_hi: broke out, broke down (दंगे भड़कना broke out, वाहन खराब होना broke down)
explanation_hi: दंगा, आग या बीमारी अचानक फैलने के लिए 'Break out' और गाड़ी/मशीनरी खराब होने के लिए 'Break down' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Select the correct pair: 'Riots _____ in the border district, while our transport vehicle _____ on the highway.'
explanation_en: 'Break out' means to start suddenly (wars, epidemic diseases, riots, fire). 'Break down' means mechanical failure of machinery/vehicles, or collapsing emotionally.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: Passive Voice में बदलें: 'The civil engineers are constructing a high-speed railway viaduct.'
optionA_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct has been constructed...
optionB_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct is constructed...
optionC_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct is being constructed by the civil engineers. (is being + V3)
optionD_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct was constructed...
explanation_hi: Present Continuous टेंस का Passive Voice बनाते समय 'is/am/are + being + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Convert to Passive Voice: 'The civil engineers are constructing a high-speed railway viaduct.'
optionA_en: A high-speed railway viaduct has been constructed by the engineers.
optionB_en: A high-speed railway viaduct is constructed by the engineers.
optionC_en: A high-speed railway viaduct is being constructed by the civil engineers.
optionD_en: A high-speed railway viaduct was constructed by the civil engineers.
explanation_en: Present Continuous Passive transformation: 'Subject + is/am/are + BEING + V3 (past participle) + by + agent'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: आदेशात्मक वाक्य का Passive Voice बनाएं: 'Shut the front gate immediately.'
optionB_hi: Let the front gate be shut immediately. (Let + Object + be + V3)
optionC_hi: The front gate should be shut...
optionD_hi: You are requested to shut the gate.
explanation_hi: आज्ञा या आदेश वाले वाक्यों का Passive Voice 'Let + Object + be + V3' संरचना से बनाया जाता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Convert the imperative command into passive: 'Shut the front gate immediately.'
optionB_en: Let the front gate be shut immediately.
optionC_en: The front gate should be shut by you immediately.
optionD_en: You are requested to shut the gate.
explanation_en: Imperative Order Passive formula: 'LET + Object + BE + V3'. 'Shut' has identical base and past participle forms (shut-shut-shut).
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: Passive Voice में परिवर्तित करें: 'Everyone in the academic community knows Professor Sen.'
optionA_hi: Professor Sen has been known with everyone.
optionB_hi: Professor Sen is known to everyone in the academic community. (Know के बाद to आता है, by नहीं)
optionC_hi: Professor Sen was known to everyone.
optionD_hi: Professor Sen is known by everyone...
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Know' क्रिया के Passive Voice में 'by' के स्थान पर 'to' (known to) का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Convert to passive: 'Everyone in the academic community knows Professor Sen.'
optionA_en: Professor Sen has been known with everyone.
optionB_en: Professor Sen is known to everyone in the academic community.
optionC_en: Professor Sen was known to everyone.
optionD_en: Professor Sen is known by everyone in the academic community.
explanation_en: Prepositional Passive Exception: The verb 'know' takes 'TO' in passive voice (known TO), never 'by'. Similarly: surprised AT, pleased WITH, astonished AT, satisfied WITH.
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: अर्ध-कर्मवाच्य (Quasi-passive) का सही रूपांतरण पहचानें: 'Quinine tastes bitter.'
optionA_hi: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted. (Quasi-passive मानक संरचना)
explanation_hi: Quasi-passive नियम: स्वाद या गंध बताने वाले वाक्यों का पैसिव 'Subject + is + adjective + when it is + V3' से बनता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Identify the standard passive conversion of: 'Quinine tastes bitter.'
optionA_en: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.
explanation_en: Quasi-passive / Middle voice verbs of perception (taste, smell, feel): 'Subject + verb (be) + adjective + when it is/they are + V3'. 'Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.'
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: Passive Voice बनाएं: 'The audience laughed at the comic performer.'
optionA_hi: The audience was laughed at by the performer.
optionB_hi: The comic performer was laughed at by the audience. (फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन 'at' क्रिया के साथ रहेगा)
optionC_hi: The comic performer was laughed by the audience.
optionD_hi: The comic performer laughed at the audience.
explanation_hi: नियम: जब Active voice में क्रिया के साथ Preposition जुड़ा हो (laughed at), तो Passive voice में भी वह Preposition क्रिया के ठीक साथ रहता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Convert to passive: 'The audience laughed at the comic performer.'
optionA_en: The audience was laughed at by the performer.
optionB_en: The comic performer was laughed at by the audience.
optionC_en: The comic performer was laughed by the audience.
optionD_en: The comic performer laughed at the audience.
explanation_en: Prepositional Verb Passive: When a verb takes an inseparable preposition ('laughed at', 'looked after', 'aimed at'), the preposition MUST be retained right after V3 in the passive.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'The geography professor said, "The earth revolves around the sun."'
optionA_hi: The geography professor said that the earth revolved...
optionB_hi: The geography professor said that the earth revolves around the sun. (सार्वभौमिक सत्य का काल नहीं बदलता)
optionD_hi: The geography professor said that the earth had revolved...
explanation_hi: नियम: यदि Reported Speech में कोई सार्वभौमिक सत्य (Universal Truth), ऐतिहासिक तथ्य या वैज्ञानिक नियम हो, तो Reporting verb भूतकाल में होने पर भी काल नहीं बदलता।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Convert to Indirect Speech: 'The geography professor said, "The earth revolves around the sun."'
optionA_en: The geography professor said that the earth revolved around the sun.
optionB_en: The geography professor said that the earth revolves around the sun.
optionC_en: The geography professor told that the earth was revolving.
optionD_en: The geography professor said that the earth had revolved around the sun.
explanation_en: Universal Truth / Scientific Fact Exception: When reported speech expresses a universal truth, habitual action, or scientific law, the tense of the reported clause remains in Present Indefinite.
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: Indirect Narration में बदलें: 'The investigator said to the witness, "Where did you find the abandoned document?"'
optionA_hi: The investigator asked that where... ('that' का प्रयोग वर्जित)
optionB_hi: The investigator enquired where he found...
optionC_hi: The investigator asked where did he find...
optionD_hi: The investigator asked the witness where he had found the abandoned document. (did find बदलता है had found में तथा साधारण पदक्रम)
explanation_hi: नियम: Wh- प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में 'that' नहीं आता, wh-शब्द ही योजक बनता है; वाक्य साधारण (Assertive) बनता है और Past Indefinite बदलकर Past Perfect (had + V3) हो जाता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Transform into indirect narration: 'The investigator said to the witness, "Where did you find the abandoned document?"'
optionA_en: The investigator asked the witness that where he had found the document.
optionB_en: The investigator enquired where he found the abandoned document.
optionC_en: The investigator asked the witness where did he find the abandoned document.
optionD_en: The investigator asked the witness where he had found the abandoned document.
explanation_en: Rules for Wh-questions: 1. 'Said to' becomes 'asked'. 2. No conjunction 'that' is used; the wh-word itself acts as connector. 3. Word order becomes assertive (Subject + Verb). 4. Past Indefinite ('did find') changes to Past Perfect ('had found').
examTag: State PCS General English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'Rohit said to me, "Can you solve this complex equation?"'
optionA_hi: Rohit enquired me that I can...
optionC_hi: Rohit asked me if I could solve that complex equation. (if + I could + that)
optionD_hi: Rohit told me that if I could...
explanation_hi: Yes/No प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में योजक 'if' या 'whether' आता है, 'can' का 'could' होता है और 'this' का 'that' हो जाता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Convert to indirect speech: 'Rohit said to me, "Can you solve this complex equation?"'
optionA_en: Rohit enquired me that I can solve that equation.
optionB_en: Rohit asked me whether could I solve that equation.
optionC_en: Rohit asked me if I could solve that complex equation.
optionD_en: Rohit told me that if I could solve this equation.
explanation_en: Auxiliary Yes/No questions: 1. Conjunction 'if' or 'whether' is used. 2. 'Can' shifts to past modal 'could'. 3. Demonstrative 'this' changes to 'that'. 4. Word order is assertive.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: Indirect Narration में बदलें: 'The doctor said to the patient, "Take these medicines regularly and avoid cold water."'
optionA_hi: The doctor told to take these...
optionB_hi: The doctor advised the patient to take those medicines regularly and to avoid cold water. (advised + to + V1 + those)
explanation_hi: आदेशात्मक या सलाह वाले वाक्यों में 'said to' को 'advised/ordered' में बदलते हैं, क्रिया से पहले 'to' जोड़ते हैं और 'these' का 'those' हो जाता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Convert to indirect narration: 'The doctor said to the patient, "Take these medicines regularly and avoid cold water."'
optionA_en: The doctor told the patient to take these medicines.
optionB_en: The doctor advised the patient to take those medicines regularly and to avoid cold water.
optionC_en: The doctor said that patient should take medicines.
optionD_en: The doctor ordered the patient that take these medicines.
explanation_en: Imperative Speech transformation: Reporting verb becomes 'advised', 'ordered', or 'requested'. The imperative verb is replaced by an infinitive ('to take'). Demonstrative 'these' changes to 'those'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'The captain said, "Hurrah! We have won the championship trophy!"'
optionB_hi: The captain exclaimed with joy that they had won the championship trophy. (exclaimed with joy + that they had won)
optionC_hi: The captain exclaimed that they have won...
explanation_hi: 'Hurrah' विस्मयबोधक शब्द को 'exclaimed with joy' में बदलते हैं, 'that' लगाते हैं और 'have won' का 'had won' हो जाता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Change into indirect speech: 'The captain said, "Hurrah! We have won the championship trophy!"'
optionA_en: The captain said with happiness that we won the trophy.
optionB_en: The captain exclaimed with joy that they had won the championship trophy.
optionC_en: The captain exclaimed that they have won the championship trophy.
optionD_en: The captain shouted that we had won the trophy.
explanation_en: Exclamations with 'Hurrah' become 'exclaimed with joy that...'. Present Perfect 'have won' shifts to Past Perfect 'had won', and pronoun 'we' changes to 'they'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The patient died _____ cancer, while many miners died _____ exhaustion and asphyxiation.'
optionB_hi: of, from (बीमारी से मृत्यु Die of, थकान/कारण से मृत्यु Die from)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी बीमारी से मरने पर 'die OF' (die of disease) और बाहरी कारण, भूख या थकान से मरने पर 'die FROM' आता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Select the correct prepositions: 'The patient died _____ cancer, while many miners died _____ exhaustion and asphyxiation.'
explanation_en: Cause of death nuance: Dying of a specific disease = 'die OF cancer/cholera'. Dying from an external cause or overwork = 'die FROM hunger/overwork/exhaustion'. Dying in battle = 'die IN harness/action'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: शुद्ध वाक्यांश चुनें: 'It was arduous for the junior clerks to _____ the heavy workload.'
optionA_hi: cope with (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cope up with' सर्वथा अशुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: परीक्षाओं में बार-बार पूछी जाने वाली त्रुटि: मानक अंग्रेजी में केवल 'cope with' सही होता है, 'cope up with' बोलना या लिखना पूर्णतः अशुद्ध है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Identify the standard idiom: 'It was arduous for the junior clerks to _____ the heavy workload.'
explanation_en: Frequent Indian English Error: The idiom is strictly 'COPE WITH' (meaning to manage or deal successfully with something difficult). The expression 'cope up with' is a non-standard grammatical error.
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The old files were properly catalogued and disposed _____ according to archives protocol.'
optionA_hi: of (Disposed of में सिंगल 'f' आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: छुटकारा पाने या निस्तारण करने के लिए 'Dispose OF' (सिंगल 'f') होता है, 'dispose off' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Fill in the blank: 'The old files were properly catalogued and disposed _____ according to archives protocol.'
explanation_en: Spelling/Preposition trap: The correct phrasal verb meaning to get rid of or sell off is 'DISPOSE OF' (single 'f'), never 'dispose off'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The software developer is familiar _____ Python syntax, but his name is not familiar _____ the panel.'
optionD_hi: with, to (विषय का ज्ञान familiar with, किसी व्यक्ति को परिचित होना familiar to)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी विषय या वस्तु की जानकारी होने पर 'familiar with' और किसी व्यक्ति को ज्ञात होने पर 'familiar to' आता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Select the correct prepositions: 'The software developer is familiar _____ Python syntax, but his name is not familiar _____ the panel.'
explanation_en: A person is 'familiar WITH' a subject or topic ('familiar with the rules'). Something is 'familiar TO' a person ('her voice sounds familiar to me').
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: 'Brought up' का अर्थ क्या है: 'She was brought up by her grandparents in a tranquil village'?
optionD_hi: Reared and educated from childhood (पालन-पोषण करना)
explanation_hi: 'Bring up' (Past: brought up) का अर्थ होता है बच्चे का पालन-पोषण करना या चर्चा में कोई मुद्दा उठाना।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: What is the meaning of 'bring up' in: 'She was brought up by her grandparents in a tranquil village'?
explanation_en: 'Bring up' means to care for and raise a child until maturity. Figuratively, it can also mean to mention a topic during discussion.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: 'Enter' क्रिया के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionA_hi: The diplomats entered the conference hall at 10 AM. (भौतिक स्थान में प्रवेश हेतु enter के बाद preposition नहीं आता)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी कमरे या इमारत में प्रवेश करने के अर्थ में 'Enter' के बाद 'into' नहीं आता। केवल समझौता या संधि करने में 'enter into an agreement' आता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Spot the correct usage regarding the verb 'enter':
optionA_en: The diplomats entered the conference hall at 10 AM.
optionB_en: The diplomats entered into the conference hall.
optionC_en: The diplomats were entered the hall.
optionD_en: The diplomats entered in the conference hall.
explanation_en: Rule: 'Enter' is a transitive verb that takes no preposition when physically entering a place ('entered the room/hall'). 'Enter into' is only correct figuratively when starting an agreement, contract, or discussion ('entered into a treaty').
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: Passive Voice में रूपांतरित करें: 'Citizens must obey traffic regulations.'
optionA_hi: Traffic regulations must be obeyed by citizens. (modal + be + V3)
optionC_hi: Traffic regulations must have been obeyed.
explanation_hi: Modal Auxiliary क्रियाओं का Passive Voice 'Modal + be + V3' से बनाया जाता है।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Convert to passive voice: 'Citizens must obey traffic regulations.'
optionA_en: Traffic regulations must be obeyed by citizens.
optionB_en: Traffic regulations are obeyed by citizens.
optionC_en: Traffic regulations must have been obeyed.
explanation_en: Modal Passive structure: 'Subject + Modal Auxiliary (must/can/should) + BE + V3 + by + agent'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'Karan said, "If I had known the reality, I would have intervened."'
optionA_hi: Karan said that if he knew...
optionD_hi: Karan said that if he had known the reality, he would have intervened. (Past Perfect Conditional का काल अपरिवर्तित रहता है)
explanation_hi: भूतकाल की अधूरी शर्त (Third Conditional: had + V3 ... would have + V3) का काल Indirect Speech में नहीं बदलता।
question_en: Past Year Active-Passive & Narration Transformation: Convert into indirect speech: 'Karan said, "If I had known the reality, I would have intervened."'
optionA_en: Karan said that if he knew the reality, he would intervene.
optionB_en: Karan said that if he had known, he will intervene.
optionC_en: Karan told that if he had had known the reality...
optionD_en: Karan said that if he had known the reality, he would have intervened.
explanation_en: Third conditional clauses ('had + V3 ... would have + V3') undergo no backshift in tense when converted to indirect speech because Past Perfect represents the deepest past.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के एक्टिव-पैसिव एवं नरेशन प्रश्न: सही प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'Security protocols prevented unauthorized personnel _____ accessing the main server room.'
