question_en: Exam-Oriented Prepositional Collocations: Identify the standard idiom: 'It was arduous for the junior clerks to _____ the heavy workload.'
explanation_en: Frequent Indian English Error: The idiom is strictly 'COPE WITH' (meaning to manage or deal successfully with something difficult). The expression 'cope up with' is a non-standard grammatical error.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं हेतु आवश्यक प्रीपोजिशन: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The old files were properly catalogued and disposed _____ according to archives protocol.'
optionA_hi: of (Disposed of में सिंगल 'f' आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: छुटकारा पाने या निस्तारण करने के लिए 'Dispose OF' (सिंगल 'f') होता है, 'dispose off' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: Exam-Oriented Prepositional Collocations: Fill in the blank: 'The old files were properly catalogued and disposed _____ according to archives protocol.'
explanation_en: Spelling/Preposition trap: The correct phrasal verb meaning to get rid of or sell off is 'DISPOSE OF' (single 'f'), never 'dispose off'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं हेतु आवश्यक प्रीपोजिशन: उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The software developer is familiar _____ Python syntax, but his name is not familiar _____ the panel.'
optionB_hi: with, to (विषय का ज्ञान familiar with, किसी व्यक्ति को परिचित होना familiar to)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी विषय या वस्तु की जानकारी होने पर 'familiar with' और किसी व्यक्ति को ज्ञात होने पर 'familiar to' आता है।
question_en: Exam-Oriented Prepositional Collocations: Select the correct prepositions: 'The software developer is familiar _____ Python syntax, but his name is not familiar _____ the panel.'
explanation_en: A person is 'familiar WITH' a subject or topic ('familiar with the rules'). Something is 'familiar TO' a person ('her voice sounds familiar to me').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं हेतु आवश्यक प्रीपोजिशन: 'Brought up' का अर्थ क्या है: 'She was brought up by her grandparents in a tranquil village'?
optionB_hi: Reared and educated from childhood (पालन-पोषण करना)
explanation_hi: 'Bring up' (Past: brought up) का अर्थ होता है बच्चे का पालन-पोषण करना या चर्चा में कोई मुद्दा उठाना।
question_en: Exam-Oriented Prepositional Collocations: What is the meaning of 'bring up' in: 'She was brought up by her grandparents in a tranquil village'?
explanation_en: 'Bring up' means to care for and raise a child until maturity. Figuratively, it can also mean to mention a topic during discussion.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं हेतु आवश्यक प्रीपोजिशन: 'Enter' क्रिया के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionB_hi: The diplomats entered the conference hall at 10 AM. (भौतिक स्थान में प्रवेश हेतु enter के बाद preposition नहीं आता)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी कमरे या इमारत में प्रवेश करने के अर्थ में 'Enter' के बाद 'into' नहीं आता। केवल समझौता या संधि करने में 'enter into an agreement' आता है।
question_en: Exam-Oriented Prepositional Collocations: Spot the correct usage regarding the verb 'enter':
optionA_en: The diplomats entered in the conference hall.
optionB_en: The diplomats entered the conference hall at 10 AM.
optionC_en: The diplomats entered into the conference hall.
optionD_en: The diplomats were entered the hall.
explanation_en: Rule: 'Enter' is a transitive verb that takes no preposition when physically entering a place ('entered the room/hall'). 'Enter into' is only correct figuratively when starting an agreement, contract, or discussion ('entered into a treaty').
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं हेतु आवश्यक प्रीपोजिशन: Passive Voice में रूपांतरित करें: 'Citizens must obey traffic regulations.'
optionA_hi: Traffic regulations must have been obeyed.
optionB_hi: Traffic regulations must be obeyed by citizens. (modal + be + V3)
explanation_hi: Modal Auxiliary क्रियाओं का Passive Voice 'Modal + be + V3' से बनाया जाता है।
question_en: Exam-Oriented Prepositional Collocations: Convert to passive voice: 'Citizens must obey traffic regulations.'
optionA_en: Traffic regulations must have been obeyed.
optionB_en: Traffic regulations must be obeyed by citizens.
optionD_en: Traffic regulations are obeyed by citizens.
explanation_en: Modal Passive structure: 'Subject + Modal Auxiliary (must/can/should) + BE + V3 + by + agent'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं हेतु आवश्यक प्रीपोजिशन: Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'Karan said, "If I had known the reality, I would have intervened."'
optionC_hi: Karan said that if he had known the reality, he would have intervened. (Past Perfect Conditional का काल अपरिवर्तित रहता है)
optionD_hi: Karan said that if he knew...
explanation_hi: भूतकाल की अधूरी शर्त (Third Conditional: had + V3 ... would have + V3) का काल Indirect Speech में नहीं बदलता।
question_en: Exam-Oriented Prepositional Collocations: Convert into indirect speech: 'Karan said, "If I had known the reality, I would have intervened."'
optionA_en: Karan told that if he had had known the reality...
optionB_en: Karan said that if he had known, he will intervene.
optionC_en: Karan said that if he had known the reality, he would have intervened.
optionD_en: Karan said that if he knew the reality, he would intervene.
explanation_en: Third conditional clauses ('had + V3 ... would have + V3') undergo no backshift in tense when converted to indirect speech because Past Perfect represents the deepest past.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं हेतु आवश्यक प्रीपोजिशन: सही प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'Security protocols prevented unauthorized personnel _____ accessing the main server room.'
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी को कोई काम करने से रोकने के लिए 'Prevent from + V1-ing' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Exam-Oriented Prepositional Collocations: Identify the correct preposition: 'Security protocols prevented unauthorized personnel _____ accessing the main server room.'
explanation_en: Structure: 'Prevent / Prohibit / Restrain someone FROM + doing something (Gerund)'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं हेतु आवश्यक प्रीपोजिशन: 'Resemble' के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionA_hi: The young prodigy is resembling... (Stative verb)
optionD_hi: The young prodigy resembles her grandmother remarkably. (Resemble के बाद कोई preposition नहीं आता)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Resemble' (समान दिखना) के बाद 'to' या 'with' नहीं आता और इसका continuous tense ('is resembling') नहीं बनता।
question_en: Exam-Oriented Prepositional Collocations: Spot the correct grammatical construction for 'resemble':
optionA_en: The young prodigy is resembling her grandmother.
optionB_en: The young prodigy resembles to her grandmother.
optionC_en: The young prodigy resembles with her grandmother.
optionD_en: The young prodigy resembles her grandmother remarkably.
explanation_en: Verbs like 'resemble', 'marry', 'discuss', 'order', and 'accompany' do not take prepositions like 'with' or 'to'. Furthermore, 'resemble' is a stative verb not used in continuous aspect.
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The entire faculty congratulated him _____ his stupendous achievement in the civil services exam.'
optionD_hi: on (Congratulate के बाद सदैव on आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Congratulate' और 'Congratulations' के बाद हमेशा 'ON' आता है, 'for' लगाना सामान्य परीक्षा त्रुटि है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: 'The entire faculty congratulated him _____ his stupendous achievement in the civil services exam.'
explanation_en: Fixed Preposition: The verb 'congratulate' (and noun 'congratulations') is strictly followed by the preposition 'ON' (congratulate someone ON something), never 'for'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The suspect was accused _____ embezzlement and subsequently charged _____ grand theft.'
optionA_hi: of, with (Accused of तथा Charged with)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी अपराध का आरोप लगने पर 'Accused OF' और औपचारिक कानूनी आरोप तय होने पर 'Charged WITH' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Select the correct prepositions: 'The suspect was accused _____ embezzlement and subsequently charged _____ grand theft.'
explanation_en: Fixed Preposition pair: One is 'accused OF' a crime, but 'charged WITH' a crime. Similarly: guilty of, convicted of.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] वाक्य पूरा करें: 'Physicians strongly advise patients to abstain _____ processed sugar and tobacco.'
optionB_hi: from (Abstain, Refrain के साथ from का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: बचने या परहेज करने वाले शब्द (Abstain, Refrain, Prevent, Prohibit) के बाद हमेशा 'from' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Complete the advice: 'Physicians strongly advise patients to abstain _____ processed sugar and tobacco.'
explanation_en: Verbs denoting avoidance or separation ('abstain', 'refrain', 'prevent', 'prohibit', 'deter', 'desist') take the fixed preposition 'FROM' followed by a gerund or noun.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Though he is junior _____ me in service, he is technically superior _____ solving algorithmic challenges.'
optionA_hi: to, at (Junior to तथा proficient/superior at)
explanation_hi: लैटिन तुलनात्मक शब्द (Junior, Senior, Superior, Inferior) के बाद 'than' कभी नहीं आता, सदैव 'to' आता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Fill in the blank: 'Though he is junior _____ me in service, he is technically superior _____ solving algorithmic challenges.'
explanation_en: Comparative adjectives ending in '-ior' (junior, senior, superior, inferior, anterior, posterior) are followed by 'TO', never 'than'. Being skilled at a task takes 'at' / 'in'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'His multinational firm deals _____ pharmaceutical exports, but he knows how to deal _____ difficult clients.'
optionA_hi: in, with (व्यापार हेतु Deal in, व्यवहार/निपटने हेतु Deal with)
explanation_hi: अंतर: किसी वस्तु का व्यापार करने के लिए 'Deal in' आता है, जबकि किसी व्यक्ति से व्यवहार करने या समस्या से निपटने के लिए 'Deal with' आता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Choose the correct preposition: 'His multinational firm deals _____ pharmaceutical exports, but he knows how to deal _____ difficult clients.'
explanation_en: 'Deal in' means to trade in a commodity/business ('deals in textiles/medicines'). 'Deal with' means to handle, interact with, or address someone or something.
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] सही प्रीपोजिशन चुनें: 'The veteran soldier is blind _____ the left eye, but the doting father is blind _____ his son's shortcomings.'
optionC_hi: in, to (शारीरिक आंख से अंधा blind in, दोषों के प्रति अनदेखा blind to)
explanation_hi: शारीरिक रूप से किसी आंख से अंधा होने पर 'blind in/of the eye' और दोषों या गलतियों को अनदेखा करने पर 'blind to' आता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Select the appropriate prepositions: 'The veteran soldier is blind _____ the left eye, but the doting father is blind _____ his son's shortcomings.'
explanation_en: Physical sight loss in an eye: 'blind IN an eye' (or 'blind of'). Figurative ignorance of faults: 'blind TO someone's faults'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] रद्द करने (cancel) के अर्थ में प्रयुक्त फ्रेजल वर्ब चुनें: 'Due to adverse meteorological conditions, the rescue operation was _____.'
explanation_hi: 'Call off' का अर्थ होता है किसी कार्यक्रम या अभियान को रद्द करना (Cancel)।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Identify the phrasal verb meaning 'to cancel': 'Due to adverse meteorological conditions, the rescue operation was _____.'
explanation_en: 'Call off' means to cancel an event or mission. 'Call on' means to visit someone. 'Call for' means to demand or require.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] 'Put up with' का अर्थ क्या है: 'She refused to put up with his unruly tantrums any longer'?
explanation_hi: 'Put up with' का अर्थ होता है किसी अप्रिय व्यवहार या स्थिति को सहन या बर्दाश्त करना (Tolerate)।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] What does the phrasal verb 'put up with' convey in: 'She refused to put up with his unruly tantrums any longer'?
explanation_en: The three-word phrasal verb 'put up with' means to tolerate or endure an unpleasant situation or behavior patiently.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] जांच करने के अर्थ में सही फ्रेजल वर्ब भरें: 'The magistrate constituted a special committee to _____ allegations of financial irregularities.'
explanation_hi: 'Look into' का अर्थ होता है किसी मामले या आरोप की जांच-पड़ताल (Investigate) करना।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Fill in the blank: 'The magistrate constituted a special committee to _____ allegations of financial irregularities.'
explanation_en: 'Look into' means to investigate or examine the facts of a situation. 'Look after' means to take care of someone.
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] उचित फ्रेजल वर्ब युग्म चुनें: 'Riots _____ in the border district, while our transport vehicle _____ on the highway.'
optionC_hi: broke out, broke down (दंगे भड़कना broke out, वाहन खराब होना broke down)
explanation_hi: दंगा, आग या बीमारी अचानक फैलने के लिए 'Break out' और गाड़ी/मशीनरी खराब होने के लिए 'Break down' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Select the correct pair: 'Riots _____ in the border district, while our transport vehicle _____ on the highway.'
explanation_en: 'Break out' means to start suddenly (wars, epidemic diseases, riots, fire). 'Break down' means mechanical failure of machinery/vehicles, or collapsing emotionally.
examTag: State PCS General English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] Passive Voice में बदलें: 'The civil engineers are constructing a high-speed railway viaduct.'
optionA_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct is constructed...
optionB_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct has been constructed...
optionC_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct is being constructed by the civil engineers. (is being + V3)
optionD_hi: A high-speed railway viaduct was constructed...
explanation_hi: Present Continuous टेंस का Passive Voice बनाते समय 'is/am/are + being + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Convert to Passive Voice: 'The civil engineers are constructing a high-speed railway viaduct.'
optionA_en: A high-speed railway viaduct is constructed by the engineers.
optionB_en: A high-speed railway viaduct has been constructed by the engineers.
optionC_en: A high-speed railway viaduct is being constructed by the civil engineers.
optionD_en: A high-speed railway viaduct was constructed by the civil engineers.
explanation_en: Present Continuous Passive transformation: 'Subject + is/am/are + BEING + V3 (past participle) + by + agent'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] आदेशात्मक वाक्य का Passive Voice बनाएं: 'Shut the front gate immediately.'
optionA_hi: You are requested to shut the gate.
optionB_hi: Let the front gate be shut immediately. (Let + Object + be + V3)
optionD_hi: The front gate should be shut...
explanation_hi: आज्ञा या आदेश वाले वाक्यों का Passive Voice 'Let + Object + be + V3' संरचना से बनाया जाता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Convert the imperative command into passive: 'Shut the front gate immediately.'
optionA_en: You are requested to shut the gate.
optionB_en: Let the front gate be shut immediately.
optionD_en: The front gate should be shut by you immediately.
explanation_en: Imperative Order Passive formula: 'LET + Object + BE + V3'. 'Shut' has identical base and past participle forms (shut-shut-shut).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] Passive Voice में परिवर्तित करें: 'Everyone in the academic community knows Professor Sen.'
optionA_hi: Professor Sen was known to everyone.
optionB_hi: Professor Sen is known to everyone in the academic community. (Know के बाद to आता है, by नहीं)
optionC_hi: Professor Sen is known by everyone...
optionD_hi: Professor Sen has been known with everyone.
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Know' क्रिया के Passive Voice में 'by' के स्थान पर 'to' (known to) का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Convert to passive: 'Everyone in the academic community knows Professor Sen.'
optionA_en: Professor Sen was known to everyone.
optionB_en: Professor Sen is known to everyone in the academic community.
optionC_en: Professor Sen is known by everyone in the academic community.
optionD_en: Professor Sen has been known with everyone.
explanation_en: Prepositional Passive Exception: The verb 'know' takes 'TO' in passive voice (known TO), never 'by'. Similarly: surprised AT, pleased WITH, astonished AT, satisfied WITH.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] अर्ध-कर्मवाच्य (Quasi-passive) का सही रूपांतरण पहचानें: 'Quinine tastes bitter.'
optionB_hi: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted. (Quasi-passive मानक संरचना)
explanation_hi: Quasi-passive नियम: स्वाद या गंध बताने वाले वाक्यों का पैसिव 'Subject + is + adjective + when it is + V3' से बनता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Identify the standard passive conversion of: 'Quinine tastes bitter.'
optionB_en: Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.
explanation_en: Quasi-passive / Middle voice verbs of perception (taste, smell, feel): 'Subject + verb (be) + adjective + when it is/they are + V3'. 'Quinine is bitter when it is tasted.'
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] Passive Voice बनाएं: 'The audience laughed at the comic performer.'
optionA_hi: The comic performer was laughed by the audience.
optionB_hi: The comic performer was laughed at by the audience. (फिक्स्ड प्रीपोजिशन 'at' क्रिया के साथ रहेगा)
optionC_hi: The comic performer laughed at the audience.
optionD_hi: The audience was laughed at by the performer.
explanation_hi: नियम: जब Active voice में क्रिया के साथ Preposition जुड़ा हो (laughed at), तो Passive voice में भी वह Preposition क्रिया के ठीक साथ रहता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Convert to passive: 'The audience laughed at the comic performer.'
optionA_en: The comic performer was laughed by the audience.
optionB_en: The comic performer was laughed at by the audience.
optionC_en: The comic performer laughed at the audience.
optionD_en: The audience was laughed at by the performer.
explanation_en: Prepositional Verb Passive: When a verb takes an inseparable preposition ('laughed at', 'looked after', 'aimed at'), the preposition MUST be retained right after V3 in the passive.
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'The geography professor said, "The earth revolves around the sun."'
optionA_hi: The geography professor said that the earth had revolved...
optionB_hi: The geography professor said that the earth revolves around the sun. (सार्वभौमिक सत्य का काल नहीं बदलता)
optionD_hi: The geography professor said that the earth revolved...
explanation_hi: नियम: यदि Reported Speech में कोई सार्वभौमिक सत्य (Universal Truth), ऐतिहासिक तथ्य या वैज्ञानिक नियम हो, तो Reporting verb भूतकाल में होने पर भी काल नहीं बदलता।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Convert to Indirect Speech: 'The geography professor said, "The earth revolves around the sun."'
optionA_en: The geography professor said that the earth had revolved around the sun.
optionB_en: The geography professor said that the earth revolves around the sun.
optionC_en: The geography professor told that the earth was revolving.
optionD_en: The geography professor said that the earth revolved around the sun.
explanation_en: Universal Truth / Scientific Fact Exception: When reported speech expresses a universal truth, habitual action, or scientific law, the tense of the reported clause remains in Present Indefinite.
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] Indirect Narration में बदलें: 'The investigator said to the witness, "Where did you find the abandoned document?"'
optionA_hi: The investigator asked the witness where he had found the abandoned document. (did find बदलता है had found में तथा साधारण पदक्रम)
optionB_hi: The investigator asked where did he find...
optionC_hi: The investigator enquired where he found...
optionD_hi: The investigator asked that where... ('that' का प्रयोग वर्जित)
explanation_hi: नियम: Wh- प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में 'that' नहीं आता, wh-शब्द ही योजक बनता है; वाक्य साधारण (Assertive) बनता है और Past Indefinite बदलकर Past Perfect (had + V3) हो जाता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Transform into indirect narration: 'The investigator said to the witness, "Where did you find the abandoned document?"'
optionA_en: The investigator asked the witness where he had found the abandoned document.
optionB_en: The investigator asked the witness where did he find the abandoned document.
optionC_en: The investigator enquired where he found the abandoned document.
optionD_en: The investigator asked the witness that where he had found the document.
explanation_en: Rules for Wh-questions: 1. 'Said to' becomes 'asked'. 2. No conjunction 'that' is used; the wh-word itself acts as connector. 3. Word order becomes assertive (Subject + Verb). 4. Past Indefinite ('did find') changes to Past Perfect ('had found').
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'Rohit said to me, "Can you solve this complex equation?"'
optionA_hi: Rohit enquired me that I can...
optionB_hi: Rohit asked me if I could solve that complex equation. (if + I could + that)
optionC_hi: Rohit told me that if I could...
explanation_hi: Yes/No प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में योजक 'if' या 'whether' आता है, 'can' का 'could' होता है और 'this' का 'that' हो जाता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Convert to indirect speech: 'Rohit said to me, "Can you solve this complex equation?"'
optionA_en: Rohit enquired me that I can solve that equation.
optionB_en: Rohit asked me if I could solve that complex equation.
optionC_en: Rohit told me that if I could solve this equation.
optionD_en: Rohit asked me whether could I solve that equation.
explanation_en: Auxiliary Yes/No questions: 1. Conjunction 'if' or 'whether' is used. 2. 'Can' shifts to past modal 'could'. 3. Demonstrative 'this' changes to 'that'. 4. Word order is assertive.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] Indirect Narration में बदलें: 'The doctor said to the patient, "Take these medicines regularly and avoid cold water."'
optionB_hi: The doctor advised the patient to take those medicines regularly and to avoid cold water. (advised + to + V1 + those)
optionD_hi: The doctor told to take these...
explanation_hi: आदेशात्मक या सलाह वाले वाक्यों में 'said to' को 'advised/ordered' में बदलते हैं, क्रिया से पहले 'to' जोड़ते हैं और 'these' का 'those' हो जाता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Convert to indirect narration: 'The doctor said to the patient, "Take these medicines regularly and avoid cold water."'
optionA_en: The doctor said that patient should take medicines.
optionB_en: The doctor advised the patient to take those medicines regularly and to avoid cold water.
optionC_en: The doctor ordered the patient that take these medicines.
optionD_en: The doctor told the patient to take these medicines.
explanation_en: Imperative Speech transformation: Reporting verb becomes 'advised', 'ordered', or 'requested'. The imperative verb is replaced by an infinitive ('to take'). Demonstrative 'these' changes to 'those'.
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'The captain said, "Hurrah! We have won the championship trophy!"'
optionB_hi: The captain exclaimed that they have won...
optionD_hi: The captain exclaimed with joy that they had won the championship trophy. (exclaimed with joy + that they had won)
explanation_hi: 'Hurrah' विस्मयबोधक शब्द को 'exclaimed with joy' में बदलते हैं, 'that' लगाते हैं और 'have won' का 'had won' हो जाता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Change into indirect speech: 'The captain said, "Hurrah! We have won the championship trophy!"'
optionA_en: The captain said with happiness that we won the trophy.
optionB_en: The captain exclaimed that they have won the championship trophy.
optionC_en: The captain shouted that we had won the trophy.
optionD_en: The captain exclaimed with joy that they had won the championship trophy.
explanation_en: Exclamations with 'Hurrah' become 'exclaimed with joy that...'. Present Perfect 'have won' shifts to Past Perfect 'had won', and pronoun 'we' changes to 'they'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The patient died _____ cancer, while many miners died _____ exhaustion and asphyxiation.'
optionD_hi: of, from (बीमारी से मृत्यु Die of, थकान/कारण से मृत्यु Die from)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी बीमारी से मरने पर 'die OF' (die of disease) और बाहरी कारण, भूख या थकान से मरने पर 'die FROM' आता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Select the correct prepositions: 'The patient died _____ cancer, while many miners died _____ exhaustion and asphyxiation.'
explanation_en: Cause of death nuance: Dying of a specific disease = 'die OF cancer/cholera'. Dying from an external cause or overwork = 'die FROM hunger/overwork/exhaustion'. Dying in battle = 'die IN harness/action'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] शुद्ध वाक्यांश चुनें: 'It was arduous for the junior clerks to _____ the heavy workload.'
optionC_hi: cope with (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cope up with' सर्वथा अशुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: परीक्षाओं में बार-बार पूछी जाने वाली त्रुटि: मानक अंग्रेजी में केवल 'cope with' सही होता है, 'cope up with' बोलना या लिखना पूर्णतः अशुद्ध है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Identify the standard idiom: 'It was arduous for the junior clerks to _____ the heavy workload.'
explanation_en: Frequent Indian English Error: The idiom is strictly 'COPE WITH' (meaning to manage or deal successfully with something difficult). The expression 'cope up with' is a non-standard grammatical error.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The old files were properly catalogued and disposed _____ according to archives protocol.'
optionB_hi: of (Disposed of में सिंगल 'f' आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: छुटकारा पाने या निस्तारण करने के लिए 'Dispose OF' (सिंगल 'f') होता है, 'dispose off' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Fill in the blank: 'The old files were properly catalogued and disposed _____ according to archives protocol.'
explanation_en: Spelling/Preposition trap: The correct phrasal verb meaning to get rid of or sell off is 'DISPOSE OF' (single 'f'), never 'dispose off'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] उचित प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'The software developer is familiar _____ Python syntax, but his name is not familiar _____ the panel.'
optionD_hi: with, to (विषय का ज्ञान familiar with, किसी व्यक्ति को परिचित होना familiar to)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी विषय या वस्तु की जानकारी होने पर 'familiar with' और किसी व्यक्ति को ज्ञात होने पर 'familiar to' आता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Select the correct prepositions: 'The software developer is familiar _____ Python syntax, but his name is not familiar _____ the panel.'
explanation_en: A person is 'familiar WITH' a subject or topic ('familiar with the rules'). Something is 'familiar TO' a person ('her voice sounds familiar to me').
examTag: SSC CHSL - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] 'Brought up' का अर्थ क्या है: 'She was brought up by her grandparents in a tranquil village'?
optionC_hi: Reared and educated from childhood (पालन-पोषण करना)
explanation_hi: 'Bring up' (Past: brought up) का अर्थ होता है बच्चे का पालन-पोषण करना या चर्चा में कोई मुद्दा उठाना।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] What is the meaning of 'bring up' in: 'She was brought up by her grandparents in a tranquil village'?
explanation_en: 'Bring up' means to care for and raise a child until maturity. Figuratively, it can also mean to mention a topic during discussion.
examTag: SSC CPO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] 'Enter' क्रिया के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionD_hi: The diplomats entered the conference hall at 10 AM. (भौतिक स्थान में प्रवेश हेतु enter के बाद preposition नहीं आता)
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी कमरे या इमारत में प्रवेश करने के अर्थ में 'Enter' के बाद 'into' नहीं आता। केवल समझौता या संधि करने में 'enter into an agreement' आता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Spot the correct usage regarding the verb 'enter':
optionA_en: The diplomats entered into the conference hall.
optionB_en: The diplomats were entered the hall.
optionC_en: The diplomats entered in the conference hall.
optionD_en: The diplomats entered the conference hall at 10 AM.
explanation_en: Rule: 'Enter' is a transitive verb that takes no preposition when physically entering a place ('entered the room/hall'). 'Enter into' is only correct figuratively when starting an agreement, contract, or discussion ('entered into a treaty').
examTag: IBPS PO - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] Passive Voice में रूपांतरित करें: 'Citizens must obey traffic regulations.'
optionC_hi: Traffic regulations must have been obeyed.
optionD_hi: Traffic regulations must be obeyed by citizens. (modal + be + V3)
explanation_hi: Modal Auxiliary क्रियाओं का Passive Voice 'Modal + be + V3' से बनाया जाता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Convert to passive voice: 'Citizens must obey traffic regulations.'
optionB_en: Traffic regulations are obeyed by citizens.
optionC_en: Traffic regulations must have been obeyed.
optionD_en: Traffic regulations must be obeyed by citizens.
explanation_en: Modal Passive structure: 'Subject + Modal Auxiliary (must/can/should) + BE + V3 + by + agent'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] Indirect Speech में बदलें: 'Karan said, "If I had known the reality, I would have intervened."'
optionA_hi: Karan said that if he had known the reality, he would have intervened. (Past Perfect Conditional का काल अपरिवर्तित रहता है)
optionB_hi: Karan said that if he knew...
explanation_hi: भूतकाल की अधूरी शर्त (Third Conditional: had + V3 ... would have + V3) का काल Indirect Speech में नहीं बदलता।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Convert into indirect speech: 'Karan said, "If I had known the reality, I would have intervened."'
optionA_en: Karan said that if he had known the reality, he would have intervened.
optionB_en: Karan said that if he knew the reality, he would intervene.
optionC_en: Karan said that if he had known, he will intervene.
optionD_en: Karan told that if he had had known the reality...
explanation_en: Third conditional clauses ('had + V3 ... would have + V3') undergo no backshift in tense when converted to indirect speech because Past Perfect represents the deepest past.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] सही प्रीपोजिशन भरें: 'Security protocols prevented unauthorized personnel _____ accessing the main server room.'
explanation_hi: नियम: किसी को कोई काम करने से रोकने के लिए 'Prevent from + V1-ing' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Identify the correct preposition: 'Security protocols prevented unauthorized personnel _____ accessing the main server room.'
explanation_en: Structure: 'Prevent / Prohibit / Restrain someone FROM + doing something (Gerund)'.
examTag: NDA English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 2] 'Resemble' के संबंध में सही वाक्य पहचानें:
optionA_hi: The young prodigy resembles her grandmother remarkably. (Resemble के बाद कोई preposition नहीं आता)
optionB_hi: The young prodigy is resembling... (Stative verb)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Resemble' (समान दिखना) के बाद 'to' या 'with' नहीं आता और इसका continuous tense ('is resembling') नहीं बनता।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 2] Spot the correct grammatical construction for 'resemble':
optionA_en: The young prodigy resembles her grandmother remarkably.
optionB_en: The young prodigy is resembling her grandmother.
optionC_en: The young prodigy resembles to her grandmother.
optionD_en: The young prodigy resembles with her grandmother.
explanation_en: Verbs like 'resemble', 'marry', 'discuss', 'order', and 'accompany' do not take prepositions like 'with' or 'to'. Furthermore, 'resemble' is a stative verb not used in continuous aspect.
examTag: State PCS General English - Prepositions, Voice & Narration

question_hi: वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचानें: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous): मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cousin brother' या 'cousin sister' लिखना अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
question_en: Spot the error in the sentence: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_en: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' is incorrect; use only 'cousin'
explanation_en: Superfluous Expression: In standard English, the noun 'cousin' suffices for both male and female relatives. Adding 'brother' or 'sister' ('cousin brother/sister') is redundant and ungrammatical.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: अशुद्ध भाग पहचानें: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (B) - 'returned back' में 'back' का प्रयोग अनावश्यक है; केवल 'returned' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Return', 'Revert', 'Repeat' आदि शब्दों के अर्थ में ही 'वापस' या 'दोबारा' शामिल होता है, अतः इनके साथ 'back' या 'again' लगाना गलत है।
question_en: Identify the incorrect part: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: The prefix 're-' in words like 'return', 'repeat', 'revert', 'reimburse', and 'recall' inherently means 'again' or 'back'. Adding 'back' ('return back') is a common redundancy error.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: वाक्य सुधारें: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
optionC_hi: pass marks (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'passing marks' नहीं 'pass marks' होता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण होने वाले अंकों को 'Pass marks' कहा जाता है, बोलचाल में प्रयुक्त 'passing marks' व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।
question_en: Select the correct phrase improvement: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
explanation_en: Colloquialism Correction: The standard English term is 'PASS MARKS' (or 'qualifying marks'), not 'passing marks'. Similarly: 'link language' (not linking), 'boarding house' (not boarding).
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: त्रुटि खोजें: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (A) - Preposition 'between' के बाद 'I' के स्थान पर 'me' आएगा
explanation_hi: नियम: Preposition (जैसे Between, Except, Let) के बाद हमेशा Objective Case का सर्वनाम आता है। अतः 'Between you and me' सही है।
question_en: Find the error: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Objective Case after Prepositions: All prepositions ('between', 'except', 'let', 'for', 'with') must be followed by objective pronouns (me, him, her, them, us). Hence, 'between you and me' is grammatically correct.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: तुलना दोष सुधारें: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
optionC_hi: than that of Chandigarh (जलवायु की तुलना जलवायु से करने हेतु 'that of')
explanation_hi: असंगत तुलना नियम: शिमला की जलवायु की तुलना सीधे चंडीगढ़ शहर से नहीं हो सकती; चंडीगढ़ की जलवायु से होगी, अतः 'than that of Chandigarh' सही है।
question_en: Improve the underlined segment: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
explanation_en: Logical Parallelism in Comparison: A comparison must be between two equivalent entities. Comparing Shimla's 'climate' directly with the city 'Chandigarh' is illogical. Use 'than that of Chandigarh' (singular) or 'than those of' (plural).
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
optionC_hi: was, were ('Many a' के साथ एकवचन, जबकि 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Many a' के बाद एकवचन संज्ञा व एकवचन क्रिया (Many a passenger was) आती है, जबकि केवल 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन क्रिया (were) आती है।
question_en: Fill in the blanks: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'Many a + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('Many a passenger was...'). In contrast, 'Many + PLURAL VERB' ('many were admitted').
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
optionA_hi: hearing ('Looking forward to' के बाद Gerund / V1-ing आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Looking forward to', 'with a view to', 'addicted to' में 'to' एक प्रीपोजिशन है, अतः इसके बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1 + ing यानी hearing) आता है।
question_en: Select the correct grammatical verb form: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
explanation_en: In phrases where 'to' is a preposition (look forward to, accustomed to, habituated to, with a view to, addicted to, prone to), it is strictly followed by a GERUND (V1 + ing), not base infinitive.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (B) - 'One' के लिए possessive सर्वनाम 'one's' आएगा, 'his' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: जब वाक्य का कर्ता 'One' हो, तो उसके पूरे वाक्य में संबंधसूचक सर्वनाम 'one's' और स्वयं के लिए 'oneself' आता है, 'his' नहीं।
question_en: Spot the error: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Pronoun Concord: When the indefinite pronoun 'ONE' is the subject of a sentence, its corresponding possessive form is strictly 'ONE'S' (apostrophe s), not 'his', 'her', or 'their'.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: वाक्य सुधारें: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
optionB_hi: Despite his severe fever ('Despite' के साथ 'of' कभी नहीं आता)
optionD_hi: Inspite of his severe fever (In spite अलग-अलग लिखा जाता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' नहीं लगाया जाता (केवल 'Despite his fever')। यदि 'of' लगाना हो तो 'In spite of' लिखा जाता है।
question_en: Improve the underlined segment: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
explanation_en: Prepositional rule: 'DESPITE' is a single preposition that already incorporates 'of'. Writing 'despite of' is a major grammatical blunder. Alternatively, 'IN SPITE OF' (three words) is correct.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: 'Comprise' का शुद्ध प्रयोग पहचानें:
optionA_hi: The panel consists five... ('of' छूटा है)
optionB_hi: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists. (Active voice में 'comprise of' गलत है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Active Voice में 'Comprise' के बाद 'of' नहीं आता (comprises five members)। 'Consist' के बाद 'of' अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: Identify the correct usage of 'comprise':
optionB_en: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists.
optionC_en: The panel is comprised five jurists.
optionD_en: The investigative panel comprises of five eminent jurists.
explanation_en: Rule: In active voice, 'COMPRISE' means 'consist of' or 'be made up of' and takes NO preposition. 'Consist' takes 'of' (consists of). 'Comprise of' is an incorrect hybrid.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: त्रुटि खोजें: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - 'big blunder' अशुद्ध है; 'blunder' का अर्थ ही भारी भूल होता है
explanation_hi: 'Blunder' का अर्थ ही 'बड़ी या भारी भूल' होता है। अतः इसके साथ 'big' या 'huge' लगाना पुनरुक्ति दोष है।
question_en: Spot the error: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Vocabulary Precision: A 'blunder' by definition is a colossal or catastrophic mistake. Qualifying it with 'big' or 'huge' is a classic superfluous redundancy. Use simply 'a blunder' or 'a big mistake'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: वाक्य सुधारें: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
optionD_hi: ordered three cups of espresso (Order क्रिया के बाद 'for' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Order' का प्रयोग क्रिया के रूप में हो, तो इसके बाद 'for' नहीं आता (ordered coffee, ordered books)।
question_en: Improve the sentence: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
explanation_en: Transitive Verb Rule: When 'order' is used as a transitive verb for purchasing or requisitioning food, it takes a direct object without the preposition 'for' ('ordered coffee', not 'ordered for coffee').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: सही व्याकरणिक संरचना चुनें: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
optionA_hi: avail yourself of (Avail + Reflexive Pronoun + of)
explanation_hi: नियम: लाभ उठाने के अर्थ में 'Avail' के बाद कर्ता के अनुसार Reflexive Pronoun (myself, yourself) और फिर 'of' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: Choose the grammatically complete construction: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
explanation_en: Transitive/Reflexive Rule: The verb 'avail' (in the sense of taking advantage of an opportunity) strictly demands a reflexive pronoun corresponding to the subject, followed by 'of': 'avail + oneself + OF'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरणिक समानांतरता (Parallelism) वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionB_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record. (दो क्रियाओं won और broke के बीच समानांतरता)
optionC_hi: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionD_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
explanation_hi: समानांतरता का नियम (Parallelism): 'Not only' और 'but also' के बाद एक ही प्रकार के पद (जैसे दोनों जगह Verb या दोनों जगह Noun) आने चाहिए।
question_en: Select the sentence demonstrating flawless grammatical parallelism:
optionA_en: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionB_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record.
optionC_en: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionD_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
explanation_en: Parallel Structure: The elements following 'not only' and 'but also' must be of identical grammatical category. Here, 'won' (verb phrase) and 'broke' (verb phrase) are perfectly parallel.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
optionB_hi: hard, hardly (कठिन परिश्रम worked hard, मुश्किल से hardly)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Hard' का अर्थ कठिन या परिश्रमपूर्वक होता है (work hard); जबकि 'Hardly' नकारात्मक शब्द है जिसका अर्थ 'मुश्किल से ही' होता है।
question_en: Fill in the blank with precision: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
explanation_en: 'Hard' functions as both adjective and adverb meaning diligently or with effort ('work hard'). 'Hardly' is a negative adverb meaning scarcely or almost not ('hardly pass').
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (B) - अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं होता; 'fast' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: नियम: अंग्रेजी में 'Fast' ही Adverb (क्रियाविशेषण) और Adjective दोनों होता है। 'Fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं है।
question_en: Spot the error: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_en: Part (B) - 'fastly' is not a recognized English word; use 'fast'
explanation_en: Non-existent word: 'Fast' serves as both an adjective and an adverb in English ('drove fast', 'a fast car'). The word 'fastly' does not exist in standard dictionaries.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: सही भिन्न (Fraction) रूप चुनें: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
optionA_hi: Two thirds (अंश 1 से अधिक होने पर हर में plural 'thirds' आता है)
explanation_hi: भिन्न का नियम: यदि अंश (Numerator) एक से अधिक हो (2, 3), तो हर (Denominator) बहुवचन होता है: 'two thirds', 'three fourths'।
question_en: Select the grammatically correct fraction expression: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
explanation_en: Fractional grammar: When the numerator is greater than one (two, three), the denominator takes the plural form: 'two-thirds', 'three-fourths'. ('One-third' remains singular).
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: त्रुटि खोजें: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'more stronger' दोहरा comparative है; केवल 'stronger' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: जब किसी विशेषण में '-er' जोड़कर comparative बनाया जाए (stronger), तो उसके पहले 'more' लगाना 'Double Comparative' की गलती है।
question_en: Spot the error: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_en: Part (B) - Double comparative 'more stronger' is ungrammatical; use only 'stronger'
explanation_en: Double Comparative Error: When a monosyllabic adjective forms its comparative with '-er' ('stronger'), preceding it with 'more' is a double comparative error. Use simply 'stronger'.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: देखभाल करने के अर्थ में सही क्रिया भरें: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_hi: 'Look after' का अर्थ होता है किसी बच्चे या रोगी की देखभाल करना (Take care of)।
question_en: Complete the sentence logically: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_en: 'Look after' means to take care of someone or nurture them. 'Look for' means to search for something lost.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: 'Although' के साथ सही योजक चुनें: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
optionD_hi: yet (या केवल कॉमा; 'but' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Although' या 'Though' के साथ केवल 'yet' या अल्पविराम (comma) आता है, 'but' का प्रयोग सर्वथा गलत है।
question_en: Choose the correct conjunction pairing: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
explanation_en: Conjunction rule: 'Although / Though' pairs with 'YET' (or a single comma). Using 'but' with although ('Although... but') is a severe examination error.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: वाक्य सुधारें: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
optionC_hi: put your signature (हस्ताक्षर संज्ञा हेतु 'signature' शब्द शुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Sign' एक क्रिया (Verb) है; हस्ताक्षर के संज्ञा रूप (Noun) के लिए 'Signature' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Improve the sentence: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
explanation_en: Word Choice: 'Sign' is primarily a verb ('please sign the document'). The corresponding noun for one's handwritten name is 'SIGNATURE'. 'Put your sign' is colloquial Indian English; use 'put your signature'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
optionA_hi: between, among (दो के बीच Between, दो से अधिक के बीच Among)
explanation_hi: नियम: दो व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के बीच बंटवारे के लिए 'between' और दो से अधिक के लिए 'among' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Select the correct prepositions: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
explanation_en: Distribution Rule: 'Between' is used when dividing between two distinct entities. 'Among' is used for division among three or more entities.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: उचित शब्द भरें: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
optionB_hi: latter (दो में से बाद वाले के लिए 'latter')
explanation_hi: नियम: दो वस्तुओं में से बाद वाली के लिए 'latter' आता है; 'later' समय बताता है और 'last' दो से अधिक में अंतिम के लिए आता है।
question_en: Fill in the blank with precision: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
explanation_en: 'Former' and 'Latter' refer to position between two items (former = first of two; latter = second of two). 'Later' refers to time. 'Last' refers to position among three or more.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: सही डिटरमिनर भरें: 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
optionB_hi: the little (थोड़ा जो कुछ भी बचा था, वह सब)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Little' = न के बराबर; 'A little' = कुछ मात्रा; 'The little' = जो कुछ थोड़ा बचा था वह सब।
question_en: Select the option that conveys 'a small quantity, but all of it': 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
explanation_en: Quantity distinction: 'Little' = almost none (negative). 'A little' = some amount (positive). 'The little' = the specific small amount available in its entirety.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: न के बराबर के अर्थ में सही शब्द चुनें: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
optionC_hi: few (न के बराबर संख्या / लगभग कोई नहीं)
explanation_hi: नियम: Countable संज्ञा के साथ 'Few' का अर्थ 'न के बराबर' होता है; 'A few' का अर्थ 'कुछ' होता है।
question_en: Fill in the blank: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
explanation_en: 'Few' means almost none (hardly any students, negative implication). 'A few' means a small number (positive). 'Students' is countable, so 'few' applies.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
optionA_hi: elder, older (रक्त संबंध में elder, आयु की सामान्य तुलना में older than)
explanation_hi: नियम: एक ही परिवार के सगे भाई-बहनों के लिए 'Elder/Eldest' आता है (इसके साथ than नहीं आता)। सामान्य आयु तुलना में 'older than' आता है।
question_en: Fill in the blank: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
explanation_en: 'Elder' and 'Eldest' are strictly used for members of the same family (blood relations) and take 'to' or no preposition (never 'than'). 'Older' is used for people and objects generally, followed by 'than'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: उचित पारस्परिक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
optionC_hi: each other, one another (दो के लिए each other, दो से अधिक के लिए one another)
explanation_hi: नियम: केवल दो व्यक्तियों के परस्पर संबंध के लिए 'each other' और दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों के लिए 'one another' आता है।
question_en: Select the correct pronouns: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
explanation_en: Reciprocal Pronouns: 'Each other' is used when two entities interact mutually. 'One another' is used when three or more entities interact mutually.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (A) - 'seldom or ever' गलत है; 'seldom or never' या 'seldom if ever' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: मुहावरेदार रूप से या तो 'seldom or never' होता है या 'seldom if ever'। 'Seldom or ever' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: Spot the idiomatic error: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_en: Part (A) - Use either 'seldom or never' OR 'seldom if ever'
explanation_en: Idiomatic Standard: The established negative pairings are either 'SELDOM OR NEVER' or 'SELDOM IF EVER'. The combination 'seldom or ever' is ungrammatical.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: काल्पनिक स्थिति हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
optionD_hi: were ('As if' के बाद काल्पनिक स्थिति में 'were' का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'As if' (मानो कि) के बाद जब अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक तुलना की जाए, तो एकवचन कर्ता के साथ भी 'were' आता है।
question_en: Fill in the blank: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
explanation_en: Unreal comparison: Conjunctions 'as if' and 'as though' introducing imaginary or contrary-to-fact suppositions take the subjunctive past verb 'WERE'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: त्रुटि खोजें: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (A) - 'did' के बाद क्रिया का प्रथम रूप (V1 - sound) आएगा, 'sounded' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया की प्रथम फॉर्म (V1 यानी sound) आती है, 'sounded' लिखना अशुद्ध है।
question_en: Identify the error in: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (A) - After auxiliary 'did', base verb 'sound' (V1) must be used, not 'sounded'
explanation_en: Auxiliary syntax: The auxiliary 'did' takes the bare base form of the main verb (V1). Writing 'did sounded' is a double past tense error. It must be 'did the alarm sound'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचानें: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous): मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cousin brother' या 'cousin sister' लिखना अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Spot the error in the sentence: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_en: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' is incorrect; use only 'cousin'
explanation_en: Superfluous Expression: In standard English, the noun 'cousin' suffices for both male and female relatives. Adding 'brother' or 'sister' ('cousin brother/sister') is redundant and ungrammatical.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] अशुद्ध भाग पहचानें: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - 'returned back' में 'back' का प्रयोग अनावश्यक है; केवल 'returned' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Return', 'Revert', 'Repeat' आदि शब्दों के अर्थ में ही 'वापस' या 'दोबारा' शामिल होता है, अतः इनके साथ 'back' या 'again' लगाना गलत है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Identify the incorrect part: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: The prefix 're-' in words like 'return', 'repeat', 'revert', 'reimburse', and 'recall' inherently means 'again' or 'back'. Adding 'back' ('return back') is a common redundancy error.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] वाक्य सुधारें: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
optionC_hi: pass marks (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'passing marks' नहीं 'pass marks' होता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण होने वाले अंकों को 'Pass marks' कहा जाता है, बोलचाल में प्रयुक्त 'passing marks' व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Select the correct phrase improvement: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
explanation_en: Colloquialism Correction: The standard English term is 'PASS MARKS' (or 'qualifying marks'), not 'passing marks'. Similarly: 'link language' (not linking), 'boarding house' (not boarding).
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] त्रुटि खोजें: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (A) - Preposition 'between' के बाद 'I' के स्थान पर 'me' आएगा
explanation_hi: नियम: Preposition (जैसे Between, Except, Let) के बाद हमेशा Objective Case का सर्वनाम आता है। अतः 'Between you and me' सही है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Find the error: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Objective Case after Prepositions: All prepositions ('between', 'except', 'let', 'for', 'with') must be followed by objective pronouns (me, him, her, them, us). Hence, 'between you and me' is grammatically correct.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] तुलना दोष सुधारें: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
optionB_hi: than that of Chandigarh (जलवायु की तुलना जलवायु से करने हेतु 'that of')
explanation_hi: असंगत तुलना नियम: शिमला की जलवायु की तुलना सीधे चंडीगढ़ शहर से नहीं हो सकती; चंडीगढ़ की जलवायु से होगी, अतः 'than that of Chandigarh' सही है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Improve the underlined segment: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
explanation_en: Logical Parallelism in Comparison: A comparison must be between two equivalent entities. Comparing Shimla's 'climate' directly with the city 'Chandigarh' is illogical. Use 'than that of Chandigarh' (singular) or 'than those of' (plural).
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
optionC_hi: was, were ('Many a' के साथ एकवचन, जबकि 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Many a' के बाद एकवचन संज्ञा व एकवचन क्रिया (Many a passenger was) आती है, जबकि केवल 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन क्रिया (were) आती है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Fill in the blanks: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'Many a + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('Many a passenger was...'). In contrast, 'Many + PLURAL VERB' ('many were admitted').
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
optionC_hi: hearing ('Looking forward to' के बाद Gerund / V1-ing आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Looking forward to', 'with a view to', 'addicted to' में 'to' एक प्रीपोजिशन है, अतः इसके बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1 + ing यानी hearing) आता है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Select the correct grammatical verb form: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
explanation_en: In phrases where 'to' is a preposition (look forward to, accustomed to, habituated to, with a view to, addicted to, prone to), it is strictly followed by a GERUND (V1 + ing), not base infinitive.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (B) - 'One' के लिए possessive सर्वनाम 'one's' आएगा, 'his' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: जब वाक्य का कर्ता 'One' हो, तो उसके पूरे वाक्य में संबंधसूचक सर्वनाम 'one's' और स्वयं के लिए 'oneself' आता है, 'his' नहीं।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Spot the error: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Pronoun Concord: When the indefinite pronoun 'ONE' is the subject of a sentence, its corresponding possessive form is strictly 'ONE'S' (apostrophe s), not 'his', 'her', or 'their'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] वाक्य सुधारें: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
optionB_hi: Despite his severe fever ('Despite' के साथ 'of' कभी नहीं आता)
optionC_hi: Inspite of his severe fever (In spite अलग-अलग लिखा जाता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' नहीं लगाया जाता (केवल 'Despite his fever')। यदि 'of' लगाना हो तो 'In spite of' लिखा जाता है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Improve the underlined segment: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
explanation_en: Prepositional rule: 'DESPITE' is a single preposition that already incorporates 'of'. Writing 'despite of' is a major grammatical blunder. Alternatively, 'IN SPITE OF' (three words) is correct.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] 'Comprise' का शुद्ध प्रयोग पहचानें:
optionA_hi: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists. (Active voice में 'comprise of' गलत है)
optionC_hi: The panel consists five... ('of' छूटा है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Active Voice में 'Comprise' के बाद 'of' नहीं आता (comprises five members)। 'Consist' के बाद 'of' अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Identify the correct usage of 'comprise':
optionA_en: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists.
optionB_en: The investigative panel comprises of five eminent jurists.
optionD_en: The panel is comprised five jurists.
explanation_en: Rule: In active voice, 'COMPRISE' means 'consist of' or 'be made up of' and takes NO preposition. 'Consist' takes 'of' (consists of). 'Comprise of' is an incorrect hybrid.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] त्रुटि खोजें: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'big blunder' अशुद्ध है; 'blunder' का अर्थ ही भारी भूल होता है
explanation_hi: 'Blunder' का अर्थ ही 'बड़ी या भारी भूल' होता है। अतः इसके साथ 'big' या 'huge' लगाना पुनरुक्ति दोष है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Spot the error: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Vocabulary Precision: A 'blunder' by definition is a colossal or catastrophic mistake. Qualifying it with 'big' or 'huge' is a classic superfluous redundancy. Use simply 'a blunder' or 'a big mistake'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] वाक्य सुधारें: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
optionD_hi: ordered three cups of espresso (Order क्रिया के बाद 'for' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Order' का प्रयोग क्रिया के रूप में हो, तो इसके बाद 'for' नहीं आता (ordered coffee, ordered books)।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Improve the sentence: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
explanation_en: Transitive Verb Rule: When 'order' is used as a transitive verb for purchasing or requisitioning food, it takes a direct object without the preposition 'for' ('ordered coffee', not 'ordered for coffee').
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] सही व्याकरणिक संरचना चुनें: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
optionA_hi: avail yourself of (Avail + Reflexive Pronoun + of)
explanation_hi: नियम: लाभ उठाने के अर्थ में 'Avail' के बाद कर्ता के अनुसार Reflexive Pronoun (myself, yourself) और फिर 'of' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Choose the grammatically complete construction: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
explanation_en: Transitive/Reflexive Rule: The verb 'avail' (in the sense of taking advantage of an opportunity) strictly demands a reflexive pronoun corresponding to the subject, followed by 'of': 'avail + oneself + OF'.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] व्याकरणिक समानांतरता (Parallelism) वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionB_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record. (दो क्रियाओं won और broke के बीच समानांतरता)
optionC_hi: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionD_hi: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
explanation_hi: समानांतरता का नियम (Parallelism): 'Not only' और 'but also' के बाद एक ही प्रकार के पद (जैसे दोनों जगह Verb या दोनों जगह Noun) आने चाहिए।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Select the sentence demonstrating flawless grammatical parallelism:
optionA_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionB_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record.
optionC_en: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionD_en: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
explanation_en: Parallel Structure: The elements following 'not only' and 'but also' must be of identical grammatical category. Here, 'won' (verb phrase) and 'broke' (verb phrase) are perfectly parallel.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
optionA_hi: hard, hardly (कठिन परिश्रम worked hard, मुश्किल से hardly)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Hard' का अर्थ कठिन या परिश्रमपूर्वक होता है (work hard); जबकि 'Hardly' नकारात्मक शब्द है जिसका अर्थ 'मुश्किल से ही' होता है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Fill in the blank with precision: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
explanation_en: 'Hard' functions as both adjective and adverb meaning diligently or with effort ('work hard'). 'Hardly' is a negative adverb meaning scarcely or almost not ('hardly pass').
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं होता; 'fast' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: नियम: अंग्रेजी में 'Fast' ही Adverb (क्रियाविशेषण) और Adjective दोनों होता है। 'Fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Spot the error: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_en: Part (B) - 'fastly' is not a recognized English word; use 'fast'
explanation_en: Non-existent word: 'Fast' serves as both an adjective and an adverb in English ('drove fast', 'a fast car'). The word 'fastly' does not exist in standard dictionaries.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] सही भिन्न (Fraction) रूप चुनें: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
optionB_hi: Two thirds (अंश 1 से अधिक होने पर हर में plural 'thirds' आता है)
explanation_hi: भिन्न का नियम: यदि अंश (Numerator) एक से अधिक हो (2, 3), तो हर (Denominator) बहुवचन होता है: 'two thirds', 'three fourths'।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Select the grammatically correct fraction expression: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
explanation_en: Fractional grammar: When the numerator is greater than one (two, three), the denominator takes the plural form: 'two-thirds', 'three-fourths'. ('One-third' remains singular).
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] त्रुटि खोजें: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'more stronger' दोहरा comparative है; केवल 'stronger' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: जब किसी विशेषण में '-er' जोड़कर comparative बनाया जाए (stronger), तो उसके पहले 'more' लगाना 'Double Comparative' की गलती है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Spot the error: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_en: Part (B) - Double comparative 'more stronger' is ungrammatical; use only 'stronger'
explanation_en: Double Comparative Error: When a monosyllabic adjective forms its comparative with '-er' ('stronger'), preceding it with 'more' is a double comparative error. Use simply 'stronger'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] देखभाल करने के अर्थ में सही क्रिया भरें: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_hi: 'Look after' का अर्थ होता है किसी बच्चे या रोगी की देखभाल करना (Take care of)।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Complete the sentence logically: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_en: 'Look after' means to take care of someone or nurture them. 'Look for' means to search for something lost.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] 'Although' के साथ सही योजक चुनें: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
optionD_hi: yet (या केवल कॉमा; 'but' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Although' या 'Though' के साथ केवल 'yet' या अल्पविराम (comma) आता है, 'but' का प्रयोग सर्वथा गलत है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Choose the correct conjunction pairing: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
explanation_en: Conjunction rule: 'Although / Though' pairs with 'YET' (or a single comma). Using 'but' with although ('Although... but') is a severe examination error.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] वाक्य सुधारें: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
optionB_hi: put your signature (हस्ताक्षर संज्ञा हेतु 'signature' शब्द शुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Sign' एक क्रिया (Verb) है; हस्ताक्षर के संज्ञा रूप (Noun) के लिए 'Signature' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Improve the sentence: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
explanation_en: Word Choice: 'Sign' is primarily a verb ('please sign the document'). The corresponding noun for one's handwritten name is 'SIGNATURE'. 'Put your sign' is colloquial Indian English; use 'put your signature'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
optionA_hi: between, among (दो के बीच Between, दो से अधिक के बीच Among)
explanation_hi: नियम: दो व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के बीच बंटवारे के लिए 'between' और दो से अधिक के लिए 'among' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Select the correct prepositions: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
explanation_en: Distribution Rule: 'Between' is used when dividing between two distinct entities. 'Among' is used for division among three or more entities.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] उचित शब्द भरें: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
optionC_hi: latter (दो में से बाद वाले के लिए 'latter')
explanation_hi: नियम: दो वस्तुओं में से बाद वाली के लिए 'latter' आता है; 'later' समय बताता है और 'last' दो से अधिक में अंतिम के लिए आता है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Fill in the blank with precision: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
explanation_en: 'Former' and 'Latter' refer to position between two items (former = first of two; latter = second of two). 'Later' refers to time. 'Last' refers to position among three or more.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] सही डिटरमिनर भरें: 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
optionA_hi: the little (थोड़ा जो कुछ भी बचा था, वह सब)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Little' = न के बराबर; 'A little' = कुछ मात्रा; 'The little' = जो कुछ थोड़ा बचा था वह सब।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Select the option that conveys 'a small quantity, but all of it': 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
explanation_en: Quantity distinction: 'Little' = almost none (negative). 'A little' = some amount (positive). 'The little' = the specific small amount available in its entirety.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] न के बराबर के अर्थ में सही शब्द चुनें: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
optionC_hi: few (न के बराबर संख्या / लगभग कोई नहीं)
explanation_hi: नियम: Countable संज्ञा के साथ 'Few' का अर्थ 'न के बराबर' होता है; 'A few' का अर्थ 'कुछ' होता है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Fill in the blank: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
explanation_en: 'Few' means almost none (hardly any students, negative implication). 'A few' means a small number (positive). 'Students' is countable, so 'few' applies.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
optionA_hi: elder, older (रक्त संबंध में elder, आयु की सामान्य तुलना में older than)
explanation_hi: नियम: एक ही परिवार के सगे भाई-बहनों के लिए 'Elder/Eldest' आता है (इसके साथ than नहीं आता)। सामान्य आयु तुलना में 'older than' आता है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Fill in the blank: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
explanation_en: 'Elder' and 'Eldest' are strictly used for members of the same family (blood relations) and take 'to' or no preposition (never 'than'). 'Older' is used for people and objects generally, followed by 'than'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement
