question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] उचित पारस्परिक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
optionD_hi: each other, one another (दो के लिए each other, दो से अधिक के लिए one another)
explanation_hi: नियम: केवल दो व्यक्तियों के परस्पर संबंध के लिए 'each other' और दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों के लिए 'one another' आता है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Select the correct pronouns: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
explanation_en: Reciprocal Pronouns: 'Each other' is used when two entities interact mutually. 'One another' is used when three or more entities interact mutually.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (A) - 'seldom or ever' गलत है; 'seldom or never' या 'seldom if ever' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: मुहावरेदार रूप से या तो 'seldom or never' होता है या 'seldom if ever'। 'Seldom or ever' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Spot the idiomatic error: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (A) - Use either 'seldom or never' OR 'seldom if ever'
explanation_en: Idiomatic Standard: The established negative pairings are either 'SELDOM OR NEVER' or 'SELDOM IF EVER'. The combination 'seldom or ever' is ungrammatical.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] काल्पनिक स्थिति हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
optionD_hi: were ('As if' के बाद काल्पनिक स्थिति में 'were' का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'As if' (मानो कि) के बाद जब अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक तुलना की जाए, तो एकवचन कर्ता के साथ भी 'were' आता है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Fill in the blank: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
explanation_en: Unreal comparison: Conjunctions 'as if' and 'as though' introducing imaginary or contrary-to-fact suppositions take the subjunctive past verb 'WERE'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [सामान्य त्रुटि विशेषांक - बारंबार पूछे जाने वाले नियम] त्रुटि खोजें: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (A) - 'did' के बाद क्रिया का प्रथम रूप (V1 - sound) आएगा, 'sounded' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया की प्रथम फॉर्म (V1 यानी sound) आती है, 'sounded' लिखना अशुद्ध है।
question_en: [Error Spotting Special - High Frequency Patterns] Identify the error in: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (A) - After auxiliary 'did', base verb 'sound' (V1) must be used, not 'sounded'
explanation_en: Auxiliary syntax: The auxiliary 'did' takes the bare base form of the main verb (V1). Writing 'did sounded' is a double past tense error. It must be 'did the alarm sound'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचानें: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous): मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cousin brother' या 'cousin sister' लिखना अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Spot the error in the sentence: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_en: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' is incorrect; use only 'cousin'
explanation_en: Superfluous Expression: In standard English, the noun 'cousin' suffices for both male and female relatives. Adding 'brother' or 'sister' ('cousin brother/sister') is redundant and ungrammatical.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: अशुद्ध भाग पहचानें: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (B) - 'returned back' में 'back' का प्रयोग अनावश्यक है; केवल 'returned' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Return', 'Revert', 'Repeat' आदि शब्दों के अर्थ में ही 'वापस' या 'दोबारा' शामिल होता है, अतः इनके साथ 'back' या 'again' लगाना गलत है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Identify the incorrect part: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: The prefix 're-' in words like 'return', 'repeat', 'revert', 'reimburse', and 'recall' inherently means 'again' or 'back'. Adding 'back' ('return back') is a common redundancy error.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: वाक्य सुधारें: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
optionD_hi: pass marks (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'passing marks' नहीं 'pass marks' होता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण होने वाले अंकों को 'Pass marks' कहा जाता है, बोलचाल में प्रयुक्त 'passing marks' व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Select the correct phrase improvement: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
explanation_en: Colloquialism Correction: The standard English term is 'PASS MARKS' (or 'qualifying marks'), not 'passing marks'. Similarly: 'link language' (not linking), 'boarding house' (not boarding).
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: त्रुटि खोजें: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (A) - Preposition 'between' के बाद 'I' के स्थान पर 'me' आएगा
explanation_hi: नियम: Preposition (जैसे Between, Except, Let) के बाद हमेशा Objective Case का सर्वनाम आता है। अतः 'Between you and me' सही है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Find the error: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Objective Case after Prepositions: All prepositions ('between', 'except', 'let', 'for', 'with') must be followed by objective pronouns (me, him, her, them, us). Hence, 'between you and me' is grammatically correct.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: तुलना दोष सुधारें: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
optionB_hi: than that of Chandigarh (जलवायु की तुलना जलवायु से करने हेतु 'that of')
explanation_hi: असंगत तुलना नियम: शिमला की जलवायु की तुलना सीधे चंडीगढ़ शहर से नहीं हो सकती; चंडीगढ़ की जलवायु से होगी, अतः 'than that of Chandigarh' सही है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Improve the underlined segment: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
explanation_en: Logical Parallelism in Comparison: A comparison must be between two equivalent entities. Comparing Shimla's 'climate' directly with the city 'Chandigarh' is illogical. Use 'than that of Chandigarh' (singular) or 'than those of' (plural).
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
optionC_hi: was, were ('Many a' के साथ एकवचन, जबकि 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Many a' के बाद एकवचन संज्ञा व एकवचन क्रिया (Many a passenger was) आती है, जबकि केवल 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन क्रिया (were) आती है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Fill in the blanks: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'Many a + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('Many a passenger was...'). In contrast, 'Many + PLURAL VERB' ('many were admitted').
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
optionC_hi: hearing ('Looking forward to' के बाद Gerund / V1-ing आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Looking forward to', 'with a view to', 'addicted to' में 'to' एक प्रीपोजिशन है, अतः इसके बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1 + ing यानी hearing) आता है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Select the correct grammatical verb form: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
explanation_en: In phrases where 'to' is a preposition (look forward to, accustomed to, habituated to, with a view to, addicted to, prone to), it is strictly followed by a GERUND (V1 + ing), not base infinitive.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (B) - 'One' के लिए possessive सर्वनाम 'one's' आएगा, 'his' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: जब वाक्य का कर्ता 'One' हो, तो उसके पूरे वाक्य में संबंधसूचक सर्वनाम 'one's' और स्वयं के लिए 'oneself' आता है, 'his' नहीं।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Spot the error: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Pronoun Concord: When the indefinite pronoun 'ONE' is the subject of a sentence, its corresponding possessive form is strictly 'ONE'S' (apostrophe s), not 'his', 'her', or 'their'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: वाक्य सुधारें: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
optionA_hi: Inspite of his severe fever (In spite अलग-अलग लिखा जाता है)
optionC_hi: Despite his severe fever ('Despite' के साथ 'of' कभी नहीं आता)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' नहीं लगाया जाता (केवल 'Despite his fever')। यदि 'of' लगाना हो तो 'In spite of' लिखा जाता है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Improve the underlined segment: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
explanation_en: Prepositional rule: 'DESPITE' is a single preposition that already incorporates 'of'. Writing 'despite of' is a major grammatical blunder. Alternatively, 'IN SPITE OF' (three words) is correct.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: 'Comprise' का शुद्ध प्रयोग पहचानें:
optionB_hi: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists. (Active voice में 'comprise of' गलत है)
optionC_hi: The panel consists five... ('of' छूटा है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Active Voice में 'Comprise' के बाद 'of' नहीं आता (comprises five members)। 'Consist' के बाद 'of' अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Identify the correct usage of 'comprise':
optionA_en: The panel is comprised five jurists.
optionB_en: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists.
optionD_en: The investigative panel comprises of five eminent jurists.
explanation_en: Rule: In active voice, 'COMPRISE' means 'consist of' or 'be made up of' and takes NO preposition. 'Consist' takes 'of' (consists of). 'Comprise of' is an incorrect hybrid.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: त्रुटि खोजें: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - 'big blunder' अशुद्ध है; 'blunder' का अर्थ ही भारी भूल होता है
explanation_hi: 'Blunder' का अर्थ ही 'बड़ी या भारी भूल' होता है। अतः इसके साथ 'big' या 'huge' लगाना पुनरुक्ति दोष है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Spot the error: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Vocabulary Precision: A 'blunder' by definition is a colossal or catastrophic mistake. Qualifying it with 'big' or 'huge' is a classic superfluous redundancy. Use simply 'a blunder' or 'a big mistake'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: वाक्य सुधारें: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
optionB_hi: ordered three cups of espresso (Order क्रिया के बाद 'for' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Order' का प्रयोग क्रिया के रूप में हो, तो इसके बाद 'for' नहीं आता (ordered coffee, ordered books)।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Improve the sentence: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
explanation_en: Transitive Verb Rule: When 'order' is used as a transitive verb for purchasing or requisitioning food, it takes a direct object without the preposition 'for' ('ordered coffee', not 'ordered for coffee').
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: सही व्याकरणिक संरचना चुनें: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
optionB_hi: avail yourself of (Avail + Reflexive Pronoun + of)
explanation_hi: नियम: लाभ उठाने के अर्थ में 'Avail' के बाद कर्ता के अनुसार Reflexive Pronoun (myself, yourself) और फिर 'of' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Choose the grammatically complete construction: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
explanation_en: Transitive/Reflexive Rule: The verb 'avail' (in the sense of taking advantage of an opportunity) strictly demands a reflexive pronoun corresponding to the subject, followed by 'of': 'avail + oneself + OF'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: व्याकरणिक समानांतरता (Parallelism) वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionB_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record. (दो क्रियाओं won और broke के बीच समानांतरता)
optionC_hi: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionD_hi: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
explanation_hi: समानांतरता का नियम (Parallelism): 'Not only' और 'but also' के बाद एक ही प्रकार के पद (जैसे दोनों जगह Verb या दोनों जगह Noun) आने चाहिए।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Select the sentence demonstrating flawless grammatical parallelism:
optionA_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionB_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record.
optionC_en: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionD_en: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
explanation_en: Parallel Structure: The elements following 'not only' and 'but also' must be of identical grammatical category. Here, 'won' (verb phrase) and 'broke' (verb phrase) are perfectly parallel.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
optionB_hi: hard, hardly (कठिन परिश्रम worked hard, मुश्किल से hardly)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Hard' का अर्थ कठिन या परिश्रमपूर्वक होता है (work hard); जबकि 'Hardly' नकारात्मक शब्द है जिसका अर्थ 'मुश्किल से ही' होता है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Fill in the blank with precision: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
explanation_en: 'Hard' functions as both adjective and adverb meaning diligently or with effort ('work hard'). 'Hardly' is a negative adverb meaning scarcely or almost not ('hardly pass').
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं होता; 'fast' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: नियम: अंग्रेजी में 'Fast' ही Adverb (क्रियाविशेषण) और Adjective दोनों होता है। 'Fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Spot the error: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_en: Part (B) - 'fastly' is not a recognized English word; use 'fast'
explanation_en: Non-existent word: 'Fast' serves as both an adjective and an adverb in English ('drove fast', 'a fast car'). The word 'fastly' does not exist in standard dictionaries.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: सही भिन्न (Fraction) रूप चुनें: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
optionA_hi: Two thirds (अंश 1 से अधिक होने पर हर में plural 'thirds' आता है)
explanation_hi: भिन्न का नियम: यदि अंश (Numerator) एक से अधिक हो (2, 3), तो हर (Denominator) बहुवचन होता है: 'two thirds', 'three fourths'।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Select the grammatically correct fraction expression: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
explanation_en: Fractional grammar: When the numerator is greater than one (two, three), the denominator takes the plural form: 'two-thirds', 'three-fourths'. ('One-third' remains singular).
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: त्रुटि खोजें: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - 'more stronger' दोहरा comparative है; केवल 'stronger' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: जब किसी विशेषण में '-er' जोड़कर comparative बनाया जाए (stronger), तो उसके पहले 'more' लगाना 'Double Comparative' की गलती है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Spot the error: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_en: Part (B) - Double comparative 'more stronger' is ungrammatical; use only 'stronger'
explanation_en: Double Comparative Error: When a monosyllabic adjective forms its comparative with '-er' ('stronger'), preceding it with 'more' is a double comparative error. Use simply 'stronger'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: देखभाल करने के अर्थ में सही क्रिया भरें: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_hi: 'Look after' का अर्थ होता है किसी बच्चे या रोगी की देखभाल करना (Take care of)।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Complete the sentence logically: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_en: 'Look after' means to take care of someone or nurture them. 'Look for' means to search for something lost.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: 'Although' के साथ सही योजक चुनें: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
optionC_hi: yet (या केवल कॉमा; 'but' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Although' या 'Though' के साथ केवल 'yet' या अल्पविराम (comma) आता है, 'but' का प्रयोग सर्वथा गलत है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Choose the correct conjunction pairing: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
explanation_en: Conjunction rule: 'Although / Though' pairs with 'YET' (or a single comma). Using 'but' with although ('Although... but') is a severe examination error.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: वाक्य सुधारें: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
optionB_hi: put your signature (हस्ताक्षर संज्ञा हेतु 'signature' शब्द शुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Sign' एक क्रिया (Verb) है; हस्ताक्षर के संज्ञा रूप (Noun) के लिए 'Signature' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Improve the sentence: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
explanation_en: Word Choice: 'Sign' is primarily a verb ('please sign the document'). The corresponding noun for one's handwritten name is 'SIGNATURE'. 'Put your sign' is colloquial Indian English; use 'put your signature'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
optionA_hi: between, among (दो के बीच Between, दो से अधिक के बीच Among)
explanation_hi: नियम: दो व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के बीच बंटवारे के लिए 'between' और दो से अधिक के लिए 'among' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Select the correct prepositions: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
explanation_en: Distribution Rule: 'Between' is used when dividing between two distinct entities. 'Among' is used for division among three or more entities.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: उचित शब्द भरें: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
optionA_hi: latter (दो में से बाद वाले के लिए 'latter')
explanation_hi: नियम: दो वस्तुओं में से बाद वाली के लिए 'latter' आता है; 'later' समय बताता है और 'last' दो से अधिक में अंतिम के लिए आता है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Fill in the blank with precision: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
explanation_en: 'Former' and 'Latter' refer to position between two items (former = first of two; latter = second of two). 'Later' refers to time. 'Last' refers to position among three or more.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: सही डिटरमिनर भरें: 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
optionA_hi: the little (थोड़ा जो कुछ भी बचा था, वह सब)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Little' = न के बराबर; 'A little' = कुछ मात्रा; 'The little' = जो कुछ थोड़ा बचा था वह सब।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Select the option that conveys 'a small quantity, but all of it': 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
explanation_en: Quantity distinction: 'Little' = almost none (negative). 'A little' = some amount (positive). 'The little' = the specific small amount available in its entirety.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: न के बराबर के अर्थ में सही शब्द चुनें: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
optionC_hi: few (न के बराबर संख्या / लगभग कोई नहीं)
explanation_hi: नियम: Countable संज्ञा के साथ 'Few' का अर्थ 'न के बराबर' होता है; 'A few' का अर्थ 'कुछ' होता है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Fill in the blank: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
explanation_en: 'Few' means almost none (hardly any students, negative implication). 'A few' means a small number (positive). 'Students' is countable, so 'few' applies.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
optionD_hi: elder, older (रक्त संबंध में elder, आयु की सामान्य तुलना में older than)
explanation_hi: नियम: एक ही परिवार के सगे भाई-बहनों के लिए 'Elder/Eldest' आता है (इसके साथ than नहीं आता)। सामान्य आयु तुलना में 'older than' आता है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Fill in the blank: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
explanation_en: 'Elder' and 'Eldest' are strictly used for members of the same family (blood relations) and take 'to' or no preposition (never 'than'). 'Older' is used for people and objects generally, followed by 'than'.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: उचित पारस्परिक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
optionC_hi: each other, one another (दो के लिए each other, दो से अधिक के लिए one another)
explanation_hi: नियम: केवल दो व्यक्तियों के परस्पर संबंध के लिए 'each other' और दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों के लिए 'one another' आता है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Select the correct pronouns: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
explanation_en: Reciprocal Pronouns: 'Each other' is used when two entities interact mutually. 'One another' is used when three or more entities interact mutually.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (A) - 'seldom or ever' गलत है; 'seldom or never' या 'seldom if ever' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: मुहावरेदार रूप से या तो 'seldom or never' होता है या 'seldom if ever'। 'Seldom or ever' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Spot the idiomatic error: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_en: Part (A) - Use either 'seldom or never' OR 'seldom if ever'
explanation_en: Idiomatic Standard: The established negative pairings are either 'SELDOM OR NEVER' or 'SELDOM IF EVER'. The combination 'seldom or ever' is ungrammatical.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: काल्पनिक स्थिति हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
optionB_hi: were ('As if' के बाद काल्पनिक स्थिति में 'were' का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'As if' (मानो कि) के बाद जब अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक तुलना की जाए, तो एकवचन कर्ता के साथ भी 'were' आता है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Fill in the blank: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
explanation_en: Unreal comparison: Conjunctions 'as if' and 'as though' introducing imaginary or contrary-to-fact suppositions take the subjunctive past verb 'WERE'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के वाक्य सुधार एवं त्रुटि संशोधन प्रश्न: त्रुटि खोजें: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (A) - 'did' के बाद क्रिया का प्रथम रूप (V1 - sound) आएगा, 'sounded' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया की प्रथम फॉर्म (V1 यानी sound) आती है, 'sounded' लिखना अशुद्ध है।
question_en: Past Year Sentence Improvement & Error Detection: Identify the error in: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_en: Part (A) - After auxiliary 'did', base verb 'sound' (V1) must be used, not 'sounded'
explanation_en: Auxiliary syntax: The auxiliary 'did' takes the bare base form of the main verb (V1). Writing 'did sounded' is a double past tense error. It must be 'did the alarm sound'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचानें: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous): मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cousin brother' या 'cousin sister' लिखना अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Spot the error in the sentence: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' is incorrect; use only 'cousin'
explanation_en: Superfluous Expression: In standard English, the noun 'cousin' suffices for both male and female relatives. Adding 'brother' or 'sister' ('cousin brother/sister') is redundant and ungrammatical.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] अशुद्ध भाग पहचानें: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (B) - 'returned back' में 'back' का प्रयोग अनावश्यक है; केवल 'returned' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Return', 'Revert', 'Repeat' आदि शब्दों के अर्थ में ही 'वापस' या 'दोबारा' शामिल होता है, अतः इनके साथ 'back' या 'again' लगाना गलत है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Identify the incorrect part: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: The prefix 're-' in words like 'return', 'repeat', 'revert', 'reimburse', and 'recall' inherently means 'again' or 'back'. Adding 'back' ('return back') is a common redundancy error.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] वाक्य सुधारें: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
optionB_hi: pass marks (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'passing marks' नहीं 'pass marks' होता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण होने वाले अंकों को 'Pass marks' कहा जाता है, बोलचाल में प्रयुक्त 'passing marks' व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Select the correct phrase improvement: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
explanation_en: Colloquialism Correction: The standard English term is 'PASS MARKS' (or 'qualifying marks'), not 'passing marks'. Similarly: 'link language' (not linking), 'boarding house' (not boarding).
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] त्रुटि खोजें: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (A) - Preposition 'between' के बाद 'I' के स्थान पर 'me' आएगा
explanation_hi: नियम: Preposition (जैसे Between, Except, Let) के बाद हमेशा Objective Case का सर्वनाम आता है। अतः 'Between you and me' सही है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Find the error: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Objective Case after Prepositions: All prepositions ('between', 'except', 'let', 'for', 'with') must be followed by objective pronouns (me, him, her, them, us). Hence, 'between you and me' is grammatically correct.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] तुलना दोष सुधारें: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
optionD_hi: than that of Chandigarh (जलवायु की तुलना जलवायु से करने हेतु 'that of')
explanation_hi: असंगत तुलना नियम: शिमला की जलवायु की तुलना सीधे चंडीगढ़ शहर से नहीं हो सकती; चंडीगढ़ की जलवायु से होगी, अतः 'than that of Chandigarh' सही है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Improve the underlined segment: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
explanation_en: Logical Parallelism in Comparison: A comparison must be between two equivalent entities. Comparing Shimla's 'climate' directly with the city 'Chandigarh' is illogical. Use 'than that of Chandigarh' (singular) or 'than those of' (plural).
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
optionA_hi: was, were ('Many a' के साथ एकवचन, जबकि 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Many a' के बाद एकवचन संज्ञा व एकवचन क्रिया (Many a passenger was) आती है, जबकि केवल 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन क्रिया (were) आती है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Fill in the blanks: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'Many a + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('Many a passenger was...'). In contrast, 'Many + PLURAL VERB' ('many were admitted').
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
optionB_hi: hearing ('Looking forward to' के बाद Gerund / V1-ing आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Looking forward to', 'with a view to', 'addicted to' में 'to' एक प्रीपोजिशन है, अतः इसके बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1 + ing यानी hearing) आता है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Select the correct grammatical verb form: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
explanation_en: In phrases where 'to' is a preposition (look forward to, accustomed to, habituated to, with a view to, addicted to, prone to), it is strictly followed by a GERUND (V1 + ing), not base infinitive.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - 'One' के लिए possessive सर्वनाम 'one's' आएगा, 'his' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: जब वाक्य का कर्ता 'One' हो, तो उसके पूरे वाक्य में संबंधसूचक सर्वनाम 'one's' और स्वयं के लिए 'oneself' आता है, 'his' नहीं।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Spot the error: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Pronoun Concord: When the indefinite pronoun 'ONE' is the subject of a sentence, its corresponding possessive form is strictly 'ONE'S' (apostrophe s), not 'his', 'her', or 'their'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] वाक्य सुधारें: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
optionB_hi: Despite his severe fever ('Despite' के साथ 'of' कभी नहीं आता)
optionD_hi: Inspite of his severe fever (In spite अलग-अलग लिखा जाता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' नहीं लगाया जाता (केवल 'Despite his fever')। यदि 'of' लगाना हो तो 'In spite of' लिखा जाता है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Improve the underlined segment: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
explanation_en: Prepositional rule: 'DESPITE' is a single preposition that already incorporates 'of'. Writing 'despite of' is a major grammatical blunder. Alternatively, 'IN SPITE OF' (three words) is correct.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] 'Comprise' का शुद्ध प्रयोग पहचानें:
optionB_hi: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists. (Active voice में 'comprise of' गलत है)
optionD_hi: The panel consists five... ('of' छूटा है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Active Voice में 'Comprise' के बाद 'of' नहीं आता (comprises five members)। 'Consist' के बाद 'of' अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Identify the correct usage of 'comprise':
optionA_en: The investigative panel comprises of five eminent jurists.
optionB_en: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists.
optionC_en: The panel is comprised five jurists.
explanation_en: Rule: In active voice, 'COMPRISE' means 'consist of' or 'be made up of' and takes NO preposition. 'Consist' takes 'of' (consists of). 'Comprise of' is an incorrect hybrid.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] त्रुटि खोजें: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'big blunder' अशुद्ध है; 'blunder' का अर्थ ही भारी भूल होता है
explanation_hi: 'Blunder' का अर्थ ही 'बड़ी या भारी भूल' होता है। अतः इसके साथ 'big' या 'huge' लगाना पुनरुक्ति दोष है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Spot the error: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Vocabulary Precision: A 'blunder' by definition is a colossal or catastrophic mistake. Qualifying it with 'big' or 'huge' is a classic superfluous redundancy. Use simply 'a blunder' or 'a big mistake'.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] वाक्य सुधारें: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
optionB_hi: ordered three cups of espresso (Order क्रिया के बाद 'for' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Order' का प्रयोग क्रिया के रूप में हो, तो इसके बाद 'for' नहीं आता (ordered coffee, ordered books)।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Improve the sentence: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
explanation_en: Transitive Verb Rule: When 'order' is used as a transitive verb for purchasing or requisitioning food, it takes a direct object without the preposition 'for' ('ordered coffee', not 'ordered for coffee').
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] सही व्याकरणिक संरचना चुनें: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
optionC_hi: avail yourself of (Avail + Reflexive Pronoun + of)
explanation_hi: नियम: लाभ उठाने के अर्थ में 'Avail' के बाद कर्ता के अनुसार Reflexive Pronoun (myself, yourself) और फिर 'of' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Choose the grammatically complete construction: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
explanation_en: Transitive/Reflexive Rule: The verb 'avail' (in the sense of taking advantage of an opportunity) strictly demands a reflexive pronoun corresponding to the subject, followed by 'of': 'avail + oneself + OF'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] व्याकरणिक समानांतरता (Parallelism) वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionB_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record. (दो क्रियाओं won और broke के बीच समानांतरता)
optionC_hi: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionD_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
explanation_hi: समानांतरता का नियम (Parallelism): 'Not only' और 'but also' के बाद एक ही प्रकार के पद (जैसे दोनों जगह Verb या दोनों जगह Noun) आने चाहिए।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Select the sentence demonstrating flawless grammatical parallelism:
optionA_en: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionB_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record.
optionC_en: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionD_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
explanation_en: Parallel Structure: The elements following 'not only' and 'but also' must be of identical grammatical category. Here, 'won' (verb phrase) and 'broke' (verb phrase) are perfectly parallel.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
optionC_hi: hard, hardly (कठिन परिश्रम worked hard, मुश्किल से hardly)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Hard' का अर्थ कठिन या परिश्रमपूर्वक होता है (work hard); जबकि 'Hardly' नकारात्मक शब्द है जिसका अर्थ 'मुश्किल से ही' होता है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Fill in the blank with precision: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
explanation_en: 'Hard' functions as both adjective and adverb meaning diligently or with effort ('work hard'). 'Hardly' is a negative adverb meaning scarcely or almost not ('hardly pass').
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं होता; 'fast' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: नियम: अंग्रेजी में 'Fast' ही Adverb (क्रियाविशेषण) और Adjective दोनों होता है। 'Fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Spot the error: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_en: Part (B) - 'fastly' is not a recognized English word; use 'fast'
explanation_en: Non-existent word: 'Fast' serves as both an adjective and an adverb in English ('drove fast', 'a fast car'). The word 'fastly' does not exist in standard dictionaries.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] सही भिन्न (Fraction) रूप चुनें: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
optionD_hi: Two thirds (अंश 1 से अधिक होने पर हर में plural 'thirds' आता है)
explanation_hi: भिन्न का नियम: यदि अंश (Numerator) एक से अधिक हो (2, 3), तो हर (Denominator) बहुवचन होता है: 'two thirds', 'three fourths'।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Select the grammatically correct fraction expression: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
explanation_en: Fractional grammar: When the numerator is greater than one (two, three), the denominator takes the plural form: 'two-thirds', 'three-fourths'. ('One-third' remains singular).
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] त्रुटि खोजें: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (B) - 'more stronger' दोहरा comparative है; केवल 'stronger' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: जब किसी विशेषण में '-er' जोड़कर comparative बनाया जाए (stronger), तो उसके पहले 'more' लगाना 'Double Comparative' की गलती है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Spot the error: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (B) - Double comparative 'more stronger' is ungrammatical; use only 'stronger'
explanation_en: Double Comparative Error: When a monosyllabic adjective forms its comparative with '-er' ('stronger'), preceding it with 'more' is a double comparative error. Use simply 'stronger'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] देखभाल करने के अर्थ में सही क्रिया भरें: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_hi: 'Look after' का अर्थ होता है किसी बच्चे या रोगी की देखभाल करना (Take care of)।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Complete the sentence logically: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_en: 'Look after' means to take care of someone or nurture them. 'Look for' means to search for something lost.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] 'Although' के साथ सही योजक चुनें: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
optionC_hi: yet (या केवल कॉमा; 'but' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Although' या 'Though' के साथ केवल 'yet' या अल्पविराम (comma) आता है, 'but' का प्रयोग सर्वथा गलत है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Choose the correct conjunction pairing: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
explanation_en: Conjunction rule: 'Although / Though' pairs with 'YET' (or a single comma). Using 'but' with although ('Although... but') is a severe examination error.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] वाक्य सुधारें: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
optionC_hi: put your signature (हस्ताक्षर संज्ञा हेतु 'signature' शब्द शुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Sign' एक क्रिया (Verb) है; हस्ताक्षर के संज्ञा रूप (Noun) के लिए 'Signature' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Improve the sentence: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
explanation_en: Word Choice: 'Sign' is primarily a verb ('please sign the document'). The corresponding noun for one's handwritten name is 'SIGNATURE'. 'Put your sign' is colloquial Indian English; use 'put your signature'.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
optionC_hi: between, among (दो के बीच Between, दो से अधिक के बीच Among)
explanation_hi: नियम: दो व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के बीच बंटवारे के लिए 'between' और दो से अधिक के लिए 'among' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Select the correct prepositions: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
explanation_en: Distribution Rule: 'Between' is used when dividing between two distinct entities. 'Among' is used for division among three or more entities.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] उचित शब्द भरें: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
optionB_hi: latter (दो में से बाद वाले के लिए 'latter')
explanation_hi: नियम: दो वस्तुओं में से बाद वाली के लिए 'latter' आता है; 'later' समय बताता है और 'last' दो से अधिक में अंतिम के लिए आता है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Fill in the blank with precision: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
explanation_en: 'Former' and 'Latter' refer to position between two items (former = first of two; latter = second of two). 'Later' refers to time. 'Last' refers to position among three or more.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] सही डिटरमिनर भरें: 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
optionC_hi: the little (थोड़ा जो कुछ भी बचा था, वह सब)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Little' = न के बराबर; 'A little' = कुछ मात्रा; 'The little' = जो कुछ थोड़ा बचा था वह सब।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Select the option that conveys 'a small quantity, but all of it': 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
explanation_en: Quantity distinction: 'Little' = almost none (negative). 'A little' = some amount (positive). 'The little' = the specific small amount available in its entirety.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] न के बराबर के अर्थ में सही शब्द चुनें: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
optionC_hi: few (न के बराबर संख्या / लगभग कोई नहीं)
explanation_hi: नियम: Countable संज्ञा के साथ 'Few' का अर्थ 'न के बराबर' होता है; 'A few' का अर्थ 'कुछ' होता है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Fill in the blank: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
explanation_en: 'Few' means almost none (hardly any students, negative implication). 'A few' means a small number (positive). 'Students' is countable, so 'few' applies.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
optionC_hi: elder, older (रक्त संबंध में elder, आयु की सामान्य तुलना में older than)
explanation_hi: नियम: एक ही परिवार के सगे भाई-बहनों के लिए 'Elder/Eldest' आता है (इसके साथ than नहीं आता)। सामान्य आयु तुलना में 'older than' आता है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Fill in the blank: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
explanation_en: 'Elder' and 'Eldest' are strictly used for members of the same family (blood relations) and take 'to' or no preposition (never 'than'). 'Older' is used for people and objects generally, followed by 'than'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] उचित पारस्परिक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
optionB_hi: each other, one another (दो के लिए each other, दो से अधिक के लिए one another)
explanation_hi: नियम: केवल दो व्यक्तियों के परस्पर संबंध के लिए 'each other' और दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों के लिए 'one another' आता है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Select the correct pronouns: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
explanation_en: Reciprocal Pronouns: 'Each other' is used when two entities interact mutually. 'One another' is used when three or more entities interact mutually.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (A) - 'seldom or ever' गलत है; 'seldom or never' या 'seldom if ever' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: मुहावरेदार रूप से या तो 'seldom or never' होता है या 'seldom if ever'। 'Seldom or ever' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Spot the idiomatic error: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (A) - Use either 'seldom or never' OR 'seldom if ever'
explanation_en: Idiomatic Standard: The established negative pairings are either 'SELDOM OR NEVER' or 'SELDOM IF EVER'. The combination 'seldom or ever' is ungrammatical.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] काल्पनिक स्थिति हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
optionC_hi: were ('As if' के बाद काल्पनिक स्थिति में 'were' का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'As if' (मानो कि) के बाद जब अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक तुलना की जाए, तो एकवचन कर्ता के साथ भी 'were' आता है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Fill in the blank: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
explanation_en: Unreal comparison: Conjunctions 'as if' and 'as though' introducing imaginary or contrary-to-fact suppositions take the subjunctive past verb 'WERE'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [अनावश्यक शब्द एवं पुनरुक्ति दोष निवारण] त्रुटि खोजें: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (A) - 'did' के बाद क्रिया का प्रथम रूप (V1 - sound) आएगा, 'sounded' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया की प्रथम फॉर्म (V1 यानी sound) आती है, 'sounded' लिखना अशुद्ध है।
question_en: [Superfluous Expressions & Redundancy Traps] Identify the error in: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (A) - After auxiliary 'did', base verb 'sound' (V1) must be used, not 'sounded'
explanation_en: Auxiliary syntax: The auxiliary 'did' takes the bare base form of the main verb (V1). Writing 'did sounded' is a double past tense error. It must be 'did the alarm sound'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचानें: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous): मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cousin brother' या 'cousin sister' लिखना अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Spot the error in the sentence: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' is incorrect; use only 'cousin'
explanation_en: Superfluous Expression: In standard English, the noun 'cousin' suffices for both male and female relatives. Adding 'brother' or 'sister' ('cousin brother/sister') is redundant and ungrammatical.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: अशुद्ध भाग पहचानें: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (B) - 'returned back' में 'back' का प्रयोग अनावश्यक है; केवल 'returned' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Return', 'Revert', 'Repeat' आदि शब्दों के अर्थ में ही 'वापस' या 'दोबारा' शामिल होता है, अतः इनके साथ 'back' या 'again' लगाना गलत है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Identify the incorrect part: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: The prefix 're-' in words like 'return', 'repeat', 'revert', 'reimburse', and 'recall' inherently means 'again' or 'back'. Adding 'back' ('return back') is a common redundancy error.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: वाक्य सुधारें: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
optionD_hi: pass marks (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'passing marks' नहीं 'pass marks' होता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण होने वाले अंकों को 'Pass marks' कहा जाता है, बोलचाल में प्रयुक्त 'passing marks' व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Select the correct phrase improvement: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
explanation_en: Colloquialism Correction: The standard English term is 'PASS MARKS' (or 'qualifying marks'), not 'passing marks'. Similarly: 'link language' (not linking), 'boarding house' (not boarding).
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: त्रुटि खोजें: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (A) - Preposition 'between' के बाद 'I' के स्थान पर 'me' आएगा
explanation_hi: नियम: Preposition (जैसे Between, Except, Let) के बाद हमेशा Objective Case का सर्वनाम आता है। अतः 'Between you and me' सही है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Find the error: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Objective Case after Prepositions: All prepositions ('between', 'except', 'let', 'for', 'with') must be followed by objective pronouns (me, him, her, them, us). Hence, 'between you and me' is grammatically correct.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: तुलना दोष सुधारें: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
optionD_hi: than that of Chandigarh (जलवायु की तुलना जलवायु से करने हेतु 'that of')
explanation_hi: असंगत तुलना नियम: शिमला की जलवायु की तुलना सीधे चंडीगढ़ शहर से नहीं हो सकती; चंडीगढ़ की जलवायु से होगी, अतः 'than that of Chandigarh' सही है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Improve the underlined segment: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
explanation_en: Logical Parallelism in Comparison: A comparison must be between two equivalent entities. Comparing Shimla's 'climate' directly with the city 'Chandigarh' is illogical. Use 'than that of Chandigarh' (singular) or 'than those of' (plural).
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
optionB_hi: was, were ('Many a' के साथ एकवचन, जबकि 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Many a' के बाद एकवचन संज्ञा व एकवचन क्रिया (Many a passenger was) आती है, जबकि केवल 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन क्रिया (were) आती है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Fill in the blanks: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'Many a + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('Many a passenger was...'). In contrast, 'Many + PLURAL VERB' ('many were admitted').
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
optionA_hi: hearing ('Looking forward to' के बाद Gerund / V1-ing आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Looking forward to', 'with a view to', 'addicted to' में 'to' एक प्रीपोजिशन है, अतः इसके बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1 + ing यानी hearing) आता है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Select the correct grammatical verb form: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
explanation_en: In phrases where 'to' is a preposition (look forward to, accustomed to, habituated to, with a view to, addicted to, prone to), it is strictly followed by a GERUND (V1 + ing), not base infinitive.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'One' के लिए possessive सर्वनाम 'one's' आएगा, 'his' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: जब वाक्य का कर्ता 'One' हो, तो उसके पूरे वाक्य में संबंधसूचक सर्वनाम 'one's' और स्वयं के लिए 'oneself' आता है, 'his' नहीं।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Spot the error: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Pronoun Concord: When the indefinite pronoun 'ONE' is the subject of a sentence, its corresponding possessive form is strictly 'ONE'S' (apostrophe s), not 'his', 'her', or 'their'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: वाक्य सुधारें: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
optionA_hi: Despite his severe fever ('Despite' के साथ 'of' कभी नहीं आता)
optionD_hi: Inspite of his severe fever (In spite अलग-अलग लिखा जाता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' नहीं लगाया जाता (केवल 'Despite his fever')। यदि 'of' लगाना हो तो 'In spite of' लिखा जाता है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Improve the underlined segment: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
explanation_en: Prepositional rule: 'DESPITE' is a single preposition that already incorporates 'of'. Writing 'despite of' is a major grammatical blunder. Alternatively, 'IN SPITE OF' (three words) is correct.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: 'Comprise' का शुद्ध प्रयोग पहचानें:
optionA_hi: The panel consists five... ('of' छूटा है)
optionB_hi: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists. (Active voice में 'comprise of' गलत है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Active Voice में 'Comprise' के बाद 'of' नहीं आता (comprises five members)। 'Consist' के बाद 'of' अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Identify the correct usage of 'comprise':
optionB_en: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists.
optionC_en: The panel is comprised five jurists.
optionD_en: The investigative panel comprises of five eminent jurists.
explanation_en: Rule: In active voice, 'COMPRISE' means 'consist of' or 'be made up of' and takes NO preposition. 'Consist' takes 'of' (consists of). 'Comprise of' is an incorrect hybrid.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: त्रुटि खोजें: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'big blunder' अशुद्ध है; 'blunder' का अर्थ ही भारी भूल होता है
explanation_hi: 'Blunder' का अर्थ ही 'बड़ी या भारी भूल' होता है। अतः इसके साथ 'big' या 'huge' लगाना पुनरुक्ति दोष है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Spot the error: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Vocabulary Precision: A 'blunder' by definition is a colossal or catastrophic mistake. Qualifying it with 'big' or 'huge' is a classic superfluous redundancy. Use simply 'a blunder' or 'a big mistake'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: वाक्य सुधारें: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
optionA_hi: ordered three cups of espresso (Order क्रिया के बाद 'for' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Order' का प्रयोग क्रिया के रूप में हो, तो इसके बाद 'for' नहीं आता (ordered coffee, ordered books)।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Improve the sentence: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
explanation_en: Transitive Verb Rule: When 'order' is used as a transitive verb for purchasing or requisitioning food, it takes a direct object without the preposition 'for' ('ordered coffee', not 'ordered for coffee').
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: सही व्याकरणिक संरचना चुनें: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
optionC_hi: avail yourself of (Avail + Reflexive Pronoun + of)
explanation_hi: नियम: लाभ उठाने के अर्थ में 'Avail' के बाद कर्ता के अनुसार Reflexive Pronoun (myself, yourself) और फिर 'of' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Choose the grammatically complete construction: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
explanation_en: Transitive/Reflexive Rule: The verb 'avail' (in the sense of taking advantage of an opportunity) strictly demands a reflexive pronoun corresponding to the subject, followed by 'of': 'avail + oneself + OF'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: व्याकरणिक समानांतरता (Parallelism) वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionB_hi: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionC_hi: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionD_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record. (दो क्रियाओं won और broke के बीच समानांतरता)
explanation_hi: समानांतरता का नियम (Parallelism): 'Not only' और 'but also' के बाद एक ही प्रकार के पद (जैसे दोनों जगह Verb या दोनों जगह Noun) आने चाहिए।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Select the sentence demonstrating flawless grammatical parallelism:
optionA_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionB_en: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionC_en: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionD_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record.
explanation_en: Parallel Structure: The elements following 'not only' and 'but also' must be of identical grammatical category. Here, 'won' (verb phrase) and 'broke' (verb phrase) are perfectly parallel.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
optionD_hi: hard, hardly (कठिन परिश्रम worked hard, मुश्किल से hardly)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Hard' का अर्थ कठिन या परिश्रमपूर्वक होता है (work hard); जबकि 'Hardly' नकारात्मक शब्द है जिसका अर्थ 'मुश्किल से ही' होता है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Fill in the blank with precision: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
explanation_en: 'Hard' functions as both adjective and adverb meaning diligently or with effort ('work hard'). 'Hardly' is a negative adverb meaning scarcely or almost not ('hardly pass').
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं होता; 'fast' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: नियम: अंग्रेजी में 'Fast' ही Adverb (क्रियाविशेषण) और Adjective दोनों होता है। 'Fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Spot the error: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_en: Part (B) - 'fastly' is not a recognized English word; use 'fast'
explanation_en: Non-existent word: 'Fast' serves as both an adjective and an adverb in English ('drove fast', 'a fast car'). The word 'fastly' does not exist in standard dictionaries.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: सही भिन्न (Fraction) रूप चुनें: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
optionC_hi: Two thirds (अंश 1 से अधिक होने पर हर में plural 'thirds' आता है)
explanation_hi: भिन्न का नियम: यदि अंश (Numerator) एक से अधिक हो (2, 3), तो हर (Denominator) बहुवचन होता है: 'two thirds', 'three fourths'।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Select the grammatically correct fraction expression: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
explanation_en: Fractional grammar: When the numerator is greater than one (two, three), the denominator takes the plural form: 'two-thirds', 'three-fourths'. ('One-third' remains singular).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: त्रुटि खोजें: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - 'more stronger' दोहरा comparative है; केवल 'stronger' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: जब किसी विशेषण में '-er' जोड़कर comparative बनाया जाए (stronger), तो उसके पहले 'more' लगाना 'Double Comparative' की गलती है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Spot the error: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_en: Part (B) - Double comparative 'more stronger' is ungrammatical; use only 'stronger'
explanation_en: Double Comparative Error: When a monosyllabic adjective forms its comparative with '-er' ('stronger'), preceding it with 'more' is a double comparative error. Use simply 'stronger'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: देखभाल करने के अर्थ में सही क्रिया भरें: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_hi: 'Look after' का अर्थ होता है किसी बच्चे या रोगी की देखभाल करना (Take care of)।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Complete the sentence logically: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_en: 'Look after' means to take care of someone or nurture them. 'Look for' means to search for something lost.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: 'Although' के साथ सही योजक चुनें: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
optionB_hi: yet (या केवल कॉमा; 'but' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Although' या 'Though' के साथ केवल 'yet' या अल्पविराम (comma) आता है, 'but' का प्रयोग सर्वथा गलत है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Choose the correct conjunction pairing: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
explanation_en: Conjunction rule: 'Although / Though' pairs with 'YET' (or a single comma). Using 'but' with although ('Although... but') is a severe examination error.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: वाक्य सुधारें: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
optionC_hi: put your signature (हस्ताक्षर संज्ञा हेतु 'signature' शब्द शुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Sign' एक क्रिया (Verb) है; हस्ताक्षर के संज्ञा रूप (Noun) के लिए 'Signature' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Improve the sentence: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
explanation_en: Word Choice: 'Sign' is primarily a verb ('please sign the document'). The corresponding noun for one's handwritten name is 'SIGNATURE'. 'Put your sign' is colloquial Indian English; use 'put your signature'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
optionD_hi: between, among (दो के बीच Between, दो से अधिक के बीच Among)
explanation_hi: नियम: दो व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के बीच बंटवारे के लिए 'between' और दो से अधिक के लिए 'among' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Select the correct prepositions: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
explanation_en: Distribution Rule: 'Between' is used when dividing between two distinct entities. 'Among' is used for division among three or more entities.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: उचित शब्द भरें: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
optionC_hi: latter (दो में से बाद वाले के लिए 'latter')
explanation_hi: नियम: दो वस्तुओं में से बाद वाली के लिए 'latter' आता है; 'later' समय बताता है और 'last' दो से अधिक में अंतिम के लिए आता है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Fill in the blank with precision: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
explanation_en: 'Former' and 'Latter' refer to position between two items (former = first of two; latter = second of two). 'Later' refers to time. 'Last' refers to position among three or more.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: सही डिटरमिनर भरें: 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
optionA_hi: the little (थोड़ा जो कुछ भी बचा था, वह सब)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Little' = न के बराबर; 'A little' = कुछ मात्रा; 'The little' = जो कुछ थोड़ा बचा था वह सब।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Select the option that conveys 'a small quantity, but all of it': 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
explanation_en: Quantity distinction: 'Little' = almost none (negative). 'A little' = some amount (positive). 'The little' = the specific small amount available in its entirety.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: न के बराबर के अर्थ में सही शब्द चुनें: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
optionB_hi: few (न के बराबर संख्या / लगभग कोई नहीं)
explanation_hi: नियम: Countable संज्ञा के साथ 'Few' का अर्थ 'न के बराबर' होता है; 'A few' का अर्थ 'कुछ' होता है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Fill in the blank: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
explanation_en: 'Few' means almost none (hardly any students, negative implication). 'A few' means a small number (positive). 'Students' is countable, so 'few' applies.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
optionC_hi: elder, older (रक्त संबंध में elder, आयु की सामान्य तुलना में older than)
explanation_hi: नियम: एक ही परिवार के सगे भाई-बहनों के लिए 'Elder/Eldest' आता है (इसके साथ than नहीं आता)। सामान्य आयु तुलना में 'older than' आता है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Fill in the blank: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
explanation_en: 'Elder' and 'Eldest' are strictly used for members of the same family (blood relations) and take 'to' or no preposition (never 'than'). 'Older' is used for people and objects generally, followed by 'than'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: उचित पारस्परिक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
optionC_hi: each other, one another (दो के लिए each other, दो से अधिक के लिए one another)
explanation_hi: नियम: केवल दो व्यक्तियों के परस्पर संबंध के लिए 'each other' और दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों के लिए 'one another' आता है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Select the correct pronouns: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
explanation_en: Reciprocal Pronouns: 'Each other' is used when two entities interact mutually. 'One another' is used when three or more entities interact mutually.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (A) - 'seldom or ever' गलत है; 'seldom or never' या 'seldom if ever' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: मुहावरेदार रूप से या तो 'seldom or never' होता है या 'seldom if ever'। 'Seldom or ever' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Spot the idiomatic error: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_en: Part (A) - Use either 'seldom or never' OR 'seldom if ever'
explanation_en: Idiomatic Standard: The established negative pairings are either 'SELDOM OR NEVER' or 'SELDOM IF EVER'. The combination 'seldom or ever' is ungrammatical.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: काल्पनिक स्थिति हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
optionA_hi: were ('As if' के बाद काल्पनिक स्थिति में 'were' का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'As if' (मानो कि) के बाद जब अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक तुलना की जाए, तो एकवचन कर्ता के साथ भी 'were' आता है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Fill in the blank: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
explanation_en: Unreal comparison: Conjunctions 'as if' and 'as though' introducing imaginary or contrary-to-fact suppositions take the subjunctive past verb 'WERE'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: व्याकरण सम्मत शुद्ध पदबंध का चयन कीजिए: त्रुटि खोजें: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (A) - 'did' के बाद क्रिया का प्रथम रूप (V1 - sound) आएगा, 'sounded' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया की प्रथम फॉर्म (V1 यानी sound) आती है, 'sounded' लिखना अशुद्ध है।
question_en: Select the grammatically refined phrase: Identify the error in: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_en: Part (A) - After auxiliary 'did', base verb 'sound' (V1) must be used, not 'sounded'
explanation_en: Auxiliary syntax: The auxiliary 'did' takes the bare base form of the main verb (V1). Writing 'did sounded' is a double past tense error. It must be 'did the alarm sound'.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचानें: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous): मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cousin brother' या 'cousin sister' लिखना अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
