question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Spot the error in the sentence: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_en: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' is incorrect; use only 'cousin'
explanation_en: Superfluous Expression: In standard English, the noun 'cousin' suffices for both male and female relatives. Adding 'brother' or 'sister' ('cousin brother/sister') is redundant and ungrammatical.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] अशुद्ध भाग पहचानें: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'returned back' में 'back' का प्रयोग अनावश्यक है; केवल 'returned' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Return', 'Revert', 'Repeat' आदि शब्दों के अर्थ में ही 'वापस' या 'दोबारा' शामिल होता है, अतः इनके साथ 'back' या 'again' लगाना गलत है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Identify the incorrect part: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: The prefix 're-' in words like 'return', 'repeat', 'revert', 'reimburse', and 'recall' inherently means 'again' or 'back'. Adding 'back' ('return back') is a common redundancy error.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] वाक्य सुधारें: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
optionD_hi: pass marks (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'passing marks' नहीं 'pass marks' होता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण होने वाले अंकों को 'Pass marks' कहा जाता है, बोलचाल में प्रयुक्त 'passing marks' व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Select the correct phrase improvement: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
explanation_en: Colloquialism Correction: The standard English term is 'PASS MARKS' (or 'qualifying marks'), not 'passing marks'. Similarly: 'link language' (not linking), 'boarding house' (not boarding).
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] त्रुटि खोजें: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (A) - Preposition 'between' के बाद 'I' के स्थान पर 'me' आएगा
explanation_hi: नियम: Preposition (जैसे Between, Except, Let) के बाद हमेशा Objective Case का सर्वनाम आता है। अतः 'Between you and me' सही है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Find the error: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Objective Case after Prepositions: All prepositions ('between', 'except', 'let', 'for', 'with') must be followed by objective pronouns (me, him, her, them, us). Hence, 'between you and me' is grammatically correct.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] तुलना दोष सुधारें: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
optionC_hi: than that of Chandigarh (जलवायु की तुलना जलवायु से करने हेतु 'that of')
explanation_hi: असंगत तुलना नियम: शिमला की जलवायु की तुलना सीधे चंडीगढ़ शहर से नहीं हो सकती; चंडीगढ़ की जलवायु से होगी, अतः 'than that of Chandigarh' सही है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Improve the underlined segment: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
explanation_en: Logical Parallelism in Comparison: A comparison must be between two equivalent entities. Comparing Shimla's 'climate' directly with the city 'Chandigarh' is illogical. Use 'than that of Chandigarh' (singular) or 'than those of' (plural).
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
optionB_hi: was, were ('Many a' के साथ एकवचन, जबकि 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Many a' के बाद एकवचन संज्ञा व एकवचन क्रिया (Many a passenger was) आती है, जबकि केवल 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन क्रिया (were) आती है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Fill in the blanks: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'Many a + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('Many a passenger was...'). In contrast, 'Many + PLURAL VERB' ('many were admitted').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
optionA_hi: hearing ('Looking forward to' के बाद Gerund / V1-ing आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Looking forward to', 'with a view to', 'addicted to' में 'to' एक प्रीपोजिशन है, अतः इसके बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1 + ing यानी hearing) आता है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Select the correct grammatical verb form: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
explanation_en: In phrases where 'to' is a preposition (look forward to, accustomed to, habituated to, with a view to, addicted to, prone to), it is strictly followed by a GERUND (V1 + ing), not base infinitive.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - 'One' के लिए possessive सर्वनाम 'one's' आएगा, 'his' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: जब वाक्य का कर्ता 'One' हो, तो उसके पूरे वाक्य में संबंधसूचक सर्वनाम 'one's' और स्वयं के लिए 'oneself' आता है, 'his' नहीं।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Spot the error: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Pronoun Concord: When the indefinite pronoun 'ONE' is the subject of a sentence, its corresponding possessive form is strictly 'ONE'S' (apostrophe s), not 'his', 'her', or 'their'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] वाक्य सुधारें: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
optionA_hi: Inspite of his severe fever (In spite अलग-अलग लिखा जाता है)
optionC_hi: Despite his severe fever ('Despite' के साथ 'of' कभी नहीं आता)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' नहीं लगाया जाता (केवल 'Despite his fever')। यदि 'of' लगाना हो तो 'In spite of' लिखा जाता है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Improve the underlined segment: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
explanation_en: Prepositional rule: 'DESPITE' is a single preposition that already incorporates 'of'. Writing 'despite of' is a major grammatical blunder. Alternatively, 'IN SPITE OF' (three words) is correct.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] 'Comprise' का शुद्ध प्रयोग पहचानें:
optionC_hi: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists. (Active voice में 'comprise of' गलत है)
optionD_hi: The panel consists five... ('of' छूटा है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Active Voice में 'Comprise' के बाद 'of' नहीं आता (comprises five members)। 'Consist' के बाद 'of' अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Identify the correct usage of 'comprise':
optionA_en: The panel is comprised five jurists.
optionB_en: The investigative panel comprises of five eminent jurists.
optionC_en: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists.
explanation_en: Rule: In active voice, 'COMPRISE' means 'consist of' or 'be made up of' and takes NO preposition. 'Consist' takes 'of' (consists of). 'Comprise of' is an incorrect hybrid.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] त्रुटि खोजें: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'big blunder' अशुद्ध है; 'blunder' का अर्थ ही भारी भूल होता है
explanation_hi: 'Blunder' का अर्थ ही 'बड़ी या भारी भूल' होता है। अतः इसके साथ 'big' या 'huge' लगाना पुनरुक्ति दोष है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Spot the error: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Vocabulary Precision: A 'blunder' by definition is a colossal or catastrophic mistake. Qualifying it with 'big' or 'huge' is a classic superfluous redundancy. Use simply 'a blunder' or 'a big mistake'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] वाक्य सुधारें: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
optionC_hi: ordered three cups of espresso (Order क्रिया के बाद 'for' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Order' का प्रयोग क्रिया के रूप में हो, तो इसके बाद 'for' नहीं आता (ordered coffee, ordered books)।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Improve the sentence: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
explanation_en: Transitive Verb Rule: When 'order' is used as a transitive verb for purchasing or requisitioning food, it takes a direct object without the preposition 'for' ('ordered coffee', not 'ordered for coffee').
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] सही व्याकरणिक संरचना चुनें: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
optionB_hi: avail yourself of (Avail + Reflexive Pronoun + of)
explanation_hi: नियम: लाभ उठाने के अर्थ में 'Avail' के बाद कर्ता के अनुसार Reflexive Pronoun (myself, yourself) और फिर 'of' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Choose the grammatically complete construction: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
explanation_en: Transitive/Reflexive Rule: The verb 'avail' (in the sense of taking advantage of an opportunity) strictly demands a reflexive pronoun corresponding to the subject, followed by 'of': 'avail + oneself + OF'.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] व्याकरणिक समानांतरता (Parallelism) वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionB_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record. (दो क्रियाओं won और broke के बीच समानांतरता)
optionC_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionD_hi: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
explanation_hi: समानांतरता का नियम (Parallelism): 'Not only' और 'but also' के बाद एक ही प्रकार के पद (जैसे दोनों जगह Verb या दोनों जगह Noun) आने चाहिए।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Select the sentence demonstrating flawless grammatical parallelism:
optionA_en: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionB_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record.
optionC_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionD_en: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
explanation_en: Parallel Structure: The elements following 'not only' and 'but also' must be of identical grammatical category. Here, 'won' (verb phrase) and 'broke' (verb phrase) are perfectly parallel.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
optionB_hi: hard, hardly (कठिन परिश्रम worked hard, मुश्किल से hardly)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Hard' का अर्थ कठिन या परिश्रमपूर्वक होता है (work hard); जबकि 'Hardly' नकारात्मक शब्द है जिसका अर्थ 'मुश्किल से ही' होता है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Fill in the blank with precision: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
explanation_en: 'Hard' functions as both adjective and adverb meaning diligently or with effort ('work hard'). 'Hardly' is a negative adverb meaning scarcely or almost not ('hardly pass').
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं होता; 'fast' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: नियम: अंग्रेजी में 'Fast' ही Adverb (क्रियाविशेषण) और Adjective दोनों होता है। 'Fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Spot the error: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_en: Part (B) - 'fastly' is not a recognized English word; use 'fast'
explanation_en: Non-existent word: 'Fast' serves as both an adjective and an adverb in English ('drove fast', 'a fast car'). The word 'fastly' does not exist in standard dictionaries.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] सही भिन्न (Fraction) रूप चुनें: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
optionB_hi: Two thirds (अंश 1 से अधिक होने पर हर में plural 'thirds' आता है)
explanation_hi: भिन्न का नियम: यदि अंश (Numerator) एक से अधिक हो (2, 3), तो हर (Denominator) बहुवचन होता है: 'two thirds', 'three fourths'।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Select the grammatically correct fraction expression: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
explanation_en: Fractional grammar: When the numerator is greater than one (two, three), the denominator takes the plural form: 'two-thirds', 'three-fourths'. ('One-third' remains singular).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] त्रुटि खोजें: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'more stronger' दोहरा comparative है; केवल 'stronger' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: जब किसी विशेषण में '-er' जोड़कर comparative बनाया जाए (stronger), तो उसके पहले 'more' लगाना 'Double Comparative' की गलती है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Spot the error: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_en: Part (B) - Double comparative 'more stronger' is ungrammatical; use only 'stronger'
explanation_en: Double Comparative Error: When a monosyllabic adjective forms its comparative with '-er' ('stronger'), preceding it with 'more' is a double comparative error. Use simply 'stronger'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] देखभाल करने के अर्थ में सही क्रिया भरें: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_hi: 'Look after' का अर्थ होता है किसी बच्चे या रोगी की देखभाल करना (Take care of)।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Complete the sentence logically: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_en: 'Look after' means to take care of someone or nurture them. 'Look for' means to search for something lost.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] 'Although' के साथ सही योजक चुनें: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
optionA_hi: yet (या केवल कॉमा; 'but' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Although' या 'Though' के साथ केवल 'yet' या अल्पविराम (comma) आता है, 'but' का प्रयोग सर्वथा गलत है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Choose the correct conjunction pairing: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
explanation_en: Conjunction rule: 'Although / Though' pairs with 'YET' (or a single comma). Using 'but' with although ('Although... but') is a severe examination error.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] वाक्य सुधारें: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
optionB_hi: put your signature (हस्ताक्षर संज्ञा हेतु 'signature' शब्द शुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Sign' एक क्रिया (Verb) है; हस्ताक्षर के संज्ञा रूप (Noun) के लिए 'Signature' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Improve the sentence: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
explanation_en: Word Choice: 'Sign' is primarily a verb ('please sign the document'). The corresponding noun for one's handwritten name is 'SIGNATURE'. 'Put your sign' is colloquial Indian English; use 'put your signature'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
optionB_hi: between, among (दो के बीच Between, दो से अधिक के बीच Among)
explanation_hi: नियम: दो व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के बीच बंटवारे के लिए 'between' और दो से अधिक के लिए 'among' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Select the correct prepositions: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
explanation_en: Distribution Rule: 'Between' is used when dividing between two distinct entities. 'Among' is used for division among three or more entities.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] उचित शब्द भरें: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
optionD_hi: latter (दो में से बाद वाले के लिए 'latter')
explanation_hi: नियम: दो वस्तुओं में से बाद वाली के लिए 'latter' आता है; 'later' समय बताता है और 'last' दो से अधिक में अंतिम के लिए आता है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Fill in the blank with precision: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
explanation_en: 'Former' and 'Latter' refer to position between two items (former = first of two; latter = second of two). 'Later' refers to time. 'Last' refers to position among three or more.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] सही डिटरमिनर भरें: 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
optionA_hi: the little (थोड़ा जो कुछ भी बचा था, वह सब)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Little' = न के बराबर; 'A little' = कुछ मात्रा; 'The little' = जो कुछ थोड़ा बचा था वह सब।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Select the option that conveys 'a small quantity, but all of it': 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
explanation_en: Quantity distinction: 'Little' = almost none (negative). 'A little' = some amount (positive). 'The little' = the specific small amount available in its entirety.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] न के बराबर के अर्थ में सही शब्द चुनें: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
optionB_hi: few (न के बराबर संख्या / लगभग कोई नहीं)
explanation_hi: नियम: Countable संज्ञा के साथ 'Few' का अर्थ 'न के बराबर' होता है; 'A few' का अर्थ 'कुछ' होता है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Fill in the blank: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
explanation_en: 'Few' means almost none (hardly any students, negative implication). 'A few' means a small number (positive). 'Students' is countable, so 'few' applies.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
optionA_hi: elder, older (रक्त संबंध में elder, आयु की सामान्य तुलना में older than)
explanation_hi: नियम: एक ही परिवार के सगे भाई-बहनों के लिए 'Elder/Eldest' आता है (इसके साथ than नहीं आता)। सामान्य आयु तुलना में 'older than' आता है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Fill in the blank: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
explanation_en: 'Elder' and 'Eldest' are strictly used for members of the same family (blood relations) and take 'to' or no preposition (never 'than'). 'Older' is used for people and objects generally, followed by 'than'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] उचित पारस्परिक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
optionD_hi: each other, one another (दो के लिए each other, दो से अधिक के लिए one another)
explanation_hi: नियम: केवल दो व्यक्तियों के परस्पर संबंध के लिए 'each other' और दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों के लिए 'one another' आता है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Select the correct pronouns: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
explanation_en: Reciprocal Pronouns: 'Each other' is used when two entities interact mutually. 'One another' is used when three or more entities interact mutually.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (A) - 'seldom or ever' गलत है; 'seldom or never' या 'seldom if ever' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: मुहावरेदार रूप से या तो 'seldom or never' होता है या 'seldom if ever'। 'Seldom or ever' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Spot the idiomatic error: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_en: Part (A) - Use either 'seldom or never' OR 'seldom if ever'
explanation_en: Idiomatic Standard: The established negative pairings are either 'SELDOM OR NEVER' or 'SELDOM IF EVER'. The combination 'seldom or ever' is ungrammatical.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] काल्पनिक स्थिति हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
optionD_hi: were ('As if' के बाद काल्पनिक स्थिति में 'were' का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'As if' (मानो कि) के बाद जब अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक तुलना की जाए, तो एकवचन कर्ता के साथ भी 'were' आता है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Fill in the blank: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
explanation_en: Unreal comparison: Conjunctions 'as if' and 'as though' introducing imaginary or contrary-to-fact suppositions take the subjunctive past verb 'WERE'.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [बैंक पीओ एवं एसएससी एरर मास्टर कैप्सूल] त्रुटि खोजें: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (A) - 'did' के बाद क्रिया का प्रथम रूप (V1 - sound) आएगा, 'sounded' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया की प्रथम फॉर्म (V1 यानी sound) आती है, 'sounded' लिखना अशुद्ध है।
question_en: [Bank PO & SSC CGL Error Master Capsule] Identify the error in: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_en: Part (A) - After auxiliary 'did', base verb 'sound' (V1) must be used, not 'sounded'
explanation_en: Auxiliary syntax: The auxiliary 'did' takes the bare base form of the main verb (V1). Writing 'did sounded' is a double past tense error. It must be 'did the alarm sound'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचानें: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous): मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cousin brother' या 'cousin sister' लिखना अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Spot the error in the sentence: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_en: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' is incorrect; use only 'cousin'
explanation_en: Superfluous Expression: In standard English, the noun 'cousin' suffices for both male and female relatives. Adding 'brother' or 'sister' ('cousin brother/sister') is redundant and ungrammatical.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: अशुद्ध भाग पहचानें: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (B) - 'returned back' में 'back' का प्रयोग अनावश्यक है; केवल 'returned' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Return', 'Revert', 'Repeat' आदि शब्दों के अर्थ में ही 'वापस' या 'दोबारा' शामिल होता है, अतः इनके साथ 'back' या 'again' लगाना गलत है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Identify the incorrect part: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: The prefix 're-' in words like 'return', 'repeat', 'revert', 'reimburse', and 'recall' inherently means 'again' or 'back'. Adding 'back' ('return back') is a common redundancy error.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: वाक्य सुधारें: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
optionD_hi: pass marks (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'passing marks' नहीं 'pass marks' होता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण होने वाले अंकों को 'Pass marks' कहा जाता है, बोलचाल में प्रयुक्त 'passing marks' व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Select the correct phrase improvement: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
explanation_en: Colloquialism Correction: The standard English term is 'PASS MARKS' (or 'qualifying marks'), not 'passing marks'. Similarly: 'link language' (not linking), 'boarding house' (not boarding).
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: त्रुटि खोजें: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (A) - Preposition 'between' के बाद 'I' के स्थान पर 'me' आएगा
explanation_hi: नियम: Preposition (जैसे Between, Except, Let) के बाद हमेशा Objective Case का सर्वनाम आता है। अतः 'Between you and me' सही है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Find the error: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Objective Case after Prepositions: All prepositions ('between', 'except', 'let', 'for', 'with') must be followed by objective pronouns (me, him, her, them, us). Hence, 'between you and me' is grammatically correct.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: तुलना दोष सुधारें: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
optionD_hi: than that of Chandigarh (जलवायु की तुलना जलवायु से करने हेतु 'that of')
explanation_hi: असंगत तुलना नियम: शिमला की जलवायु की तुलना सीधे चंडीगढ़ शहर से नहीं हो सकती; चंडीगढ़ की जलवायु से होगी, अतः 'than that of Chandigarh' सही है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Improve the underlined segment: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
explanation_en: Logical Parallelism in Comparison: A comparison must be between two equivalent entities. Comparing Shimla's 'climate' directly with the city 'Chandigarh' is illogical. Use 'than that of Chandigarh' (singular) or 'than those of' (plural).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
optionD_hi: was, were ('Many a' के साथ एकवचन, जबकि 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Many a' के बाद एकवचन संज्ञा व एकवचन क्रिया (Many a passenger was) आती है, जबकि केवल 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन क्रिया (were) आती है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Fill in the blanks: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'Many a + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('Many a passenger was...'). In contrast, 'Many + PLURAL VERB' ('many were admitted').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
optionB_hi: hearing ('Looking forward to' के बाद Gerund / V1-ing आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Looking forward to', 'with a view to', 'addicted to' में 'to' एक प्रीपोजिशन है, अतः इसके बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1 + ing यानी hearing) आता है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Select the correct grammatical verb form: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
explanation_en: In phrases where 'to' is a preposition (look forward to, accustomed to, habituated to, with a view to, addicted to, prone to), it is strictly followed by a GERUND (V1 + ing), not base infinitive.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (B) - 'One' के लिए possessive सर्वनाम 'one's' आएगा, 'his' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: जब वाक्य का कर्ता 'One' हो, तो उसके पूरे वाक्य में संबंधसूचक सर्वनाम 'one's' और स्वयं के लिए 'oneself' आता है, 'his' नहीं।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Spot the error: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Pronoun Concord: When the indefinite pronoun 'ONE' is the subject of a sentence, its corresponding possessive form is strictly 'ONE'S' (apostrophe s), not 'his', 'her', or 'their'.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: वाक्य सुधारें: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
optionC_hi: Inspite of his severe fever (In spite अलग-अलग लिखा जाता है)
optionD_hi: Despite his severe fever ('Despite' के साथ 'of' कभी नहीं आता)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' नहीं लगाया जाता (केवल 'Despite his fever')। यदि 'of' लगाना हो तो 'In spite of' लिखा जाता है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Improve the underlined segment: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
explanation_en: Prepositional rule: 'DESPITE' is a single preposition that already incorporates 'of'. Writing 'despite of' is a major grammatical blunder. Alternatively, 'IN SPITE OF' (three words) is correct.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: 'Comprise' का शुद्ध प्रयोग पहचानें:
optionB_hi: The panel consists five... ('of' छूटा है)
optionD_hi: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists. (Active voice में 'comprise of' गलत है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Active Voice में 'Comprise' के बाद 'of' नहीं आता (comprises five members)। 'Consist' के बाद 'of' अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Identify the correct usage of 'comprise':
optionA_en: The panel is comprised five jurists.
optionC_en: The investigative panel comprises of five eminent jurists.
optionD_en: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists.
explanation_en: Rule: In active voice, 'COMPRISE' means 'consist of' or 'be made up of' and takes NO preposition. 'Consist' takes 'of' (consists of). 'Comprise of' is an incorrect hybrid.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: त्रुटि खोजें: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'big blunder' अशुद्ध है; 'blunder' का अर्थ ही भारी भूल होता है
explanation_hi: 'Blunder' का अर्थ ही 'बड़ी या भारी भूल' होता है। अतः इसके साथ 'big' या 'huge' लगाना पुनरुक्ति दोष है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Spot the error: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Vocabulary Precision: A 'blunder' by definition is a colossal or catastrophic mistake. Qualifying it with 'big' or 'huge' is a classic superfluous redundancy. Use simply 'a blunder' or 'a big mistake'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: वाक्य सुधारें: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
optionC_hi: ordered three cups of espresso (Order क्रिया के बाद 'for' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Order' का प्रयोग क्रिया के रूप में हो, तो इसके बाद 'for' नहीं आता (ordered coffee, ordered books)।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Improve the sentence: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
explanation_en: Transitive Verb Rule: When 'order' is used as a transitive verb for purchasing or requisitioning food, it takes a direct object without the preposition 'for' ('ordered coffee', not 'ordered for coffee').
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: सही व्याकरणिक संरचना चुनें: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
optionB_hi: avail yourself of (Avail + Reflexive Pronoun + of)
explanation_hi: नियम: लाभ उठाने के अर्थ में 'Avail' के बाद कर्ता के अनुसार Reflexive Pronoun (myself, yourself) और फिर 'of' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Choose the grammatically complete construction: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
explanation_en: Transitive/Reflexive Rule: The verb 'avail' (in the sense of taking advantage of an opportunity) strictly demands a reflexive pronoun corresponding to the subject, followed by 'of': 'avail + oneself + OF'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: व्याकरणिक समानांतरता (Parallelism) वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionB_hi: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionC_hi: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionD_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record. (दो क्रियाओं won और broke के बीच समानांतरता)
explanation_hi: समानांतरता का नियम (Parallelism): 'Not only' और 'but also' के बाद एक ही प्रकार के पद (जैसे दोनों जगह Verb या दोनों जगह Noun) आने चाहिए।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Select the sentence demonstrating flawless grammatical parallelism:
optionA_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionB_en: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionC_en: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionD_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record.
explanation_en: Parallel Structure: The elements following 'not only' and 'but also' must be of identical grammatical category. Here, 'won' (verb phrase) and 'broke' (verb phrase) are perfectly parallel.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
optionD_hi: hard, hardly (कठिन परिश्रम worked hard, मुश्किल से hardly)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Hard' का अर्थ कठिन या परिश्रमपूर्वक होता है (work hard); जबकि 'Hardly' नकारात्मक शब्द है जिसका अर्थ 'मुश्किल से ही' होता है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Fill in the blank with precision: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
explanation_en: 'Hard' functions as both adjective and adverb meaning diligently or with effort ('work hard'). 'Hardly' is a negative adverb meaning scarcely or almost not ('hardly pass').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (B) - अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं होता; 'fast' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: नियम: अंग्रेजी में 'Fast' ही Adverb (क्रियाविशेषण) और Adjective दोनों होता है। 'Fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Spot the error: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (B) - 'fastly' is not a recognized English word; use 'fast'
explanation_en: Non-existent word: 'Fast' serves as both an adjective and an adverb in English ('drove fast', 'a fast car'). The word 'fastly' does not exist in standard dictionaries.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: सही भिन्न (Fraction) रूप चुनें: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
optionB_hi: Two thirds (अंश 1 से अधिक होने पर हर में plural 'thirds' आता है)
explanation_hi: भिन्न का नियम: यदि अंश (Numerator) एक से अधिक हो (2, 3), तो हर (Denominator) बहुवचन होता है: 'two thirds', 'three fourths'।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Select the grammatically correct fraction expression: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
explanation_en: Fractional grammar: When the numerator is greater than one (two, three), the denominator takes the plural form: 'two-thirds', 'three-fourths'. ('One-third' remains singular).
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: त्रुटि खोजें: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - 'more stronger' दोहरा comparative है; केवल 'stronger' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: जब किसी विशेषण में '-er' जोड़कर comparative बनाया जाए (stronger), तो उसके पहले 'more' लगाना 'Double Comparative' की गलती है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Spot the error: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_en: Part (B) - Double comparative 'more stronger' is ungrammatical; use only 'stronger'
explanation_en: Double Comparative Error: When a monosyllabic adjective forms its comparative with '-er' ('stronger'), preceding it with 'more' is a double comparative error. Use simply 'stronger'.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: देखभाल करने के अर्थ में सही क्रिया भरें: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_hi: 'Look after' का अर्थ होता है किसी बच्चे या रोगी की देखभाल करना (Take care of)।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Complete the sentence logically: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_en: 'Look after' means to take care of someone or nurture them. 'Look for' means to search for something lost.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: 'Although' के साथ सही योजक चुनें: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
optionC_hi: yet (या केवल कॉमा; 'but' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Although' या 'Though' के साथ केवल 'yet' या अल्पविराम (comma) आता है, 'but' का प्रयोग सर्वथा गलत है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Choose the correct conjunction pairing: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
explanation_en: Conjunction rule: 'Although / Though' pairs with 'YET' (or a single comma). Using 'but' with although ('Although... but') is a severe examination error.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: वाक्य सुधारें: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
optionB_hi: put your signature (हस्ताक्षर संज्ञा हेतु 'signature' शब्द शुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Sign' एक क्रिया (Verb) है; हस्ताक्षर के संज्ञा रूप (Noun) के लिए 'Signature' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Improve the sentence: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
explanation_en: Word Choice: 'Sign' is primarily a verb ('please sign the document'). The corresponding noun for one's handwritten name is 'SIGNATURE'. 'Put your sign' is colloquial Indian English; use 'put your signature'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
optionB_hi: between, among (दो के बीच Between, दो से अधिक के बीच Among)
explanation_hi: नियम: दो व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के बीच बंटवारे के लिए 'between' और दो से अधिक के लिए 'among' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Select the correct prepositions: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
explanation_en: Distribution Rule: 'Between' is used when dividing between two distinct entities. 'Among' is used for division among three or more entities.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: उचित शब्द भरें: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
optionB_hi: latter (दो में से बाद वाले के लिए 'latter')
explanation_hi: नियम: दो वस्तुओं में से बाद वाली के लिए 'latter' आता है; 'later' समय बताता है और 'last' दो से अधिक में अंतिम के लिए आता है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Fill in the blank with precision: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
explanation_en: 'Former' and 'Latter' refer to position between two items (former = first of two; latter = second of two). 'Later' refers to time. 'Last' refers to position among three or more.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: सही डिटरमिनर भरें: 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
optionA_hi: the little (थोड़ा जो कुछ भी बचा था, वह सब)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Little' = न के बराबर; 'A little' = कुछ मात्रा; 'The little' = जो कुछ थोड़ा बचा था वह सब।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Select the option that conveys 'a small quantity, but all of it': 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
explanation_en: Quantity distinction: 'Little' = almost none (negative). 'A little' = some amount (positive). 'The little' = the specific small amount available in its entirety.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: न के बराबर के अर्थ में सही शब्द चुनें: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
optionB_hi: few (न के बराबर संख्या / लगभग कोई नहीं)
explanation_hi: नियम: Countable संज्ञा के साथ 'Few' का अर्थ 'न के बराबर' होता है; 'A few' का अर्थ 'कुछ' होता है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Fill in the blank: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
explanation_en: 'Few' means almost none (hardly any students, negative implication). 'A few' means a small number (positive). 'Students' is countable, so 'few' applies.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
optionA_hi: elder, older (रक्त संबंध में elder, आयु की सामान्य तुलना में older than)
explanation_hi: नियम: एक ही परिवार के सगे भाई-बहनों के लिए 'Elder/Eldest' आता है (इसके साथ than नहीं आता)। सामान्य आयु तुलना में 'older than' आता है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Fill in the blank: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
explanation_en: 'Elder' and 'Eldest' are strictly used for members of the same family (blood relations) and take 'to' or no preposition (never 'than'). 'Older' is used for people and objects generally, followed by 'than'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: उचित पारस्परिक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
optionA_hi: each other, one another (दो के लिए each other, दो से अधिक के लिए one another)
explanation_hi: नियम: केवल दो व्यक्तियों के परस्पर संबंध के लिए 'each other' और दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों के लिए 'one another' आता है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Select the correct pronouns: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
explanation_en: Reciprocal Pronouns: 'Each other' is used when two entities interact mutually. 'One another' is used when three or more entities interact mutually.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (A) - 'seldom or ever' गलत है; 'seldom or never' या 'seldom if ever' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: मुहावरेदार रूप से या तो 'seldom or never' होता है या 'seldom if ever'। 'Seldom or ever' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Spot the idiomatic error: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_en: Part (A) - Use either 'seldom or never' OR 'seldom if ever'
explanation_en: Idiomatic Standard: The established negative pairings are either 'SELDOM OR NEVER' or 'SELDOM IF EVER'. The combination 'seldom or ever' is ungrammatical.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: काल्पनिक स्थिति हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
optionC_hi: were ('As if' के बाद काल्पनिक स्थिति में 'were' का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'As if' (मानो कि) के बाद जब अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक तुलना की जाए, तो एकवचन कर्ता के साथ भी 'were' आता है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Fill in the blank: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
explanation_en: Unreal comparison: Conjunctions 'as if' and 'as though' introducing imaginary or contrary-to-fact suppositions take the subjunctive past verb 'WERE'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: समानांतरता एवं पदक्रम शुद्धता विश्लेषण: त्रुटि खोजें: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (A) - 'did' के बाद क्रिया का प्रथम रूप (V1 - sound) आएगा, 'sounded' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया की प्रथम फॉर्म (V1 यानी sound) आती है, 'sounded' लिखना अशुद्ध है।
question_en: Standard Parallelism & Modifier Concord: Identify the error in: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_en: Part (A) - After auxiliary 'did', base verb 'sound' (V1) must be used, not 'sounded'
explanation_en: Auxiliary syntax: The auxiliary 'did' takes the bare base form of the main verb (V1). Writing 'did sounded' is a double past tense error. It must be 'did the alarm sound'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचानें: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous): मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cousin brother' या 'cousin sister' लिखना अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Spot the error in the sentence: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' is incorrect; use only 'cousin'
explanation_en: Superfluous Expression: In standard English, the noun 'cousin' suffices for both male and female relatives. Adding 'brother' or 'sister' ('cousin brother/sister') is redundant and ungrammatical.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] अशुद्ध भाग पहचानें: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'returned back' में 'back' का प्रयोग अनावश्यक है; केवल 'returned' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Return', 'Revert', 'Repeat' आदि शब्दों के अर्थ में ही 'वापस' या 'दोबारा' शामिल होता है, अतः इनके साथ 'back' या 'again' लगाना गलत है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Identify the incorrect part: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: The prefix 're-' in words like 'return', 'repeat', 'revert', 'reimburse', and 'recall' inherently means 'again' or 'back'. Adding 'back' ('return back') is a common redundancy error.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] वाक्य सुधारें: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
optionC_hi: pass marks (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'passing marks' नहीं 'pass marks' होता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण होने वाले अंकों को 'Pass marks' कहा जाता है, बोलचाल में प्रयुक्त 'passing marks' व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Select the correct phrase improvement: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
explanation_en: Colloquialism Correction: The standard English term is 'PASS MARKS' (or 'qualifying marks'), not 'passing marks'. Similarly: 'link language' (not linking), 'boarding house' (not boarding).
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] त्रुटि खोजें: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (A) - Preposition 'between' के बाद 'I' के स्थान पर 'me' आएगा
explanation_hi: नियम: Preposition (जैसे Between, Except, Let) के बाद हमेशा Objective Case का सर्वनाम आता है। अतः 'Between you and me' सही है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Find the error: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Objective Case after Prepositions: All prepositions ('between', 'except', 'let', 'for', 'with') must be followed by objective pronouns (me, him, her, them, us). Hence, 'between you and me' is grammatically correct.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] तुलना दोष सुधारें: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
optionA_hi: than that of Chandigarh (जलवायु की तुलना जलवायु से करने हेतु 'that of')
explanation_hi: असंगत तुलना नियम: शिमला की जलवायु की तुलना सीधे चंडीगढ़ शहर से नहीं हो सकती; चंडीगढ़ की जलवायु से होगी, अतः 'than that of Chandigarh' सही है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Improve the underlined segment: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
explanation_en: Logical Parallelism in Comparison: A comparison must be between two equivalent entities. Comparing Shimla's 'climate' directly with the city 'Chandigarh' is illogical. Use 'than that of Chandigarh' (singular) or 'than those of' (plural).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
optionD_hi: was, were ('Many a' के साथ एकवचन, जबकि 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Many a' के बाद एकवचन संज्ञा व एकवचन क्रिया (Many a passenger was) आती है, जबकि केवल 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन क्रिया (were) आती है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Fill in the blanks: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'Many a + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('Many a passenger was...'). In contrast, 'Many + PLURAL VERB' ('many were admitted').
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
optionC_hi: hearing ('Looking forward to' के बाद Gerund / V1-ing आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Looking forward to', 'with a view to', 'addicted to' में 'to' एक प्रीपोजिशन है, अतः इसके बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1 + ing यानी hearing) आता है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Select the correct grammatical verb form: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
explanation_en: In phrases where 'to' is a preposition (look forward to, accustomed to, habituated to, with a view to, addicted to, prone to), it is strictly followed by a GERUND (V1 + ing), not base infinitive.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (B) - 'One' के लिए possessive सर्वनाम 'one's' आएगा, 'his' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: जब वाक्य का कर्ता 'One' हो, तो उसके पूरे वाक्य में संबंधसूचक सर्वनाम 'one's' और स्वयं के लिए 'oneself' आता है, 'his' नहीं।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Spot the error: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Pronoun Concord: When the indefinite pronoun 'ONE' is the subject of a sentence, its corresponding possessive form is strictly 'ONE'S' (apostrophe s), not 'his', 'her', or 'their'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] वाक्य सुधारें: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
optionB_hi: Inspite of his severe fever (In spite अलग-अलग लिखा जाता है)
optionD_hi: Despite his severe fever ('Despite' के साथ 'of' कभी नहीं आता)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' नहीं लगाया जाता (केवल 'Despite his fever')। यदि 'of' लगाना हो तो 'In spite of' लिखा जाता है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Improve the underlined segment: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
explanation_en: Prepositional rule: 'DESPITE' is a single preposition that already incorporates 'of'. Writing 'despite of' is a major grammatical blunder. Alternatively, 'IN SPITE OF' (three words) is correct.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] 'Comprise' का शुद्ध प्रयोग पहचानें:
optionB_hi: The panel consists five... ('of' छूटा है)
optionC_hi: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists. (Active voice में 'comprise of' गलत है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Active Voice में 'Comprise' के बाद 'of' नहीं आता (comprises five members)। 'Consist' के बाद 'of' अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Identify the correct usage of 'comprise':
optionA_en: The panel is comprised five jurists.
optionC_en: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists.
optionD_en: The investigative panel comprises of five eminent jurists.
explanation_en: Rule: In active voice, 'COMPRISE' means 'consist of' or 'be made up of' and takes NO preposition. 'Consist' takes 'of' (consists of). 'Comprise of' is an incorrect hybrid.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] त्रुटि खोजें: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (B) - 'big blunder' अशुद्ध है; 'blunder' का अर्थ ही भारी भूल होता है
explanation_hi: 'Blunder' का अर्थ ही 'बड़ी या भारी भूल' होता है। अतः इसके साथ 'big' या 'huge' लगाना पुनरुक्ति दोष है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Spot the error: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Vocabulary Precision: A 'blunder' by definition is a colossal or catastrophic mistake. Qualifying it with 'big' or 'huge' is a classic superfluous redundancy. Use simply 'a blunder' or 'a big mistake'.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] वाक्य सुधारें: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
optionD_hi: ordered three cups of espresso (Order क्रिया के बाद 'for' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Order' का प्रयोग क्रिया के रूप में हो, तो इसके बाद 'for' नहीं आता (ordered coffee, ordered books)।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Improve the sentence: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
explanation_en: Transitive Verb Rule: When 'order' is used as a transitive verb for purchasing or requisitioning food, it takes a direct object without the preposition 'for' ('ordered coffee', not 'ordered for coffee').
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] सही व्याकरणिक संरचना चुनें: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
optionB_hi: avail yourself of (Avail + Reflexive Pronoun + of)
explanation_hi: नियम: लाभ उठाने के अर्थ में 'Avail' के बाद कर्ता के अनुसार Reflexive Pronoun (myself, yourself) और फिर 'of' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Choose the grammatically complete construction: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
explanation_en: Transitive/Reflexive Rule: The verb 'avail' (in the sense of taking advantage of an opportunity) strictly demands a reflexive pronoun corresponding to the subject, followed by 'of': 'avail + oneself + OF'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] व्याकरणिक समानांतरता (Parallelism) वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record. (दो क्रियाओं won और broke के बीच समानांतरता)
optionB_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionC_hi: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionD_hi: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
explanation_hi: समानांतरता का नियम (Parallelism): 'Not only' और 'but also' के बाद एक ही प्रकार के पद (जैसे दोनों जगह Verb या दोनों जगह Noun) आने चाहिए।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Select the sentence demonstrating flawless grammatical parallelism:
optionA_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record.
optionB_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionC_en: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
optionD_en: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
explanation_en: Parallel Structure: The elements following 'not only' and 'but also' must be of identical grammatical category. Here, 'won' (verb phrase) and 'broke' (verb phrase) are perfectly parallel.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
optionB_hi: hard, hardly (कठिन परिश्रम worked hard, मुश्किल से hardly)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Hard' का अर्थ कठिन या परिश्रमपूर्वक होता है (work hard); जबकि 'Hardly' नकारात्मक शब्द है जिसका अर्थ 'मुश्किल से ही' होता है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Fill in the blank with precision: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
explanation_en: 'Hard' functions as both adjective and adverb meaning diligently or with effort ('work hard'). 'Hardly' is a negative adverb meaning scarcely or almost not ('hardly pass').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (B) - अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं होता; 'fast' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: नियम: अंग्रेजी में 'Fast' ही Adverb (क्रियाविशेषण) और Adjective दोनों होता है। 'Fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Spot the error: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_en: Part (B) - 'fastly' is not a recognized English word; use 'fast'
explanation_en: Non-existent word: 'Fast' serves as both an adjective and an adverb in English ('drove fast', 'a fast car'). The word 'fastly' does not exist in standard dictionaries.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] सही भिन्न (Fraction) रूप चुनें: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
optionA_hi: Two thirds (अंश 1 से अधिक होने पर हर में plural 'thirds' आता है)
explanation_hi: भिन्न का नियम: यदि अंश (Numerator) एक से अधिक हो (2, 3), तो हर (Denominator) बहुवचन होता है: 'two thirds', 'three fourths'।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Select the grammatically correct fraction expression: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
explanation_en: Fractional grammar: When the numerator is greater than one (two, three), the denominator takes the plural form: 'two-thirds', 'three-fourths'. ('One-third' remains singular).
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] त्रुटि खोजें: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (B) - 'more stronger' दोहरा comparative है; केवल 'stronger' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: जब किसी विशेषण में '-er' जोड़कर comparative बनाया जाए (stronger), तो उसके पहले 'more' लगाना 'Double Comparative' की गलती है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Spot the error: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (B) - Double comparative 'more stronger' is ungrammatical; use only 'stronger'
explanation_en: Double Comparative Error: When a monosyllabic adjective forms its comparative with '-er' ('stronger'), preceding it with 'more' is a double comparative error. Use simply 'stronger'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] देखभाल करने के अर्थ में सही क्रिया भरें: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_hi: 'Look after' का अर्थ होता है किसी बच्चे या रोगी की देखभाल करना (Take care of)।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Complete the sentence logically: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_en: 'Look after' means to take care of someone or nurture them. 'Look for' means to search for something lost.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] 'Although' के साथ सही योजक चुनें: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
optionA_hi: yet (या केवल कॉमा; 'but' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Although' या 'Though' के साथ केवल 'yet' या अल्पविराम (comma) आता है, 'but' का प्रयोग सर्वथा गलत है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Choose the correct conjunction pairing: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
explanation_en: Conjunction rule: 'Although / Though' pairs with 'YET' (or a single comma). Using 'but' with although ('Although... but') is a severe examination error.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] वाक्य सुधारें: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
optionD_hi: put your signature (हस्ताक्षर संज्ञा हेतु 'signature' शब्द शुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Sign' एक क्रिया (Verb) है; हस्ताक्षर के संज्ञा रूप (Noun) के लिए 'Signature' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Improve the sentence: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
explanation_en: Word Choice: 'Sign' is primarily a verb ('please sign the document'). The corresponding noun for one's handwritten name is 'SIGNATURE'. 'Put your sign' is colloquial Indian English; use 'put your signature'.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
optionC_hi: between, among (दो के बीच Between, दो से अधिक के बीच Among)
explanation_hi: नियम: दो व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के बीच बंटवारे के लिए 'between' और दो से अधिक के लिए 'among' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Select the correct prepositions: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
explanation_en: Distribution Rule: 'Between' is used when dividing between two distinct entities. 'Among' is used for division among three or more entities.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] उचित शब्द भरें: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
optionC_hi: latter (दो में से बाद वाले के लिए 'latter')
explanation_hi: नियम: दो वस्तुओं में से बाद वाली के लिए 'latter' आता है; 'later' समय बताता है और 'last' दो से अधिक में अंतिम के लिए आता है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Fill in the blank with precision: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
explanation_en: 'Former' and 'Latter' refer to position between two items (former = first of two; latter = second of two). 'Later' refers to time. 'Last' refers to position among three or more.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] सही डिटरमिनर भरें: 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
optionB_hi: the little (थोड़ा जो कुछ भी बचा था, वह सब)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Little' = न के बराबर; 'A little' = कुछ मात्रा; 'The little' = जो कुछ थोड़ा बचा था वह सब।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Select the option that conveys 'a small quantity, but all of it': 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
explanation_en: Quantity distinction: 'Little' = almost none (negative). 'A little' = some amount (positive). 'The little' = the specific small amount available in its entirety.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] न के बराबर के अर्थ में सही शब्द चुनें: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
optionB_hi: few (न के बराबर संख्या / लगभग कोई नहीं)
explanation_hi: नियम: Countable संज्ञा के साथ 'Few' का अर्थ 'न के बराबर' होता है; 'A few' का अर्थ 'कुछ' होता है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Fill in the blank: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
explanation_en: 'Few' means almost none (hardly any students, negative implication). 'A few' means a small number (positive). 'Students' is countable, so 'few' applies.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
optionC_hi: elder, older (रक्त संबंध में elder, आयु की सामान्य तुलना में older than)
explanation_hi: नियम: एक ही परिवार के सगे भाई-बहनों के लिए 'Elder/Eldest' आता है (इसके साथ than नहीं आता)। सामान्य आयु तुलना में 'older than' आता है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Fill in the blank: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
explanation_en: 'Elder' and 'Eldest' are strictly used for members of the same family (blood relations) and take 'to' or no preposition (never 'than'). 'Older' is used for people and objects generally, followed by 'than'.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] उचित पारस्परिक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
optionC_hi: each other, one another (दो के लिए each other, दो से अधिक के लिए one another)
explanation_hi: नियम: केवल दो व्यक्तियों के परस्पर संबंध के लिए 'each other' और दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों के लिए 'one another' आता है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Select the correct pronouns: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
explanation_en: Reciprocal Pronouns: 'Each other' is used when two entities interact mutually. 'One another' is used when three or more entities interact mutually.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (A) - 'seldom or ever' गलत है; 'seldom or never' या 'seldom if ever' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: मुहावरेदार रूप से या तो 'seldom or never' होता है या 'seldom if ever'। 'Seldom or ever' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Spot the idiomatic error: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_en: Part (A) - Use either 'seldom or never' OR 'seldom if ever'
explanation_en: Idiomatic Standard: The established negative pairings are either 'SELDOM OR NEVER' or 'SELDOM IF EVER'. The combination 'seldom or ever' is ungrammatical.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] काल्पनिक स्थिति हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
optionC_hi: were ('As if' के बाद काल्पनिक स्थिति में 'were' का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'As if' (मानो कि) के बाद जब अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक तुलना की जाए, तो एकवचन कर्ता के साथ भी 'were' आता है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Fill in the blank: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
explanation_en: Unreal comparison: Conjunctions 'as if' and 'as though' introducing imaginary or contrary-to-fact suppositions take the subjunctive past verb 'WERE'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [उच्चस्तरीय वाक्य पूर्ति एवं त्रुटि पहचान] त्रुटि खोजें: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (A) - 'did' के बाद क्रिया का प्रथम रूप (V1 - sound) आएगा, 'sounded' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया की प्रथम फॉर्म (V1 यानी sound) आती है, 'sounded' लिखना अशुद्ध है।
question_en: [Advanced Sentence Completion & Error Spotting] Identify the error in: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_en: Part (A) - After auxiliary 'did', base verb 'sound' (V1) must be used, not 'sounded'
explanation_en: Auxiliary syntax: The auxiliary 'did' takes the bare base form of the main verb (V1). Writing 'did sounded' is a double past tense error. It must be 'did the alarm sound'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचानें: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous): मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cousin brother' या 'cousin sister' लिखना अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Spot the error in the sentence: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_en: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' is incorrect; use only 'cousin'
explanation_en: Superfluous Expression: In standard English, the noun 'cousin' suffices for both male and female relatives. Adding 'brother' or 'sister' ('cousin brother/sister') is redundant and ungrammatical.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: अशुद्ध भाग पहचानें: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'returned back' में 'back' का प्रयोग अनावश्यक है; केवल 'returned' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Return', 'Revert', 'Repeat' आदि शब्दों के अर्थ में ही 'वापस' या 'दोबारा' शामिल होता है, अतः इनके साथ 'back' या 'again' लगाना गलत है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Identify the incorrect part: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: The prefix 're-' in words like 'return', 'repeat', 'revert', 'reimburse', and 'recall' inherently means 'again' or 'back'. Adding 'back' ('return back') is a common redundancy error.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: वाक्य सुधारें: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
optionA_hi: pass marks (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'passing marks' नहीं 'pass marks' होता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण होने वाले अंकों को 'Pass marks' कहा जाता है, बोलचाल में प्रयुक्त 'passing marks' व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Select the correct phrase improvement: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
explanation_en: Colloquialism Correction: The standard English term is 'PASS MARKS' (or 'qualifying marks'), not 'passing marks'. Similarly: 'link language' (not linking), 'boarding house' (not boarding).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: त्रुटि खोजें: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (A) - Preposition 'between' के बाद 'I' के स्थान पर 'me' आएगा
explanation_hi: नियम: Preposition (जैसे Between, Except, Let) के बाद हमेशा Objective Case का सर्वनाम आता है। अतः 'Between you and me' सही है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Find the error: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Objective Case after Prepositions: All prepositions ('between', 'except', 'let', 'for', 'with') must be followed by objective pronouns (me, him, her, them, us). Hence, 'between you and me' is grammatically correct.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: तुलना दोष सुधारें: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
optionC_hi: than that of Chandigarh (जलवायु की तुलना जलवायु से करने हेतु 'that of')
explanation_hi: असंगत तुलना नियम: शिमला की जलवायु की तुलना सीधे चंडीगढ़ शहर से नहीं हो सकती; चंडीगढ़ की जलवायु से होगी, अतः 'than that of Chandigarh' सही है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Improve the underlined segment: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
explanation_en: Logical Parallelism in Comparison: A comparison must be between two equivalent entities. Comparing Shimla's 'climate' directly with the city 'Chandigarh' is illogical. Use 'than that of Chandigarh' (singular) or 'than those of' (plural).
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
optionB_hi: was, were ('Many a' के साथ एकवचन, जबकि 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन)
