explanation_hi: नियम: 'Many a' के बाद एकवचन संज्ञा व एकवचन क्रिया (Many a passenger was) आती है, जबकि केवल 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन क्रिया (were) आती है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Fill in the blanks: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'Many a + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('Many a passenger was...'). In contrast, 'Many + PLURAL VERB' ('many were admitted').
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
optionD_hi: hearing ('Looking forward to' के बाद Gerund / V1-ing आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Looking forward to', 'with a view to', 'addicted to' में 'to' एक प्रीपोजिशन है, अतः इसके बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1 + ing यानी hearing) आता है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Select the correct grammatical verb form: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
explanation_en: In phrases where 'to' is a preposition (look forward to, accustomed to, habituated to, with a view to, addicted to, prone to), it is strictly followed by a GERUND (V1 + ing), not base infinitive.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - 'One' के लिए possessive सर्वनाम 'one's' आएगा, 'his' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: जब वाक्य का कर्ता 'One' हो, तो उसके पूरे वाक्य में संबंधसूचक सर्वनाम 'one's' और स्वयं के लिए 'oneself' आता है, 'his' नहीं।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Spot the error: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Pronoun Concord: When the indefinite pronoun 'ONE' is the subject of a sentence, its corresponding possessive form is strictly 'ONE'S' (apostrophe s), not 'his', 'her', or 'their'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: वाक्य सुधारें: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
optionC_hi: Despite his severe fever ('Despite' के साथ 'of' कभी नहीं आता)
optionD_hi: Inspite of his severe fever (In spite अलग-अलग लिखा जाता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' नहीं लगाया जाता (केवल 'Despite his fever')। यदि 'of' लगाना हो तो 'In spite of' लिखा जाता है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Improve the underlined segment: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
explanation_en: Prepositional rule: 'DESPITE' is a single preposition that already incorporates 'of'. Writing 'despite of' is a major grammatical blunder. Alternatively, 'IN SPITE OF' (three words) is correct.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: 'Comprise' का शुद्ध प्रयोग पहचानें:
optionB_hi: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists. (Active voice में 'comprise of' गलत है)
optionD_hi: The panel consists five... ('of' छूटा है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Active Voice में 'Comprise' के बाद 'of' नहीं आता (comprises five members)। 'Consist' के बाद 'of' अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Identify the correct usage of 'comprise':
optionA_en: The panel is comprised five jurists.
optionB_en: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists.
optionC_en: The investigative panel comprises of five eminent jurists.
explanation_en: Rule: In active voice, 'COMPRISE' means 'consist of' or 'be made up of' and takes NO preposition. 'Consist' takes 'of' (consists of). 'Comprise of' is an incorrect hybrid.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: त्रुटि खोजें: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (B) - 'big blunder' अशुद्ध है; 'blunder' का अर्थ ही भारी भूल होता है
explanation_hi: 'Blunder' का अर्थ ही 'बड़ी या भारी भूल' होता है। अतः इसके साथ 'big' या 'huge' लगाना पुनरुक्ति दोष है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Spot the error: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Vocabulary Precision: A 'blunder' by definition is a colossal or catastrophic mistake. Qualifying it with 'big' or 'huge' is a classic superfluous redundancy. Use simply 'a blunder' or 'a big mistake'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: वाक्य सुधारें: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
optionC_hi: ordered three cups of espresso (Order क्रिया के बाद 'for' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Order' का प्रयोग क्रिया के रूप में हो, तो इसके बाद 'for' नहीं आता (ordered coffee, ordered books)।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Improve the sentence: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
explanation_en: Transitive Verb Rule: When 'order' is used as a transitive verb for purchasing or requisitioning food, it takes a direct object without the preposition 'for' ('ordered coffee', not 'ordered for coffee').
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: सही व्याकरणिक संरचना चुनें: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
optionB_hi: avail yourself of (Avail + Reflexive Pronoun + of)
explanation_hi: नियम: लाभ उठाने के अर्थ में 'Avail' के बाद कर्ता के अनुसार Reflexive Pronoun (myself, yourself) और फिर 'of' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Choose the grammatically complete construction: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
explanation_en: Transitive/Reflexive Rule: The verb 'avail' (in the sense of taking advantage of an opportunity) strictly demands a reflexive pronoun corresponding to the subject, followed by 'of': 'avail + oneself + OF'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: व्याकरणिक समानांतरता (Parallelism) वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionB_hi: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionC_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record. (दो क्रियाओं won और broke के बीच समानांतरता)
optionD_hi: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
explanation_hi: समानांतरता का नियम (Parallelism): 'Not only' और 'but also' के बाद एक ही प्रकार के पद (जैसे दोनों जगह Verb या दोनों जगह Noun) आने चाहिए।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Select the sentence demonstrating flawless grammatical parallelism:
optionA_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionB_en: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionC_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record.
optionD_en: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
explanation_en: Parallel Structure: The elements following 'not only' and 'but also' must be of identical grammatical category. Here, 'won' (verb phrase) and 'broke' (verb phrase) are perfectly parallel.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
optionA_hi: hard, hardly (कठिन परिश्रम worked hard, मुश्किल से hardly)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Hard' का अर्थ कठिन या परिश्रमपूर्वक होता है (work hard); जबकि 'Hardly' नकारात्मक शब्द है जिसका अर्थ 'मुश्किल से ही' होता है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Fill in the blank with precision: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
explanation_en: 'Hard' functions as both adjective and adverb meaning diligently or with effort ('work hard'). 'Hardly' is a negative adverb meaning scarcely or almost not ('hardly pass').
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (B) - अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं होता; 'fast' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: नियम: अंग्रेजी में 'Fast' ही Adverb (क्रियाविशेषण) और Adjective दोनों होता है। 'Fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Spot the error: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (B) - 'fastly' is not a recognized English word; use 'fast'
explanation_en: Non-existent word: 'Fast' serves as both an adjective and an adverb in English ('drove fast', 'a fast car'). The word 'fastly' does not exist in standard dictionaries.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: सही भिन्न (Fraction) रूप चुनें: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
optionC_hi: Two thirds (अंश 1 से अधिक होने पर हर में plural 'thirds' आता है)
explanation_hi: भिन्न का नियम: यदि अंश (Numerator) एक से अधिक हो (2, 3), तो हर (Denominator) बहुवचन होता है: 'two thirds', 'three fourths'।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Select the grammatically correct fraction expression: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
explanation_en: Fractional grammar: When the numerator is greater than one (two, three), the denominator takes the plural form: 'two-thirds', 'three-fourths'. ('One-third' remains singular).
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: त्रुटि खोजें: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (B) - 'more stronger' दोहरा comparative है; केवल 'stronger' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: जब किसी विशेषण में '-er' जोड़कर comparative बनाया जाए (stronger), तो उसके पहले 'more' लगाना 'Double Comparative' की गलती है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Spot the error: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (B) - Double comparative 'more stronger' is ungrammatical; use only 'stronger'
explanation_en: Double Comparative Error: When a monosyllabic adjective forms its comparative with '-er' ('stronger'), preceding it with 'more' is a double comparative error. Use simply 'stronger'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: देखभाल करने के अर्थ में सही क्रिया भरें: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_hi: 'Look after' का अर्थ होता है किसी बच्चे या रोगी की देखभाल करना (Take care of)।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Complete the sentence logically: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_en: 'Look after' means to take care of someone or nurture them. 'Look for' means to search for something lost.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: 'Although' के साथ सही योजक चुनें: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
optionC_hi: yet (या केवल कॉमा; 'but' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Although' या 'Though' के साथ केवल 'yet' या अल्पविराम (comma) आता है, 'but' का प्रयोग सर्वथा गलत है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Choose the correct conjunction pairing: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
explanation_en: Conjunction rule: 'Although / Though' pairs with 'YET' (or a single comma). Using 'but' with although ('Although... but') is a severe examination error.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: वाक्य सुधारें: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
optionA_hi: put your signature (हस्ताक्षर संज्ञा हेतु 'signature' शब्द शुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Sign' एक क्रिया (Verb) है; हस्ताक्षर के संज्ञा रूप (Noun) के लिए 'Signature' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Improve the sentence: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
explanation_en: Word Choice: 'Sign' is primarily a verb ('please sign the document'). The corresponding noun for one's handwritten name is 'SIGNATURE'. 'Put your sign' is colloquial Indian English; use 'put your signature'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
optionC_hi: between, among (दो के बीच Between, दो से अधिक के बीच Among)
explanation_hi: नियम: दो व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के बीच बंटवारे के लिए 'between' और दो से अधिक के लिए 'among' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Select the correct prepositions: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
explanation_en: Distribution Rule: 'Between' is used when dividing between two distinct entities. 'Among' is used for division among three or more entities.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: उचित शब्द भरें: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
optionC_hi: latter (दो में से बाद वाले के लिए 'latter')
explanation_hi: नियम: दो वस्तुओं में से बाद वाली के लिए 'latter' आता है; 'later' समय बताता है और 'last' दो से अधिक में अंतिम के लिए आता है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Fill in the blank with precision: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
explanation_en: 'Former' and 'Latter' refer to position between two items (former = first of two; latter = second of two). 'Later' refers to time. 'Last' refers to position among three or more.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: सही डिटरमिनर भरें: 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
optionA_hi: the little (थोड़ा जो कुछ भी बचा था, वह सब)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Little' = न के बराबर; 'A little' = कुछ मात्रा; 'The little' = जो कुछ थोड़ा बचा था वह सब।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Select the option that conveys 'a small quantity, but all of it': 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
explanation_en: Quantity distinction: 'Little' = almost none (negative). 'A little' = some amount (positive). 'The little' = the specific small amount available in its entirety.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: न के बराबर के अर्थ में सही शब्द चुनें: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
optionA_hi: few (न के बराबर संख्या / लगभग कोई नहीं)
explanation_hi: नियम: Countable संज्ञा के साथ 'Few' का अर्थ 'न के बराबर' होता है; 'A few' का अर्थ 'कुछ' होता है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Fill in the blank: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
explanation_en: 'Few' means almost none (hardly any students, negative implication). 'A few' means a small number (positive). 'Students' is countable, so 'few' applies.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
optionD_hi: elder, older (रक्त संबंध में elder, आयु की सामान्य तुलना में older than)
explanation_hi: नियम: एक ही परिवार के सगे भाई-बहनों के लिए 'Elder/Eldest' आता है (इसके साथ than नहीं आता)। सामान्य आयु तुलना में 'older than' आता है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Fill in the blank: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
explanation_en: 'Elder' and 'Eldest' are strictly used for members of the same family (blood relations) and take 'to' or no preposition (never 'than'). 'Older' is used for people and objects generally, followed by 'than'.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: उचित पारस्परिक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
optionC_hi: each other, one another (दो के लिए each other, दो से अधिक के लिए one another)
explanation_hi: नियम: केवल दो व्यक्तियों के परस्पर संबंध के लिए 'each other' और दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों के लिए 'one another' आता है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Select the correct pronouns: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
explanation_en: Reciprocal Pronouns: 'Each other' is used when two entities interact mutually. 'One another' is used when three or more entities interact mutually.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (A) - 'seldom or ever' गलत है; 'seldom or never' या 'seldom if ever' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: मुहावरेदार रूप से या तो 'seldom or never' होता है या 'seldom if ever'। 'Seldom or ever' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Spot the idiomatic error: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (A) - Use either 'seldom or never' OR 'seldom if ever'
explanation_en: Idiomatic Standard: The established negative pairings are either 'SELDOM OR NEVER' or 'SELDOM IF EVER'. The combination 'seldom or ever' is ungrammatical.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: काल्पनिक स्थिति हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
optionC_hi: were ('As if' के बाद काल्पनिक स्थिति में 'were' का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'As if' (मानो कि) के बाद जब अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक तुलना की जाए, तो एकवचन कर्ता के साथ भी 'were' आता है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Fill in the blank: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
explanation_en: Unreal comparison: Conjunctions 'as if' and 'as though' introducing imaginary or contrary-to-fact suppositions take the subjunctive past verb 'WERE'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में सर्वाधिक पूछे जाने वाले एरर: त्रुटि खोजें: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (A) - 'did' के बाद क्रिया का प्रथम रूप (V1 - sound) आएगा, 'sounded' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया की प्रथम फॉर्म (V1 यानी sound) आती है, 'sounded' लिखना अशुद्ध है।
question_en: Exam-Crucial Common Errors in English: Identify the error in: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_en: Part (A) - After auxiliary 'did', base verb 'sound' (V1) must be used, not 'sounded'
explanation_en: Auxiliary syntax: The auxiliary 'did' takes the bare base form of the main verb (V1). Writing 'did sounded' is a double past tense error. It must be 'did the alarm sound'.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचानें: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: पुनरुक्ति दोष (Superfluous): मानक अंग्रेजी में 'cousin brother' या 'cousin sister' लिखना अशुद्ध है; केवल 'cousin' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Spot the error in the sentence: 'She went to (A) / the railway station (B) / to receive her cousin sister. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_en: Part (C) - 'cousin sister' is incorrect; use only 'cousin'
explanation_en: Superfluous Expression: In standard English, the noun 'cousin' suffices for both male and female relatives. Adding 'brother' or 'sister' ('cousin brother/sister') is redundant and ungrammatical.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] अशुद्ध भाग पहचानें: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
optionC_hi: Part (B) - 'returned back' में 'back' का प्रयोग अनावश्यक है; केवल 'returned' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Return', 'Revert', 'Repeat' आदि शब्दों के अर्थ में ही 'वापस' या 'दोबारा' शामिल होता है, अतः इनके साथ 'back' या 'again' लगाना गलत है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Identify the incorrect part: 'After completing his higher education (A) / in London, he returned back (B) / to his native village. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: The prefix 're-' in words like 'return', 'repeat', 'revert', 'reimburse', and 'recall' inherently means 'again' or 'back'. Adding 'back' ('return back') is a common redundancy error.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] वाक्य सुधारें: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
optionC_hi: pass marks (मानक अंग्रेजी में 'passing marks' नहीं 'pass marks' होता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: परीक्षा में उत्तीर्ण होने वाले अंकों को 'Pass marks' कहा जाता है, बोलचाल में प्रयुक्त 'passing marks' व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Select the correct phrase improvement: 'He secured sixty percent marks, which was well above the passing marks.'
explanation_en: Colloquialism Correction: The standard English term is 'PASS MARKS' (or 'qualifying marks'), not 'passing marks'. Similarly: 'link language' (not linking), 'boarding house' (not boarding).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] त्रुटि खोजें: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (A) - Preposition 'between' के बाद 'I' के स्थान पर 'me' आएगा
explanation_hi: नियम: Preposition (जैसे Between, Except, Let) के बाद हमेशा Objective Case का सर्वनाम आता है। अतः 'Between you and me' सही है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Find the error: 'Between you and I, (A) / the newly appointed manager (B) / lacks technical expertise. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Objective Case after Prepositions: All prepositions ('between', 'except', 'let', 'for', 'with') must be followed by objective pronouns (me, him, her, them, us). Hence, 'between you and me' is grammatically correct.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] तुलना दोष सुधारें: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
optionC_hi: than that of Chandigarh (जलवायु की तुलना जलवायु से करने हेतु 'that of')
explanation_hi: असंगत तुलना नियम: शिमला की जलवायु की तुलना सीधे चंडीगढ़ शहर से नहीं हो सकती; चंडीगढ़ की जलवायु से होगी, अतः 'than that of Chandigarh' सही है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Improve the underlined segment: 'The climate of Shimla is cooler than Chandigarh.'
explanation_en: Logical Parallelism in Comparison: A comparison must be between two equivalent entities. Comparing Shimla's 'climate' directly with the city 'Chandigarh' is illogical. Use 'than that of Chandigarh' (singular) or 'than those of' (plural).
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
optionD_hi: was, were ('Many a' के साथ एकवचन, जबकि 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Many a' के बाद एकवचन संज्ञा व एकवचन क्रिया (Many a passenger was) आती है, जबकि केवल 'Many' के साथ बहुवचन क्रिया (were) आती है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Fill in the blanks: 'Many a passenger _____ injured in the collision, and many _____ admitted to hospital.'
explanation_en: Rule: 'Many a + Singular Noun + SINGULAR VERB' ('Many a passenger was...'). In contrast, 'Many + PLURAL VERB' ('many were admitted').
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
optionD_hi: hearing ('Looking forward to' के बाद Gerund / V1-ing आता है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Looking forward to', 'with a view to', 'addicted to' में 'to' एक प्रीपोजिशन है, अतः इसके बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1 + ing यानी hearing) आता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Select the correct grammatical verb form: 'I am eagerly looking forward to _____ from you regarding the fellowship.'
explanation_en: In phrases where 'to' is a preposition (look forward to, accustomed to, habituated to, with a view to, addicted to, prone to), it is strictly followed by a GERUND (V1 + ing), not base infinitive.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (B) - 'One' के लिए possessive सर्वनाम 'one's' आएगा, 'his' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: जब वाक्य का कर्ता 'One' हो, तो उसके पूरे वाक्य में संबंधसूचक सर्वनाम 'one's' और स्वयं के लिए 'oneself' आता है, 'his' नहीं।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Spot the error: 'One should always be (A) / conscious of his moral duties (B) / towards the nation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Pronoun Concord: When the indefinite pronoun 'ONE' is the subject of a sentence, its corresponding possessive form is strictly 'ONE'S' (apostrophe s), not 'his', 'her', or 'their'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] वाक्य सुधारें: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
optionC_hi: Inspite of his severe fever (In spite अलग-अलग लिखा जाता है)
optionD_hi: Despite his severe fever ('Despite' के साथ 'of' कभी नहीं आता)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' नहीं लगाया जाता (केवल 'Despite his fever')। यदि 'of' लगाना हो तो 'In spite of' लिखा जाता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Improve the underlined segment: 'Despite of his severe fever, he delivered the keynote address.'
explanation_en: Prepositional rule: 'DESPITE' is a single preposition that already incorporates 'of'. Writing 'despite of' is a major grammatical blunder. Alternatively, 'IN SPITE OF' (three words) is correct.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] 'Comprise' का शुद्ध प्रयोग पहचानें:
optionB_hi: The panel consists five... ('of' छूटा है)
optionD_hi: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists. (Active voice में 'comprise of' गलत है)
explanation_hi: नियम: Active Voice में 'Comprise' के बाद 'of' नहीं आता (comprises five members)। 'Consist' के बाद 'of' अनिवार्य होता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Identify the correct usage of 'comprise':
optionA_en: The investigative panel comprises of five eminent jurists.
optionC_en: The panel is comprised five jurists.
optionD_en: The investigative panel comprises five eminent jurists.
explanation_en: Rule: In active voice, 'COMPRISE' means 'consist of' or 'be made up of' and takes NO preposition. 'Consist' takes 'of' (consists of). 'Comprise of' is an incorrect hybrid.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] त्रुटि खोजें: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (B) - 'big blunder' अशुद्ध है; 'blunder' का अर्थ ही भारी भूल होता है
explanation_hi: 'Blunder' का अर्थ ही 'बड़ी या भारी भूल' होता है। अतः इसके साथ 'big' या 'huge' लगाना पुनरुक्ति दोष है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Spot the error: 'Committing such a (A) / big blunder during the audit (B) / ruined his corporate reputation. (C) / No error (D)'
explanation_en: Vocabulary Precision: A 'blunder' by definition is a colossal or catastrophic mistake. Qualifying it with 'big' or 'huge' is a classic superfluous redundancy. Use simply 'a blunder' or 'a big mistake'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] वाक्य सुधारें: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
optionD_hi: ordered three cups of espresso (Order क्रिया के बाद 'for' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: जब 'Order' का प्रयोग क्रिया के रूप में हो, तो इसके बाद 'for' नहीं आता (ordered coffee, ordered books)।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Improve the sentence: 'We sat at the cafeteria table and ordered for three cups of espresso.'
explanation_en: Transitive Verb Rule: When 'order' is used as a transitive verb for purchasing or requisitioning food, it takes a direct object without the preposition 'for' ('ordered coffee', not 'ordered for coffee').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] सही व्याकरणिक संरचना चुनें: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
optionC_hi: avail yourself of (Avail + Reflexive Pronoun + of)
explanation_hi: नियम: लाभ उठाने के अर्थ में 'Avail' के बाद कर्ता के अनुसार Reflexive Pronoun (myself, yourself) और फिर 'of' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Choose the grammatically complete construction: 'You should _____ this rare scholarship opportunity.'
explanation_en: Transitive/Reflexive Rule: The verb 'avail' (in the sense of taking advantage of an opportunity) strictly demands a reflexive pronoun corresponding to the subject, followed by 'of': 'avail + oneself + OF'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] व्याकरणिक समानांतरता (Parallelism) वाला शुद्ध वाक्य चुनें:
optionA_hi: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionB_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record. (दो क्रियाओं won और broke के बीच समानांतरता)
optionC_hi: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionD_hi: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
explanation_hi: समानांतरता का नियम (Parallelism): 'Not only' और 'but also' के बाद एक ही प्रकार के पद (जैसे दोनों जगह Verb या दोनों जगह Noun) आने चाहिए।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Select the sentence demonstrating flawless grammatical parallelism:
optionA_en: The athlete won not only a medal but broke also the record.
optionB_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but also broke the national record.
optionC_en: The athlete not only won a gold medal but the record was also broken.
optionD_en: Not only the athlete won a gold medal but also broke the record.
explanation_en: Parallel Structure: The elements following 'not only' and 'but also' must be of identical grammatical category. Here, 'won' (verb phrase) and 'broke' (verb phrase) are perfectly parallel.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
optionB_hi: hard, hardly (कठिन परिश्रम worked hard, मुश्किल से hardly)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Hard' का अर्थ कठिन या परिश्रमपूर्वक होता है (work hard); जबकि 'Hardly' नकारात्मक शब्द है जिसका अर्थ 'मुश्किल से ही' होता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Fill in the blank with precision: 'He worked _____ throughout the semester, but he could _____ secure passing grades.'
explanation_en: 'Hard' functions as both adjective and adverb meaning diligently or with effort ('work hard'). 'Hardly' is a negative adverb meaning scarcely or almost not ('hardly pass').
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (B) - अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं होता; 'fast' का प्रयोग करें
explanation_hi: नियम: अंग्रेजी में 'Fast' ही Adverb (क्रियाविशेषण) और Adjective दोनों होता है। 'Fastly' कोई शब्द नहीं है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Spot the error: 'The ambulance driver (A) / drove very fastly (B) / to reach the trauma centre in time. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_en: Part (B) - 'fastly' is not a recognized English word; use 'fast'
explanation_en: Non-existent word: 'Fast' serves as both an adjective and an adverb in English ('drove fast', 'a fast car'). The word 'fastly' does not exist in standard dictionaries.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] सही भिन्न (Fraction) रूप चुनें: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
optionA_hi: Two thirds (अंश 1 से अधिक होने पर हर में plural 'thirds' आता है)
explanation_hi: भिन्न का नियम: यदि अंश (Numerator) एक से अधिक हो (2, 3), तो हर (Denominator) बहुवचन होता है: 'two thirds', 'three fourths'।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Select the grammatically correct fraction expression: '_____ of the arable land has been allocated for organic farming.'
explanation_en: Fractional grammar: When the numerator is greater than one (two, three), the denominator takes the plural form: 'two-thirds', 'three-fourths'. ('One-third' remains singular).
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] त्रुटि खोजें: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_hi: Part (B) - 'more stronger' दोहरा comparative है; केवल 'stronger' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: जब किसी विशेषण में '-er' जोड़कर comparative बनाया जाए (stronger), तो उसके पहले 'more' लगाना 'Double Comparative' की गलती है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Spot the error: 'This modern alloy is (A) / more stronger than (B) / conventional cast iron. (C) / No error (D)'
optionB_en: Part (B) - Double comparative 'more stronger' is ungrammatical; use only 'stronger'
explanation_en: Double Comparative Error: When a monosyllabic adjective forms its comparative with '-er' ('stronger'), preceding it with 'more' is a double comparative error. Use simply 'stronger'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] देखभाल करने के अर्थ में सही क्रिया भरें: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_hi: 'Look after' का अर्थ होता है किसी बच्चे या रोगी की देखभाल करना (Take care of)।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Complete the sentence logically: 'While the parents attended the summit, the experienced nurse _____ the infant.'
explanation_en: 'Look after' means to take care of someone or nurture them. 'Look for' means to search for something lost.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] 'Although' के साथ सही योजक चुनें: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
optionC_hi: yet (या केवल कॉमा; 'but' का प्रयोग वर्जित है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Although' या 'Though' के साथ केवल 'yet' या अल्पविराम (comma) आता है, 'but' का प्रयोग सर्वथा गलत है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Choose the correct conjunction pairing: 'Although he worked with relentless perseverance, _____ he could not clear the cutoff.'
explanation_en: Conjunction rule: 'Although / Though' pairs with 'YET' (or a single comma). Using 'but' with although ('Although... but') is a severe examination error.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] वाक्य सुधारें: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
optionB_hi: put your signature (हस्ताक्षर संज्ञा हेतु 'signature' शब्द शुद्ध है)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Sign' एक क्रिया (Verb) है; हस्ताक्षर के संज्ञा रूप (Noun) के लिए 'Signature' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Improve the sentence: 'Please put your sign on the dotted line at the bottom of the affidavit.'
explanation_en: Word Choice: 'Sign' is primarily a verb ('please sign the document'). The corresponding noun for one's handwritten name is 'SIGNATURE'. 'Put your sign' is colloquial Indian English; use 'put your signature'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] सही प्रीपोजिशन युग्म चुनें: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
optionD_hi: between, among (दो के बीच Between, दो से अधिक के बीच Among)
explanation_hi: नियम: दो व्यक्तियों या वस्तुओं के बीच बंटवारे के लिए 'between' और दो से अधिक के लिए 'among' का प्रयोग होता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Select the correct prepositions: 'The ancestral property was divided equally _____ the two brothers, but the cash reserves were distributed _____ the five charities.'
explanation_en: Distribution Rule: 'Between' is used when dividing between two distinct entities. 'Among' is used for division among three or more entities.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] उचित शब्द भरें: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
optionD_hi: latter (दो में से बाद वाले के लिए 'latter')
explanation_hi: नियम: दो वस्तुओं में से बाद वाली के लिए 'latter' आता है; 'later' समय बताता है और 'last' दो से अधिक में अंतिम के लिए आता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Fill in the blank with precision: 'Of the two proposed fiscal strategies, the _____ is far more pragmatic.'
explanation_en: 'Former' and 'Latter' refer to position between two items (former = first of two; latter = second of two). 'Later' refers to time. 'Last' refers to position among three or more.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] सही डिटरमिनर भरें: 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
optionB_hi: the little (थोड़ा जो कुछ भी बचा था, वह सब)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Little' = न के बराबर; 'A little' = कुछ मात्रा; 'The little' = जो कुछ थोड़ा बचा था वह सब।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Select the option that conveys 'a small quantity, but all of it': 'He spent _____ money he had left in his pocket.'
explanation_en: Quantity distinction: 'Little' = almost none (negative). 'A little' = some amount (positive). 'The little' = the specific small amount available in its entirety.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] न के बराबर के अर्थ में सही शब्द चुनें: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
optionC_hi: few (न के बराबर संख्या / लगभग कोई नहीं)
explanation_hi: नियम: Countable संज्ञा के साथ 'Few' का अर्थ 'न के बराबर' होता है; 'A few' का अर्थ 'कुछ' होता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Fill in the blank: 'Because the lecture was so esoteric, _____ students could comprehend the thesis.'
explanation_en: 'Few' means almost none (hardly any students, negative implication). 'A few' means a small number (positive). 'Students' is countable, so 'few' applies.
examTag: SSC CPO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
optionA_hi: elder, older (रक्त संबंध में elder, आयु की सामान्य तुलना में older than)
explanation_hi: नियम: एक ही परिवार के सगे भाई-बहनों के लिए 'Elder/Eldest' आता है (इसके साथ than नहीं आता)। सामान्य आयु तुलना में 'older than' आता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Fill in the blank: 'Ravi is my _____ brother, while Mr. Kapoor is _____ than all other board members.'
explanation_en: 'Elder' and 'Eldest' are strictly used for members of the same family (blood relations) and take 'to' or no preposition (never 'than'). 'Older' is used for people and objects generally, followed by 'than'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] उचित पारस्परिक सर्वनाम चुनें: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
optionB_hi: each other, one another (दो के लिए each other, दो से अधिक के लिए one another)
explanation_hi: नियम: केवल दो व्यक्तियों के परस्पर संबंध के लिए 'each other' और दो से अधिक व्यक्तियों के लिए 'one another' आता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Select the correct pronouns: 'The two boxers glared at _____, while the five team members congratulated _____.'
explanation_en: Reciprocal Pronouns: 'Each other' is used when two entities interact mutually. 'One another' is used when three or more entities interact mutually.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_hi: Part (A) - 'seldom or ever' गलत है; 'seldom or never' या 'seldom if ever' लिखें
explanation_hi: नियम: मुहावरेदार रूप से या तो 'seldom or never' होता है या 'seldom if ever'। 'Seldom or ever' लिखना गलत है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Spot the idiomatic error: 'He seldom or ever (A) / attends the weekly seminars (B) / hosted by the department. (C) / No error (D)'
optionA_en: Part (A) - Use either 'seldom or never' OR 'seldom if ever'
explanation_en: Idiomatic Standard: The established negative pairings are either 'SELDOM OR NEVER' or 'SELDOM IF EVER'. The combination 'seldom or ever' is ungrammatical.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] काल्पनिक स्थिति हेतु सही क्रिया चुनें: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
optionA_hi: were ('As if' के बाद काल्पनिक स्थिति में 'were' का प्रयोग)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'As if' (मानो कि) के बाद जब अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक तुलना की जाए, तो एकवचन कर्ता के साथ भी 'were' आता है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Fill in the blank: 'He behaves as if he _____ the sovereign ruler of this entire institution.'
explanation_en: Unreal comparison: Conjunctions 'as if' and 'as though' introducing imaginary or contrary-to-fact suppositions take the subjunctive past verb 'WERE'.
examTag: NDA English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: [संपूर्ण अंग्रेजी अभ्यास सेट - सेक्टर 3] त्रुटि खोजें: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_hi: Part (A) - 'did' के बाद क्रिया का प्रथम रूप (V1 - sound) आएगा, 'sounded' नहीं
explanation_hi: नियम: सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद हमेशा मुख्य क्रिया की प्रथम फॉर्म (V1 यानी sound) आती है, 'sounded' लिखना अशुद्ध है।
question_en: [Comprehensive English Practice Set - Sector 3] Identify the error in: 'No sooner did the alarm sounded (A) / than the security personnel (B) / cordoned off the perimeter. (C) / No error (D)'
optionD_en: Part (A) - After auxiliary 'did', base verb 'sound' (V1) must be used, not 'sounded'
explanation_en: Auxiliary syntax: The auxiliary 'did' takes the bare base form of the main verb (V1). Writing 'did sounded' is a double past tense error. It must be 'did the alarm sound'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Common Errors & Sentence Improvement

question_hi: रेखांकित शब्द 'ephemeral' का सटीक पर्यायवाची चुनें: 'Fame and popularity in digital entertainment are often ephemeral.'
explanation_hi: 'Ephemeral' का अर्थ क्षणभंगुर या अल्पकालिक होता है। इसका पर्यायवाची 'transient' या 'fleeting' है, और विलोम 'eternal' है।
question_en: Choose the most accurate synonym for the underlined word: 'Fame and popularity in digital entertainment are often ephemeral.'
explanation_en: 'Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short duration (transient, fleeting, evanescent, momentary). Its antonym is 'perennial' or 'eternal'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'BENEVOLENT' (परोपकारी/दयालु) का सटीक विलोम शब्द चुनें:
explanation_hi: रूट वर्ड: 'Bene-' का अर्थ अच्छा होता है (Benevolent = परोपकारी); 'Male-' का अर्थ बुरा होता है (Malevolent = दुर्भावना रखने वाला)।
question_en: Select the exact antonym of 'BENEVOLENT' (kind, generous, well-meaning):
explanation_en: Root words: 'Bene-' means good ('benevolent' = wishing well to others). 'Male-' means bad/ill ('malevolent' = wishing ill or malicious).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'CANDID' का निकटतम पर्यायवाची पहचानें: 'The diplomat gave a remarkably candid assessment of the geopolitical crisis.'
explanation_hi: 'Candid' का अर्थ स्पष्ट, निष्कपट और खरा (Frank) होता है। इसका विलोम 'evasive' या 'deceptive' होता है।
question_en: Identify the closest synonym of 'CANDID': 'The diplomat gave a remarkably candid assessment of the geopolitical crisis.'
explanation_en: 'Candid' means truthful, straightforward, and frank. Synonyms: outspoken, honest, sincere, blunt. Antonyms: evasive, disingenuous, deceitful.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'FASTIDIOUS' का क्या अर्थ है: 'The senior editor is fastidious about grammatical precision and typography'?
optionB_hi: Meticulous / अति-सावधान एवं जिसे संतुष्ट करना कठिन हो (नखरेबाज)
explanation_hi: 'Fastidious' का अर्थ होता है हर बारीक विवरण पर बहुत ध्यान देने वाला जिसे आसानी से खुश न किया जा सके (तुनकमिज़ाज/परिश्रमी)।
question_en: What is the meaning of 'FASTIDIOUS' in: 'The senior editor is fastidious about grammatical precision and typography'?
optionB_en: Meticulous / hard to please / extremely careful
explanation_en: 'Fastidious' describes someone very attentive to accuracy and detail; difficult to please (meticulous, scrupulous, finicky). Antonym: careless, sloppy.
examTag: SSC CPO - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'GREGARIOUS' (मिलनसार/सामाजिक) का विलोम शब्द चुनें:
optionC_hi: Reclusive / एकांतप्रिय या सन्यासी स्वभाव वाला
explanation_hi: 'Gregarious' का अर्थ मिलनसार या समूह में रहने का शौकीन होता है। इसका विलोम 'reclusive' (एकांतवासी) होता है।
question_en: Select the antonym of 'GREGARIOUS': 'Unlike his gregarious elder brother, Neil preferred solitude.'
explanation_en: Latin root 'greg-' (flock/herd): 'Gregarious' means fond of company and sociable. Its antonym is 'reclusive', 'introverted', or 'solitary'.
examTag: IBPS PO - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'INUNDATE' का पर्यायवाची चुनें: 'The consumer helpline was inundated with grievances after the server outage.'
optionA_hi: Overwhelmed / बाढ़ की तरह उमड़ पड़ना (जलमग्न)
explanation_hi: 'Inundate' का शाब्दिक अर्थ बाढ़ से जलमग्न करना और लाक्षणिक अर्थ शिकायतों या काम से अभिभूत कर देना (Flood/Overwhelm) है।
question_en: Identify the synonym of 'INUNDATE': 'The consumer helpline was inundated with grievances after the server outage.'
explanation_en: 'Inundate' literally means to cover with floodwaters; figuratively, to overwhelm with huge numbers of things or requests.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'METICULOUS' का सही पर्यायवाची चुनें: 'The forensic scientist conducted a meticulous examination of the ballistic evidence.'
explanation_hi: 'Meticulous' का अर्थ अत्यंत सावधान, सूक्ष्मता से कार्य करने वाला (Painstaking) होता है।
question_en: Choose the exact synonym of 'METICULOUS': 'The forensic scientist conducted a meticulous examination of the ballistic evidence.'
explanation_en: 'Meticulous' means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise (painstaking, punctilious). Antonym: careless, negligent.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'NEFARIOUS' (कुख्यात/दुष्ट) का विलोम शब्द चुनें:
explanation_hi: 'Nefarious' का अर्थ कुटिल, दुष्ट या जघन्य होता है। इसका सटीक विलोम 'virtuous' (सदाचारी) या 'noble' है।
question_en: Select the antonym of 'NEFARIOUS': 'The cyber syndicates hatched a nefarious conspiracy to siphon treasury funds.'
explanation_en: 'Nefarious' means wicked, depraved, or criminal (vicious, heinous, iniquitous). Its antonym is 'virtuous', 'exemplary', or 'honourable'.
examTag: NDA English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'PRAGMATIC' (व्यावहारिक/यथार्थवादी) का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
explanation_hi: 'Pragmatic' का अर्थ व्यावहारिक और यथार्थपरक होता है। इसका विलोम 'Quixotic' (काल्पनिक/अव्यावहारिक) होता है।
question_en: What is the antonym of 'PRAGMATIC' (practical, realistic, utilitarian)?
explanation_en: 'Pragmatic' means dealing with things sensibly and realistically based on practical considerations. Its antonym is 'quixotic' (exceedingly idealistic and unrealistic) or 'visionary'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'RESILIENT' का सटीक पर्यायवाची चुनें: 'The nation's economy proved surprisingly resilient despite geopolitical turbulence.'
optionA_hi: Elastic / आघात सहकर पुनः संभलने वाला (लचीला)
explanation_hi: 'Resilient' का अर्थ आघात सहकर तेजी से उबरने वाला (लचीला/दृढ़) होता है। इसका विलोम 'fragile' (नाजुक) है।
question_en: Choose the synonym of 'RESILIENT': 'The nation's economy proved surprisingly resilient despite geopolitical turbulence.'
explanation_en: 'Resilient' means able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions or shock (buoyant, hardy, adaptable). Antonym: fragile, brittle.
examTag: Bank SO English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: व्यक्ति जो अपने स्वार्थ सिद्धि हेतु बड़े लोगों की चापलूसी करता है, कहलाता है:
optionD_hi: Sycophant / चापलूस या तलवे चाटने वाला
explanation_hi: 'Sycophant' वह व्यक्ति होता है जो व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ के लिए अधिकारियों या बड़े लोगों की चापलूसी करता है।
question_en: A person who acts obsequiously toward someone important in order to gain advantage is called a:
explanation_en: 'Sycophant' is a servile flatterer who fawns on influential people for personal gain (toady, flatterer, bootlicker, yes-man).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'TENACIOUS' का पर्यायवाची चुनें: 'Her tenacious pursuit of justice finally brought the perpetrators to trial.'
explanation_hi: 'Tenacious' का अर्थ दृढ़ संकल्पी, हठी या किसी लक्ष्य से न हटने वाला (Persistent) होता है।
question_en: Choose the synonym of 'TENACIOUS': 'Her tenacious pursuit of justice finally brought the perpetrators to trial.'
explanation_en: 'Tenacious' means holding fast; persistent, stubborn, and unwavering in purpose. Antonym: yielding, wavering, irresolute.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'UBIQUITOUS' (सर्वव्यापी) का विलोम शब्द चुनें:
optionA_hi: Rare / दुर्लभ या कभी-कभार मिलने वाला
explanation_hi: 'Ubiquitous' का अर्थ हर जगह पाया जाने वाला (सर्वव्यापी/Omnipresent) होता है। इसका विलोम 'rare' (दुर्लभ) है।
question_en: Select the antonym of 'UBIQUITOUS': 'In modern urban life, smartphones have become ubiquitous.'
explanation_en: 'Ubiquitous' means present, appearing, or found everywhere simultaneously (omnipresent, pervasive). Antonym: rare, scarce, isolated.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'VORACIOUS' का क्या अर्थ है: 'Dr. Ambedkar was a voracious reader...'?
optionA_hi: Insatiable / अत्यंत उत्सुक, भुक्खड़ या पेटू पाठक
explanation_hi: 'Voracious' का अर्थ ज्ञान या भोजन की असीम भूख रखने वाला (पेटू/अति-उत्सुक पाठक) होता है।
question_en: Identify the meaning of 'VORACIOUS' in: 'Dr. Ambedkar was a voracious reader who acquired thousands of monumental treatises'?
optionA_en: Insatiable / avid / consuming large quantities with great eagerness
explanation_en: 'Voracious' means having a huge appetite for food or an insatiable eagerness for an activity ('voracious reader', 'voracious appetite').
examTag: SSC CPO - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द: 'वह व्यक्ति जिसने सौ वर्ष की आयु पूर्ण कर ली हो'?
explanation_hi: आयु सूचक शब्द: 70-79 वर्ष = Septuagenarian; 80-89 वर्ष = Octogenarian; 90-99 वर्ष = Nonagenarian; 100+ वर्ष = Centenarian।
question_en: What is the single word for: 'A person who has reached or surpassed the age of one hundred years'?
explanation_en: Age milestones: Septuagenarian (70s), Octogenarian (80s), Nonagenarian (90s), Centenarian (100+ years), Supercentenarian (110+ years).
examTag: IBPS PO - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: मानव जाति से प्रेम करने वाला और धर्मार्थ दान देने वाला व्यक्ति कहलाता है:
explanation_hi: रूट वर्ड: 'Phil-' (प्रेम) + 'Anthropos' (मानव) = Philanthropist (मानव प्रेमी/परोपकारी)। 'Misanthrope' मानव जाति से घृणा करने वाला होता है।
question_en: A person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by the generous donation of money to good causes, is a:
explanation_en: Roots: 'Phil-' (love) + 'anthrop-' (humanity) = Philanthropist (lover of humanity). In contrast, 'Mis-' (hate) + 'anthrop-' = Misanthrope (hater of humanity).
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'नींद में चलने वाला व्यक्ति' क्या कहलाता है?
explanation_hi: नींद में चलने वाले को 'Somnambulist' (निद्राभ्रमणकर्ता) और नींद में बड़बड़ाने/बोलने वाले को 'Somniloquist' कहते हैं।
question_en: One who walks while asleep is known in medical and lexical terminology as a:
explanation_en: Roots: 'Somn-' (sleep) + 'ambul-' (walk) = Somnambulist (sleepwalker). 'Somn-' + 'loq-' (speak) = Somniloquist (one who talks in sleep).
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: अनेक भाषाओं का ज्ञाता और धाराप्रवाह बोलने वाला व्यक्ति कहलाता है:
explanation_hi: 'Polyglot' (Poly = अनेक, Glotta = भाषा) कई भाषाओं के ज्ञाता को कहते हैं।
question_en: A person who knows and is able to use several different languages fluently is termed a:
explanation_en: 'Polyglot' (poly = many, glot = tongue/language) denotes an individual proficient in multiple languages. A 'linguist' studies the scientific structure of language.
examTag: NDA English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'जो कभी कोई भूल या गलती न करे (अचूक)' - कहलाता है:
explanation_hi: 'Infallible' का अर्थ अचूक होता है जिससे कभी कोई त्रुटि या गलती न हो।
question_en: One who is incapable of making mistakes or being wrong is described as:
explanation_en: 'Infallible' (in = not, fallere = to deceive/err) means completely trustworthy, faultless, and incapable of error.
examTag: State PCS General English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: 'सभी रोगों या कष्टों की रामबाण दवा' कहलाती है:
explanation_hi: 'Panacea' का अर्थ सभी बीमारियों या समस्याओं का रामबाण इलाज (Cure-all) होता है।
question_en: A remedy for all diseases, evils, or difficulties is called a:
explanation_en: 'Panacea' (from Greek pan = all, akos = cure) means a universal remedy for all diseases or social ills (cure-all, universal panacea).
examTag: Bank SO English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: समाधि या कब्र के पत्थर पर उत्कीर्ण स्मृति-लेख कहलाता है:
explanation_hi: कब्र या समाधि पर लिखे गए स्मृति-लेख को 'Epitaph' (समाधि-लेख) कहते हैं।
question_en: An inscription on a tombstone or monument in memory of the person buried there is an:
explanation_en: 'Epitaph' (epi = upon, taphos = tomb) is a commemorative text engraved on a gravestone. 'Epilogue' is the concluding speech at the end of a play.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: धनिकों या सबसे अमीर वर्ग द्वारा संचालित शासन प्रणाली कहलाती है:
explanation_hi: शासन प्रणालियां: धनवानों का शासन = Plutocracy; कुछ शक्तिशाली लोगों का शासन = Oligarchy; राजा/एक व्यक्ति का शासन = Autocracy।
question_en: A state or government rule by the wealthy class of society is termed a:
optionB_en: Oligarchy (Rule by a few powerful people)
explanation_en: Forms of government: Plutocracy = rule by the rich (Pluto = wealth). Oligarchy = rule by a small elite faction. Aristocracy = rule by hereditary nobles. Autocracy = rule by one dictator.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: व्यक्ति की मृत्यु के उपरांत प्रदान किया जाने वाला सम्मान या पुरस्कार कहलाता है:
explanation_hi: मृत्यु के बाद मिलने वाले सम्मान, पुस्तक प्रकाशन या जन्म लेने वाले बच्चे को 'Posthumous' (मरणोपरांत) कहते हैं।
question_en: An award or honour conferred after the death of the recipient (e.g. posthumous Bharat Ratna) is called:
explanation_en: 'Posthumous' occurs, is awarded, or published after a person's death ('posthumous award', 'posthumous child' born after father's demise).
examTag: SSC CHSL - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: जो मानता है कि ईश्वर के अस्तित्व के बारे में कुछ भी जानना संभव नहीं है (संदेहवादी):
optionA_hi: Agnostic / अज्ञेयवादी (ईश्वर के अस्तित्व पर संदेह रखने वाला)
explanation_hi: अंतर: जो ईश्वर के अस्तित्व को नकारा नहीं जा सकता और सिद्ध भी नहीं किया जा सकता मानता है = Agnostic (अज्ञेयवादी); जो ईश्वर को सिरे से खारिज करता है = Atheist (नास्तिक)।
question_en: A person who believes that nothing is known or can be known of the existence or nature of God is an:
explanation_en: 'Agnostic' asserts that ultimate reality (God) is unknowable. An 'Atheist' actively disbelieves in or denies the existence of God. A 'Theist' believes in God.
examTag: SSC CPO - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वर्तनी (Correct Spelling) वाला शब्द चुनें:
optionD_hi: Accommodate (डबल 'c' और डबल 'm' दोनों आते हैं)
explanation_hi: परीक्षाओं की सबसे प्रसिद्ध वर्तनी: 'ACCOMMODATE' में दो बार 'c' और दो बार 'm' (A-C-C-O-M-M-O-D-A-T-E) आता है।
question_en: Select the correctly spelt word from the options below:
explanation_en: Spelling Rule: 'ACCOMMODATE' features both double 'C' and double 'M': A-C-C-O-M-M-O-D-A-T-E. It is one of the most frequently tested words in SSC and Banking exams.
examTag: IBPS PO - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: सही वर्तनी वाले शब्द की पहचान कीजिए:
optionC_hi: Millennium (डबल 'l' और डबल 'n' दोनों आते हैं)
explanation_hi: एक हज़ार वर्ष की अवधि को 'Millennium' कहते हैं जिसमें 'll' और 'nn' दोनों डबल होते हैं।
question_en: Identify the word with the accurate spelling:
explanation_en: 'MILLENNIUM' (a period of one thousand years) is spelled with double 'L' and double 'N': M-I-L-L-E-N-N-I-U-M.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: नौकरशाही के अर्थ में शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनें:
explanation_hi: नौकरशाही को अंग्रेजी में 'BUREAUCRACY' (B-U-R-E-A-U + CRACY) लिखा जाता है।
question_en: Select the correctly spelt word meaning administrative machinery:
explanation_en: French origin root: 'BUREAUCRACY' is spelled B-U-R-E-A-U-C-R-A-C-Y. Remember 'bureau' + 'cracy'.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: कर्तव्यनिष्ठ के अर्थ में सही स्पेलिंग चुनें:
explanation_hi: कर्तव्यनिष्ठ एवं ईमानदार को 'Conscientious' (C-O-N-S-C-I-E-N-T-I-O-U-S) लिखा जाता है।
question_en: Choose the correctly spelt word meaning diligent and principled:
explanation_en: 'CONSCIENTIOUS' (wishing to do one's work thoroughly and properly) is spelled C-O-N-S-C-I-E-N-T-I-O-U-S.
examTag: NDA English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: विशेषाधिकार के लिए प्रयुक्त शुद्ध वर्तनी पहचानें:
explanation_hi: परीक्षाओं में बहुतायत से पूछा जाने वाला शब्द: 'Privilege' में 'd' नहीं होता (P-R-I-V-I-L-E-G-E)।
question_en: Identify the correct spelling of the word denoting a special right or advantage:
explanation_en: Common Trap: 'PRIVILEGE' has NO 'd'. It is spelled P-R-I-V-I-L-E-G-E (not priviledge).
examTag: State PCS General English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: शर्मिंदा करने के अर्थ में सही स्पेलिंग चुनें:
optionC_hi: Embarrass (डबल 'r' और डबल 's' दोनों आते हैं)
explanation_hi: 'Embarrass' में दो बार 'r' और दो बार 's' (E-M-B-A-R-R-A-S-S) आता है।
question_en: Select the correct spelling of the word meaning to cause awkwardness or self-consciousness:
explanation_en: Rule: 'EMBARRASS' has both double 'R' and double 'S': E-M-B-A-R-R-A-S-S.
examTag: Bank SO English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] रेखांकित शब्द 'ephemeral' का सटीक पर्यायवाची चुनें: 'Fame and popularity in digital entertainment are often ephemeral.'
explanation_hi: 'Ephemeral' का अर्थ क्षणभंगुर या अल्पकालिक होता है। इसका पर्यायवाची 'transient' या 'fleeting' है, और विलोम 'eternal' है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Choose the most accurate synonym for the underlined word: 'Fame and popularity in digital entertainment are often ephemeral.'
explanation_en: 'Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short duration (transient, fleeting, evanescent, momentary). Its antonym is 'perennial' or 'eternal'.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'BENEVOLENT' (परोपकारी/दयालु) का सटीक विलोम शब्द चुनें:
explanation_hi: रूट वर्ड: 'Bene-' का अर्थ अच्छा होता है (Benevolent = परोपकारी); 'Male-' का अर्थ बुरा होता है (Malevolent = दुर्भावना रखने वाला)।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Select the exact antonym of 'BENEVOLENT' (kind, generous, well-meaning):
explanation_en: Root words: 'Bene-' means good ('benevolent' = wishing well to others). 'Male-' means bad/ill ('malevolent' = wishing ill or malicious).
examTag: SSC CHSL - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'CANDID' का निकटतम पर्यायवाची पहचानें: 'The diplomat gave a remarkably candid assessment of the geopolitical crisis.'
explanation_hi: 'Candid' का अर्थ स्पष्ट, निष्कपट और खरा (Frank) होता है। इसका विलोम 'evasive' या 'deceptive' होता है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Identify the closest synonym of 'CANDID': 'The diplomat gave a remarkably candid assessment of the geopolitical crisis.'
explanation_en: 'Candid' means truthful, straightforward, and frank. Synonyms: outspoken, honest, sincere, blunt. Antonyms: evasive, disingenuous, deceitful.
examTag: SSC CPO - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'FASTIDIOUS' का क्या अर्थ है: 'The senior editor is fastidious about grammatical precision and typography'?
optionC_hi: Meticulous / अति-सावधान एवं जिसे संतुष्ट करना कठिन हो (नखरेबाज)
explanation_hi: 'Fastidious' का अर्थ होता है हर बारीक विवरण पर बहुत ध्यान देने वाला जिसे आसानी से खुश न किया जा सके (तुनकमिज़ाज/परिश्रमी)।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] What is the meaning of 'FASTIDIOUS' in: 'The senior editor is fastidious about grammatical precision and typography'?
optionC_en: Meticulous / hard to please / extremely careful
explanation_en: 'Fastidious' describes someone very attentive to accuracy and detail; difficult to please (meticulous, scrupulous, finicky). Antonym: careless, sloppy.
examTag: IBPS PO - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'GREGARIOUS' (मिलनसार/सामाजिक) का विलोम शब्द चुनें:
optionC_hi: Reclusive / एकांतप्रिय या सन्यासी स्वभाव वाला
explanation_hi: 'Gregarious' का अर्थ मिलनसार या समूह में रहने का शौकीन होता है। इसका विलोम 'reclusive' (एकांतवासी) होता है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Select the antonym of 'GREGARIOUS': 'Unlike his gregarious elder brother, Neil preferred solitude.'
explanation_en: Latin root 'greg-' (flock/herd): 'Gregarious' means fond of company and sociable. Its antonym is 'reclusive', 'introverted', or 'solitary'.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'INUNDATE' का पर्यायवाची चुनें: 'The consumer helpline was inundated with grievances after the server outage.'
optionB_hi: Overwhelmed / बाढ़ की तरह उमड़ पड़ना (जलमग्न)
explanation_hi: 'Inundate' का शाब्दिक अर्थ बाढ़ से जलमग्न करना और लाक्षणिक अर्थ शिकायतों या काम से अभिभूत कर देना (Flood/Overwhelm) है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Identify the synonym of 'INUNDATE': 'The consumer helpline was inundated with grievances after the server outage.'
explanation_en: 'Inundate' literally means to cover with floodwaters; figuratively, to overwhelm with huge numbers of things or requests.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'METICULOUS' का सही पर्यायवाची चुनें: 'The forensic scientist conducted a meticulous examination of the ballistic evidence.'
explanation_hi: 'Meticulous' का अर्थ अत्यंत सावधान, सूक्ष्मता से कार्य करने वाला (Painstaking) होता है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Choose the exact synonym of 'METICULOUS': 'The forensic scientist conducted a meticulous examination of the ballistic evidence.'
explanation_en: 'Meticulous' means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise (painstaking, punctilious). Antonym: careless, negligent.
examTag: NDA English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'NEFARIOUS' (कुख्यात/दुष्ट) का विलोम शब्द चुनें:
explanation_hi: 'Nefarious' का अर्थ कुटिल, दुष्ट या जघन्य होता है। इसका सटीक विलोम 'virtuous' (सदाचारी) या 'noble' है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Select the antonym of 'NEFARIOUS': 'The cyber syndicates hatched a nefarious conspiracy to siphon treasury funds.'
explanation_en: 'Nefarious' means wicked, depraved, or criminal (vicious, heinous, iniquitous). Its antonym is 'virtuous', 'exemplary', or 'honourable'.
examTag: State PCS General English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'PRAGMATIC' (व्यावहारिक/यथार्थवादी) का विलोम शब्द क्या है?
explanation_hi: 'Pragmatic' का अर्थ व्यावहारिक और यथार्थपरक होता है। इसका विलोम 'Quixotic' (काल्पनिक/अव्यावहारिक) होता है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] What is the antonym of 'PRAGMATIC' (practical, realistic, utilitarian)?
explanation_en: 'Pragmatic' means dealing with things sensibly and realistically based on practical considerations. Its antonym is 'quixotic' (exceedingly idealistic and unrealistic) or 'visionary'.
examTag: Bank SO English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'RESILIENT' का सटीक पर्यायवाची चुनें: 'The nation's economy proved surprisingly resilient despite geopolitical turbulence.'
optionA_hi: Elastic / आघात सहकर पुनः संभलने वाला (लचीला)
explanation_hi: 'Resilient' का अर्थ आघात सहकर तेजी से उबरने वाला (लचीला/दृढ़) होता है। इसका विलोम 'fragile' (नाजुक) है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Choose the synonym of 'RESILIENT': 'The nation's economy proved surprisingly resilient despite geopolitical turbulence.'
explanation_en: 'Resilient' means able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions or shock (buoyant, hardy, adaptable). Antonym: fragile, brittle.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] व्यक्ति जो अपने स्वार्थ सिद्धि हेतु बड़े लोगों की चापलूसी करता है, कहलाता है:
optionC_hi: Sycophant / चापलूस या तलवे चाटने वाला
explanation_hi: 'Sycophant' वह व्यक्ति होता है जो व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ के लिए अधिकारियों या बड़े लोगों की चापलूसी करता है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] A person who acts obsequiously toward someone important in order to gain advantage is called a:
explanation_en: 'Sycophant' is a servile flatterer who fawns on influential people for personal gain (toady, flatterer, bootlicker, yes-man).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'TENACIOUS' का पर्यायवाची चुनें: 'Her tenacious pursuit of justice finally brought the perpetrators to trial.'
explanation_hi: 'Tenacious' का अर्थ दृढ़ संकल्पी, हठी या किसी लक्ष्य से न हटने वाला (Persistent) होता है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Choose the synonym of 'TENACIOUS': 'Her tenacious pursuit of justice finally brought the perpetrators to trial.'
explanation_en: 'Tenacious' means holding fast; persistent, stubborn, and unwavering in purpose. Antonym: yielding, wavering, irresolute.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'UBIQUITOUS' (सर्वव्यापी) का विलोम शब्द चुनें:
optionA_hi: Rare / दुर्लभ या कभी-कभार मिलने वाला
explanation_hi: 'Ubiquitous' का अर्थ हर जगह पाया जाने वाला (सर्वव्यापी/Omnipresent) होता है। इसका विलोम 'rare' (दुर्लभ) है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Select the antonym of 'UBIQUITOUS': 'In modern urban life, smartphones have become ubiquitous.'
explanation_en: 'Ubiquitous' means present, appearing, or found everywhere simultaneously (omnipresent, pervasive). Antonym: rare, scarce, isolated.
examTag: SSC CPO - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'VORACIOUS' का क्या अर्थ है: 'Dr. Ambedkar was a voracious reader...'?
optionB_hi: Insatiable / अत्यंत उत्सुक, भुक्खड़ या पेटू पाठक
explanation_hi: 'Voracious' का अर्थ ज्ञान या भोजन की असीम भूख रखने वाला (पेटू/अति-उत्सुक पाठक) होता है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Identify the meaning of 'VORACIOUS' in: 'Dr. Ambedkar was a voracious reader who acquired thousands of monumental treatises'?
optionB_en: Insatiable / avid / consuming large quantities with great eagerness
explanation_en: 'Voracious' means having a huge appetite for food or an insatiable eagerness for an activity ('voracious reader', 'voracious appetite').
examTag: IBPS PO - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द: 'वह व्यक्ति जिसने सौ वर्ष की आयु पूर्ण कर ली हो'?
explanation_hi: आयु सूचक शब्द: 70-79 वर्ष = Septuagenarian; 80-89 वर्ष = Octogenarian; 90-99 वर्ष = Nonagenarian; 100+ वर्ष = Centenarian।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] What is the single word for: 'A person who has reached or surpassed the age of one hundred years'?
explanation_en: Age milestones: Septuagenarian (70s), Octogenarian (80s), Nonagenarian (90s), Centenarian (100+ years), Supercentenarian (110+ years).
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] मानव जाति से प्रेम करने वाला और धर्मार्थ दान देने वाला व्यक्ति कहलाता है:
explanation_hi: रूट वर्ड: 'Phil-' (प्रेम) + 'Anthropos' (मानव) = Philanthropist (मानव प्रेमी/परोपकारी)। 'Misanthrope' मानव जाति से घृणा करने वाला होता है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] A person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by the generous donation of money to good causes, is a:
explanation_en: Roots: 'Phil-' (love) + 'anthrop-' (humanity) = Philanthropist (lover of humanity). In contrast, 'Mis-' (hate) + 'anthrop-' = Misanthrope (hater of humanity).
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'नींद में चलने वाला व्यक्ति' क्या कहलाता है?
explanation_hi: नींद में चलने वाले को 'Somnambulist' (निद्राभ्रमणकर्ता) और नींद में बड़बड़ाने/बोलने वाले को 'Somniloquist' कहते हैं।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] One who walks while asleep is known in medical and lexical terminology as a:
explanation_en: Roots: 'Somn-' (sleep) + 'ambul-' (walk) = Somnambulist (sleepwalker). 'Somn-' + 'loq-' (speak) = Somniloquist (one who talks in sleep).
examTag: NDA English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] अनेक भाषाओं का ज्ञाता और धाराप्रवाह बोलने वाला व्यक्ति कहलाता है:
explanation_hi: 'Polyglot' (Poly = अनेक, Glotta = भाषा) कई भाषाओं के ज्ञाता को कहते हैं।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] A person who knows and is able to use several different languages fluently is termed a:
explanation_en: 'Polyglot' (poly = many, glot = tongue/language) denotes an individual proficient in multiple languages. A 'linguist' studies the scientific structure of language.
examTag: State PCS General English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'जो कभी कोई भूल या गलती न करे (अचूक)' - कहलाता है:
explanation_hi: 'Infallible' का अर्थ अचूक होता है जिससे कभी कोई त्रुटि या गलती न हो।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] One who is incapable of making mistakes or being wrong is described as:
explanation_en: 'Infallible' (in = not, fallere = to deceive/err) means completely trustworthy, faultless, and incapable of error.
examTag: Bank SO English - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] 'सभी रोगों या कष्टों की रामबाण दवा' कहलाती है:
explanation_hi: 'Panacea' का अर्थ सभी बीमारियों या समस्याओं का रामबाण इलाज (Cure-all) होता है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] A remedy for all diseases, evils, or difficulties is called a:
explanation_en: 'Panacea' (from Greek pan = all, akos = cure) means a universal remedy for all diseases or social ills (cure-all, universal panacea).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] समाधि या कब्र के पत्थर पर उत्कीर्ण स्मृति-लेख कहलाता है:
explanation_hi: कब्र या समाधि पर लिखे गए स्मृति-लेख को 'Epitaph' (समाधि-लेख) कहते हैं।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] An inscription on a tombstone or monument in memory of the person buried there is an:
explanation_en: 'Epitaph' (epi = upon, taphos = tomb) is a commemorative text engraved on a gravestone. 'Epilogue' is the concluding speech at the end of a play.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] धनिकों या सबसे अमीर वर्ग द्वारा संचालित शासन प्रणाली कहलाती है:
explanation_hi: शासन प्रणालियां: धनवानों का शासन = Plutocracy; कुछ शक्तिशाली लोगों का शासन = Oligarchy; राजा/एक व्यक्ति का शासन = Autocracy।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] A state or government rule by the wealthy class of society is termed a:
optionD_en: Oligarchy (Rule by a few powerful people)
explanation_en: Forms of government: Plutocracy = rule by the rich (Pluto = wealth). Oligarchy = rule by a small elite faction. Aristocracy = rule by hereditary nobles. Autocracy = rule by one dictator.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] व्यक्ति की मृत्यु के उपरांत प्रदान किया जाने वाला सम्मान या पुरस्कार कहलाता है:
explanation_hi: मृत्यु के बाद मिलने वाले सम्मान, पुस्तक प्रकाशन या जन्म लेने वाले बच्चे को 'Posthumous' (मरणोपरांत) कहते हैं।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] An award or honour conferred after the death of the recipient (e.g. posthumous Bharat Ratna) is called:
explanation_en: 'Posthumous' occurs, is awarded, or published after a person's death ('posthumous award', 'posthumous child' born after father's demise).
examTag: SSC CPO - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] जो मानता है कि ईश्वर के अस्तित्व के बारे में कुछ भी जानना संभव नहीं है (संदेहवादी):
optionA_hi: Agnostic / अज्ञेयवादी (ईश्वर के अस्तित्व पर संदेह रखने वाला)
explanation_hi: अंतर: जो ईश्वर के अस्तित्व को नकारा नहीं जा सकता और सिद्ध भी नहीं किया जा सकता मानता है = Agnostic (अज्ञेयवादी); जो ईश्वर को सिरे से खारिज करता है = Atheist (नास्तिक)।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] A person who believes that nothing is known or can be known of the existence or nature of God is an:
explanation_en: 'Agnostic' asserts that ultimate reality (God) is unknowable. An 'Atheist' actively disbelieves in or denies the existence of God. A 'Theist' believes in God.
examTag: IBPS PO - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] निम्नलिखित में से शुद्ध वर्तनी (Correct Spelling) वाला शब्द चुनें:
optionA_hi: Accommodate (डबल 'c' और डबल 'm' दोनों आते हैं)
explanation_hi: परीक्षाओं की सबसे प्रसिद्ध वर्तनी: 'ACCOMMODATE' में दो बार 'c' और दो बार 'm' (A-C-C-O-M-M-O-D-A-T-E) आता है।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Select the correctly spelt word from the options below:
explanation_en: Spelling Rule: 'ACCOMMODATE' features both double 'C' and double 'M': A-C-C-O-M-M-O-D-A-T-E. It is one of the most frequently tested words in SSC and Banking exams.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] सही वर्तनी वाले शब्द की पहचान कीजिए:
optionB_hi: Millennium (डबल 'l' और डबल 'n' दोनों आते हैं)
explanation_hi: एक हज़ार वर्ष की अवधि को 'Millennium' कहते हैं जिसमें 'll' और 'nn' दोनों डबल होते हैं।
question_en: [High-Yield Synonyms & Antonyms Special] Identify the word with the accurate spelling:
explanation_en: 'MILLENNIUM' (a period of one thousand years) is spelled with double 'L' and double 'N': M-I-L-L-E-N-N-I-U-M.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Vocabulary, Synonyms, One-Word & Spelling

question_hi: [पर्यायवाची एवं विलोम शब्द विशेषांक] नौकरशाही के अर्थ में शुद्ध वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनें:
