explanation_en: Biblical idiom meaning to offer valuable advice, gifts, or art to people who lack the refinement or capacity to appreciate them (Hindi equivalent: 'अंधे के आगे रोवे, अपना दीदा खोवे' / 'भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना').
examTag: SSC CHSL - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: 'CRY OVER SPILT MILK' (अब पछताए होत क्या जब चिड़िया चुग गई खेत) का अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: To waste time grieving over past losses that cannot be rectified (बीती ताहि बिसारि दे / जो बीत गया उस पर व्यर्थ पछताना)
explanation_hi: 'Cry over spilt milk' का अर्थ है किसी ऐसी बीती हुई हानि पर आंसू बहाना जिसे अब सुधारा नहीं जा सकता।
question_en: Identify the meaning of 'CRY OVER SPILT MILK':
optionA_en: To clean up a kitchen accident
optionD_en: To waste time grieving over past losses or misfortunes that cannot be rectified
explanation_en: 'Cry over spilt milk' means to express futile sorrow over an irreversible mistake or past misfortune ('अब पछताए होत क्या जब चिड़िया चुग गई खेत').
examTag: SSC CPO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: 'BEAT AROUND THE BUSH' का अर्थ क्या है: 'Please stop beating around the bush...'
optionA_hi: To speak in a round-about, evasive manner (घुमा-फिराकर बात करना / मुख्य मुद्दे पर न आना)
explanation_hi: 'Beat around the bush' का अर्थ होता है मुख्य मुद्दे की बात टालते हुए इधर-उधर की बातें बनाना।
question_en: Select the meaning of 'BEAT AROUND THE BUSH': 'Please stop beating around the bush and state the exact figures.'
optionA_en: To speak in a round-about, evasive manner without addressing the core point
optionB_en: To strike bushes with a stick
optionD_en: To trim hedges in a garden
explanation_en: 'Beat around the bush' means to delay or avoid talking about the most crucial issue directly (evasive prevarication).
examTag: IBPS PO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: मुहावरे 'SPILL THE BEANS' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: To reveal confidential information prematurely (भेद खोल देना / भंडाफोड़ करना)
explanation_hi: 'Spill the beans' का अर्थ होता है किसी गुप्त रहस्य या योजना को समय से पहले उजागर कर देना।
question_en: Choose the meaning of the idiom 'SPILL THE BEANS':
optionA_en: To drop groceries on the floor
optionD_en: To reveal confidential or secret information prematurely or unintentionally
explanation_en: 'Spill the beans' means to disclose a secret, surprise, or classified information before the appropriate time.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: 'A WILD GOOSE CHASE' का क्या अभिप्राय है?
optionA_hi: A futile, hopeless pursuit that yields no result (निरर्थक एवं व्यर्थ प्रयास)
explanation_hi: 'Wild goose chase' का अर्थ होता है एक निष्फल खोज या व्यर्थ की भागदौड़ जिसका कोई परिणाम न निकले।
question_en: What is the meaning of 'A WILD GOOSE CHASE' in competitive English?
optionA_en: A futile, hopeless pursuit or foolish search that yields no result
explanation_en: 'Wild goose chase' denotes a completely fruitless, time-wasting search or enterprise that is bound to fail.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: राजनीति या खेल जगत में 'DARK HORSE' किसे कहा जाता है?
optionD_hi: An unexpected contender who achieves victory (छुपा रुस्तम / अप्रत्याशित विजेता)
explanation_hi: 'Dark horse' का अर्थ 'छुपा रुस्तम' होता है यानी वह व्यक्ति जिसके जीतने की किसी को उम्मीद न थी किंतु वह विजयी बन गया।
question_en: In political and competitive parlance, what is a 'DARK HORSE'?
optionD_en: An unexpected contender who achieves unforeseen victory
explanation_en: 'Dark horse' refers to a candidate or competitor about whom little is known, who unexpectedly wins or triumphs (Hindi: 'छुपा रुस्तम').
examTag: NDA English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: 'A BLESSING IN DISGUISE' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionA_hi: An apparent misfortune that results in a good outcome (विपत्ति के वेश में वरदान / अंततः लाभदायक साबित होना)
explanation_hi: 'Blessing in disguise' का अर्थ है शुरुआत में बुरा लगने वाला किंतु अंततः अत्यंत लाभकारी सिद्ध होने वाला घटनाक्रम।
question_en: Identify the meaning of 'A BLESSING IN DISGUISE':
optionA_en: An apparent misfortune that eventually results in an unexpected good outcome
optionB_en: A religious boon in a dream
explanation_en: 'Blessing in disguise' is an apparent misfortune or mishap that ultimately yields positive or beneficial consequences.
examTag: State PCS General English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: मुहावरे 'ONCE IN A BLUE MOON' (ईद का चांद) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionC_hi: Very rarely / अत्यंत दुर्लभ रूप से (कभी-कभार / ईद का चांद)
explanation_hi: 'Once in a blue moon' का अर्थ होता है अत्यंत दुर्लभ रूप से कभी-कभार होने वाली घटना (ईद का चांद होना)।
question_en: What does the celestial idiom 'ONCE IN A BLUE MOON' mean?
explanation_en: Astronomy-based idiom: A 'blue moon' (second full moon in a single calendar month) happens only once every 2.7 years. Hence, 'once in a blue moon' means very rarely.
examTag: Bank SO English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: सही शब्द भरें: 'The prolonged drought will adversely _____ crop yield, and the economic _____ will be catastrophic.'
optionB_hi: affect, effect (क्रिया हेतु Affect, संज्ञा/परिणाम हेतु Effect)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Affect' मुख्य रूप से क्रिया (Verb - प्रभावित करना) है; जबकि 'Effect' संज्ञा (Noun - प्रभाव या परिणाम) है।
question_en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words: 'The prolonged drought will adversely _____ crop yield, and the economic _____ will be catastrophic.'
explanation_en: Grammar rule: 'AFFECT' is usually a VERB meaning to influence or act upon ('will affect yield'). 'EFFECT' is usually a NOUN meaning a result or outcome ('the economic effect').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: सही शब्द युग्म चुनें: 'The ambassador paid her a gracious _____ on her diplomacy, noting that her skillset served as a perfect _____ to the panel.'
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Compliment' (i वाला) = प्रशंसा या तारीफ; 'Complement' (e वाला) = किसी का पूरक होना या पूर्णता प्रदान करना।
question_en: Select the correct pair: 'The ambassador paid her a gracious _____ on her diplomacy, noting that her skillset served as a perfect _____ to the panel.'
explanation_en: 'COMPLIMENT' (with 'i') means praise or polite admiration. 'COMPLEMENT' (with 'e') means something that completes, enhances, or pairs perfectly with something else.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'The college _____ is a man of unshakeable moral _____.'
optionD_hi: principal, principles (प्राचार्य हेतु Principal, सिद्धांत हेतु Principle)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Principal' = प्रधानाचार्य या मुख्य राशि (मूलधन); 'Principle' = नैतिक नियम या दार्शनिक सिद्धांत।
question_en: Fill in the blank: 'The college _____ is a man of unshakeable moral _____.'
explanation_en: 'PRINCIPAL' (ending in -pal) refers to the head of an educational institution or a primary capital sum. 'PRINCIPLE' (ending in -ple) means a fundamental moral truth, rule, or doctrine.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'The train remained _____ at the signal while the clerk replenished office _____.'
optionC_hi: stationary, stationery (स्थिर stationary, लेखन सामग्री stationery)
explanation_hi: याद रखने की ट्रिक: 'Stationary' (a वाला) = अचल/स्थिर; 'Stationery' (e वाला - Envelope/Eraser) = कॉपी-कलम लेखन सामग्री।
question_en: Choose the correct words: 'The train remained _____ at the signal while the clerk replenished office _____.'
explanation_en: Mnemonic: 'STATIONARY' (with 'a') means unmoving/fixed in position. 'STATIONERY' (with 'e' for envelope/eraser) refers to writing materials (pens, paper, notebooks).
examTag: SSC CPO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'The _____ astrophysicist warned that a severe solar geomagnetic storm was _____.'
optionD_hi: eminent, imminent (प्रतिष्ठित eminent, सिर पर मंडराता/आसन्न imminent)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Eminent' = प्रसिद्ध या प्रख्यात वैज्ञानिक; 'Imminent' = जो संकट या घटना तुरंत घटित होने वाली हो (आसन्न)।
question_en: Fill in the blank: 'The _____ astrophysicist warned that a severe solar geomagnetic storm was _____.'
explanation_en: 'EMINENT' means famous, distinguished, and respected. 'IMMINENT' means impending or about to happen very soon (especially of danger or storm).
examTag: IBPS PO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Trekking through the arid Thar _____ left them longing for a cold sweet _____.'
optionD_hi: desert, dessert (रेगिस्तान desert, भोजनोपरांत मिष्ठान्न dessert)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Desert' (सिंगल s) = मरुस्थल या छोड़ देना; 'Dessert' (डबल s) = भोजन के अंत में परोसी जाने वाली मिठाई/आइसक्रीम।
question_en: Select the correct pair: 'Trekking through the arid Thar _____ left them longing for a cold sweet _____.'
explanation_en: Mnemonic: 'DESERT' (single 's') = barren sandy wilderness or to abandon. 'DESSERT' (double 's' for sweet stuff) = the sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: सही शब्द भरें: 'The municipal _____ sought legal _____ from a senior supreme court advocate.'
optionA_hi: council, counsel (परिषद council, कानूनी सलाह counsel)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Council' = समिति या प्रशासनिक परिषद; 'Counsel' = कानूनी परामर्श या अधिवक्ता (वकील)।
question_en: Fill in the blank: 'The municipal _____ sought legal _____ from a senior supreme court advocate.'
explanation_en: 'COUNCIL' is an administrative or legislative advisory body/assembly. 'COUNSEL' means legal advice, guidance, or a practicing trial lawyer.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'If you wear _____ garments during training, you might _____ your balance on the beam.'
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Loose' (डबल o) = ढीला ढाला; 'Lose' (सिंगल o) = खो देना या पराजित हो जाना।
question_en: Select the correct pair: 'If you wear _____ garments during training, you might _____ your balance on the beam.'
explanation_en: 'LOOSE' (rhymes with goose) is an adjective meaning not tight or unbound. 'LOSE' (rhymes with choose) is a verb meaning to be deprived of or to fail to win.
examTag: NDA English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: उचित शब्द भरें: 'My mentor gave me valuable _____ and continues to _____ me on career choices.'
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Advice' (c वाला) = सलाह (संज्ञा/Noun); 'Advise' (s वाला) = सलाह देना (क्रिया/Verb)।
question_en: Choose the correct parts of speech: 'My mentor gave me valuable _____ and continues to _____ me on career choices.'
explanation_en: Noun vs Verb pair: 'ADVICE' (with 'c') is an uncountable noun. 'ADVISE' (with 's') is the corresponding verb meaning to recommend a course of action.
examTag: State PCS General English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: लैटिन विधिक पद 'AD HOC' (तदर्थ) का सही अर्थ क्या है?
optionA_hi: Created for a specific purpose only / तदर्थ (अस्थायी रूप से किसी विशेष कार्य हेतु)
explanation_hi: 'Ad hoc' का अर्थ होता है 'तदर्थ' यानी किसी विशेष उद्देश्य के लिए अस्थायी तौर पर गठित समिति या पद।
question_en: What is the meaning of the Latin legal phrase 'AD HOC'?
optionA_en: Created or done for a particular, specific purpose only (temporary)
explanation_en: 'Ad hoc' literally translates to 'for this' in Latin. It denotes a committee, post, or solution created for a specific immediate situation only, not permanent.
examTag: Bank SO English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विधिक शब्दावली 'BONA FIDE' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionC_hi: Genuine / in good faith (सच्चा, वास्तविक एवं नेकनीयत)
explanation_hi: 'Bona fide' का अर्थ वास्तविक, प्रामाणिक या नेकनीयती (सच्चा) होता है।
question_en: Identify the meaning of the Latin term 'BONA FIDE':
optionC_en: Genuine, real, or in good faith without fraud
explanation_en: 'Bona fide' means genuine, real, or undertaken in good faith without intention to deceive ('bona fide student / resident'). Opposite: 'mala fide' (bad faith).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: राजनयिक अभिव्यक्ति 'STATUS QUO' (यथास्थिति) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionA_hi: The existing state of affairs (यथास्थिति / वर्तमान स्थिति को ज्यों का त्यों बनाए रखना)
explanation_hi: 'Status quo' का अर्थ 'यथास्थिति' होता है यानी वर्तमान स्थिति में बिना कोई बदलाव किए उसे वैसा ही बनाए रखना।
question_en: What does the diplomatic phrase 'STATUS QUO' signify?
optionA_en: The existing state of affairs or present condition
explanation_en: 'Status quo' refers to the existing current state of affairs, particularly regarding social, political, or border matters ('maintain the status quo').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: 'TURN A DEAF EAR' (अनसुनी कर देना) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionB_hi: To deliberately disregard or refuse to listen (जानबूझकर अनसुना कर देना / ध्यान न देना)
explanation_hi: 'Turn a deaf ear' का अर्थ होता है किसी की शिकायत या प्रार्थना पर बिल्कुल ध्यान न देना और उसे अनसुना कर देना।
question_en: Select the meaning of 'TURN A DEAF EAR': 'The administration turned a deaf ear to the workers' grievances.'
optionB_en: To deliberately disregard or refuse to listen to advice or complaints
explanation_en: 'Turn a deaf ear' means to refuse to listen to or ignore pleas, advice, or protests intentionally.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: मुहावरे 'A PIECE OF CAKE' (बाएं हाथ का खेल) का अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: Something exceptionally easy to accomplish (अत्यंत आसान काम / बाएं हाथ का खेल)
explanation_hi: 'A piece of cake' का अर्थ बहुत सरल या सहजता से हो जाने वाला कार्य (बाएं हाथ का खेल) होता है।
question_en: What does the colloquial idiom 'A PIECE OF CAKE' denote?
optionD_en: Something that is exceptionally easy, simple, and effortless to accomplish
explanation_en: 'A piece of cake' means a task or challenge that is extremely easy, effortless, or simple (synonym: child's play).
examTag: SSC CPO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: 'THROUGH THICK AND THIN' (सुख-दुख में साथ निभाना) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionB_hi: Under all circumstances, both good and bad (हर परिस्थिति में सुख-दुख साथ निभाना)
explanation_hi: 'Through thick and thin' का अर्थ होता है हर सुख-दुख और अनुकूल-प्रतिकूल परिस्थितियों में निष्ठापूर्वक साथ रहना।
question_en: Identify the meaning of 'THROUGH THICK AND THIN': 'True lifelong friends stand by each other through thick and thin.'
optionB_en: Under all circumstances, through both good and bad times
explanation_en: 'Through thick and thin' means supporting someone steadfastly under all circumstances, through prosperity and adversity alike.
examTag: IBPS PO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: 'CALL IT A DAY' का क्या अर्थ है: 'We have resolved all critical bugs; let's call it a day'?
optionD_hi: To stop working on something for the day (आज का काम समाप्त करना / छुट्टी करना)
explanation_hi: 'Call it a day' का अर्थ होता है उस दिन के लिए काम बंद करना या छुट्टी करना।
question_en: Choose the meaning of 'CALL IT A DAY': 'We have resolved all critical bugs; let's call it a day.'
optionD_en: To stop working on something for the rest of the day
explanation_en: 'Call it a day' means to conclude one's work session or decide that enough progress has been made for that day.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: 'AT THE ELEVENTH HOUR' (अंतिम क्षण में) का सही अर्थ क्या है?
optionA_hi: At the very last moment (बिल्कुल अंतिम क्षण में / ऐन मौके पर)
explanation_hi: 'At the eleventh hour' का अर्थ होता है ठीक अंतिम क्षण में जब समय समाप्त होने ही वाला हो।
question_en: Select the meaning of 'AT THE ELEVENTH HOUR': 'The government reached an accord with trade unions at the eleventh hour.'
optionA_en: At the very last moment before deadline or disaster
explanation_en: 'At the eleventh hour' means at the latest possible time before it is too late to act or prevent a catastrophe.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विधि में 'DE FACTO' और 'DE JURE' के मध्य क्या अंतर है?
optionC_hi: De facto = वास्तविक रूप से मौजूद (तथ्यतः), जबकि De jure = कानूनी अधिकार से (विधितः)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'De facto' का अर्थ वास्तव में (In reality) होता है, जबकि 'De jure' का अर्थ कानूनन (By law) होता है।
question_en: What is the distinction between 'DE FACTO' and 'DE JURE' in jurisprudence?
optionA_en: De facto is legal, De jure is illegal
optionC_en: De facto means existing in actual reality/fact, while De jure means established by legal right/law
optionD_en: De facto applies to criminals only
explanation_en: 'De facto' (Latin) denotes a state of affairs that exists in actual reality, whether legally sanctioned or not. 'De jure' denotes rightful state of affairs according to the law.
examTag: NDA English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: राजनय में जब किसी विदेशी राजदूत को अस्वीकार्य घोषित कर देश छोड़ने को कहा जाता है, तो उसे क्या कहते हैं?
optionC_hi: Persona non grata (अवांछित व्यक्ति / अस्वीकार्य राजनयिक)
explanation_hi: 'Persona non grata' का अर्थ होता है 'अवांछित व्यक्ति' जिसे मेजबान देश से निष्कासित किया जाता है।
question_en: In diplomatic conventions, an ambassador or foreign envoy who is declared unacceptable to the host nation is termed:
explanation_en: 'Persona non grata' is a Latin term used in diplomacy for an official who is banned or unacceptable to a host country.
examTag: State PCS General English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: 'QUID PRO QUO' (एक के बदले दूसरा / प्रतिदान) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionD_hi: A favour granted in return for something equal (पारस्परिक लाभ / एक के बदले दूसरा)
explanation_hi: 'Quid pro quo' का अर्थ होता है 'कुछ के बदले कुछ' यानी पारस्परिक लेनदेन या प्रतिफल।
question_en: What does the contractual phrase 'QUID PRO QUO' signify?
optionD_en: A favour or advantage granted in return for something equal
explanation_en: 'Quid pro quo' translates to 'something for something'—a mutual exchange of goods, services, or reciprocal advantages.
examTag: Bank SO English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] मुहावरे 'BITE THE BULLET' का सही अर्थ क्या है?
optionB_hi: To face a grim, inevitable situation with courage (अप्रिय किंतु आवश्यक काम को साहसपूर्वक झेलना)
explanation_hi: 'Bite the bullet' का अर्थ होता है किसी कठिन या अप्रिय परिस्थिति का साहसपूर्वक और चुपचाप सामना करना।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] What is the authentic meaning of the idiom 'BITE THE BULLET'?
optionB_en: To face a grim, inevitable situation with courage and fortitude
explanation_en: 'Bite the bullet' means to force oneself to undergo a painful or difficult situation that cannot be avoided (derived from battlefield surgery without anesthesia).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] 'BURN THE MIDNIGHT OIL' का सही अर्थ पहचानें: 'Aspirants often burn the midnight oil...'
optionC_hi: To study or work intensely late into the night (देर रात तक कड़ी मेहनत/पढ़ाई करना)
explanation_hi: 'Burn the midnight oil' का अर्थ होता है परीक्षा या काम के लिए देर रात तक जागकर कठोर परिश्रम करना।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Choose the correct meaning of 'BURN THE MIDNIGHT OIL': 'Aspirants often burn the midnight oil before competitive exams.'
optionC_en: To study or work intensely late into the night
explanation_en: 'Burn the midnight oil' means to work or study late into the night, historically referencing an oil lamp.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] कहावत 'CAST PEARLS BEFORE SWINE' (भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना) का अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: To offer valuable things to people who cannot appreciate them (अपात्र या कद्र न जानने वाले के सामने उत्तम वस्तु प्रस्तुत करना)
explanation_hi: 'Cast pearls before swine' का हिंदी समतुल्य 'भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना' है अर्थात् किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति को बहुमूल्य ज्ञान या वस्तु देना जो उसकी कद्र न समझे।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] What does 'CAST PEARLS BEFORE SWINE' mean?
optionD_en: To offer valuable or cultured things to people who cannot appreciate their worth
explanation_en: Biblical idiom meaning to offer valuable advice, gifts, or art to people who lack the refinement or capacity to appreciate them (Hindi equivalent: 'अंधे के आगे रोवे, अपना दीदा खोवे' / 'भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना').
examTag: SSC CPO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] 'CRY OVER SPILT MILK' (अब पछताए होत क्या जब चिड़िया चुग गई खेत) का अर्थ क्या है?
optionC_hi: To waste time grieving over past losses that cannot be rectified (बीती ताहि बिसारि दे / जो बीत गया उस पर व्यर्थ पछताना)
explanation_hi: 'Cry over spilt milk' का अर्थ है किसी ऐसी बीती हुई हानि पर आंसू बहाना जिसे अब सुधारा नहीं जा सकता।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Identify the meaning of 'CRY OVER SPILT MILK':
optionB_en: To clean up a kitchen accident
optionC_en: To waste time grieving over past losses or misfortunes that cannot be rectified
explanation_en: 'Cry over spilt milk' means to express futile sorrow over an irreversible mistake or past misfortune ('अब पछताए होत क्या जब चिड़िया चुग गई खेत').
examTag: IBPS PO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] 'BEAT AROUND THE BUSH' का अर्थ क्या है: 'Please stop beating around the bush...'
optionB_hi: To speak in a round-about, evasive manner (घुमा-फिराकर बात करना / मुख्य मुद्दे पर न आना)
explanation_hi: 'Beat around the bush' का अर्थ होता है मुख्य मुद्दे की बात टालते हुए इधर-उधर की बातें बनाना।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Select the meaning of 'BEAT AROUND THE BUSH': 'Please stop beating around the bush and state the exact figures.'
optionB_en: To speak in a round-about, evasive manner without addressing the core point
optionC_en: To trim hedges in a garden
optionD_en: To strike bushes with a stick
explanation_en: 'Beat around the bush' means to delay or avoid talking about the most crucial issue directly (evasive prevarication).
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] मुहावरे 'SPILL THE BEANS' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionC_hi: To reveal confidential information prematurely (भेद खोल देना / भंडाफोड़ करना)
explanation_hi: 'Spill the beans' का अर्थ होता है किसी गुप्त रहस्य या योजना को समय से पहले उजागर कर देना।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Choose the meaning of the idiom 'SPILL THE BEANS':
optionC_en: To reveal confidential or secret information prematurely or unintentionally
optionD_en: To drop groceries on the floor
explanation_en: 'Spill the beans' means to disclose a secret, surprise, or classified information before the appropriate time.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] 'A WILD GOOSE CHASE' का क्या अभिप्राय है?
optionD_hi: A futile, hopeless pursuit that yields no result (निरर्थक एवं व्यर्थ प्रयास)
explanation_hi: 'Wild goose chase' का अर्थ होता है एक निष्फल खोज या व्यर्थ की भागदौड़ जिसका कोई परिणाम न निकले।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] What is the meaning of 'A WILD GOOSE CHASE' in competitive English?
optionD_en: A futile, hopeless pursuit or foolish search that yields no result
explanation_en: 'Wild goose chase' denotes a completely fruitless, time-wasting search or enterprise that is bound to fail.
examTag: NDA English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] राजनीति या खेल जगत में 'DARK HORSE' किसे कहा जाता है?
optionA_hi: An unexpected contender who achieves victory (छुपा रुस्तम / अप्रत्याशित विजेता)
explanation_hi: 'Dark horse' का अर्थ 'छुपा रुस्तम' होता है यानी वह व्यक्ति जिसके जीतने की किसी को उम्मीद न थी किंतु वह विजयी बन गया।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] In political and competitive parlance, what is a 'DARK HORSE'?
optionA_en: An unexpected contender who achieves unforeseen victory
explanation_en: 'Dark horse' refers to a candidate or competitor about whom little is known, who unexpectedly wins or triumphs (Hindi: 'छुपा रुस्तम').
examTag: State PCS General English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] 'A BLESSING IN DISGUISE' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: An apparent misfortune that results in a good outcome (विपत्ति के वेश में वरदान / अंततः लाभदायक साबित होना)
explanation_hi: 'Blessing in disguise' का अर्थ है शुरुआत में बुरा लगने वाला किंतु अंततः अत्यंत लाभकारी सिद्ध होने वाला घटनाक्रम।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Identify the meaning of 'A BLESSING IN DISGUISE':
optionA_en: A religious boon in a dream
optionD_en: An apparent misfortune that eventually results in an unexpected good outcome
explanation_en: 'Blessing in disguise' is an apparent misfortune or mishap that ultimately yields positive or beneficial consequences.
examTag: Bank SO English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] मुहावरे 'ONCE IN A BLUE MOON' (ईद का चांद) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionA_hi: Very rarely / अत्यंत दुर्लभ रूप से (कभी-कभार / ईद का चांद)
explanation_hi: 'Once in a blue moon' का अर्थ होता है अत्यंत दुर्लभ रूप से कभी-कभार होने वाली घटना (ईद का चांद होना)।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] What does the celestial idiom 'ONCE IN A BLUE MOON' mean?
explanation_en: Astronomy-based idiom: A 'blue moon' (second full moon in a single calendar month) happens only once every 2.7 years. Hence, 'once in a blue moon' means very rarely.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] सही शब्द भरें: 'The prolonged drought will adversely _____ crop yield, and the economic _____ will be catastrophic.'
optionB_hi: affect, effect (क्रिया हेतु Affect, संज्ञा/परिणाम हेतु Effect)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Affect' मुख्य रूप से क्रिया (Verb - प्रभावित करना) है; जबकि 'Effect' संज्ञा (Noun - प्रभाव या परिणाम) है।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Fill in the blanks with the correct words: 'The prolonged drought will adversely _____ crop yield, and the economic _____ will be catastrophic.'
explanation_en: Grammar rule: 'AFFECT' is usually a VERB meaning to influence or act upon ('will affect yield'). 'EFFECT' is usually a NOUN meaning a result or outcome ('the economic effect').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] सही शब्द युग्म चुनें: 'The ambassador paid her a gracious _____ on her diplomacy, noting that her skillset served as a perfect _____ to the panel.'
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Compliment' (i वाला) = प्रशंसा या तारीफ; 'Complement' (e वाला) = किसी का पूरक होना या पूर्णता प्रदान करना।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Select the correct pair: 'The ambassador paid her a gracious _____ on her diplomacy, noting that her skillset served as a perfect _____ to the panel.'
explanation_en: 'COMPLIMENT' (with 'i') means praise or polite admiration. 'COMPLEMENT' (with 'e') means something that completes, enhances, or pairs perfectly with something else.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'The college _____ is a man of unshakeable moral _____.'
optionD_hi: principal, principles (प्राचार्य हेतु Principal, सिद्धांत हेतु Principle)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Principal' = प्रधानाचार्य या मुख्य राशि (मूलधन); 'Principle' = नैतिक नियम या दार्शनिक सिद्धांत।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Fill in the blank: 'The college _____ is a man of unshakeable moral _____.'
explanation_en: 'PRINCIPAL' (ending in -pal) refers to the head of an educational institution or a primary capital sum. 'PRINCIPLE' (ending in -ple) means a fundamental moral truth, rule, or doctrine.
examTag: SSC CPO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'The train remained _____ at the signal while the clerk replenished office _____.'
optionA_hi: stationary, stationery (स्थिर stationary, लेखन सामग्री stationery)
explanation_hi: याद रखने की ट्रिक: 'Stationary' (a वाला) = अचल/स्थिर; 'Stationery' (e वाला - Envelope/Eraser) = कॉपी-कलम लेखन सामग्री।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Choose the correct words: 'The train remained _____ at the signal while the clerk replenished office _____.'
explanation_en: Mnemonic: 'STATIONARY' (with 'a') means unmoving/fixed in position. 'STATIONERY' (with 'e' for envelope/eraser) refers to writing materials (pens, paper, notebooks).
examTag: IBPS PO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'The _____ astrophysicist warned that a severe solar geomagnetic storm was _____.'
optionA_hi: eminent, imminent (प्रतिष्ठित eminent, सिर पर मंडराता/आसन्न imminent)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Eminent' = प्रसिद्ध या प्रख्यात वैज्ञानिक; 'Imminent' = जो संकट या घटना तुरंत घटित होने वाली हो (आसन्न)।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Fill in the blank: 'The _____ astrophysicist warned that a severe solar geomagnetic storm was _____.'
explanation_en: 'EMINENT' means famous, distinguished, and respected. 'IMMINENT' means impending or about to happen very soon (especially of danger or storm).
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Trekking through the arid Thar _____ left them longing for a cold sweet _____.'
optionB_hi: desert, dessert (रेगिस्तान desert, भोजनोपरांत मिष्ठान्न dessert)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Desert' (सिंगल s) = मरुस्थल या छोड़ देना; 'Dessert' (डबल s) = भोजन के अंत में परोसी जाने वाली मिठाई/आइसक्रीम।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Select the correct pair: 'Trekking through the arid Thar _____ left them longing for a cold sweet _____.'
explanation_en: Mnemonic: 'DESERT' (single 's') = barren sandy wilderness or to abandon. 'DESSERT' (double 's' for sweet stuff) = the sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] सही शब्द भरें: 'The municipal _____ sought legal _____ from a senior supreme court advocate.'
optionD_hi: council, counsel (परिषद council, कानूनी सलाह counsel)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Council' = समिति या प्रशासनिक परिषद; 'Counsel' = कानूनी परामर्श या अधिवक्ता (वकील)।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Fill in the blank: 'The municipal _____ sought legal _____ from a senior supreme court advocate.'
explanation_en: 'COUNCIL' is an administrative or legislative advisory body/assembly. 'COUNSEL' means legal advice, guidance, or a practicing trial lawyer.
examTag: NDA English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'If you wear _____ garments during training, you might _____ your balance on the beam.'
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Loose' (डबल o) = ढीला ढाला; 'Lose' (सिंगल o) = खो देना या पराजित हो जाना।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Select the correct pair: 'If you wear _____ garments during training, you might _____ your balance on the beam.'
explanation_en: 'LOOSE' (rhymes with goose) is an adjective meaning not tight or unbound. 'LOSE' (rhymes with choose) is a verb meaning to be deprived of or to fail to win.
examTag: State PCS General English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] उचित शब्द भरें: 'My mentor gave me valuable _____ and continues to _____ me on career choices.'
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Advice' (c वाला) = सलाह (संज्ञा/Noun); 'Advise' (s वाला) = सलाह देना (क्रिया/Verb)।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Choose the correct parts of speech: 'My mentor gave me valuable _____ and continues to _____ me on career choices.'
explanation_en: Noun vs Verb pair: 'ADVICE' (with 'c') is an uncountable noun. 'ADVISE' (with 's') is the corresponding verb meaning to recommend a course of action.
examTag: Bank SO English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] लैटिन विधिक पद 'AD HOC' (तदर्थ) का सही अर्थ क्या है?
optionA_hi: Created for a specific purpose only / तदर्थ (अस्थायी रूप से किसी विशेष कार्य हेतु)
explanation_hi: 'Ad hoc' का अर्थ होता है 'तदर्थ' यानी किसी विशेष उद्देश्य के लिए अस्थायी तौर पर गठित समिति या पद।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] What is the meaning of the Latin legal phrase 'AD HOC'?
optionA_en: Created or done for a particular, specific purpose only (temporary)
explanation_en: 'Ad hoc' literally translates to 'for this' in Latin. It denotes a committee, post, or solution created for a specific immediate situation only, not permanent.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] विधिक शब्दावली 'BONA FIDE' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionC_hi: Genuine / in good faith (सच्चा, वास्तविक एवं नेकनीयत)
explanation_hi: 'Bona fide' का अर्थ वास्तविक, प्रामाणिक या नेकनीयती (सच्चा) होता है।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Identify the meaning of the Latin term 'BONA FIDE':
optionC_en: Genuine, real, or in good faith without fraud
explanation_en: 'Bona fide' means genuine, real, or undertaken in good faith without intention to deceive ('bona fide student / resident'). Opposite: 'mala fide' (bad faith).
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] राजनयिक अभिव्यक्ति 'STATUS QUO' (यथास्थिति) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionD_hi: The existing state of affairs (यथास्थिति / वर्तमान स्थिति को ज्यों का त्यों बनाए रखना)
explanation_hi: 'Status quo' का अर्थ 'यथास्थिति' होता है यानी वर्तमान स्थिति में बिना कोई बदलाव किए उसे वैसा ही बनाए रखना।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] What does the diplomatic phrase 'STATUS QUO' signify?
optionD_en: The existing state of affairs or present condition
explanation_en: 'Status quo' refers to the existing current state of affairs, particularly regarding social, political, or border matters ('maintain the status quo').
examTag: SSC CHSL - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] 'TURN A DEAF EAR' (अनसुनी कर देना) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionC_hi: To deliberately disregard or refuse to listen (जानबूझकर अनसुना कर देना / ध्यान न देना)
explanation_hi: 'Turn a deaf ear' का अर्थ होता है किसी की शिकायत या प्रार्थना पर बिल्कुल ध्यान न देना और उसे अनसुना कर देना।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Select the meaning of 'TURN A DEAF EAR': 'The administration turned a deaf ear to the workers' grievances.'
optionC_en: To deliberately disregard or refuse to listen to advice or complaints
explanation_en: 'Turn a deaf ear' means to refuse to listen to or ignore pleas, advice, or protests intentionally.
examTag: SSC CPO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] मुहावरे 'A PIECE OF CAKE' (बाएं हाथ का खेल) का अर्थ क्या है?
optionA_hi: Something exceptionally easy to accomplish (अत्यंत आसान काम / बाएं हाथ का खेल)
explanation_hi: 'A piece of cake' का अर्थ बहुत सरल या सहजता से हो जाने वाला कार्य (बाएं हाथ का खेल) होता है।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] What does the colloquial idiom 'A PIECE OF CAKE' denote?
optionA_en: Something that is exceptionally easy, simple, and effortless to accomplish
explanation_en: 'A piece of cake' means a task or challenge that is extremely easy, effortless, or simple (synonym: child's play).
examTag: IBPS PO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] 'THROUGH THICK AND THIN' (सुख-दुख में साथ निभाना) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionA_hi: Under all circumstances, both good and bad (हर परिस्थिति में सुख-दुख साथ निभाना)
explanation_hi: 'Through thick and thin' का अर्थ होता है हर सुख-दुख और अनुकूल-प्रतिकूल परिस्थितियों में निष्ठापूर्वक साथ रहना।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Identify the meaning of 'THROUGH THICK AND THIN': 'True lifelong friends stand by each other through thick and thin.'
optionA_en: Under all circumstances, through both good and bad times
explanation_en: 'Through thick and thin' means supporting someone steadfastly under all circumstances, through prosperity and adversity alike.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] 'CALL IT A DAY' का क्या अर्थ है: 'We have resolved all critical bugs; let's call it a day'?
optionB_hi: To stop working on something for the day (आज का काम समाप्त करना / छुट्टी करना)
explanation_hi: 'Call it a day' का अर्थ होता है उस दिन के लिए काम बंद करना या छुट्टी करना।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Choose the meaning of 'CALL IT A DAY': 'We have resolved all critical bugs; let's call it a day.'
optionB_en: To stop working on something for the rest of the day
explanation_en: 'Call it a day' means to conclude one's work session or decide that enough progress has been made for that day.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] 'AT THE ELEVENTH HOUR' (अंतिम क्षण में) का सही अर्थ क्या है?
optionA_hi: At the very last moment (बिल्कुल अंतिम क्षण में / ऐन मौके पर)
explanation_hi: 'At the eleventh hour' का अर्थ होता है ठीक अंतिम क्षण में जब समय समाप्त होने ही वाला हो।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] Select the meaning of 'AT THE ELEVENTH HOUR': 'The government reached an accord with trade unions at the eleventh hour.'
optionA_en: At the very last moment before deadline or disaster
explanation_en: 'At the eleventh hour' means at the latest possible time before it is too late to act or prevent a catastrophe.
examTag: NDA English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] विधि में 'DE FACTO' और 'DE JURE' के मध्य क्या अंतर है?
optionC_hi: De facto = वास्तविक रूप से मौजूद (तथ्यतः), जबकि De jure = कानूनी अधिकार से (विधितः)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'De facto' का अर्थ वास्तव में (In reality) होता है, जबकि 'De jure' का अर्थ कानूनन (By law) होता है।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] What is the distinction between 'DE FACTO' and 'DE JURE' in jurisprudence?
optionB_en: De facto applies to criminals only
optionC_en: De facto means existing in actual reality/fact, while De jure means established by legal right/law
optionD_en: De facto is legal, De jure is illegal
explanation_en: 'De facto' (Latin) denotes a state of affairs that exists in actual reality, whether legally sanctioned or not. 'De jure' denotes rightful state of affairs according to the law.
examTag: State PCS General English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] राजनय में जब किसी विदेशी राजदूत को अस्वीकार्य घोषित कर देश छोड़ने को कहा जाता है, तो उसे क्या कहते हैं?
optionD_hi: Persona non grata (अवांछित व्यक्ति / अस्वीकार्य राजनयिक)
explanation_hi: 'Persona non grata' का अर्थ होता है 'अवांछित व्यक्ति' जिसे मेजबान देश से निष्कासित किया जाता है।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] In diplomatic conventions, an ambassador or foreign envoy who is declared unacceptable to the host nation is termed:
explanation_en: 'Persona non grata' is a Latin term used in diplomacy for an official who is banned or unacceptable to a host country.
examTag: Bank SO English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [मुहावरे एवं लोकोक्तियां विशेषांक] 'QUID PRO QUO' (एक के बदले दूसरा / प्रतिदान) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionA_hi: A favour granted in return for something equal (पारस्परिक लाभ / एक के बदले दूसरा)
explanation_hi: 'Quid pro quo' का अर्थ होता है 'कुछ के बदले कुछ' यानी पारस्परिक लेनदेन या प्रतिफल।
question_en: [Idioms & Phrases Special - Figurative Meanings] What does the contractual phrase 'QUID PRO QUO' signify?
optionA_en: A favour or advantage granted in return for something equal
explanation_en: 'Quid pro quo' translates to 'something for something'—a mutual exchange of goods, services, or reciprocal advantages.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: मुहावरे 'BITE THE BULLET' का सही अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: To face a grim, inevitable situation with courage (अप्रिय किंतु आवश्यक काम को साहसपूर्वक झेलना)
explanation_hi: 'Bite the bullet' का अर्थ होता है किसी कठिन या अप्रिय परिस्थिति का साहसपूर्वक और चुपचाप सामना करना।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: What is the authentic meaning of the idiom 'BITE THE BULLET'?
optionD_en: To face a grim, inevitable situation with courage and fortitude
explanation_en: 'Bite the bullet' means to force oneself to undergo a painful or difficult situation that cannot be avoided (derived from battlefield surgery without anesthesia).
examTag: SSC CHSL - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: 'BURN THE MIDNIGHT OIL' का सही अर्थ पहचानें: 'Aspirants often burn the midnight oil...'
optionC_hi: To study or work intensely late into the night (देर रात तक कड़ी मेहनत/पढ़ाई करना)
explanation_hi: 'Burn the midnight oil' का अर्थ होता है परीक्षा या काम के लिए देर रात तक जागकर कठोर परिश्रम करना।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Choose the correct meaning of 'BURN THE MIDNIGHT OIL': 'Aspirants often burn the midnight oil before competitive exams.'
optionC_en: To study or work intensely late into the night
explanation_en: 'Burn the midnight oil' means to work or study late into the night, historically referencing an oil lamp.
examTag: SSC CPO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: कहावत 'CAST PEARLS BEFORE SWINE' (भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना) का अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: To offer valuable things to people who cannot appreciate them (अपात्र या कद्र न जानने वाले के सामने उत्तम वस्तु प्रस्तुत करना)
explanation_hi: 'Cast pearls before swine' का हिंदी समतुल्य 'भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना' है अर्थात् किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति को बहुमूल्य ज्ञान या वस्तु देना जो उसकी कद्र न समझे।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: What does 'CAST PEARLS BEFORE SWINE' mean?
optionD_en: To offer valuable or cultured things to people who cannot appreciate their worth
explanation_en: Biblical idiom meaning to offer valuable advice, gifts, or art to people who lack the refinement or capacity to appreciate them (Hindi equivalent: 'अंधे के आगे रोवे, अपना दीदा खोवे' / 'भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना').
examTag: IBPS PO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: 'CRY OVER SPILT MILK' (अब पछताए होत क्या जब चिड़िया चुग गई खेत) का अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: To waste time grieving over past losses that cannot be rectified (बीती ताहि बिसारि दे / जो बीत गया उस पर व्यर्थ पछताना)
explanation_hi: 'Cry over spilt milk' का अर्थ है किसी ऐसी बीती हुई हानि पर आंसू बहाना जिसे अब सुधारा नहीं जा सकता।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Identify the meaning of 'CRY OVER SPILT MILK':
optionB_en: To clean up a kitchen accident
optionD_en: To waste time grieving over past losses or misfortunes that cannot be rectified
explanation_en: 'Cry over spilt milk' means to express futile sorrow over an irreversible mistake or past misfortune ('अब पछताए होत क्या जब चिड़िया चुग गई खेत').
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: 'BEAT AROUND THE BUSH' का अर्थ क्या है: 'Please stop beating around the bush...'
optionD_hi: To speak in a round-about, evasive manner (घुमा-फिराकर बात करना / मुख्य मुद्दे पर न आना)
explanation_hi: 'Beat around the bush' का अर्थ होता है मुख्य मुद्दे की बात टालते हुए इधर-उधर की बातें बनाना।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Select the meaning of 'BEAT AROUND THE BUSH': 'Please stop beating around the bush and state the exact figures.'
optionA_en: To trim hedges in a garden
optionB_en: To strike bushes with a stick
optionD_en: To speak in a round-about, evasive manner without addressing the core point
explanation_en: 'Beat around the bush' means to delay or avoid talking about the most crucial issue directly (evasive prevarication).
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: मुहावरे 'SPILL THE BEANS' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionB_hi: To reveal confidential information prematurely (भेद खोल देना / भंडाफोड़ करना)
explanation_hi: 'Spill the beans' का अर्थ होता है किसी गुप्त रहस्य या योजना को समय से पहले उजागर कर देना।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Choose the meaning of the idiom 'SPILL THE BEANS':
optionA_en: To drop groceries on the floor
optionB_en: To reveal confidential or secret information prematurely or unintentionally
explanation_en: 'Spill the beans' means to disclose a secret, surprise, or classified information before the appropriate time.
examTag: NDA English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: 'A WILD GOOSE CHASE' का क्या अभिप्राय है?
optionC_hi: A futile, hopeless pursuit that yields no result (निरर्थक एवं व्यर्थ प्रयास)
explanation_hi: 'Wild goose chase' का अर्थ होता है एक निष्फल खोज या व्यर्थ की भागदौड़ जिसका कोई परिणाम न निकले।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: What is the meaning of 'A WILD GOOSE CHASE' in competitive English?
optionC_en: A futile, hopeless pursuit or foolish search that yields no result
explanation_en: 'Wild goose chase' denotes a completely fruitless, time-wasting search or enterprise that is bound to fail.
examTag: State PCS General English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: राजनीति या खेल जगत में 'DARK HORSE' किसे कहा जाता है?
optionA_hi: An unexpected contender who achieves victory (छुपा रुस्तम / अप्रत्याशित विजेता)
explanation_hi: 'Dark horse' का अर्थ 'छुपा रुस्तम' होता है यानी वह व्यक्ति जिसके जीतने की किसी को उम्मीद न थी किंतु वह विजयी बन गया।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: In political and competitive parlance, what is a 'DARK HORSE'?
optionA_en: An unexpected contender who achieves unforeseen victory
explanation_en: 'Dark horse' refers to a candidate or competitor about whom little is known, who unexpectedly wins or triumphs (Hindi: 'छुपा रुस्तम').
examTag: Bank SO English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: 'A BLESSING IN DISGUISE' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: An apparent misfortune that results in a good outcome (विपत्ति के वेश में वरदान / अंततः लाभदायक साबित होना)
explanation_hi: 'Blessing in disguise' का अर्थ है शुरुआत में बुरा लगने वाला किंतु अंततः अत्यंत लाभकारी सिद्ध होने वाला घटनाक्रम।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Identify the meaning of 'A BLESSING IN DISGUISE':
optionA_en: A religious boon in a dream
optionD_en: An apparent misfortune that eventually results in an unexpected good outcome
explanation_en: 'Blessing in disguise' is an apparent misfortune or mishap that ultimately yields positive or beneficial consequences.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: मुहावरे 'ONCE IN A BLUE MOON' (ईद का चांद) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionC_hi: Very rarely / अत्यंत दुर्लभ रूप से (कभी-कभार / ईद का चांद)
explanation_hi: 'Once in a blue moon' का अर्थ होता है अत्यंत दुर्लभ रूप से कभी-कभार होने वाली घटना (ईद का चांद होना)।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: What does the celestial idiom 'ONCE IN A BLUE MOON' mean?
explanation_en: Astronomy-based idiom: A 'blue moon' (second full moon in a single calendar month) happens only once every 2.7 years. Hence, 'once in a blue moon' means very rarely.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: सही शब्द भरें: 'The prolonged drought will adversely _____ crop yield, and the economic _____ will be catastrophic.'
optionA_hi: affect, effect (क्रिया हेतु Affect, संज्ञा/परिणाम हेतु Effect)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Affect' मुख्य रूप से क्रिया (Verb - प्रभावित करना) है; जबकि 'Effect' संज्ञा (Noun - प्रभाव या परिणाम) है।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Fill in the blanks with the correct words: 'The prolonged drought will adversely _____ crop yield, and the economic _____ will be catastrophic.'
explanation_en: Grammar rule: 'AFFECT' is usually a VERB meaning to influence or act upon ('will affect yield'). 'EFFECT' is usually a NOUN meaning a result or outcome ('the economic effect').
examTag: SSC CHSL - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: सही शब्द युग्म चुनें: 'The ambassador paid her a gracious _____ on her diplomacy, noting that her skillset served as a perfect _____ to the panel.'
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Compliment' (i वाला) = प्रशंसा या तारीफ; 'Complement' (e वाला) = किसी का पूरक होना या पूर्णता प्रदान करना।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Select the correct pair: 'The ambassador paid her a gracious _____ on her diplomacy, noting that her skillset served as a perfect _____ to the panel.'
explanation_en: 'COMPLIMENT' (with 'i') means praise or polite admiration. 'COMPLEMENT' (with 'e') means something that completes, enhances, or pairs perfectly with something else.
examTag: SSC CPO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'The college _____ is a man of unshakeable moral _____.'
optionC_hi: principal, principles (प्राचार्य हेतु Principal, सिद्धांत हेतु Principle)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Principal' = प्रधानाचार्य या मुख्य राशि (मूलधन); 'Principle' = नैतिक नियम या दार्शनिक सिद्धांत।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Fill in the blank: 'The college _____ is a man of unshakeable moral _____.'
explanation_en: 'PRINCIPAL' (ending in -pal) refers to the head of an educational institution or a primary capital sum. 'PRINCIPLE' (ending in -ple) means a fundamental moral truth, rule, or doctrine.
examTag: IBPS PO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'The train remained _____ at the signal while the clerk replenished office _____.'
optionA_hi: stationary, stationery (स्थिर stationary, लेखन सामग्री stationery)
explanation_hi: याद रखने की ट्रिक: 'Stationary' (a वाला) = अचल/स्थिर; 'Stationery' (e वाला - Envelope/Eraser) = कॉपी-कलम लेखन सामग्री।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Choose the correct words: 'The train remained _____ at the signal while the clerk replenished office _____.'
explanation_en: Mnemonic: 'STATIONARY' (with 'a') means unmoving/fixed in position. 'STATIONERY' (with 'e' for envelope/eraser) refers to writing materials (pens, paper, notebooks).
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'The _____ astrophysicist warned that a severe solar geomagnetic storm was _____.'
optionD_hi: eminent, imminent (प्रतिष्ठित eminent, सिर पर मंडराता/आसन्न imminent)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Eminent' = प्रसिद्ध या प्रख्यात वैज्ञानिक; 'Imminent' = जो संकट या घटना तुरंत घटित होने वाली हो (आसन्न)।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Fill in the blank: 'The _____ astrophysicist warned that a severe solar geomagnetic storm was _____.'
explanation_en: 'EMINENT' means famous, distinguished, and respected. 'IMMINENT' means impending or about to happen very soon (especially of danger or storm).
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Trekking through the arid Thar _____ left them longing for a cold sweet _____.'
optionD_hi: desert, dessert (रेगिस्तान desert, भोजनोपरांत मिष्ठान्न dessert)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Desert' (सिंगल s) = मरुस्थल या छोड़ देना; 'Dessert' (डबल s) = भोजन के अंत में परोसी जाने वाली मिठाई/आइसक्रीम।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Select the correct pair: 'Trekking through the arid Thar _____ left them longing for a cold sweet _____.'
explanation_en: Mnemonic: 'DESERT' (single 's') = barren sandy wilderness or to abandon. 'DESSERT' (double 's' for sweet stuff) = the sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.
examTag: NDA English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: सही शब्द भरें: 'The municipal _____ sought legal _____ from a senior supreme court advocate.'
optionB_hi: council, counsel (परिषद council, कानूनी सलाह counsel)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Council' = समिति या प्रशासनिक परिषद; 'Counsel' = कानूनी परामर्श या अधिवक्ता (वकील)।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Fill in the blank: 'The municipal _____ sought legal _____ from a senior supreme court advocate.'
explanation_en: 'COUNCIL' is an administrative or legislative advisory body/assembly. 'COUNSEL' means legal advice, guidance, or a practicing trial lawyer.
examTag: State PCS General English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'If you wear _____ garments during training, you might _____ your balance on the beam.'
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Loose' (डबल o) = ढीला ढाला; 'Lose' (सिंगल o) = खो देना या पराजित हो जाना।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Select the correct pair: 'If you wear _____ garments during training, you might _____ your balance on the beam.'
explanation_en: 'LOOSE' (rhymes with goose) is an adjective meaning not tight or unbound. 'LOSE' (rhymes with choose) is a verb meaning to be deprived of or to fail to win.
examTag: Bank SO English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: उचित शब्द भरें: 'My mentor gave me valuable _____ and continues to _____ me on career choices.'
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Advice' (c वाला) = सलाह (संज्ञा/Noun); 'Advise' (s वाला) = सलाह देना (क्रिया/Verb)।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Choose the correct parts of speech: 'My mentor gave me valuable _____ and continues to _____ me on career choices.'
explanation_en: Noun vs Verb pair: 'ADVICE' (with 'c') is an uncountable noun. 'ADVISE' (with 's') is the corresponding verb meaning to recommend a course of action.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: लैटिन विधिक पद 'AD HOC' (तदर्थ) का सही अर्थ क्या है?
optionA_hi: Created for a specific purpose only / तदर्थ (अस्थायी रूप से किसी विशेष कार्य हेतु)
explanation_hi: 'Ad hoc' का अर्थ होता है 'तदर्थ' यानी किसी विशेष उद्देश्य के लिए अस्थायी तौर पर गठित समिति या पद।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: What is the meaning of the Latin legal phrase 'AD HOC'?
optionA_en: Created or done for a particular, specific purpose only (temporary)
explanation_en: 'Ad hoc' literally translates to 'for this' in Latin. It denotes a committee, post, or solution created for a specific immediate situation only, not permanent.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: विधिक शब्दावली 'BONA FIDE' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: Genuine / in good faith (सच्चा, वास्तविक एवं नेकनीयत)
explanation_hi: 'Bona fide' का अर्थ वास्तविक, प्रामाणिक या नेकनीयती (सच्चा) होता है।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Identify the meaning of the Latin term 'BONA FIDE':
optionD_en: Genuine, real, or in good faith without fraud
explanation_en: 'Bona fide' means genuine, real, or undertaken in good faith without intention to deceive ('bona fide student / resident'). Opposite: 'mala fide' (bad faith).
examTag: SSC CHSL - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: राजनयिक अभिव्यक्ति 'STATUS QUO' (यथास्थिति) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionD_hi: The existing state of affairs (यथास्थिति / वर्तमान स्थिति को ज्यों का त्यों बनाए रखना)
explanation_hi: 'Status quo' का अर्थ 'यथास्थिति' होता है यानी वर्तमान स्थिति में बिना कोई बदलाव किए उसे वैसा ही बनाए रखना।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: What does the diplomatic phrase 'STATUS QUO' signify?
optionD_en: The existing state of affairs or present condition
explanation_en: 'Status quo' refers to the existing current state of affairs, particularly regarding social, political, or border matters ('maintain the status quo').
examTag: SSC CPO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: 'TURN A DEAF EAR' (अनसुनी कर देना) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionA_hi: To deliberately disregard or refuse to listen (जानबूझकर अनसुना कर देना / ध्यान न देना)
explanation_hi: 'Turn a deaf ear' का अर्थ होता है किसी की शिकायत या प्रार्थना पर बिल्कुल ध्यान न देना और उसे अनसुना कर देना।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Select the meaning of 'TURN A DEAF EAR': 'The administration turned a deaf ear to the workers' grievances.'
optionA_en: To deliberately disregard or refuse to listen to advice or complaints
explanation_en: 'Turn a deaf ear' means to refuse to listen to or ignore pleas, advice, or protests intentionally.
examTag: IBPS PO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: मुहावरे 'A PIECE OF CAKE' (बाएं हाथ का खेल) का अर्थ क्या है?
optionB_hi: Something exceptionally easy to accomplish (अत्यंत आसान काम / बाएं हाथ का खेल)
explanation_hi: 'A piece of cake' का अर्थ बहुत सरल या सहजता से हो जाने वाला कार्य (बाएं हाथ का खेल) होता है।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: What does the colloquial idiom 'A PIECE OF CAKE' denote?
optionB_en: Something that is exceptionally easy, simple, and effortless to accomplish
explanation_en: 'A piece of cake' means a task or challenge that is extremely easy, effortless, or simple (synonym: child's play).
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: 'THROUGH THICK AND THIN' (सुख-दुख में साथ निभाना) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionD_hi: Under all circumstances, both good and bad (हर परिस्थिति में सुख-दुख साथ निभाना)
explanation_hi: 'Through thick and thin' का अर्थ होता है हर सुख-दुख और अनुकूल-प्रतिकूल परिस्थितियों में निष्ठापूर्वक साथ रहना।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Identify the meaning of 'THROUGH THICK AND THIN': 'True lifelong friends stand by each other through thick and thin.'
optionD_en: Under all circumstances, through both good and bad times
explanation_en: 'Through thick and thin' means supporting someone steadfastly under all circumstances, through prosperity and adversity alike.
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: 'CALL IT A DAY' का क्या अर्थ है: 'We have resolved all critical bugs; let's call it a day'?
optionC_hi: To stop working on something for the day (आज का काम समाप्त करना / छुट्टी करना)
explanation_hi: 'Call it a day' का अर्थ होता है उस दिन के लिए काम बंद करना या छुट्टी करना।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Choose the meaning of 'CALL IT A DAY': 'We have resolved all critical bugs; let's call it a day.'
optionC_en: To stop working on something for the rest of the day
explanation_en: 'Call it a day' means to conclude one's work session or decide that enough progress has been made for that day.
examTag: NDA English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: 'AT THE ELEVENTH HOUR' (अंतिम क्षण में) का सही अर्थ क्या है?
optionC_hi: At the very last moment (बिल्कुल अंतिम क्षण में / ऐन मौके पर)
explanation_hi: 'At the eleventh hour' का अर्थ होता है ठीक अंतिम क्षण में जब समय समाप्त होने ही वाला हो।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: Select the meaning of 'AT THE ELEVENTH HOUR': 'The government reached an accord with trade unions at the eleventh hour.'
optionC_en: At the very last moment before deadline or disaster
explanation_en: 'At the eleventh hour' means at the latest possible time before it is too late to act or prevent a catastrophe.
examTag: State PCS General English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: विधि में 'DE FACTO' और 'DE JURE' के मध्य क्या अंतर है?
optionD_hi: De facto = वास्तविक रूप से मौजूद (तथ्यतः), जबकि De jure = कानूनी अधिकार से (विधितः)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'De facto' का अर्थ वास्तव में (In reality) होता है, जबकि 'De jure' का अर्थ कानूनन (By law) होता है।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: What is the distinction between 'DE FACTO' and 'DE JURE' in jurisprudence?
optionB_en: De facto applies to criminals only
optionC_en: De facto is legal, De jure is illegal
optionD_en: De facto means existing in actual reality/fact, while De jure means established by legal right/law
explanation_en: 'De facto' (Latin) denotes a state of affairs that exists in actual reality, whether legally sanctioned or not. 'De jure' denotes rightful state of affairs according to the law.
examTag: Bank SO English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: राजनय में जब किसी विदेशी राजदूत को अस्वीकार्य घोषित कर देश छोड़ने को कहा जाता है, तो उसे क्या कहते हैं?
optionA_hi: Persona non grata (अवांछित व्यक्ति / अस्वीकार्य राजनयिक)
explanation_hi: 'Persona non grata' का अर्थ होता है 'अवांछित व्यक्ति' जिसे मेजबान देश से निष्कासित किया जाता है।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: In diplomatic conventions, an ambassador or foreign envoy who is declared unacceptable to the host nation is termed:
explanation_en: 'Persona non grata' is a Latin term used in diplomacy for an official who is banned or unacceptable to a host country.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: विगत वर्षों के समरूपी भ्रमित करने वाले शब्द: 'QUID PRO QUO' (एक के बदले दूसरा / प्रतिदान) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionB_hi: A favour granted in return for something equal (पारस्परिक लाभ / एक के बदले दूसरा)
explanation_hi: 'Quid pro quo' का अर्थ होता है 'कुछ के बदले कुछ' यानी पारस्परिक लेनदेन या प्रतिफल।
question_en: Past Year Confusing Words & Homophones: What does the contractual phrase 'QUID PRO QUO' signify?
optionB_en: A favour or advantage granted in return for something equal
explanation_en: 'Quid pro quo' translates to 'something for something'—a mutual exchange of goods, services, or reciprocal advantages.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] मुहावरे 'BITE THE BULLET' का सही अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: To face a grim, inevitable situation with courage (अप्रिय किंतु आवश्यक काम को साहसपूर्वक झेलना)
explanation_hi: 'Bite the bullet' का अर्थ होता है किसी कठिन या अप्रिय परिस्थिति का साहसपूर्वक और चुपचाप सामना करना।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] What is the authentic meaning of the idiom 'BITE THE BULLET'?
optionD_en: To face a grim, inevitable situation with courage and fortitude
explanation_en: 'Bite the bullet' means to force oneself to undergo a painful or difficult situation that cannot be avoided (derived from battlefield surgery without anesthesia).
examTag: SSC CPO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] 'BURN THE MIDNIGHT OIL' का सही अर्थ पहचानें: 'Aspirants often burn the midnight oil...'
optionD_hi: To study or work intensely late into the night (देर रात तक कड़ी मेहनत/पढ़ाई करना)
explanation_hi: 'Burn the midnight oil' का अर्थ होता है परीक्षा या काम के लिए देर रात तक जागकर कठोर परिश्रम करना।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Choose the correct meaning of 'BURN THE MIDNIGHT OIL': 'Aspirants often burn the midnight oil before competitive exams.'
optionD_en: To study or work intensely late into the night
explanation_en: 'Burn the midnight oil' means to work or study late into the night, historically referencing an oil lamp.
examTag: IBPS PO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] कहावत 'CAST PEARLS BEFORE SWINE' (भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना) का अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: To offer valuable things to people who cannot appreciate them (अपात्र या कद्र न जानने वाले के सामने उत्तम वस्तु प्रस्तुत करना)
explanation_hi: 'Cast pearls before swine' का हिंदी समतुल्य 'भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना' है अर्थात् किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति को बहुमूल्य ज्ञान या वस्तु देना जो उसकी कद्र न समझे।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] What does 'CAST PEARLS BEFORE SWINE' mean?
optionD_en: To offer valuable or cultured things to people who cannot appreciate their worth
explanation_en: Biblical idiom meaning to offer valuable advice, gifts, or art to people who lack the refinement or capacity to appreciate them (Hindi equivalent: 'अंधे के आगे रोवे, अपना दीदा खोवे' / 'भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना').
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] 'CRY OVER SPILT MILK' (अब पछताए होत क्या जब चिड़िया चुग गई खेत) का अर्थ क्या है?
optionA_hi: To waste time grieving over past losses that cannot be rectified (बीती ताहि बिसारि दे / जो बीत गया उस पर व्यर्थ पछताना)
explanation_hi: 'Cry over spilt milk' का अर्थ है किसी ऐसी बीती हुई हानि पर आंसू बहाना जिसे अब सुधारा नहीं जा सकता।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Identify the meaning of 'CRY OVER SPILT MILK':
optionA_en: To waste time grieving over past losses or misfortunes that cannot be rectified
optionD_en: To clean up a kitchen accident
explanation_en: 'Cry over spilt milk' means to express futile sorrow over an irreversible mistake or past misfortune ('अब पछताए होत क्या जब चिड़िया चुग गई खेत').
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] 'BEAT AROUND THE BUSH' का अर्थ क्या है: 'Please stop beating around the bush...'
optionD_hi: To speak in a round-about, evasive manner (घुमा-फिराकर बात करना / मुख्य मुद्दे पर न आना)
explanation_hi: 'Beat around the bush' का अर्थ होता है मुख्य मुद्दे की बात टालते हुए इधर-उधर की बातें बनाना।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Select the meaning of 'BEAT AROUND THE BUSH': 'Please stop beating around the bush and state the exact figures.'
optionB_en: To strike bushes with a stick
optionC_en: To trim hedges in a garden
optionD_en: To speak in a round-about, evasive manner without addressing the core point
explanation_en: 'Beat around the bush' means to delay or avoid talking about the most crucial issue directly (evasive prevarication).
examTag: NDA English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] मुहावरे 'SPILL THE BEANS' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionB_hi: To reveal confidential information prematurely (भेद खोल देना / भंडाफोड़ करना)
explanation_hi: 'Spill the beans' का अर्थ होता है किसी गुप्त रहस्य या योजना को समय से पहले उजागर कर देना।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Choose the meaning of the idiom 'SPILL THE BEANS':
optionB_en: To reveal confidential or secret information prematurely or unintentionally
optionD_en: To drop groceries on the floor
explanation_en: 'Spill the beans' means to disclose a secret, surprise, or classified information before the appropriate time.
examTag: State PCS General English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] 'A WILD GOOSE CHASE' का क्या अभिप्राय है?
optionC_hi: A futile, hopeless pursuit that yields no result (निरर्थक एवं व्यर्थ प्रयास)
explanation_hi: 'Wild goose chase' का अर्थ होता है एक निष्फल खोज या व्यर्थ की भागदौड़ जिसका कोई परिणाम न निकले।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] What is the meaning of 'A WILD GOOSE CHASE' in competitive English?
optionC_en: A futile, hopeless pursuit or foolish search that yields no result
explanation_en: 'Wild goose chase' denotes a completely fruitless, time-wasting search or enterprise that is bound to fail.
examTag: Bank SO English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] राजनीति या खेल जगत में 'DARK HORSE' किसे कहा जाता है?
optionD_hi: An unexpected contender who achieves victory (छुपा रुस्तम / अप्रत्याशित विजेता)
explanation_hi: 'Dark horse' का अर्थ 'छुपा रुस्तम' होता है यानी वह व्यक्ति जिसके जीतने की किसी को उम्मीद न थी किंतु वह विजयी बन गया।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] In political and competitive parlance, what is a 'DARK HORSE'?
optionD_en: An unexpected contender who achieves unforeseen victory
explanation_en: 'Dark horse' refers to a candidate or competitor about whom little is known, who unexpectedly wins or triumphs (Hindi: 'छुपा रुस्तम').
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] 'A BLESSING IN DISGUISE' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionA_hi: An apparent misfortune that results in a good outcome (विपत्ति के वेश में वरदान / अंततः लाभदायक साबित होना)
explanation_hi: 'Blessing in disguise' का अर्थ है शुरुआत में बुरा लगने वाला किंतु अंततः अत्यंत लाभकारी सिद्ध होने वाला घटनाक्रम।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Identify the meaning of 'A BLESSING IN DISGUISE':
optionA_en: An apparent misfortune that eventually results in an unexpected good outcome
optionB_en: A religious boon in a dream
explanation_en: 'Blessing in disguise' is an apparent misfortune or mishap that ultimately yields positive or beneficial consequences.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] मुहावरे 'ONCE IN A BLUE MOON' (ईद का चांद) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionA_hi: Very rarely / अत्यंत दुर्लभ रूप से (कभी-कभार / ईद का चांद)
explanation_hi: 'Once in a blue moon' का अर्थ होता है अत्यंत दुर्लभ रूप से कभी-कभार होने वाली घटना (ईद का चांद होना)।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] What does the celestial idiom 'ONCE IN A BLUE MOON' mean?
explanation_en: Astronomy-based idiom: A 'blue moon' (second full moon in a single calendar month) happens only once every 2.7 years. Hence, 'once in a blue moon' means very rarely.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] सही शब्द भरें: 'The prolonged drought will adversely _____ crop yield, and the economic _____ will be catastrophic.'
optionA_hi: affect, effect (क्रिया हेतु Affect, संज्ञा/परिणाम हेतु Effect)
explanation_hi: नियम: 'Affect' मुख्य रूप से क्रिया (Verb - प्रभावित करना) है; जबकि 'Effect' संज्ञा (Noun - प्रभाव या परिणाम) है।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Fill in the blanks with the correct words: 'The prolonged drought will adversely _____ crop yield, and the economic _____ will be catastrophic.'
explanation_en: Grammar rule: 'AFFECT' is usually a VERB meaning to influence or act upon ('will affect yield'). 'EFFECT' is usually a NOUN meaning a result or outcome ('the economic effect').
examTag: SSC CPO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] सही शब्द युग्म चुनें: 'The ambassador paid her a gracious _____ on her diplomacy, noting that her skillset served as a perfect _____ to the panel.'
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Compliment' (i वाला) = प्रशंसा या तारीफ; 'Complement' (e वाला) = किसी का पूरक होना या पूर्णता प्रदान करना।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Select the correct pair: 'The ambassador paid her a gracious _____ on her diplomacy, noting that her skillset served as a perfect _____ to the panel.'
explanation_en: 'COMPLIMENT' (with 'i') means praise or polite admiration. 'COMPLEMENT' (with 'e') means something that completes, enhances, or pairs perfectly with something else.
examTag: IBPS PO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'The college _____ is a man of unshakeable moral _____.'
optionB_hi: principal, principles (प्राचार्य हेतु Principal, सिद्धांत हेतु Principle)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Principal' = प्रधानाचार्य या मुख्य राशि (मूलधन); 'Principle' = नैतिक नियम या दार्शनिक सिद्धांत।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Fill in the blank: 'The college _____ is a man of unshakeable moral _____.'
explanation_en: 'PRINCIPAL' (ending in -pal) refers to the head of an educational institution or a primary capital sum. 'PRINCIPLE' (ending in -ple) means a fundamental moral truth, rule, or doctrine.
examTag: IBPS Clerk - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'The train remained _____ at the signal while the clerk replenished office _____.'
optionA_hi: stationary, stationery (स्थिर stationary, लेखन सामग्री stationery)
explanation_hi: याद रखने की ट्रिक: 'Stationary' (a वाला) = अचल/स्थिर; 'Stationery' (e वाला - Envelope/Eraser) = कॉपी-कलम लेखन सामग्री।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Choose the correct words: 'The train remained _____ at the signal while the clerk replenished office _____.'
explanation_en: Mnemonic: 'STATIONARY' (with 'a') means unmoving/fixed in position. 'STATIONERY' (with 'e' for envelope/eraser) refers to writing materials (pens, paper, notebooks).
examTag: CDS English PYQ - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'The _____ astrophysicist warned that a severe solar geomagnetic storm was _____.'
optionD_hi: eminent, imminent (प्रतिष्ठित eminent, सिर पर मंडराता/आसन्न imminent)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Eminent' = प्रसिद्ध या प्रख्यात वैज्ञानिक; 'Imminent' = जो संकट या घटना तुरंत घटित होने वाली हो (आसन्न)।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Fill in the blank: 'The _____ astrophysicist warned that a severe solar geomagnetic storm was _____.'
explanation_en: 'EMINENT' means famous, distinguished, and respected. 'IMMINENT' means impending or about to happen very soon (especially of danger or storm).
examTag: NDA English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] उचित शब्द युग्म भरें: 'Trekking through the arid Thar _____ left them longing for a cold sweet _____.'
optionB_hi: desert, dessert (रेगिस्तान desert, भोजनोपरांत मिष्ठान्न dessert)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Desert' (सिंगल s) = मरुस्थल या छोड़ देना; 'Dessert' (डबल s) = भोजन के अंत में परोसी जाने वाली मिठाई/आइसक्रीम।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Select the correct pair: 'Trekking through the arid Thar _____ left them longing for a cold sweet _____.'
explanation_en: Mnemonic: 'DESERT' (single 's') = barren sandy wilderness or to abandon. 'DESSERT' (double 's' for sweet stuff) = the sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.
examTag: State PCS General English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] सही शब्द भरें: 'The municipal _____ sought legal _____ from a senior supreme court advocate.'
optionC_hi: council, counsel (परिषद council, कानूनी सलाह counsel)
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Council' = समिति या प्रशासनिक परिषद; 'Counsel' = कानूनी परामर्श या अधिवक्ता (वकील)।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Fill in the blank: 'The municipal _____ sought legal _____ from a senior supreme court advocate.'
explanation_en: 'COUNCIL' is an administrative or legislative advisory body/assembly. 'COUNSEL' means legal advice, guidance, or a practicing trial lawyer.
examTag: Bank SO English - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] सही शब्द युग्म भरें: 'If you wear _____ garments during training, you might _____ your balance on the beam.'
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Loose' (डबल o) = ढीला ढाला; 'Lose' (सिंगल o) = खो देना या पराजित हो जाना।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Select the correct pair: 'If you wear _____ garments during training, you might _____ your balance on the beam.'
explanation_en: 'LOOSE' (rhymes with goose) is an adjective meaning not tight or unbound. 'LOSE' (rhymes with choose) is a verb meaning to be deprived of or to fail to win.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-1 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] उचित शब्द भरें: 'My mentor gave me valuable _____ and continues to _____ me on career choices.'
explanation_hi: अंतर: 'Advice' (c वाला) = सलाह (संज्ञा/Noun); 'Advise' (s वाला) = सलाह देना (क्रिया/Verb)।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Choose the correct parts of speech: 'My mentor gave me valuable _____ and continues to _____ me on career choices.'
explanation_en: Noun vs Verb pair: 'ADVICE' (with 'c') is an uncountable noun. 'ADVISE' (with 's') is the corresponding verb meaning to recommend a course of action.
examTag: SSC CGL Tier-2 - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] लैटिन विधिक पद 'AD HOC' (तदर्थ) का सही अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: Created for a specific purpose only / तदर्थ (अस्थायी रूप से किसी विशेष कार्य हेतु)
explanation_hi: 'Ad hoc' का अर्थ होता है 'तदर्थ' यानी किसी विशेष उद्देश्य के लिए अस्थायी तौर पर गठित समिति या पद।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] What is the meaning of the Latin legal phrase 'AD HOC'?
optionD_en: Created or done for a particular, specific purpose only (temporary)
explanation_en: 'Ad hoc' literally translates to 'for this' in Latin. It denotes a committee, post, or solution created for a specific immediate situation only, not permanent.
examTag: SSC CHSL - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] विधिक शब्दावली 'BONA FIDE' का अर्थ क्या है?
optionD_hi: Genuine / in good faith (सच्चा, वास्तविक एवं नेकनीयत)
explanation_hi: 'Bona fide' का अर्थ वास्तविक, प्रामाणिक या नेकनीयती (सच्चा) होता है।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] Identify the meaning of the Latin term 'BONA FIDE':
optionD_en: Genuine, real, or in good faith without fraud
explanation_en: 'Bona fide' means genuine, real, or undertaken in good faith without intention to deceive ('bona fide student / resident'). Opposite: 'mala fide' (bad faith).
examTag: SSC CPO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] राजनयिक अभिव्यक्ति 'STATUS QUO' (यथास्थिति) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionA_hi: The existing state of affairs (यथास्थिति / वर्तमान स्थिति को ज्यों का त्यों बनाए रखना)
explanation_hi: 'Status quo' का अर्थ 'यथास्थिति' होता है यानी वर्तमान स्थिति में बिना कोई बदलाव किए उसे वैसा ही बनाए रखना।
question_en: [Latin & Foreign Expressions in English Law & Diplomacy] What does the diplomatic phrase 'STATUS QUO' signify?
optionA_en: The existing state of affairs or present condition
explanation_en: 'Status quo' refers to the existing current state of affairs, particularly regarding social, political, or border matters ('maintain the status quo').
examTag: IBPS PO - Idioms, Phrases & Confusing Words

question_hi: [विदेशी एवं लैटिन शब्दावली विशेषांक] 'TURN A DEAF EAR' (अनसुनी कर देना) का क्या अर्थ है?
optionB_hi: To deliberately disregard or refuse to listen (जानबूझकर अनसुना कर देना / ध्यान न देना)
